jobs.title: SIEM Analyst
jobs.excerpt: To apply for this position, you must reside in the Americas, preferably South and Central America.
jobs.description:
To apply for this position, you must reside in the Americas, preferably South and Central America. Applications from other locations will be disqualified from this selection process.

We are..

a cutting-edge e-commerce company developing products for our own technological platform. Our creative, smart, and dedicated teams pool their knowledge and experience to find the best solutions to meet project needs, while maintaining sustainable and long-lasting results. How do we achieve this? By making sure that our teams thrive and develop professionally. Strong advocates of hiring top talent and letting them do what they do best, we strive to create a workplace that allows for an open, collaborative, and respectful culture.

What you will be doing

You will be responsible for collecting, normalizing, analyzing, and exploiting security logs from multiple sources across the organization, ensuring they are ingested into SIEM platforms and used to detect threats, anomalies, and security incidents. You will play a key role in threat detection, incident investigation, and forensic analysis by transforming raw logs into actionable insights through dashboards, alerts, and advanced log analysis.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain log collection pipelines from multiple sources, including security, infrastructure, cloud, and application systems.
  • Ensure logs are ingested, parsed, normalized, and retained correctly across SIEM platforms such as FortiAnalyzer, Splunk, CrowdStrike, and others.
  • Maintain data quality and consistency across all log sources.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and visualizations to provide visibility into security posture, threats, and operational metrics.
  • Create, tune, and maintain correlation rules and alerts based on:
    • Attack patterns
    • Indicators of compromise (IOCs)
    • Behavioral anomalies
  • Custom detection use cases defined by the Information Security Team
  • Continuously analyze logs to identify suspicious, anomalous, or out-of-the-ordinary behavior.
  • Proactively hunt for threats by performing advanced log searches and pattern analysis.
  • Support incident response and forensic investigations by:
    • Searching historical logs
    • Reconstructing attack timelines
    • Identifying entry points, lateral movement, and attacker activity
  • Collaborate with SOC Analysts, Dev Security, IAM, Threat Hunting, and other security roles during incident investigation and response.
  • Validate alerts and detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
  • Ensure all detections, investigations, and findings are properly documented and tracked via tickets (Jira).
  • Document new procedures or update existing ones for log management, detection, and investigation.
  • Ensure documentation is accurate, comprehensive, and delivered on time.
  • Create reports based on SIEM data for operational, technical, and management audiences.
  • Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay current with emerging threats, attack techniques, and detection strategies.
  • Share knowledge and expertise with the team to foster a culture of security awareness and continuous improvement.
  • Adhere to the organization's different policies.
  • Keep your work organized and traceable through tickets (Jira).

Knowledge and skills you need to have

  • Studies in computer science, telecommunications, cybersecurity, or other related academic fields.
  • At least 3 years of work experience in SIEM operations, log analysis, or security monitoring roles.
  • Hands-on experience collecting and managing logs from multiple sources (endpoints, network devices, servers, cloud services, applications, authentication systems, etc.).
  • At least 2 years of experience with Splunk is required (by operating and configuring rules and settings), and 2 years of experience working with CrowdStrike is required also.
  • Experience working with other SIEM and log platforms such as FortiAnalyzer, New Relic, ManageEngine AD Audit, Axonius, or similar.
  • Experience creating dashboards, visualizations, and reports based on log data.
  • Experience in defining and tuning alerts and correlation rules.
  • Knowledge of scripting or query languages used in SIEM platforms (e.g., SPL, KQL, SQL-like queries), YARA rules, Regular expressions (regex).
  • Familiarity with security tools generating logs, such as firewalls, EDR, IAM, cloud platforms, and application security tools.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns and anomalies in large datasets.
  • Experience supporting incident response and forensic investigations through log analysis.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of the Information Security Team under minimal supervision.
  • Eager to learn and continuously improve detection capabilities.
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills.

Technical skills:

o Solid foundations in networking, operating systems, authentication flows, and cybersecurity.

o Ability to understand how logs reflect system and user behavior across different platforms.

Additional requirements, not essential but "nice to have":

  • Any cybersecurity certification.
  • Experience with log normalization standards and detection methodologies.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and threat detection frameworks.
  • Experience with threat hunting activities.
  • Familiarity with forensic analysis concepts and incident response workflow

Why choose us?

We provide the opportunity to be the best version of yourself, develop professionally, and create strong working relationships, whether working remotely or on-site. While offering a competitive salary, we also invest in our people's professional development and want to see you grow and love what you do. We are dedicated to listening to our team's needs and are constantly working on creating an environment in which you can feel at home.

We offer a range of benefits to support your personal and professional development:

  • 22 days of annual leave.
  • 10 days of national holidays.
  • Health Insurance options.
  • Access to e-learning platforms.
  • Possibility of on-site English classes in some countries, and more.

Join our team and enjoy an environment that values and supports your well-being. If this sounds like the place for you, contact us now!

This is a remote position.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenenCyber Defence Analyst / SOC Analystfür ein sechsmonatiges Freelance-Projekt bei einem internationalen Enterprise-Consulting-Unternehmen in Deutschland. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf kontinuierlichem Security Monitoring, der Analyse und Bewertung von Sicherheitsvorfällen sowie der initialen Incident Response innerhalb einer komplexen Enterprise-SOC-Umgebung.

Das Projekt startet am1. Februar 2027und läuft zunächst bis zum31. Juli 2027, mit Option auf eine Verlängerung um weitere sechs Monate.Das Projekt wird überwiegend remote durchgeführt, mit gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Einsätzen in Deutschland. Ein Tagessatz ist auf Anfrage verfügbar.

Aufgaben

  • Kontinuierliches Monitoring von SIEM-, SOAR-, EDR- und Netzwerk-Sicherheitsdaten

  • Unterscheidung zwischen False Positives und tatsächlichen Sicherheitsvorfällen

  • Durchführung initialer Incident-Response- und Containment-Maßnahmen anhand bestehender Playbooks

  • Dokumentation von Sicherheitsvorfällen und Erstellung von Incident Reports

  • Sicherstellung strukturierter Eskalationsprozesse und Schichtübergaben

  • Unterstützung bei der Einhaltung definierter Security SLAs


Requirements

  • +3 Jahre Berufserfahrung als SOC Analyst, Cyber Defence Analyst oder Security Operations Analyst

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit SIEM-Lösungen wie Splunk oder Microsoft Sentinel

  • Erfahrung mit EDR-/XDR-Technologien wie Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, HarfangLab oder Palo Alto

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse von Netzwerkprotokollen, Windows, Linux und Active Directory

  • Erfahrung mit Security Incident Triage und grundlegender Netzwerk-Paketanalyse

  • Gute Kenntnisse des MITRE ATT&CK Frameworks

  • Einwandfreies Führungszeugnis sowie die Möglichkeit, erforderliche deutsche/europäische Sicherheitsüberprüfungen zu erhalten und aufrechtzuerhalten

Bevorzugte Anforderungen

  • Microsoft AZ-900 oder SC-200

  • Blue Team Level 1 oder Level 2

  • Palo Alto Networks XDR Analyst

  • GIAC-Zertifizierungen wie GCIH, GCIA oder GCFA

  • Erfahrung mit SOAR-Plattformen und automatisierten Incident-Response-Prozessen

  • Erfahrung mit Threat Hunting und Detection Engineering

  • Erfahrung in sicherheitskritischen oder stark regulierten Umgebungen


Benefits

Als Freelancer / Contractor bei uns profitierst du von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Freiheit, deine Projekte selbst auszuwählen. Über unsere Plattform erhältst du Zugang zu spannenden Projekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen und Unterstützung bei deiner beruflichen Weiterentwicklung. Du profitierst von einer attraktiven Vergütung und einem engagierten Team, das dir bei Fragen zur Seite steht. Jacuzzi Group is seeking a Business Development Manager to drive new dealer and sales development in focus markets for the North America Spa Division (Sundance Spas) across the United States and Canada. Reporting to the Director of Business Development and partnering closely with regional sales teams, this role identifies distribution opportunities, increases dealer coverage, and drives incremental sales in new or underserved markets, directly supporting the division's growth objectives.

This role can be performed remotely and requires travel up to 50% of the time seasonally.

You are a driven business developer who knows how to find, negotiate, and close new partnerships, and you understand what makes a retail dealer successful. You bring organizational discipline to your work, keeping your pipeline visible, forecasting accurately, and following through from first conversation to a successful dealer launch. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities with ease, and build strong, accountable relationships with sales leaders and cross-functional partners.

Market Development & Dealer Acquisition

Dealer Onboarding & Growth

  • Assist with dealer onboarding to help ensure a successful launch
  • Support early-stage dealer development to drive long-term dealer performance and growth

Required

Preferred

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Senior Product Manager, Clinical Content owns the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for one or more product areas within the Clinical Content portfolio. This individual applies strong product management fundamentals — discovery, prioritization, experimentation, and measurable KPIs — to define and execute a roadmap that maximizes customer value and business results. The Senior Product Manager partners closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to bring the roadmap to life, and serves as a subject-matter expert and mentor to other product managers, contributing to the company's broader effort to modernize and scale the product management function around strong technology product management craft. For this role, the portfolio is the company's ambulatory EHR and practice management platform, spanning the clinical documentation, ordering, e-prescribing, scheduling, patient access, and revenue cycle workflows that physician practices and ambulatory organizations depend on daily; the Senior Product Manager therefore pairs strong product craft with domain fluency in ambulatory care delivery and healthcare interoperability.
  • Own the product roadmap and backlog for one or more [Clinical Content product areas, from discovery through launch and post-launch iteration.
  • Contribute to and help execute the product-led growth (PLG) strategy for the product portfolio, identifying opportunities to expand adoption and usage through the product experience.
  • Partner closely with engineering, design, and data teams to define and execute the roadmap and backlog, applying strong product management fundamentals (discovery, prioritization, experimentation, and measurable KPIs) to deliver an exceptional end-to-end user experience.
  • Write clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and work with the VP/Director of Product Management and executive leadership to inform the broader strategic plan for business growth, including new product development and build-vs-buy-vs-partner input.
  • Maintain a deep, current understanding of prospects, customers, competitors, and partners (their strategic direction, pain points, desired integrations, and buying behavior) to inform product decisions, market positioning, and competitive differentiation.
  • Define and track the product metrics that define success for the product area (activation, adoption, expansion revenue, retention, churn, and customer/patient satisfaction) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate product releases to ensure alignment between product, support, and service operations, and partner with finance, sales, and product marketing on go-to-market messaging, pricing input, and business models that support both sales-assisted and product-led paths to revenue.
  • Support business and contractual discussions with partners specific to the market, as needed.
  • Ensure regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to the product line are identified, accurate, and delivered within deadlines, partnering with legal, compliance, and regulatory affairs as needed.
  • Establish and maintain a robust product lifecycle management framework, focused on modernizing aged products and building toward a scalable, extensible technology and platform architecture.
  • Contribute to forecasting and reporting on revenue, cost, and margin for the product area, and bring the discipline and rigor of sound business judgment to product decisions.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to Product Managers and Associate Product Managers on strong product management craft (discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, execution), helping them deliver high-quality products within aggressive timelines regardless of subject matter.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, biology, engineering, or a related field.
  • An MBA, MHA or other advanced business degree is a plus.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in technology/software product management, with a proven ability to own and deliver results for ambulatory EHR and practice management product areas.
  • Direct experience owning or contributing to ambulatory EHR and practice management products, with deep familiarity across the clinical and front/back-office workflows they support, including provider documentation, computerized order entry, e-prescribing (eRx/EPCS), clinical decision support, patient scheduling and registration, eligibility, and end-to-end revenue cycle management.
  • Healthcare/healthcare IT industry experience, ideally in an Ambulatory or Acute Healthcare environment, is preferred but secondary to demonstrated product management skill.
  • Ambulatory clinical and practice-management workflows, including provider documentation, computerized order entry, e-prescribing, clinical decision support, patient scheduling and access, eligibility, and end-to-end revenue cycle management (charge capture, coding, claims, and patient collections). Experience with ambulatory regulatory and quality programs, including ONC Health IT Certification (CEHRT), CMS incentive and quality programs (MIPS/MACRA and Promoting Interoperability), clinical quality measurement (eCQMs), information-blocking compliance, and value-based care and patient-engagement capabilities.
  • Experience contributing to the definition, launch, and scaling of AI/ML-powered product capabilities (for example, clinical decision support, predictive and risk analytics, ambient/automated documentation, and generative AI/LLM features), with attention to model performance, clinical validation, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with data science and engineering teams to operationalize AI/ML across the model lifecycle (data strategy, model development and evaluation, and production monitoring), including build-vs-buy decisions across foundation models, third-party vendors, and in-house capabilities.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

What You’ll Do

Europe is one of the world’s most important regions for climate policy, energy innovation, and emissions reduction. CATF has built a strong presence in Europe by advancing pragmatic climate solutions, including carbon management, clean hydrogen, nuclear energy, advanced geothermal, fusion energy, and methane mitigation.

The Senior Director, European Advocacy will set the strategic direction for CATF’s work across Europe leading regional growth and impact, overseeing the EU and Central and Eastern Europe advocacy teams, and shaping future opportunities for expansion across the region. This is a fully remote role that can be based anywhere in Europe, offering the opportunity to lead a geographically distributed team and influence climate policy across the continent.

  • Regional Strategic Leadership – Lead the development and execution of CATF’s pan-European policy advocacy strategy, aligning regional priorities with global goals and program objectives.
  • Enterprise Governance – Serve on our senior leadership team to align priorities, resources, and investments across the organization.
  • People Leadership & Team Development – Develop and empower a high-performing, geographically distributed team of 7 policy experts and consultants.
  • Fundraising & Partnership Development – Lead regional fundraising in partnership with the Development team, accountable for revenue growth, donor engagement and sustainable funding for European work.
  • Policy & Advocacy Leadership – Guide regional advocacy efforts that advance practical climate solutions across Europe’s complex political, economic, and energy landscape.
  • Thought Leadership & Communications Oversight – Elevate CATF’s external voice and manage risk by ensuring high-quality, consistent messaging—serving as the final reviewer for external-facing materials such as reports, policy briefs, white papers, and press releases.
  • External Engagement & Influence – Represent CATF with European institutions, national governments, funders, industry leaders, media, and other high-level stakeholders.
  • Operational & Resource Management – Steward regional resources, including team planning, budgets, consultant support, and priority-setting across European initiatives.

What You’ll Bring

You will succeed in this role if you are a strategic, collaborative leader who can bring structure to complexity, build trust across cultures and institutions, and turn ambitious climate goals into focused action. You should be comfortable leading through influence, making sound decisions in dynamic environments, and empowering others to do their best work.

Desired experience

  • Significant senior leadership experience, including at least 10 years of progressive experience in management, strategy, policy, and advocacy.
  • Deep understanding of European political dynamics and context as well an understanding of European energy and climate policy.
  • Experience working with European Union institutions and/or Member States.
  • Proven ability to shape and lead regional or multinational strategies in complex policy, nonprofit, advocacy, or technical environments.
  • Strong track record of engaging senior stakeholders, including government officials, industry leaders, funders, and multilateral organizations.
  • At least 6 years of experience directly leading, coaching, and developing high-performing teams across cultures, locations, or disciplines.
  • Experience managing significant budgets, resources, priorities, and organizational tradeoffs in a mission-driven environment.
  • Fluency in English and the ability to communicate clearly with internal and external audiences at senior levels.
  • A leadership style grounded in curiosity, collaboration, persistence, integrity, and commitment to measurable climate impact.

Preferred experience

  • Familiarity with CATF’s breadth of work in Europe at the EU level and in the CEE, across topics including methane, industries, carbon management, electricity, nuclear, fusion, geothermal, and transports.
  • Additional European language skills.
  • Background working in global, remote, or highly matrixed organizations.

What We Provide

  • A collaborative and intellectually curious culture where diverse perspectives are valued and bold, practical solutions to climate change are encouraged.
  • A flexible remote working environment within a global organization operating across North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and international forums.
  • An excellent benefits package that supports the health, wellbeing, and financial security of our employees.
  • Benefits aligned to your country of employment.

Ready to Apply?

If you’ve made it this far, you should go ahead and apply.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to be a strong candidate. If this role aligns with how you like to work and the kind of impact you want to have, we encourage you to submit your application.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Clean Air Task Force is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Frontend Software Engineer

Type: Remote Contract
Location: Brazil, Mexico, Chile or Colombia
Coverage: Pacific Time overlap required

Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced Frontend Software Engineer to build, maintain, and test features for a large-scale cloud management web console.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with strong React and TypeScript experience who is comfortable working in a mature, shared codebase and owning frontend features from requirements through implementation, testing, deployment, and verification.

A strong testing discipline is particularly important. Engineers are expected to write unit and integration tests alongside feature development rather than treating testing as a separate or optional activity.

You will work closely with engineering and product stakeholders in a distributed environment, integrate frontend experiences with production REST APIs, and build interfaces using established design systems and shared components.

Key Responsibilities:

Frontend Engineering:

  • Build, maintain, and improve production frontend features using React and TypeScript.

  • Develop complex forms, configuration workflows, dashboards, and other interactive application experiences.

  • Apply strong React fundamentals, including hooks, state management, component architecture, and reusable patterns.

  • Translate product and UI/UX requirements into reliable, maintainable production interfaces.

  • Work within an established design system and shared component ecosystem rather than relying primarily on custom styling.

  • Contribute to shared frontend components, libraries, tooling, and engineering patterns.

Testing and Software Quality:

  • Write unit and integration tests alongside all feature development.

  • Build testable frontend components and application logic.

  • Maintain and improve existing test suites as functionality evolves.

  • Diagnose and resolve regressions, edge cases, and production issues.

  • Participate in peer code reviews and incorporate engineering feedback.

  • Maintain high standards for code quality, reliability, readability, and maintainability.

APIs and Application Integration:

  • Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs in production environments.

  • Build user interfaces around complex API-backed workflows and configuration models.

  • Handle application state, validation, errors, loading states, and API responses reliably.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers when defining or troubleshooting frontend-to-service integrations.

  • Diagnose issues across the boundary between frontend applications and backend services.

Engineering Delivery:

  • Own features from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production verification.

  • Work effectively within large shared codebases with established engineering standards.

  • Use Git and pull-request workflows as part of day-to-day development.

  • Work within automated linting, testing, build, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Contribute to technical discussions and identify appropriate implementation approaches and trade-offs.

  • Use GenAI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining engineering quality and ownership of the resulting code.

Collaboration:

  • Work effectively with engineers, product stakeholders, and designers in a distributed environment.

  • Communicate implementation decisions, blockers, risks, and progress clearly.

  • Participate constructively in code reviews and technical discussions.

  • Work independently while coordinating effectively with the broader engineering team.

  • Document technical decisions and implementation details when appropriate.

Qualifications:

Education and Experience:

  • 5+ years of professional frontend software development experience.

  • Significant hands-on experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.

  • Demonstrated experience writing unit and integration tests as part of regular feature development.

  • Production experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs.

  • Experience contributing to large, shared production codebases.

  • Experience working with Git, pull requests, code reviews, and CI/CD workflows.

  • Experience using GenAI-assisted coding tools as part of the software development process.

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Technical Skills:

  • Strong production experience with React and TypeScript.

  • Strong understanding of React hooks, component architecture, state management, and complex forms.

  • Strong frontend testing experience, including unit and integration testing.

  • Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs in production applications.

  • Strong JavaScript and modern web development fundamentals.

  • Experience working with established frontend architecture and shared component libraries.

  • Strong Git and pull-request workflow experience.

  • Experience with automated linting, testing, build processes, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Ability to debug frontend application issues and identify problems across UI, state, API, and application layers.

  • Practical experience using GenAI-assisted development tools while independently validating and owning generated code.

Preferred:

  • Experience working with monorepos.

  • Experience building applications using established design systems or component libraries.

  • Experience with Node.js, Python, or broader full-stack development.

  • Experience developing GenAI-powered products or user experiences.

  • Experience with complex cloud portals, developer tools, administrative consoles, dashboards, or configuration-heavy applications.

  • Experience improving shared frontend tooling, architecture, or developer experience.

  • Experience working in large engineering organizations or mature software platforms.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong written and verbal communication.

  • High degree of ownership and ability to work independently.

  • Comfortable collaborating asynchronously across a distributed team.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Able to receive and provide constructive code-review feedback.

  • Comfortable working within an established engineering environment and adapting to existing standards and patterns.

  • Able to take a feature from an initial requirement through production delivery and verification.

Please Note:

  • This is a hands-on frontend engineering role. We are looking for candidates with substantial production React and TypeScript experience, not primarily UI/UX design or website-focused backgrounds.

  • Writing tests is an expected part of feature development. Candidates should have practical experience writing unit and integration tests for production frontend applications.

  • Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs and working with complex forms or configuration workflows is important for this role.

  • Candidates should be comfortable contributing to an existing large codebase with established linting, testing, code-review, and CI/CD practices.

  • Experience using GenAI-assisted coding tools is required, but candidates must be able to independently understand, validate, test, and maintain the code they deliver.

  • Experience with monorepos, design systems, Node.js/Python, or GenAI product development is preferred but not required.

  • This role is currently focused on candidates based in Brazil, Mexico, Chile or Colombia.

jobs.excerpt: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)Location: Remote.
jobs.description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)

Location: Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

Clients: Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

Reports to: VP of Solutions

Salary Range: $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

  1. Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
  2. Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
  3. Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities

Relationship ownership

  • Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
  • Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
  • Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

Strategy and consulting

  • Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
  • Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
  • Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

Delegation and project leadership

  • Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
  • Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
  • Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
  • Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

New business

  • Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
  • Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
  • Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
  • Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

Commercial

  • Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
  • Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
  • Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience

Required

  • Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
  • Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
  • 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
  • Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
  • Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
  • Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
  • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
  • Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
  • Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
  • Scope and price technical work profitably.
  • Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

Systems. Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

  • Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
  • Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
  • Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
  • Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
  • Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
  • CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
  • Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

Preferred

  • Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
  • Work across both European and North American clients.
  • Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this

  • You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
  • The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
  • We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
  • Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators

Month 2

  • Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
  • Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
  • Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

Month 4

  • Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
  • Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
  • Zero undocumented scope changes.
  • Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
  • Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

Month 6

  • 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
  • Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
  • Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
  • Writing and presenting proposals independently.

Month 9

  • 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
  • 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
  • Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
  • Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not

  • Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
  • Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
  • Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values

  • Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
  • Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
  • Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
  • Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
  • Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • Flexible hours
  • Work remotely
  • Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
  • Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
  • National holidays off.
  • Radically transparent workplace
  • Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

Month 1. Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

Months 2 and 3. Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

Months 4 to 6. Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

After 6 months. You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

What is hard. You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior AI Systems Engineer with deep C++expertiseto help build the next generation of AI-enabled product and platform capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of large-scale systems engineering, applied AI, andproductionsoftware architecture. You will design and build the native infrastructure, service integration layers, evaluation systems, and reliability mechanisms that allow AI-powered features tooperatesafely, predictably, and efficiently inside complex software products.

This is not a research-only role and not a prompt-engineering role. This is a hands-on principal engineering role for someone who can move between architecture, production code, AI system design, technical strategy, and cross-team leadership.

The ideal candidate is a strong C++ engineer first, with practical AI fluency: someone who understands how modern AI systems behave, where they fail, how to integrate them into production workflows, and how to design systems that make AI useful, reliable, observable, and secure.

WhatYou’llDo

AI-Native Systems Architecture

  • Design and build native C++ infrastructure that connects complex product codebases to AI-powered services, agents, and model-backed workflows.

  • Define clean execution interfaces, schemas, validation layers, and error-handling contracts for AI-driven actions.

  • Create reliable bridges between product capabilities, AI orchestration systems, and backend services.

  • Ensure AI-initiated actionsbehavesafely, predictably, and consistently within existing product workflows.

  • Guidelong-term architecture decisions through ADRs, design documents, technical reviews, and cross-functional alignment.

C++ Platform and Integration Engineering

  • Build high-quality C++ components for performance-sensitive, cross-platform environments.

  • Improvecodehealth through modernization, refactoring, better testing, and stronger engineering patterns.

  • Balance performance, memory safety, reliability, backward compatibility, and developer experience in a mature codebase.

Applied AI Reliability and Evaluation

  • Design systems that make AI features measurable,debuggable, andproduction-ready.

  • Build evaluation frameworks for AI workflows, including automated task execution, output validation, regression testing, scoring, and human review loops.

  • Define guardrails for AI-driven actions, including safety checks, capability boundaries, fallback paths, and failure handling.

  • Create privacy-conscious tracing, observability, and diagnostics for model-backed systems.

  • Partner with product, data science, security, legal, and AI governance teams to ensure AI capabilities meet quality, safety, and compliance expectations.

Technical Leadership

  • Set engineering direction in ambiguous and fast-moving technical areas.

  • Influence architecture across native clients, backend AI services, orchestration layers, and product experience teams.

  • Help teams adopt AI-assisted engineering workflows for code generation, debugging, testing, documentation, and review.

WhatYou’llBring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant depth in C++.

  • Strong experience building ormaintaininglarge, mature, performance-sensitive codebases.

  • Expertisein modern C++ design, memory management, concurrency, API design, debugging, and systems-level performance.

  • Experience building cross-platform software across Windows, macOS, Linux, or similar environments.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI, LLMs, agents, or model-backed systems into production or production-adjacent software.

  • Practical understanding of AI system failure modes, including hallucination, tool-calling errors, incomplete context, multi-turn drift, nondeterminism, and unreliable outputs.

  • Experience designing reliable interfaces between AI systems and deterministic software systems.

jobs.excerpt: This is a role for billing and revenue professionals who want to shape how AI gets used in the profession.
jobs.description:
This is a role for billing and revenue professionals who want to shape how AI gets used in the profession. You've built your foundation inside a law firm's work to cash cycle as a billing specialist, revenue analyst, or similar and you're drawn to the strategic and operational side of how firms run, not just the transactions you process. At Intapp, you'll use that combination to advise law firms on how to adopt and deploy AI, working directly with finance leadership and billing teams to identify where it creates the most value.


Day to day, you'll act as a trusted advisor to firm stakeholders CFOs, billing managers, and revenue operations leads helping them understand what Intapp Celeste's AI agents and workflows can do for their specific context, then seeing that through to adoption. You'll shape how AI gets embedded into the work to cash process mapping how time becomes a bill and a bill becomes cash, advising on where automation applies, and making sure deployments reflect how the firm actually works. Fluency with AI tools and a billing professional's instinct for accuracy and client sensitivity are what this role runs on.


What you will do

As an AI Firm Deployed Engineer, Billing & Revenue, you can expect to:

  • Advise law firm stakeholders from CFOs to billing managers on where AI creates strategic value, helping them prioritize the work to cash workflows and practice areas where Celeste can have the most impact.
  • Lead the deployment of Intapp Celeste's AI agents, coworkers, and playbooks, configuring them around the firm's billing guidelines, client terms, and revenue standards, so agents reason the way the firm's own billing and revenue teams do.
  • Translate work to cash workflows into AI-ready processes — mapping how time entry, prebill review, invoicing, collections, and revenue recognition move through a firm, identifying where judgment can be supported by automation, and advising on where human oversight remains essential.
  • Drive adoption across billing and finance teams by building credibility with practitioners on their terms, running walkthroughs and training that meet each group where they are rather than asking them to adapt to the technology.
  • Bring client experience back into Intapp's product strategy, working with Industry Architects and Product leaders to ensure Celeste continues to reflect how billing and revenue work gets done.

What you will need

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this AI Firm Deployed Engineer, Billing & Revenue role, you will ideally have:

  • A foundation in law firm billing or revenue operations as a billing specialist, revenue analyst, or similar with enough exposure to the work to cash cycle to understand how firms structure client terms, resolve billing exceptions, and where friction lives between time entry and collections.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to billing, revenue, or commercial workflows — using LLMs for prebill review, narrative drafting, exception handling, or process design and a clear-eyed view of where they add value and where they introduce risk.
  • Practical fluency in prompt engineering, AI workflow design, and agentic tooling — enough to configure and iterate on AI deployments without writing code, and enough to evaluate outputs with a billing professional's eye for accuracy and client impact.
  • The instinct and communication skills to advise senior stakeholders, translate complex ideas clearly, and build trust with audiences who are skeptical of technology but open to the right conversation.
  • A record of building something a knowledge resource, a process of improvement, a training program, or a tool that shows you can turn expertise into something others rely on.
  • The judgment to work in ambiguous, client-facing situations and the drive to keep learning a product and a market that move quickly.

What you will gain

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You’ll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that’s connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We’ll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.


Here, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.
  • Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.
  • Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

jobs.description:
Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

Why join Coupa?

  • Pioneering Technology: At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
  • Collaborative Culture: We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
  • Global Impact: Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.
Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

The Impact of a Benefits Analyst at Coupa:

The Benefits Analyst provides operational support across Coupa's employee benefits programs in North America and Latin America. This role is responsible for the accurate and timely administration of health and welfare plans, retirement programs, leave of absence processes, and vendor operations, ensuring employees receive a consistent and high-quality benefits experience. The Benefits Analyst partners regularly with HR Operations, Payroll, and external vendors to keep programs running smoothly across a multi-country environment.

What You'll Do:

    Benefits Administration

  • Administer day-to-day enrollment transactions including new hire elections, life event changes, dependent verifications, and open enrollment processing.
  • Serve as a first point of contact for employee benefits inquiries, responding via the HR/Benefits Service Desk ticketing system and email with accuracy and professionalism.
  • Process and audit benefits enrollments in the benefits administration system, ensuring data integrity and timely updates.
  • Manage the enrollment window process: generate eligibility reports, send employee reminders, and follow up on incomplete elections.
  • Process new hire benefits paperwork and enrollment forms for NALA countries (US, Canada, Brazil, Colombia, Mexico); coordinate documentation with regional carriers and brokers as required.
  • Maintain accurate employee records across the HRIS, benefits administration system, and vendor platforms; identify and resolve file feed discrepancies.
  • Support annual open enrollment preparation including employee communications, benefits administration system testing, and intranet content updates.
  • Sending company-wide email calendar invites, for benefit related presentations.

    • Leave & Disability Administration

  • Coordinate leave of absence administration across US, Canada, and LATAM programs including disability, family leave, and country-specific statutory leave types.
  • Maintain the LOA leave tracker; audit leave dates against vendor records and flag discrepancies for resolution.
  • Send leave-related documentation (repayment agreements, leave notices, acknowledgements) and maintain organized case files.
  • Process disability employer statements and support Canada disability LOA processes; pull and review ADA reports from the disability carrier.

    • Vendor Operations & Invoice Management

  • Submit carrier invoices to Accounts Payable; save and log weekly and monthly invoice reports from medical, dental, vision, and ancillary carriers.
  • Run monthly invoice audit reconciliations and benefit payroll deduction reconciliation audits for US and Canada.
  • Download and audit carrier invoices monthly prior to submitting to AP; process self-billed premium reports for applicable vendors.
  • Support vendor census submissions including monthly LATAM life insurance census and countryspecific reporting requirements.
  • Assist with vendor file feed audits and enrollment reconciliations between the HRIS and carrier systems
    • Compliance & Reporting
  • Assist with ACA (1095-C/1094-C) review and filing support, COBRA administration, and HSA Customer Identification Program (CIP) audits.
  • Pull and distribute monthly spending account reports (HSA/FSA employee balances) to Finance; support FSA unsubstantiated claims processing.
  • Contribute to compliance calendar activities including COBRA reporting, state-specific reporting (SF HCSO, NY DBL/PFL), and annual SPD/WRAP document updates.
  • Maintain process documentation and intranet benefits content; support periodic audits of vendor admin access and system accuracy.

    • Training & Operational Support

  • Contribute to the onboarding and training of new Benefits team members by sharing knowledge of the processes, systems, and recurring tasks within your area of responsibility.
  • Support HR Operations counterparts in learning Tier 1 and Tier 2 benefits administration tasks to strengthen operational coverage across the Americas.

What You Will Bring to Coupa:

  • 2+ years of experience in benefits administration, HR operations, or a closely related field.
  • Familiarity with health and welfare benefit programs (medical, dental, vision, FSA/HSA, life, disability).
  • Experience with HRIS and benefits administration platforms; exposure to Dayforce or similar systems a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple recurring tasks accurately and on time.
  • Clear, professional communication skills with a service-oriented approach to employee interactions.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and standard office productivity tools.
  • Exposure to LATAM benefit programs or multi-country HR administration is a plus.
The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.
At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:
Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)
  • Global Wellness Days: Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .

  • Business Travel Protection: Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
  • Referral Bonus Program: Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .
Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.
Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.

SwiftComply is an award-winning early-stage technology company with a mission to protect human health and the environment with an all-in-one cloud-based software that empowers local governments to easily manage their water, wastewater, and stormwater compliance programs.

We were founded in 2016 by our founder and CEO, Mick O’Dwyer. As a water & wastewater engineer at Dublin City Council (Ireland), Mick saw first hand how manual, paper-based and inefficient compliance programs can be. He created SwiftComply to fix this problem with modern, collaborative technology.

Today, SwiftComply supports over 400+ utilities that deliver water service to 50+ million citizens - and we’re expanding the team to make an even bigger impact!

About the role

SwiftComply is looking for a motivated and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to lead and manage relationships with a select portfolio of our customers. This role requires a proactive and relationship-driven individual who can balance strategic planning with hands-on account management. The CSM is responsible for driving retention and revenue growth, through cross-selling additional programs, while building relationships at every level of our customers' organizations and collaborating with internal teams to deliver exceptional results.

What you'll do
Strategic Account Leadership and Revenue Growth
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio of accounts, fostering strong, long-term relationships.
  • Develop account plans that map each customer's regulatory programs and departments, pinpointing where SwiftComply can deliver additional value.
  • Cross-sell: Proactively uncover opportunities to expand customers into additional SwiftComply programs and introduce them to the Sales team for closure.
  • Upsell: Grow existing accounts through higher-tier packages, conversions from SaaS to Usage or added functionality and services within the programs customers already use.
  • Own the renewal process for your portfolio, securing on-time renewals and minimizing churn.
  • Build and maintain a healthy expansion pipeline in HubSpot, accurately forecasting renewal and expansion revenue.
  • Executive engagement: Build relationships beyond day-to-day users with senior stakeholders, such as utility directors, public works leadership, and city or county executives, to secure executive sponsorship and influence strategic and budget decisions.
  • Conduct regular account reviews with both operational and senior stakeholders to assess performance, align on goals, and uncover growth opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, understanding customer needs and delivering tailored solutions.

  • Identify opportunities to offer professional services, such as tailored training, managed services, or program optimizations, based on customer needs.
  • Collaborate with the Services Team to scope, price, and present service offerings to customers.
  • Facilitate the sales process for service projects and ensure a smooth handoff to the Services Team for execution.
  • Maintain oversight of active projects to ensure alignment with customer expectations and successful delivery.

Customer Success and Advocacy

  • Advocate for customer needs by gathering and sharing insights with internal teams, including product and support.
  • Identify opportunities for case studies and customer success stories to highlight the impact of SwiftComply solutions.
  • Ensure timely resolution of escalated issues, working closely with support and product teams.

Data-Driven Insights and Reporting

  • Analyze account performance and identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, renewal schedules, and account plans using tools like HubSpot and .
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline in HubSpot, accurately forecasting renewal and upsell revenue and tracking cross-sell opportunities sourced for Sales.
  • Contribute to internal discussions and workshops to refine customer success strategies.

Collaboration and Cross-Functional Support

  • Work closely with product, support, services, and marketing teams to align on customer objectives and ensure smooth implementation of initiatives.
  • Provide structured feedback to internal teams to inform product development and process improvements.
  • Participate in workshops to develop and refine account strategies, including health scores and account plans.

Process Optimization and Improvement

  • Document best practices, workflows, and customer insights to support team growth and knowledge sharing.
  • Leverage CRM and other tools to optimize account management activities.
Who you are

Essential:

  • Proven experience in account management, customer success, or a related role (3+ years), preferably in SaaS or compliance industries.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with customers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve revenue and retention targets through strategic account management.
  • Experience identifying and selling professional services and managing handoffs to delivery teams.
  • Analytical mindset with proficiency in using CRM tools like HubSpot for tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple accounts and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in GovTech or SaaS serving public-sector customers, such as municipalities, utilities, or government agencies.
  • Familiarity with water or wastewater compliance programs or similar regulatory industries.
  • Experience in developing and executing account strategies, including upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Knowledge of customer health metrics and customer lifecycle management.

Key Competencies:

  • Customer Focus: Strong commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences and driving value.
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to align customer needs with business goals and develop long-term strategies.
  • Collaboration: Skilled at working across teams to drive outcomes and improve processes.

Job Location: Livingston, West Lothian, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

The Clinical Data Manager performs activities pertaining to the conduct of Phase I-III clinical trials in accordance with ICH/Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and other relevant procedures and guidelines. The CDM ensures, from a data management perspective, assigned trials on time, within budget, and with highest achievable quality.

Summary of the Essential Functions of the Job

  • Participate as the primary data management representative on multidisciplinary project teams and ensure effective communication exchange.
  • Responsible for communicating key clinical data management metrics (e.g., data entry status, query resolution and aging, etc.) and determining appropriate actions in conjunction with study team.
  • Responsible for the review, development and/or writing of clinical trial documents and manuals, including but not limited to Case Report Forms, Edit Checks, Data Management Plans, Clinical Data Review Plans and eCRF Completion Guidelines.
  • Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT), as needed.
  • Participate in Quality Control (QC), as needed.
  • Responsible for working with the assigned Clinical Database Programmer(s) to ensure the development of the Data Flow Chart(s), Data Transfer Specifications and Import Guidelines.
  • Assist with site and/or third party vendor training on CDM-related topics.
  • Responsible for providing data review training and guidance to Sr. Clinical Data Coordinators that are supporting their trial(s).
  • Perform data review and discrepancy resolution, as needed.
  • Responsible for archiving trial(s) and associated documentation upon trial(s) completion.
  • Ensure adherence to Good Clinical Practice and all applicable local and international regulations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years of data management experience
  • Bachelor's degree OR certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (i.e. RN, MT, PA, RT) is preferred, but individuals with commensurate experience will be considered.
  • Oracle Inform EDC experience
  • Oncology and/or inflammatory therapeutic area experience is preferred.
  • Project management experience (within Data Management) is preferred.
  • CRO or Pharma data management experience

This role is not eligible for UK visa sponsorship

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

jobs.description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.
Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

  • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

  • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

  • Starting Salary: 60,000 EUR
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity

Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Our vision for Veeva OpenData is to become the global leader in reference data for the life sciences industry. The world's top pharma and biotech companies use our data as the foundational layer for their commercial and medical operations

This means the data products you build will directly accelerate getting life-saving treatments to patients. As a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC), we balance purpose with profit, operating with a culture of extreme autonomy, speed, and ownership.

We are looking for an entrepreneurial data professional to step into the Data Product Manager role in the OpenData Europe team. The role is fully remote in the UK, Germany, or Spain. Travel expected: 10%.

If you have a strong technical foundation in data analytics or engineering and are tired of just pulling data to fulfill tickets, this is your chance to own the roadmap. You won't just oversee data pipelines; you will lead product strategy, identify new market opportunities, and lead cross-functional execution from end to end.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Product Plan: Serve as the end-to-end owner for the designated product, actively scaling its customer footprint and driving product strategy.
  • Architect the Data Strategy: Make the critical, high-level product decisions governing how we source, transform, update, and analyze country datasets to maximize customer value.
  • Innovate & Execute: Translate market needs into a strategic roadmap for dedicated squads of data engineers, analysts, and product operations. You will actively identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to build data pipelines that scale with quality.
  • Drive Customer Success: Partner directly with strategy, sales, and services teams to gather customer feedback, iterate rapidly, and ensure the product is continuously improving.
  • Champion Data Excellence: Set and enforce rigorous KPIs for data coverage, completeness, and accuracy, maximizing data quality.
  • Navigate Complex Markets: Stay ahead of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and market shifts, adapting the product roadmap to turn market complexity into a competitive advantage.

Requirements

  • Speed & Quality Focus: A detail-oriented professional who executes with speed and quality.
  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in data analytics or product management, with a proven track record of extracting value from complex datasets.
  • Ruthless Prioritization: Strong product intuition with the ability to manage a backlog, balancing long-term product scope, strict data quality standards, and customer feedback.
  • Technical Fluency: Proficient in SQL. You don't just rely on dashboards; you can query the database directly to investigate issues, validate data quality, and prototype solutions.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Communication: Fluent in English (C1 or higher), enabling you to effectively manage global stakeholders and translate complex technical concepts into business strategy.

Nice to Have

  • Life Sciences Expertise: Experience building data products specifically for the life sciences industry, spanning data sources, data modeling, sourcing, analysis, and delivery.
  • Business proficiency (B2 or higher) in an additional language (e.g., French, German, Polish, Arabic), with an emphasis on complex languages and non-latin alphabets.

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.
