Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.
Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. As an alternative to an MBA, this program is intentionally designed as the entry path to shape experienced professionals as Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions while collaborating with team members at all levels of Veeva. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree or have 3-5 years of industry experience and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
The anticipated start date is April 2027.

What You'll Do

  • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for people who meet the following requirements:

  • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences Industry experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Other non-Consulting work experience
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

THE PROCESS | Our process is different than most. It is designed to be fast, efficient and respectful. Here are the steps:

  • You submit your resume, short cover letter of questions, and take a personality test
  • Within one week we will notify you via email if we would like to go to the next step or not
  • The next step is a 45-minute interview with the Executive Leader of the practice, followed by a case exercise. You will have one week to prepare for the case exercise.
  • Within one week after this step, we will give you an offer, or let you know that we do not wish to move forward
  • You will have two weeks to accept our offer or not. If you accept, we will hold a spot for you and expect you to show up on your start date. Accepting an offer and continuing to interview would be an ethical violation in our view

Compensation

  • Starting Salary: 52,000 EUR
  • After one year, if you perform well, you will receive a significant salary increase and be granted equity
Work Authorization: Qualified candidates should be legally authorized to be employed in the EU.
Work Environment: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can choose to work in an office or remotely from home on any given day of the week. There is no requirement to live near a Veeva office if a candidate is in proximity to an airport and able to meet travel requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Description🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets.
jobs.description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for an autonomous, growth-minded Social Media Content Manager to take 100% ownership of our US Instagram presence (along with Threads & LinkedIn). In this role, you won't just post content - you’ll own the entire strategy: revamping our profile storefront for a tech-savvy audience and building a seamless bridge between high-performing Meta Ads and our profile content to turn visitors into buyers.

What you will do

  • Own the Social Media Channels: Take full end-to-end ownership of our Instagram account, extending distribution to Threads and LinkedIn to drive audience engagement in the US market.
  • Repackage the Instagram Storefront: Revamp profile highlights, pinned posts, and top-of-feed content to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.
  • Bridge Ads to Profile: Sync social content with active Meta Ad campaigns, ensuring users landing from ads see consistent messaging, proof points, and value promises that drive conversions.
  • Build & Execute the Content Strategy: Create and manage a structured content calendar featuring high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, interactive posts, and compelling copy).
  • Direct Creative Production: Set clear briefs and collaborate seamlessly with in-house copywriters, graphic designers, and SEO managers to produce high-quality assets.
  • Track & Optimize Metrics: Monitor core engagement metrics (saves, shares, reach, ER) and continuously iterate on content tactics based on data and audience feedback.

Requirements

  • Channel Ownership: Take full end-to-end ownership of the Instagram account (with cross-posting to Threads and LinkedIn), driving content strategy, execution, and engagement for our US audience.
  • Profile Packaging & Value Proposition: Re-pack and maintain the Instagram storefront (Highlights, pinned posts, and top feed) to clearly communicate updated product value propositions.
  • Ad-to-Profile Funnel Matching: Align social content with active performance marketing campaigns (Meta Ads) to ensure a seamless post-click user journey that reinforces ad promises and drives conversion.
  • Content Planning & Execution: Develop and manage a consistent content calendar tailored to a tech-savvy, English-speaking audience, focusing on high-engagement formats (carousels, reels, copy).
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Brief and direct internal team members (copywriters, graphic designers, SEO managers) and external creative vendors (motion designers) to produce high-quality assets.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor key social metrics (engagement rate, saves, shares, reach) and iterate on content strategy based on data and audience feedback.

What we can offer you

  • 100% Remote: Freedom to work from anywhere (Europe, LATAM, Georgia, Serbia, etc.)
  • Full Ownership & Creative Freedom: End-to-end ownership of the social media channels with room to test new ideas, experiment with formats, and directly influence conversion metrics.
  • Strong Team Support: Dedicated internal resources at your disposal, including graphic designers, copywriters, and SEO managers to help execute your vision.
  • International Impact: Hands-on experience scaling social channels for a fast-growing EdTech product in the US market.
  • Dynamic Startup Environment: Fast-paced, low-bureaucracy environment with direct access to decision-makers and modern AI/marketing tools.

You won't just oversee data pipelines; you will lead product strategy, identify new market opportunities, and lead cross-functional execution from end to end.

  • Own the Product Plan: Serve as the end-to-end owner for the designated product, actively scaling its customer footprint and driving product strategy.

  • Champion Data Excellence: Set and enforce rigorous KPIs for data coverage, completeness, and accuracy, maximizing data quality.
  • Navigate Complex Markets: Stay ahead of healthcare regulations, compliance requirements, and market shifts, adapting the product roadmap to turn market complexity into a competitive advantage.

Requirements

  • Speed & Quality Focus: A detail-oriented professional who executes with speed and quality.
  • Experience: 2+ years of experience in data analytics or product management, with a proven track record of extracting value from complex datasets.

  • Technical Fluency: Proficient in SQL. You don't just rely on dashboards; you can query the database directly to investigate issues, validate data quality, and prototype solutions.
  • Educational Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Communication: Fluent in English (C1 or higher), enabling you to effectively manage global stakeholders and translate complex technical concepts into business strategy.

Nice to Have

  • Life Sciences Expertise: Experience building data products specifically for the life sciences industry, spanning data sources, data modeling, sourcing, analysis, and delivery.

jobs.excerpt: MissionFinances are one of the major sources of stress in American households, and nine out of ten Americans say nothing would make them feel more confident than having their personal finances in order.
jobs.description:
Mission

Finances are one of the major sources of stress in American households, and nine out of ten Americans say nothing would make them feel more confident than having their personal finances in order. At Monarch we are building the most comprehensive personal finance platform to help people improve their financial lives and achieve their goals.

The Company

Monarch came out of private beta in early 2021. Since that time we have quickly became one of the premier ways to manage your financial life. Customers love the product and we have seen rapid, organic growth. Our users say that Monarch helps them feel more confident in their finances, and more confident in their financial future.

Our founding team consists of product-driven, serial entrepreneurs with multiple exits. Additionally, our CEO was one of the original creators of and has a unique perspective on what is needed to meet consumers' needs in this market.

We are passionate about building a company, product and brand that both customers and employees love. We are well-funded by top venture firms and angel investors.

We founded the company as a fully-remote team (pre Covid!) and are open to applicants that live within a 5 hour time zone difference of US Pacific Time.

Your Contribution

  • As one of our first full-stack engineers, you will play a critical role in growing and evolving our web and mobile app.

  • You will be more than just a software craftsperson; you will also be a thought partner in building a product, company, and culture we are proud of.

  • You will have significant input into the processes, rituals, and tools we use in order to create a high performing engineering team.

  • You will typically work with a lot of autonomy, and be expected to "own" the full implementation of whatever you work on.

Skills

  • You consider yourself a "product-centric" engineer and take pride in building something people love. You are opinionated about the user experience.

  • You enjoy and strive when given autonomy and independence, and are comfortable with ambiguity and simplifying complex problems.

  • You have 3+ years experience in full-stack development with some combination of Python, Django, React, React Native, iOS and Android development.

  • You have superb written and verbal communication skills.

  • You are familiar with best practices in engineering, architecture, security, and design for both web and mobile apps, and can help build scalable, fault-tolerant products.

  • You have (or want) experience with early-stage company best practices including rapid iteration with robust metrics and qualitative user feedback.

  • Nice to have: Experience building APIs with Django Rest Framework

  • Nice to have: Experience working in a financial technology company (accounting, investing, banking, etc)

  • Nice to have: Experience working in a remote-first culture

Benefits

  • Work wherever you want! As a fully remote company with no central office, we want you to work wherever you are happiest and most productive. Whether that’s out of your home, a co-working space, or elsewhere.

  • Competitive cash and equity compensation in a hyper growth, early stage company 🚀.

  • Stipend to set-up your ideal working environment.

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits (Full time US only).

  • 401k (US only).

  • Unlimited PTO.

  • 3 day weekend every month! We take off the “First Friday” every month to focus on rest, recuperation, or just having fun!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

The Role

MLR review is one of the Life Science industry's biggest bottlenecks - and we're rebuilding it with AI.

Falcon MLR is Veeva's AI application for medical, legal, and regulatory (MLR) review. Our AI agents review promotional material the way expert reviewers do: against the actual rules of each market and the science behind the claims. We're looking for an MLR expert to take ownership of review quality across Europe.

You have sat in the review meetings. You know the codes, the process, and their pain points. Now, help build the reviewer and shape the future of MLR for the entire Life Science industry. You'll work directly with Falcon MLR's founding team, and your judgment will ship into a product used globally by the top Pharmaceutical companies.

We work like a start-up inside Veeva. The team is small, you own your area end to end, and your decisions reach the product fast. It suits people who like to build and take ownership.

Jobs that combine deep MLR expertise with frontier AI barely exist. This is one.

What You'll Do

  • Maximize reviewer agreement with Falcon's findings across our EU markets
  • Lead our regulatory monitoring system with engineering and product, and coordinate with other regions
  • Operationalize the reviewer-feedback loop, turning customer inputs into product improvements
  • Investigate, diagnose and resolve “why did Falcon flag this?” - read the agent's traces, find the root cause, fix it. Build the process for handling these questions with users
  • Automate recurring tasks with AI workflows
  • Ownership of quality benchmarks e.g. review quality, in cross functional collaboration with engineering and product

Requirements

  • You have been part of MLR/PRC review of promotional material - in pharma, biotech or at an agency serving one
  • You know the European codes - EFPIA, or national ones like ABPI, ENLI, FSA, Farmindustria, LEEM
  • You learn dense regulatory and legal material fast - and have results to show
  • AI is already part of your daily work – you have automated parts of your own job and want to go further

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Senior SAP Basis Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a seasoned SAP Basis / SAP Platform Engineer responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, performance tuning, and day-to-day operation of complex SAP landscapes that may span on-premises, hybrid, and cloud-hosted environments. This role is critical to keeping mission-critical SAP systems available, performant, secure, and compliant. jobs.description:
About Phorest

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, Phorest builds software and AI-powered tools used by more than 155,000 hair, beauty, and medspa professionals worldwide. We're a product-led SaaS company solving real-world problems across bookings, payments, marketing, and business management, with a big focus on building great experiences for both the businesses we serve and the people who use our products. Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We're building something exciting at Phorest. With an established presence in the hair and beauty industry, we're now investing in our next big growth opportunity: the North American medspa market.

We're looking for a commercially driven, entrepreneurial Account Executive – MedSpa to help us grow our presence, build relationships, and turn opportunities into long-term customers.

You'll own the full sales cycle, from qualifying leads generated through Marketing, Partnerships, and industry events to delivering engaging product demos, negotiating, and closing deals. You'll also get out into the medspa community, attending conferences and events across the US to build relationships and establish Phorest as a trusted technology partner.

This is an opportunity to help shape our sales approach in a growing market. We're looking for a self-starter who's curious, resilient, and comfortable working without an established playbook. Someone who learns quickly, takes ownership, and isn't afraid to test new ideas.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build something, make a real impact, and help drive Phorest's next phase of growth, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Own the sales journey from start to finish

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from qualifying inbound, partner-sourced, and event-generated leads through discovery, product demonstrations, negotiations, and closing new business.

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities, prioritizing established, multi-provider medspas that align with Phorest's ideal customer profile.

  • Respond promptly to new leads, understand their needs and buying timelines, and guide prospects through a thoughtful, consultative sales process.

  • Take ownership of your sales performance, consistently working toward monthly, quarterly, and annual recurring revenue targets.

  • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates, strengthen pipeline performance, and create a positive experience for prospective customers.

Deliver engaging, consultative sales experiences

  • Lead discovery conversations with medspa owners, operators, clinicians, and practice leaders to understand their business models, challenges, and growth ambitions.

  • Translate technical product capabilities into clear, relevant business benefits that resonate with different decision-makers.

  • Confidently navigate objections, competitive comparisons, and commercial negotiations to build trust and close deals.

  • Position Phorest as more than just software, demonstrating how we can be a valuable technology and growth partner.

Build relationships within the medspa community

  • Represent Phorest at medspa conferences, trade shows, partner events, and industry gatherings across the US.

  • Build meaningful relationships with prospective customers, industry professionals, and partners to strengthen our presence and credibility in the market.

  • Work closely with Marketing and Partnerships to maximize opportunities generated through events, campaigns, and partner relationships.

  • Follow up on event and partner-sourced leads, turning initial conversations into qualified opportunities and new customers.

  • Bring insights from industry events and customer conversations back into the business to help shape our sales and marketing approach.

Collaborate and help shape our approach

  • Partner closely with our MedSpa Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Product teams to deliver a seamless experience from initial engagement through onboarding.

  • Share insights on customer needs, market trends, competitor activity, and lead quality to help refine how we position and sell Phorest.

  • Work with our Partner Development team to maximize partner-sourced opportunities and build strong relationships across the medspa ecosystem.

  • Ensure smooth customer handovers by maintaining accurate information and clear communication with our onboarding teams.

  • Contribute ideas, test new approaches, and help develop a repeatable, effective sales process as our medspa business grows.

Take ownership of your pipeline and performance

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, sales activity, and pipeline information within our CRM.

  • Track key performance metrics, including lead conversion, demo effectiveness, win rates, and recurring revenue generated.

  • Use data and customer insights to identify opportunities, manage risks, and continuously improve sales performance.

  • Stay informed about the medspa industry, competitor offerings, and Phorest product developments to strengthen your customer conversations.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who's excited by the opportunity to build relationships, create opportunities, and make a real impact.

You'll ideally bring:

  • Experience in a full-cycle sales or Account Executive role, ideally within SaaS, B2B technology, or another consultative sales environment.

  • A proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets, particularly in an inbound or lead-driven sales environment.

  • Strong discovery, presentation, and product demonstration skills, with the ability to understand customer challenges and communicate relevant solutions.

  • A consultative approach to selling, with confidence handling objections, navigating negotiations, and closing deals.

  • A natural curiosity and the ability to quickly learn technical products and explain their value to non-technical audiences.

  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset, with the confidence to take initiative, work independently, and create momentum without a fully established playbook.

  • Resilience, adaptability, and a growth mindset. You're comfortable with challenges, willing to experiment, and motivated to learn from every conversation.

  • Strong organizational and pipeline management skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities simultaneously.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar sales tools.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage with business owners, clinicians, and senior decision-makers.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams.

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across the US to meet prospective customers, attend medspa conferences, and participate in partner and industry events.

Even better if you have:

  • Experience selling software or technology solutions to small and medium-sized businesses or multi-location operators.

  • Knowledge of the medspa, medical aesthetics, skincare, beauty, or wellness industries.

  • An existing network of relationships within the US medspa community.

  • Experience working in a startup, launching a new product, or helping a business expand into a new market.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered sales tools, automation, or sales engagement platforms that help improve productivity and customer engagement.

Benefits

🧘 Phorest currently offers a range of fully employer-paid benefits including Medical, Dental, Life, AD&D, Short Term Disability, an EAP, and wellness perks.

💰 Employees also have access to optional extras, such as a 401(k) and a range of upgraded insurance options.

🤓 Career development is important to us. We even have our own in-house Learning and Development/Business coach and many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

😎 We like to have fun, build camaraderie through regular social events.

👯 Phorest also encourages Employee Resource Groups, you will have the opportunity to join or champion a club, society, or group.

We know this market moves quickly, so we invest in our people for the long term, giving you the space to build real expertise, keep developing, and stay ahead of what’s next.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: About OpenMinedOpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared.
jobs.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined, a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI.

You’ll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there’s a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality–cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example. You're the most experienced engineer on the squad, the person others look to for production-quality judgment, and the voice that connects this team's decisions with the organization's broader platform strategy.

The squad is talented and mission-driven and looking to strengthen its ability to continuously ship production software. You bring this production muscle: the instinct for what scales, the judgment about what to build and what to kill, and the craft to raise the team's standard through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance rather than mandates.

If you're motivated by building distributed systems that matter, mentoring brilliant people who are just getting started, and making hard technical calls in a fast-moving nonprofit that's trying to change how the world shares data — we'd love to hear from you.

You'll report to Kevin McDonough, Head of Engineering.

This is a fully remote role for people based in the United States, working within one hour of US Eastern Time.

Responsibilities

  • Own the ScreamingFace squad technical architecture end to end — align design, engineering, and deployment across the stack to deliver reliable technical capabilities and user experience from current implementation through product roadmap evolution.
  • Drive production readiness through deployment monitoring, error handling, graceful degradation, and operational runbooks.
  • Be a force multiplier by establishing, demonstrating, and mentoring the team to establish norms around engineering best practices (including system design for modularity, security, reliability, & scalability), code quality, and delivery to production.
  • Collaborate on core technology stack strategy through architectural review and identification of components that should become shared organizational primitives and defining standard interfaces that prevent tight coupling.
  • Partner with product lead to develop and execute on realistic roadmaps that balance what is desired with what is feasible, scalable, and architecturally sound.
  • Own the delivery of engineering’s quarterly goals, ensuring consistent, high-impact delivery while effectively managing resources.
  • Own team output, delivery, and success (productivity, timeliness, morale) through appropriately matching team members and work to properly balance interest, learning opportunities, capacity, and capability.
  • Champion high-quality software delivery through the establishment of robust tools, processes, & methodologies, and by providing hands-on technical leadership via individual development contributions and code reviews.
  • Create technical documentation and processes that support high velocity and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of personally building, shipping, and operating production systems at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience building production software with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and helping a team manage their agentic workflows
  • Strong Python (3.12+) proficiency — FastAPI services, async orchestration of concurrent model calls, typed SDK design and packaging, and a working comfort with parsers, ASTs, and DAG execution
  • Distributed systems and API design experience including design & evolution of interfaces consumed by multiple independent teams
  • Technical leadership experience: has introduced engineering quality practices (code review, testing, CI/CD) to one or more teams and mentored or managed at least 2 engineers (direct reports not required)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and resource constraints
  • Commitment, accountability, ownership — this isn’t just a job, the release gets shipped and outages get restored
  • Async-fluent with strong written communication and capacity to build high-trust working relationships across 6hr+ time zone spread
  • Cross-functional collaboration & communication to facilitate and improve understanding/context sharing between engineers and non-engineering/non-technical stakeholders

Preferred

  • Practical RAG and information retrieval experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, embedding strategies, and aggregation
  • Vue 3 / TypeScript, Rust / Tauri, or cross-platform desktop app experience extremely beneficial
  • Networking/P2P application experience beneficial

Compensation

  • Salary Range: $125,000 - $258,000 per year.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

    • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
    • US employee benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance with company contributions; Retirement: 403(b) plan, the 401(k) equivalent for non-profits
    • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
    • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
    • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
    • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.
    • Flexible Paid Time Off: Take the time you need with flexible vacation days, alongside recognition of local national holidays.

Sourcing Specialist

The Sourcing Specialist owns the front end of the hiring pipeline, moving quickly to identify, engage, and deliver strong candidates for open roles. The Sourcing Specialist coordinates with the Staffing Specialists and TA Managers to actively source candidates for openings using a variety of resources, including but not limited to job boards, resume databases, news outlets, social media websites, colleges/universities, and community organizations. This role takes a highly analytical, data-driven approach to managing our sourcing partners, aggressively tracking performance metrics and holding partners accountable for results. The Sourcing Specialist will work closely with representatives from our recruitment marketing agency to monitor ad placement and performance between campaigns, identify underperforming channels, and drive improvements.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Source prospective candidates using Applicant Tracking System, job boards, and community-based organizations
  • Builds applicant sources by researching and contacting community services, colleges, employment agencies, recruiters, media, and internet sites; providing organization information, opportunities, and benefits; making presentations; maintaining rapport
  • Attracts applicants by placing job advertisements; contacting recruiters, using newsgroups and job sites
  • Proactively build talent pipelines for high-volume and hard-to-fill roles before openings occur
  • Reviews resumes for appropriate skill sets to qualify candidates
  • Evaluates candidates against job requirements, engages candidate in the opportunity, and presents qualified candidates to the Staffing Specialist or TA Manager

  • Hold sourcing partners and our recruitment marketing agency accountable to performance expectations; proactively escalate underperformance and push for corrective action
  • Analyze campaign and channel data to identify trends, gaps, and areas of opportunity, and recommend reallocating spend toward the highest-performing sources

  • Understand and demonstrate safe work practices at all times to ensure a safe work environment
  • Comply with all company policies and procedures
  • Complete special projects and other duties as assigned by your supervisor

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Effective communication skills both written and verbal
  • Able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to prioritize effectively
  • Great interpersonal skills
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities
  • Able to independently research new and trending practices in the industry
  • Able to work to agreed deadlines and targets

  • Service-oriented with a history of building excellent customer and candidate relationships

Experience and Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

  • Proficient with the use of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook

📌 Votre mission

Au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire réunissant des data engineers, des architectes, des analystes, des experts en intelligence artificielle, des spécialistes BI, des chefs de projet ainsi que des experts en gouvernance et en qualité des données, vous contribuez à valoriser les données au service des politiques publiques, de la qualité des soins et du contrôle médical.

Votre mission consiste à mettre en œuvre et à coordonner la gouvernance des données au sein de l'organisation. Vous animez les communautés de data stewards, favorisez l'adoption des outils de gouvernance et pilotez les initiatives liées à la qualité des données, conformément aux priorités définies par le Data Governance Manager.

Vous rapportez au Data Governance Manager et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes métiers, BI et IA ainsi qu'avec les data stewards.

Responsabilités clés

Data stewardship et communauté

  • Définir les rôles et les responsabilités des data stewards et des data owners.
  • Accompagner et coacher les data stewards et les data owners.
  • Animer la communauté des data stewards, notamment au moyen de réunions, du suivi des actions et du partage de bonnes pratiques.
  • Contribuer activement au développement de la culture data au sein de l'organisation.

Catalogue de données et métadonnées

  • Coordonner et suivre l'alimentation du catalogue de données et du glossaire métier.
  • Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence et à la complétude des métadonnées, conformément aux standards définis.
  • Favoriser l'adoption des outils de gouvernance des données.

Qualité des données

  • Initier et coordonner les travaux des data stewards dans le cadre de projets d'amélioration de la qualité des données.
  • Contribuer à la définition des règles, à la priorisation des actions, au reporting et au suivi des résultats.

Politiques et guidelines

  • Contribuer à la définition des politiques et des guidelines de gouvernance des données.

Data literacy

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la maturité data au moyen d'un programme de data literacy, notamment par la sélection des formations et le suivi de leur mise en œuvre.

Dans le cadre de ces activités, vous êtes en contact avec l'équipe chargée de la gestion des référentiels et des données de référence ainsi qu'avec l'équipe de validation des données, qui vous apporte son soutien.

📝 Votre profil

  • Diplôme de niveau Master en data, informatique, économie, gestion ou dans un domaine équivalent.
  • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans un rôle lié aux données, dont au moins 10 ans d'expérience pratique en gouvernance des données au sein d'une grande organisation.
  • Expérience pratique de la mise en œuvre et de la gestion d'un catalogue de données.
  • Connaissances de base en SQL.
  • La connaissance de DataBricks constitue un atout.
  • Connaissance pratique des outils de qualité des données et des outils de gouvernance des données.
  • Connaissance du RGPD.
  • Autonomie et motivation.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite.
  • Néerlandais ou français comme langue maternelle, avec une connaissance de l'autre langue nationale.

Domaines d'expertise attendus

  • Data Governance : 10 ans d'expérience.
  • Data quality management : 10 ans d'expérience.

  • Meta data management : 5 ans d'expérience.

jobs.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Staff Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

Responsibilities: - Design, build, and maintain predictive Lifetime Value (pLTV) models using machine learning techniques such as XGBoost, CatBoost, and probabilistic forecasting methods.

- Develop and manage a tiered scoring framework that assigns users to different prediction models based on data availability and signal quality.

- Create and optimize calibration frameworks that transform raw model outputs into business-ready values through normalization, scaling, and custom loss optimization strategies.

- Own feature engineering processes, building and maintaining scalable feature datasets from transactional, behavioral, and engagement data.

- Define and enforce feature quality standards, ensuring model inputs are reliable, relevant, and suitable for production use. - Monitor model performance, drift, and data distribution changes, proactively identifying when retraining or model adjustments are required.

- Analyze the impact of deployed models on downstream outcomes and detect feedback loops that may affect future model accuracy.

- Develop and improve identity resolution processes to unify behavioral and transactional data across multiple data sources.

- Build, test, and maintain production-grade Python services and data pipelines for model training, scoring, and signal delivery.

- Implement robust software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, idempotent processing, and deployment safeguards.

- Collaborate with data, engineering, and product stakeholders to improve data quality, model effectiveness, and platform scalability.

- Operate and optimize ML workflows in cloud environments using orchestration, scheduling, and distributed processing tools.

- Ensure the reliability, accuracy, and scalability of machine learning systems that support critical business decision-making and performance optimization.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on ML engineering in Python with production-deployed models (not just Jupyter notebooks). You should be comfortable writing production-grade code, not just prototypes.

  • GCP production experience. Cloud Run, Airflow/Composer, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub. You have deployed and maintained ML workloads on GCP, not just completed certification exercises.
  • Understanding of model calibration. You know the difference between a model that minimizes RMSE and a model that maximizes business value. You have experience with or strong intuition about how prediction errors compound when consumed by a downstream optimization system.
  • Outbound API integration experience. You have pushed model outputs into external systems that act on them (ad platforms, recommendation engines, pricing systems, bidding systems).

Strongly Preferred:

  • E-commerce or DTC domain experience. Customer lifetime value, purchase prediction, churn modeling, or customer segmentation for retail or subscription businesses.

  • Ad platform signal engineering. Experience with Google Ads API (ConversionUploadService, Enhanced Conversions), Meta Conversions API (CAPI), or similar server-side event dispatch systems.
  • Identity resolution or entity matching. Graph-based identity stitching, probabilistic matching, or CDP-style cross-device identity work.

Nice-to-have:

  • Terraform, CI/CD pipeline design, Docker containerization for ML workloads.
  • Experience with causal inference methods, A/B testing in ad spend environments, or multi-armed bandit allocation.
  • Familiarity with agentic development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar AI-assisted coding tools).

  • Experience with Go

  • Experience with observability tooling (e.g. OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana)

  • Experience with modern Python packaging and tooling (uv, ruff)

  • Working understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLAN, NAT, ACL, firewalls, routing)

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • Exceptional stakeholder orchestration skills: Navigate multi-layered organisations, influence without authority, and craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences

  • Experience with SQLAlchemy, or ORM-based data modeling more broadly

  • Experience with migration, import or ETL-style tooling

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical manufacturing, process optimization, technology transfer, and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) could help artificial intelligence better understand pharmaceutical production processes, operational excellence, and manufacturing best practices?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Manufacturing / Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT) Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and scientific validity of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze manufacturing, process engineering, technology transfer, operational excellence, facility operations, and quality-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in pharmaceutical manufacturing principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way
Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your pharmaceutical or biotechnology career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely
Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology
Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing scientific and regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required
We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate scientific reasoning, identify errors, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

If you're an experienced pharmaceutical or biotechnology professional who enjoys analyzing complex scientific information, applying regulatory and technical expertise, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

jobs.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior / Staff Software Engineer to join OpenMined, a nonprofit building open-source infrastructure for federated AI.

You’ll lead our 😱 ScreamingFace squad, the team that makes this vision real by building the internet's first leaderboard for fusion models (ensembles) and the open toolkit supporting benchmark evaluations for fusion models. Today, claims that the newest solo LLM beats the others are everywhere, and almost none of them can be checked or compared with the performance achieved by combining LLMs into more powerful fusion models. Results are self-reported, expensive to rerun, and hard to pick apart. We think there’s a better standard: every fusion and benchmark run compiles to a single line of text that anyone can replay for almost nothing, and a score counts only once someone else can reproduce it. The ScreamingFace toolkit is the open-source Python library and engine, leveraging our URL4 protocol, to let any researcher (a frontier lab, a university group, an independent builder) compose ensembles and routers across open and closed models, using their own keys, and grade them against pinned benchmarks. The ScreamingFace leaderboard is the public map of the quality–cost frontier, backed by a shared cache that makes every result on it cheap to verify and easy to build on.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You understand the long term vision. You write code. You make architecture decisions. You set engineering standards by example. You're the most experienced engineer on the squad, the person others look to for production-quality judgment, and the voice that connects this team's decisions with the organization's broader platform strategy.

The squad is talented and mission-driven and looking to strengthen its ability to continuously ship production software. You bring this production muscle: the instinct for what scales, the judgment about what to build and what to kill, and the craft to raise the team's standard through code review, pairing, and architectural guidance rather than mandates.

If you're motivated by building distributed systems that matter, mentoring brilliant people who are just getting started, and making hard technical calls in a fast-moving nonprofit that's trying to change how the world shares data — we'd love to hear from you.

You'll work most closely with Kevin McDonough, Head of Engineering.

You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time between one hour behind and two hours ahead of ET).

  • Drive production readiness through deployment monitoring, error handling, graceful degradation, and operational runbooks.
  • Be a force multiplier by establishing, demonstrating, and mentoring the team to establish norms around engineering best practices (including system design for modularity, security, reliability, & scalability), code quality, and delivery to production.
  • Collaborate on core technology stack strategy through architectural review and identification of components that should become shared organizational primitives and defining standard interfaces that prevent tight coupling.
  • Partner with product lead to develop and execute on realistic roadmaps that balance what is desired with what is feasible, scalable, and architecturally sound.
  • Own the delivery of engineering’s quarterly goals, ensuring consistent, high-impact delivery while effectively managing resources.
  • Own team output, delivery, and success (productivity, timeliness, morale) through appropriately matching team members and work to properly balance interest, learning opportunities, capacity, and capability.
  • Champion high-quality software delivery through the establishment of robust tools, processes, & methodologies, and by providing hands-on technical leadership via individual development contributions and code reviews.
  • Create technical documentation and processes that support high velocity and knowledge transfer.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a track record of personally building, shipping, and operating production systems at meaningful scale
  • Hands-on experience building production software with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) and helping a team manage their agentic workflows
  • Strong Python (3.12+) proficiency — FastAPI services, async orchestration of concurrent model calls, typed SDK design and packaging, and a working comfort with parsers, ASTs, and DAG execution
  • Distributed systems and API design experience including design & evolution of interfaces consumed by multiple independent teams
  • Technical leadership experience: has introduced engineering quality practices (code review, testing, CI/CD) to one or more teams and mentored or managed at least 2 engineers (direct reports not required)
  • Comfort with ambiguity and resource constraints
  • Commitment, accountability, ownership — this isn’t just a job, the release gets shipped and outages get restored

Preferred

  • Vue 3 / TypeScript, Rust / Tauri, or cross-platform desktop app experience extremely beneficial

Benefits

Job Title: Key Account Manager Rapid Diagnostics (Scotland)

Job Location: United Kingdom > Dundee : Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

The Opportunity

Abbott Rapid Diagnostics is part of Abbott’s Diagnostics family of businesses, bringing together exceptional teams of experts and industry leading technologies to support diagnostic testing which provides important information for treatment and management of diseases and other conditions.

The AbbottRapid Diagnostics Infectious Diseases Division (ARDx) portfolio is centred around ID Now. A fast growing, molecular testing platform with the flexibility to test for Covid-19, Influenza A &B, RSV and Strep A. The ID NOW delivers accurate results in just minutes, giving HCPs real-time access to the information required to make actionable decisions during the first patient visit. The ID NOW™ Platform provides diagnostics where and when they are needed most — in near patient settings at the point of care such as Emergency departments, Admissions and Wards.

Other products within the portfolio include Binax NOW rapid antigen tests, sexual health testing and womens’ health.

We are currently recruiting for a Key Account Manager role for the AbbottRapid Diagnostics Division (ARDx). The territory of this role is Scotland. The role is regional but may have national elements.

The role of the Key Account Manager is to ensure Abbott Rdx leads in the move toward Point of Care testing for infectious diseases within secondary care as well as identifying and progressing key strategic opportunities within the newly forming Clinical Diagnostic Centres (CDCs) and community landscape. This will require managing and influencing a wide variety of stakeholders and pathways, working across all levels within the NHS, Public Health and Local Authority settings.

What You’ll Do

  • Development of markets and customers, achieving sales targets, providing customer service and key account management activities
  • Lead and initiate projects or work as part of a project team as required, demonstrate excellent business acumen and strive to meet and exceed agreed financial and strategic objectives
  • Implement national strategies for new and existing products and services (mapping out and building stakeholder relationships)
  • Build strong relationships with all stakeholders in key accounts
  • Participating in all sales and marketing meetings
  • Understanding sales strategies and transferring the UK marketing campaigns to a regional level
  • Ability to articulate issues and business opportunities with relevant customers to secure long term strategic business opportunities
  • Maintain and communicate on a regular basis a view of the strategic landscape within your Region to Commercial and Marketing Teams

Required Qualifications

  • Excellent track record in sales with strong business acumen and analytical skills
  • Strong industry experience in medical devices or a diagnostics background
  • Familiarity with diagnostic industry practices preferable
  • Thorough knowledge of UK healthcare industry and NHS
  • Fluent in building / constructing compelling business cases
  • Informal coaching and leadership of stakeholders
  • IT – MS Word, Excel (intermediate), PowerPoint, CRM system(s) Salesforce and Power BI

Personal Characteristics

  • Effective communicator, excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to achieve results through influencing others
  • Self-starter, possesses flexibility and ability to work under pressure in a fast-changing environment and ambiguous situations
  • Excellent relationship builder and able to manage different agendas across customer groups
  • Team player with a high level of initiative
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Responsible-minded with a high persuasive power
  • Driven by objectives, solutions, meet the deadlines and customer satisfaction

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

Follow your career aspirations to Abbott for diverse opportunities with a company that can help you build your future and live your best life. Abbott is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to employee diversity.

Connect with us at , on Facebook at and on Twitter @AbbottNews and @AbbottGlobal.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAt Panorama, we're on a mission to improve student outcomes, and as a Senior SDR on our Inbound team, you'll be the first point of contact for K-12 school and district leaders who have already raised their hand — requesting a demo, chatting with us on our website, downloading content, or engaging with a campaign or leads that have reached a scored-up lead threshold via engagement in various marketing channels.
jobs.description:
About the Role

At Panorama, we're on a mission to improve student outcomes, and as a Senior SDR on our Inbound team, you'll be the first point of contact for K-12 school and district leaders who have already raised their hand — requesting a demo, chatting with us on our website, downloading content, or engaging with a campaign or leads that have reached a scored-up lead threshold via engagement in various marketing channels. You'll serve as the critical bridge between Marketing and Sales, turning high-intent interest in to qualified pipeline that directly accelerates Panorama's revenue growth. Speed matters, and so do engagement and conversion: you'll respond fast, build real rapport, and turn early curiosity into a well-qualified meeting before it goes cold, all while building skills that pave the way for future growth in sales and beyond.

Requirements

  • Maximize speed-to-lead by engaging new inbound leads within minutes, including real-time website chats, and turn those conversations into qualified opportunities so Account Executives meet high-potential buyers when their interest is highest.
  • Achieve daily activity targets of calls and talk time, blending fast inbound response with personalized follow-up.
  • Quickly diagnose need and buying context, using research and what the prospect has already shared to ask sharper questions, then qualify opportunities and set high-value meetings with decision-makers, handing off well-briefed conversations to closing reps.
  • Partner with sales leadership and AEs to keep inbound handling tight, consistent, and aligned with rules of engagement on account ownership.
  • Partner with Marketing to give feedback on lead quality across inbound sources, flagging when something upstream isn't working and helping sharpen targeting and campaign performance.
  • Help develop and refine messaging and follow-up flows for inbound sequences.
  • Stay current on industry and role trends, including new uses of AI in sales development, and bring new ideas back to the team.
  • Success is measured by activity volume, lead-to-meeting conversion rate, qualified meetings held, pipeline generated, and meeting-to-opportunity conversion rate.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • 1+ years in sales development or business development, ideally in SaaS, with a proven record of converting inbound interest into qualified pipeline.
  • A sharp qualifier who asks good questions, listens closely, and can quickly tell whether someone is a real fit, a future fit, or a polite pass, and routes each accordingly.
  • Interested in developing into more senior sales roles over time and building a long-term career in sales.
  • Proactive and resourceful, with a love of winning and an eye for the untapped potential in the inbound lead pool.
  • Steady under volume — can prioritize and work a high number of inbound leads, including busy weeks after a webinar or conference, without letting quality slip or leads age out.
  • A warm, consultative communicator who builds rapport fast, makes people feel heard, and handles objections by pivoting and problem-solving rather than pushing a script.
  • Process-driven and detail-oriented: follows a clear workflow, keeps the CRM clean without being reminded, and catches the details an AE will need before the call.
  • Uses technology, including AI and automation tools, to improve workflow efficiency and support sales outcomes.
  • Embraces constructive feedback, has a growth mindset, and excels at self-starting, organizing, and wants to understand why leads convert or don't.

Bonus Points

  • K-12 education or EdTech experience is a plus but not required; strong SaaS or sales experience is just as valuable.
  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong.io, HubSpot, Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini, especially lead-routing and speed-to-lead workflows.
  • A genuine passion for helping to improve outcomes in K12 education.

Benefits

The base salary range for this position is: $59,500 - $87,500

Our salary is just one component of Panorama’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual bonuses or commission awards, equity awards, as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits

Some of the additional benefits offered are:

  • 401K with an employer match
  • Health, dental, vision, life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability coverage.
  • Flexible spending account for health care and dependent care
  • Wellness Reimbursement
  • Work from Home Reimbursement
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Parental leave program
  • Company Issued Laptop

jobs.description:
Provectus is a Premier AWS partner and an Anthropic Strategic Partner, helping enterprises across Financial Services and Life Sciences design, build, and operate production AI systems. Our Forward Deployed Engineering model lets us embed with clients and deliver AI outcomes, not just advice. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide and are obsessed with reimagining how they operate and compete.

We are looking for an Alliances Team Lead to own and grow Provectus's most strategic partnerships: Anthropic and AWS. This is a build-and-lead role — you will create the programs for our alliances function from the ground up.

On the Anthropic side, you will run partner activation programs end to end: identify target accounts, align scope with Anthropic partner teams, coordinate delivery, and ensure funding milestones and closeout requirements are met. You will grow our standing in the Claude Partner Network and be the person inside Anthropic who advocates for Provectus.

On the AWS side, you will manage the alliance, maintaining AI and generative AI competency requirements, keeping Premier Tier standing current, and building the co-sell motion with AWS field teams. There is also an opportunity to develop early-stage partnerships with GCP and others as the ecosystem evolves.

You will lead a team and work directly with Provectus engineering, SO, and marketing leadership to turn partner programs into measurable pipeline.

Responsibilities:

    Anthropic partnership

  • Own the Anthropic partnership end-to-end — build and scale partner activation programs, manage funded enablement engagements from scoping through completion and reimbursement.

  • Create repeatable playbooks for partner-funded customer activations: identify target accounts, align scope with Anthropic partner teams, coordinate delivery, and ensure funding milestones are met.

  • Grow Provectus's standing in the Claude Partner Network; track program changes, tier requirements, and new co-marketing opportunities.

  • Develop named executive relationships at Anthropic — field leadership, partner success, and product teams — who actively advocate for Provectus in joint accounts.

    • AWS alliance

  • Manage the AWS alliance day-to-day — keep Provectus current on Generative AI competency requirements, renewals, and program changes; maintain Premier Tier standing.

  • Build and expand co-sell motion with AWS field teams — drive opportunity registration, joint account planning, and pipeline reviews with AWS partner sellers.

  • Manage AWS funding programs; ensure Provectus maximises available program benefits.

    • Team and cross-functional leadership

  • Lead and develop a team of partner managers; set priorities, coach on partner engagement, and build the operating cadence for the alliances function.

  • Work with sales, marketing, and delivery to turn partner programs into pipeline — co-marketing campaigns, joint solution offerings, and partner-sourced revenue.

  • Represent Provectus at executive briefings and ecosystem events; bring relevant partner intelligence back to leadership.

    • Ecosystem expansion

  • Identify and develop early-stage partnerships with GCP and other emerging AI ecosystem players as the market evolves.

  • Track the competitive alliance landscape — which SI competitors hold which partner tiers, where there are white spaces Provectus can occupy.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • 5–8+ years in technology alliances, partnerships, or channel roles, with meaningful time spent managing a hyperscaler relationship (Anthropic, AWS strongly preferred).

  • Direct experience with partner programs: competencies, funding programs (MDF, MAP, or similar), co-sell mechanisms, and partner portals — hands-on, not just supervisory.

  • Track record of building alliance programs from scratch — not just inheriting and running an existing book.

  • Experience leading and developing a team; comfortable setting direction and coaching without a large management structure behind you.

  • Comfortable operating at executive level with partners and customers, and hands-on enough to manage program mechanics personally when needed.

  • Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate partner programs into clear internal playbooks and joint value propositions.

  • Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem — enough to have credible conversations about implementation approaches and enterprise AI adoption challenges.

  • Vertical depth in Financial Services or Life Sciences — Anthropic's and Provectus's primary enterprise target markets.

  • Experience managing GCP, OpenAI, or other emerging AI ecosystem partnerships is preferred.

  • Willingness to travel (up to 40%) for customer meetings, executive briefings, onsite workshops, conferences, and other business development activities.

What success looks like:

  • Anthropic activation programs running as a repeatable, funded motion with a growing pipeline of customer engagements quarter over quarter.

  • AWS AI competency requirements current, with Premier Tier standing maintained and co-sell pipeline growing quarter over quarter.

  • Named executive relationships at both partners who actively advocate for Provectus in joint accounts.

  • An alliances team with clear ownership, operating cadence, and measurable partner-sourced revenue contribution.

About Provectus:

  • Provectus is an Artificial Intelligence consultancy and solutions provider, helping businesses achieve their objectives through AI and data-driven innovation organization-wide in such industries as Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & CPG, Media & Entertainment, and Manufacturing.
  • We are recognized by industry analysts as a leading provider of AI solutions across key business domains.
  • At Provectus, we value innovation, ownership, and collaboration — and we are looking for people who want to grow with us and make an impact.

Why Join Us:

  • Genuine autonomy and the trust to operate in your lane without micromanagement.
  • World-class AI/ML delivery capability behind you — a team that can actually execute on what you sell or source.
  • You will shape how a fast-growing AI consultancy goes to market at a defining moment for enterprise AI adoption.
  • High-impact role with direct visibility to leadership.
  • Strong earning potential with performance-based bonuses.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI and cloud solutions.
  • B2B contract model or full-time model.
  • OTE range $250k. The salary range is determined through interviews and a review of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, and alignment with market data.
  • Unlimited Vacation policy.
  • Generous health, vision, and dental insurance.
  • 401(K) matching plan.
