Overview

Be inspired. Be valued. Belong. At Emory Healthcare

At Emory Healthcare we fuel your professional journey with better benefits, valuable resources, ongoing mentorship and leadership programs for all types of jobs, and a supportive environment that enables you to reach new heights in your career and be what you want to be. We provide:

  • Comprehensive health benefits that start day 1
  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance & Reimbursement Programs
  • Family-focused benefits
  • Wellness incentives
  • Ongoing mentorship, development, leadership programs
  • And more

LOCATION:

Remote

This position is remote; however, applicants must be physically located and authorized to work in one of the following states: Alabama, Arkansas, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Michigan, New Hamsphire, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylavnia, South Caroline, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

Description

This position ensures the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of medical coding and clinical documentation for professional coding services. The role supports accurate coding practices, appropriate reimbursement, and regulatory compliance by reviewing patient records and collaborating with healthcare providers, coding teams, and compliance staff.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Ensures the accuracy, completeness, and compliance of medical coding and documentation for professional coding services.• Reviews patient records, clinical documentation, and coded data to identify discrepancies and coding issues.• Works closely with healthcare providers, coders, and compliance teams to support accurate professional coding practices.• Supports appropriate reimbursement and mitigates compliance risks through detailed coding reviews.• Conducts comprehensive chart reviews to evaluate coding accuracy and documentation quality.• Evaluates provider documentation to ensure appropriate coding and regulatory compliance.• Participates in routine audits to maintain high standards of coding accuracy and compliance.• Provides education and training to healthcare professionals regarding coding standards and documentation improvement.• Analyzes coding data to identify trends, opportunities for improvement, and compliance risks.• Generates audit reports summarizing findings and recommendations.

AUDIT AND REVIEW

• Conducts regular audits of medical coding to verify accuracy, completeness, and compliance with ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and other coding systems.• Evaluates coding practices against payer guidelines, regulatory requirements, and internal organizational policies.

COMPLIANCE MONITORING

• Ensures adherence to federal and state regulations including CMS guidelines and HIPAA standards.• Identifies discrepancies or violations and recommends corrective actions.

REPORTING AND DOCUMENTATION

• Prepares detailed audit reports outlining findings, trends, and recommendations for improvement.• Documents audit procedures, results, and issues in a clear and organized manner.

STAY CURRENT

• Maintains up-to-date knowledge of coding guidelines, healthcare regulations, and industry best practices.• Participates in relevant workshops, seminars, and continuing education programs as required.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent required.• Two years of post-secondary education in a business or medical-related field preferred.• Two years of experience in a medical billing or coding office required; medical management experience preferred.• Equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.• Coding certification through a nationally recognized organization such as AAPC or AHIMA required (CCS-P, CPC, RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC-H).

• Minimum of two years of experience working in a medical billing, coding, or healthcare revenue cycle environment preferred.• Experience with medical coding, auditing, or chart review in a healthcare setting preferred.• Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Strong knowledge of medical terminology, anatomy, and coding systems.• Strong written and verbal communication skills.• Thorough understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in documentation review.• Ability to analyze coding data and identify discrepancies or improvement opportunities.

Additional Details

Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

Emory Healthcare is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. Please contact Emory Healthcare’s Human Resources at . Please note that one week's advance notice is preferred.

jobs.description:
About Welo Life Sciences

Welo Life Sciences, a Welo Global brand, is a specialized language and technology partner serving pharmaceutical, CRO, and medical device organizations operating in regulated global markets. We deliver regulator-ready translation, linguistic validation, and localization solutions that support clinical trials, pharmacovigilance, regulatory affairs, labeling, and global commercialization. Our approach combines subject matter expertise with ISO-certified quality processes and technology-enabled workflows designed to integrate seamlessly into life sciences operations. With extensive experience supporting global product development and post-market requirements, Welo Life Sciences helps organizations accelerate timelines, protect data integrity, and maintain compliance across languages and regions. All solutions are delivered within a secure, audit-ready framework supported by seven ISO certifications. welolifesciences.com

About the Role

We are looking for experienced French (France) to English (GB and US) linguists to support a high-volume, fast-turnaround pharmacovigilance program for a leading global pharmaceutical company. Work involves translating and reviewing safety and regulatory content, including adverse event reports and related clinical documentation, with strict turnaround times and deadlines.

This is an ongoing freelance engagement with daily volumes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate pharmacovigilance and/or clinical-regulatory content from French into English.
  • Perform Machine Translation Post-Editing (MTPE) on machine-translated safety content.
  • Perform Copy Edit review of translated/post-edited content for accuracy, tone, and consistency.
  • Meet strict, non-extendable turnaround times on time-sensitive safety content.
  • Occasionally support Transcription tasks, retyping scanned or handwritten PDFs into Word for downstream translation (requires a personal Gmail account for client platform access).
  • Work within the client's CAT tool environment (XTM) following project-specific setup instructions.

Requirements

  • Degree in translation, linguistics or languages studies or an equivalent degree that includes significant
    translation training.
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience translating Life Sciences documents.
  • Experience translating pharmacovigilance content preferred: SAE/AE (serious and non-serious adverse events), PSURs, SUSARs, ICSRs, DSURs, Risk Management Plans (RMP).
  • Alternatively, experience translating regulatory or clinical documents: medical reports, protocols, synopses, ICF, discharge reports, study reports, SmPC, PIL, or medical literature.
  • Great daily availability: this program requires consistent daily capacity and is not suited to part-time schedules.
  • Strong French proficiency; native level of English preferred but not mandatory.
  • Experience with XTM or similar CAT tools.
  • Reliable, deadline-driven, and flexible, able to commit to fast turnaround times with no extensions.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare professional (HCP) background: nurse or physician preferred, especially with emergency room experience. Other HCP backgrounds also welcome.
  • Availability to cover US business hours.
  • Willingness to commit to daily and/or weekend availability.

Tools & Systems

  • CAT tool: XTM, client-provided license; onboarding and connector setup provided after onboarding.
  • A personal Gmail account is required for linguists supporting Transcription tasks, for access to a client platform.

Before Applying

Please note there will be an assessment as part of our onboarding and quality procedure, please only apply if you're willing to complete our assessment.
Please ensure your latest English CV accurately reflects your Life Sciences and Medical translation experience, including years of experience specifically in Life Sciences, the document types you’ve translated, CAT tool you've used, and relevant details also your contact information (email AND phone number).
Beware of recruitment scams. Welo Global and all of its brands never recruit through direct messages on social media or WhatsApp, and never asks candidates to pay money for a job. Official emails come only from @welocalize.com, @welodata.ai, or @hire.lever.co, and all applications go through jobs.lever.co/weloglobal. Be wary of unexpected offers, generic email addresses (such as Gmail or Yahoo), and requests for fees or sensitive information. Report suspicious messages and learn more: Recognizing Scams and Confirming Legitimate Welocalize Communications – Welo Global
We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

As the Senior IT Internal Auditor, you will execute a risk-based audit plan that supports responsible growth, protects the integrity and security of our technology platforms, and strengthens IT general controls and technology risk management across our cloud infrastructure, applications, and data environments. You will work cross-functionally with leaders from Technology & Security, Finance, Operations, and Legal and Compliance to assess risks, evaluate the company’s control environment, and deliver actionable insights that support strategic objectives.

In this role, you will contribute to building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement by translating audit objectives into meaningful business and technology enhancements, identifying improvement opportunities, and helping to ensure the company is well-positioned to scale responsibly and meet regulatory expectations. The ideal candidate will combine strong IT audit fundamentals with experience auditing cloud platforms and a growing understanding of digital platforms, online transactions, and gaming operations.

Key responsibilities:

  • Support the development and execution of a risk-based internal audit plan aligned with the company’s strategic objectives and goals.

  • Assist in performing periodic risk assessments and evaluating the design and adequacy of the company’s IT risk and control framework.

  • Lead and execute ITGC audits covering logical access, change management, IT operations, and data integrity across cloud infrastructure and critical business applications.

  • Perform other technology audits, such as cloud security, identity and access management, vulnerability management, and backup and disaster recovery.

  • Perform walkthroughs and control testing across IT general controls (ITGCs) and application controls supporting internal controls over financial reporting and key technology processes.

  • Collaborate with Information Security and Compliance teams to align audit activities with applicable gaming regulations, technical standards, PCI and data privacy requirements across jurisdictions.

  • Assess IT risks related to third-party and cloud service providers, including review of SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports.

  • Test the completeness and accuracy of information produced by the entity (IPE), including system-generated reports and queries used in key controls.

  • Leverage data analytics and technology-enabled audit techniques to evaluate automated controls, identify trends and anomalies, and assess emerging risks associated with cloud systems and artificial intelligence.

  • Prepare clear and concise audit documentation and reports, summarizing findings and recommendations for improvement.

  • Partner with stakeholders to communicate audit results and support appropriate remediation efforts.

  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external auditors to streamline audit activities and knowledge sharing.

  • Remain current on technology and cybersecurity risks, regulatory developments, and internal audit best practices.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, or related field.

  • 3+ years of IT audit experience in internal audit, information security, technology risk assurance or governance, risk and compliance roles.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CIA, cloud certifications (e.g., AWS), or other relevant credentials are a plus but not required.

  • Strong understanding of IT general controls (ITGCs) and IT application controls supporting internal controls over financial reporting.

  • Working knowledge of IT governance frameworks such as COSO, COBIT, NIST CSF and ISO 27001.

  • Familiarity with reviewing SOC 1 and SOC 2 reports and evaluating related control implications.

  • Experience auditing technology in regulated environments such as gaming, digital gaming, fintech, payments, or technology sectors desirable.

  • Experience auditing cloud-based computing and data platforms (e.g., AWS, Snowflake) and identity and access management, with the ability to assess automated controls and system interfaces.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills and ability to prioritize risk, focus on impact, and deliver value through audit execution.

  • Ability to work effectively across time zones and occasionally travel for strategic in-person working sessions.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits.

  • Flexible vacation allowance.

  • Remote or Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the flexibility of remote work, with opportunities for in-person collaboration at our various headquarter locations.

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, Treasury & Payments
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT ARBOREALArboreal Management is a fast-growing, tech-enabled and fully integrated real estate platform for the Pacific Northwest, primarily focused on affordable housing.
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARBOREAL

Arboreal Management is a fast-growing, tech-enabled and fully integrated real estate platform for the Pacific Northwest, primarily focused on affordable housing. We develop, remodel and manage housing that addresses our region’s most critical needs. Our mission: deliver below-market rents to residents while achieving above-market returns for investors.

  • Arboreal Management — property management, 8,000+ apartment homes.

  • Arboreal Construction — in-house construction, renovations and ground-up projects.

  • Great Expectations — development and investment platform; 120+ investors, 20 projects delivered.


THE ROLE

We are hiring a Senior Accountant to own treasury and payment processing for a portfolio spanning several hundred property and ownership entities. Cash sits in many accounts across many owners, and every payment, transfer and lender debit has to land in the right one, on time, recorded correctly on both sides, with a clean audit trail.

This role is for an accountant, not only an operator. You will run the daily cash and payment calendar, and you will also book what moved, reconcile it and be able to defend it to an owner, a lender or an auditor. You will not have unilateral release authority — every outgoing payment is prepared by you and approved by someone else — but you will be the person who knows, at any hour, where the cash is, what is about to move and whether the books agree.

We move quickly and the work does not arrive in a neat queue. We want someone who sets their own priorities, closes their own loops and tells us early when something will not make it, without waiting to be asked. You will also support moves between banking partners as relationships change, and help set up ACH and lender auto-payments when a property comes on.


WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Cash positioning and bank reconciliation

  • Maintain the daily and weekly cash position across all managed bank accounts, by entity and by ownership group.

  • Reconcile bank activity to the general ledger and clear differences rather than noting them; keep reconciling items current and aged.

  • Flag accounts trending toward shortfall far enough ahead that funding decisions can still be made calmly.

  • Keep the account inventory accurate — openings, closings, signers, ownership changes and entity renames.

Payment decisions and processing

  • Apply our payment rules to approved bills: review what is due against available cash by property and decide approve, hold or partial-pay, with the reasoning stated.

  • Prioritize by exposure rather than by age: utilities at shutoff risk, taxes and insurance, debt service and lien-capable vendors ahead of discretionary spend.

  • Build payment batches for approval, then release and record them once approved.

  • Send bills that look duplicated, miscoded or unsupported back to the AP team before they are paid, rather than paying and correcting later.

  • Answer vendor questions about payment status and timing.

Wires, ACH and lender administration

  • Prepare wires and ACH transactions for review and approval, with complete supporting documentation attached.

  • Verify payee banking details against an independent source before a payment is queued, and apply our callback verification standard to any new or changed instruction.

  • Track same-day cutoffs across our banking partners, confirm settlement, and follow returns, rejects and recalls through to resolution.

  • Complete and maintain lender banking forms and ACH debit authorizations, and keep a current register of which lender debits which account, on what day, for what amount.

  • Help with ACH setup forms and lender auto-payment setup for new properties, and confirm the first payment debits the right account.

Debt service and intercompany funding

  • Track scheduled debt service by property and by lender: due date, amount, funding account and clearing status.

  • Identify upcoming payments the property’s own cash will not cover, and assemble the funding options for review.

  • Record loan payments, escrow activity and transfers between related entities on both sides, and reconcile due-to and due-from balances so they agree.

  • Reconcile what was scheduled against what actually cleared, every cycle, and escalate the exceptions.

Month-end close and audit support

  • Prepare journal entries and accruals for cash, payment, intercompany and debt activity, with support a reviewer can follow without asking.

  • Reconcile cash, intercompany and loan balances at month end and deliver them on the close calendar.

  • Prepare audit-ready workpapers and respond to requests from external auditors, lenders and owners.

  • Spot errors upstream — duplicate payments, payments booked to the wrong entity, transfers recorded on one side only — and fix the cause, not just the entry.

Bank transitions

  • Support account migrations between banking partners, and keep the cutover tracker current daily — what has moved, what is pending, and what is still debiting the old account.

  • Confirm every recurring debit, autopay and transfer has been repointed before an old account is closed. This step is where transitions fail, and it will be yours to get right.

Process and controls

  • Write and maintain the procedures for the work you own, so anyone on the team can pick it up.

  • Tighten controls where you find gaps, and bring audit-grade documentation habits to day-to-day work.

  • Help us automate repetitive treasury and payment work, testing new tools and payment rails before live volume runs through them.


WHAT YOU BRING

Required

  • A bachelor’s degree in accounting, or in finance with substantial accounting coursework.

  • Five or more years of progressive accounting experience, including at least two years in public accounting (audit or assurance).

  • A background in accounts payable and in treasury or cash management, including hands-on execution of wires and ACH.

  • Experience managing cash and payments across a large number of bank accounts, legal entities and distinct clients at the same time — not a single-entity cash cycle. This is the single most important qualification for the role.

  • A solid command of accrual accounting: you can prepare and support journal entries, accruals and reconciliations without a template to follow.

  • Self-direction in a fast-paced environment: you plan your own week, keep many parallel obligations straight without being reminded, and re-prioritize calmly when something urgent lands.

  • Advanced Excel: lookups, pivots, reconciliation to the penny, and comfort building a working file someone else can follow.

  • Strong written English and the confidence to raise a problem early, in writing, without being asked.

  • A reconciliation mindset: an unexplained variance is something to chase down, not to annotate.

  • A reliable home working setup — stable high-speed internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup connection — to support a six-hour Pacific overlap.

Strongly preferred

  • An active CPA license (Philippine or US).

  • Real estate or property management accounting background, including trust or client-funds handling. Preferred, not required — we will teach the real estate context to a strong accountant.

  • Hands-on work in AppFolio, or a comparable property management accounting platform.

  • Experience with commercial bank portals, positive pay and ACH origination files.

  • Exposure to lender servicing, loan payment administration or covenant reporting.

  • A track record of writing the procedure for work you were the first to do, and of using automation or AI tools to take manual steps out of a process.


HOW WE WORK

  • Segregation of duties is absolute. You prepare and document; an approver releases. Nobody, at any level, works around this.

  • Payment instruction changes are verified by callback to a known contact, never by reply to the email that requested the change.

  • Client funds are client funds. Entity boundaries are never crossed to solve a timing problem.

  • You own your work end to end. We would rather hear about a problem early from you than late from a vendor, a lender or an owner.

  • Recurring work gets written down. We would rather spend an hour documenting a process than repeat a month of guesswork.


ENGAGEMENT TERMS

  • This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. You invoice us for hours worked and are responsible for your own taxes and statutory contributions in your country of residence.

  • Company-paid benefits, leave accrual and statutory employment entitlements do not apply to a contractor engagement.

  • You supply your own computer and internet connection. We provide software licenses and system access.

  • We will ask you to complete a Form W-8BEN so we can document your non-US status for tax purposes.


TO APPLY

Send your resume together with a short note covering two things: the largest number of bank accounts and legal entities you have managed cash and payments across at one time, and one example — from public accounting or industry — of an error you caught before it became someone else’s problem, and what you changed so it would not happen again.

Job Summary

The Director of Strategic Accounts leads projects and training staff to support existing strategic programs, as well as identify and pursue opportunities for new programs and locations based on industry trends and marketplace demand. The Director is responsible for hiring and overseeing the personnel required to implement strategic programs and maintain performance levels that meet and exceed client expectations. The Director seeks to grow division revenue and points of presence through both successful program deployments and expansion activities. This role requires a highly motivated individual with excellent leadership, communication, and analytical skills to align division objectives with client needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensures new client training programs for all segments are deployed on time and under budget to meet strategic program goals.

  • Applies program/project management best practices to track milestones, activities, and due dates for existing programs.

  • Maintain operational efficiency by monitoring key performance metrics including student testing pass yields, student and client surveys, and operating expenses.

  • Supports the implementation of key departmental policies and procedures, conferring with CDL and Operations staff as necessary.

  • Assists with recruitment, onboarding, and training of key program staff to ensure staffing meets overall program objectives.

  • Assists with the development of effective training programs to provide the best return of staff investment.

  • Coach and mentor staff to develop the careers of others and improve individual and team performance.

  • Develop and execute account strategies to maintain and grow key client relationships.

  • Maintains a regular cadence of client communications to ensure program objectives are met and to address and resolve any issues negatively impacting the client’s level of service.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for strategic accounts, ensuring customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships.

  • Identify and capitalize on growth opportunities within existing accounts to increase revenue and market share.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and customer success teams to drive customer engagement and retention.

  • Provides programmatic input for strategic planning and AT program implementation processes.

  • Analyzes market viability and determines the value of new or existing programs to achieve maximum ROI for program investments.

  • Assists with establishing relationships with clients, staff, industry influencers, and key strategic partners.

  • Provides informal coaching and feedback to program personnel on various sales related strategies/tactics.

  • Generate and analyze operations reports and provide insights to executive leadership.

  • Serves as a subject matter expert on AT program efforts to internal and external constituents.

  • Ensure training locations have all of the required supplies and resources to effectively operate the training program.

Education and Experience Required

  • 3 years of customer/client account management

  • 3 years of operational management experience, preferably with direct educational management experience.

  • Multi-site oversight experience.

  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices, and procedures within adult education.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills; effectively utilizes.

  • Knowledge and application of core program/project management methods, techniques, and best practices.

  • Excellent leadership, problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Intermediate knowledge and application of MS Office Suite products.

  • Ability to rapidly adapt and respond to changes in environment and priorities.

  • Ability to elicit cooperation and collaboration from AT leadership and other departments.

  • Excellent word processing, database management, and graphic skills.

  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, and planning skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Ability to operate in a dynamic and flexible environment with confidence and poise.

  • Collaborates effectively throughout the matrix organization toward the attainment of the division’s objectives.

  • Demonstrates and models a strong sense of personal accountability for actions and attainment of operational goals.

  • Champions innovation and positive change and adopts creative ways to solve problems.

Education and Experience Preferred

  • Previous experience as a campus and/or department manager in a proprietary education setting.

  • Experience with academic and administrative platforms or other industry-related software.

  • Experience with regulatory compliance guidelines in the education industry or a related sector.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; talk or hear; taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

jobs.description:
Summary

Yelp connects people with great local businesses. Our platform is powered by a vibrant community contributing reviews and engaging with local businesses daily. We monetize primarily through advertising, helping millions of businesses connect with high-intent consumers. The Ads Auction system sits at the heart of this exchange, determining which ads are shown for every opportunity.

The Ads Market Dynamics team is responsible for the core engine that drives Yelp's advertising business. We develop and optimize the sophisticated auction, bidding, and pacing systems that balance advertiser value (ROI), consumer experience, and Yelp's monetization goals. We work at the intersection of economics, machine learning, and large-scale systems engineering.

As the Principal Product Manager for Ads Auction and Measurement, you will own the product strategy and execution for Yelp's core ad auction, bidding, pricing, budget pacing mechanisms, and corresponding measurements. This is a highly technical leadership role where you will guide the evolution of algorithms and systems that make real-time decisions maximizing value across multiple stakeholders. You will define how we measure the performance and impact of these complex systems, focusing on both short-term efficiency and long-term impact. You will partner closely with world-class engineering and applied science teams to design, experiment, implement, and iterate on auction dynamics and the metrics that guide our progress.

This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular state within the US. We welcome applicants from throughout the US. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes.

What you'll do:

  • Auction Strategy & Roadmap: Define and drive the product roadmap for Yelp's ads auction, bidding algorithms, pricing mechanisms, and budget pacing systems, ensuring alignment with business objectives and competitive dynamics. Identify key levers for optimization and innovation.
  • Algorithm & System Optimization: Partner deeply with Engineering and Data Science to design, develop, and refine the auction-based ad selection system. Translate advertiser goals (ROI, leads, conversions), user experience, and monetization considerations into algorithmic requirements, and prioritize initiatives based on concrete data and expected impact.
  • Auction Measurement & Evaluation: Define and own the key metrics framework for evaluating auction health, efficiency, and the business impact. Drive the development of robust measurement for complex trade-offs (e.g., relevance vs. monetization, short-term vs. long-term effects). Design and interpret large-scale A/B tests.
  • Independent Data Analysis: Conduct hands-on analysis of large-scale auction and advertising datasets using tools like SQL and Python to uncover optimization opportunities, validate hypotheses, understand performance drivers, and inform product decisions.
  • Technical Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for auction-related features and improvements, from ideation and requirements definition through launch and iteration.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as the product leader for the auction domain, collaborating effectively with Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Finance, and other Product teams. Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Drive Business Impact: Directly influence Yelp's revenue and advertiser success by improving the efficiency and effectiveness of the core ad marketplace.

What it takes to succeed:

The Mission Technology Solutions business partners with governments and defense, intelligence, space, aviation, and critical infrastructure customers to deliver high-end engineering, science, technology, and mission support solutions.

Marcura connects the critical workflows that keep global shipping moving, from port spend management and procurement to compliance and financial transactions. T

The Compliance Analyst (KYC & KYB) sits in Marcura's Compliance team and carries out first line customer due diligence across the Group's regulated and unregulated business units. The Analyst onboards and reviews individual and corporate customers and counterparties, verifying identity, ownership and control, source of funds and nature of business, and applies enhanced due diligence to higher risk relationships and PEPs. Every decision is made in line with Marcura policy and procedure and is written up clearly on the case file. Where the Analyst knows or suspects money laundering or terrorist financing, they report it to the MLRO.

Requirements

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

List 5 to 8 primary accountabilities. Begin each with a strong action verb.

  • Complete KYC and KYB checks on new individual and corporate customers and counterparties at onboarding, verifying identity, legal existence, directors, nature of business, source of funds and expected account activity, and making sure no relationship goes live until due diligence is complete.
  • Identify and verify the ultimate beneficial owners and controllers of corporate customers, working through layered or offshore ownership structures and recording how each has been confirmed.
  • Assess and record a customer risk rating in line with Marcura's risk assessment methodology, taking account of jurisdiction, industry, ownership complexity and the products used.
  • Apply enhanced due diligence to higher risk relationships and politically exposed persons, obtaining further evidence of source of funds and source of wealth and preparing the file for senior approval.
  • Conduct periodic and event-driven reviews of existing customers, refreshing documents and information, re-assessing the risk rating and confirming the relationship remains within risk appetite.
  • Respond to requests for information from our banking partners on customer identity, ownership and due diligence records accurately and by the deadline given, flagging any request that raises a wider concern.
  • Report any knowledge or suspicion of money laundering or terrorist financing identified during due diligence to the MLRO straight away through an internal suspicious activity report, without tipping off the customer or anyone else.

Marcura | Compliance Analyst Page 2

  • Maintain complete and accurate due diligence files and risk assessments in the case management system, and raise recurring documentation gaps or onboarding issues with management.

Education

Certifications

ICA, ACAMS or an equivalent CDD/financial crime qualification preferred.

Min. Experience

2 to 4 years in a KYC/KYB or customer due diligence role is desirable. Experience in a firm regulated in the UK, Portugal or elsewhere in Europe is also desirable but not required.

Industry

Payments, e-money, banking or fintech preferred. Maritime, shipping or cross-border payments experience is a plus.

Skills

Good attention to detail, sound judgement on beneficial ownership and risk rating, clear written case notes, and the ability to manage a workload of onboarding and periodic reviews against deadlines.

Language

English required

Preferred prior knowledge of customer and enhanced due diligence standards, beneficial ownership verification, PEP risk assessment, and a working understanding of UK and EU anti-money laundering requirements.

jobs.title: Finance & Operation Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?

At Really Great Reading, we are building a bright, diverse, and passionate team dedicated to leading the industry in improving literacy scores nationwide. With nearly two decades of leadership bringing the Science of Reading to thousands of schools, we design innovative products, training, and materials that transform how educators teach and how students learn. Here, we empower our team with the tools, support, and professional growth opportunities they need to thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment—where your work truly makes a difference.

Why This Role Matters

Behind every informed business decision at Really Great Reading is accurate data, thoughtful analysis, and an understanding of how our business operates. As our organization evolves, we need to understand what drives performance, where processes need improvement, and how to invest resources to best support the educators and students we serve.

The Finance and Operations Analyst connects financial analysis with the everyday operations of our business. Working across departments, this role helps leaders investigate challenges, evaluate resource needs, improve processes, and translate data into practical decisions.

Success in this role means delivering trusted financial and operational insights, identifying the root causes of business challenges, improving systems and workflows, and independently moving projects from an initial question to an actionable solution.

The Role

We are seeking a resourceful, analytical Finance and Operations Analyst to support business analysis, financial planning, performance reporting, and operational improvement across Really Great Reading. This is a business operations role with a financial analysis core, partnering closely with Finance and Operations leadership and colleagues across departments.

The ideal candidate brings experience connecting operational activity to financial outcomes. They ask thoughtful questions, investigate beyond the numbers, and help determine whether a business need calls for additional resources, a process change, or a system improvement. They are comfortable with evolving priorities and can organize and move work forward without step-by-step direction.

What You’ll Do

Business and Operational Analysis

  • Partner with teams across the organization to define business questions, identify relevant data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Analyze workload, service demand, staffing capacity, costs, and process performance to support resource planning.
  • Investigate the underlying causes of operational challenges and evaluate whether staffing, process changes, system improvements, or other investments would best address them.
  • Combine financial and operational data to assess business needs, compare options, and recommend next steps.
  • Proactively identify trends, inefficiencies, and emerging issues that warrant further investigation.

Financial Planning and Analysis

  • Prepare financial reports and budget-to-actual variance analyses, explaining key drivers and their business implications.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning, and updates to financial models.
  • Translate operational assumptions, including staffing needs and changes in business activity, into financial projections.
  • Build and maintain models that compare scenarios and help leaders evaluate costs, tradeoffs, and potential investments.
  • Conduct ad hoc analysis to support planning and business decisions.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting

  • Collaborate with department partners to define and monitor meaningful key performance indicators.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that make financial and operational performance easier to understand.
  • Gather, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources, investigating discrepancies and coordinating corrections.
  • Present findings clearly, explaining what the data shows, why it matters, and what action it supports.
  • Document data sources, assumptions, and reporting methods to improve consistency and reliability.

Process Improvement and Systems Support

  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve data and reporting accuracy.
  • Work with stakeholders to implement process improvements and assess whether changes achieve their intended results.
  • Support the day-to-day administration of financial and operational tools, including systems such as Ramp.
  • Help maintain system users and access, including adding and removing users in coordination with established approval processes.
  • Document workflows and support colleagues in using systems and processes effectively.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Project Ownership

  • Build relationships across departments to understand business needs and connect operational activity with financial outcomes.
  • Manage analytical and process improvement projects from problem definition through recommendations and implementation support.
  • Organize priorities, track progress, and communicate dependencies or roadblocks.
  • Balance recurring reporting and operational responsibilities with new projects and emerging needs.
  • Take initiative to surface problems and propose solutions while keeping stakeholders informed.

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Five or more years of relevant experience in business analysis, operations analysis, financial planning and analysis, accounting, or a combination of related roles.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing business or operational questions across functions and connecting findings to financial or resource decisions.
  • A strong foundation in financial analysis, including interpreting financial results and supporting planning, forecasting, or modeling.
  • Experience investigating root causes, evaluating alternatives, and recommending practical improvements.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, and complex formulas.
  • Experience working with ERP systems or other business platforms and combining data from multiple sources.
  • Experience creating reports, tracking performance measures, or developing dashboards.
  • Ability to manage projects independently, establish an approach, and follow through without step-by-step direction.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity, shifting priorities, and evolving processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to explain findings clearly to financial and nonfinancial audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a small or growing organization, or a role with broad responsibilities spanning finance and operations.
  • Experience with NetSuite, Ramp, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting business system administration, user access, or workflow improvements.
  • Experience analyzing staffing capacity, service demand, or operational efficiency.
  • Experience in education, educational technology, or a SaaS business.
  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant experience and demonstrated capabilities are valued regardless of academic background.

What We Offer

We take care of the whole person because we believe that when our team thrives, so do the students and educators we serve. Our benefits include:

  • Competitive 401(k) with company matching
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Paid Time Off to support rest, renewal, and life outside of work
  • Employee Discount Program and partner savings
  • Ongoing professional development and learning investment
  • Wellness initiatives designed to support physical, mental, and emotional well-being
  • Evolving benefits shaped by team member voice and values

Physical Requirements

This is a fully remote role. Team members work primarily at a computer and regularly engage in financial and operational analysis, document review, video conferencing, and digital collaboration. The role involves extended periods of computer-based work and participation in virtual meetings. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Really Great Reading is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performing workplace that reflects the diverse students, educators, and communities we serve. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation, improve learning outcomes, and advance educational equity nationwide.

All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Product Data Scientist SaaS
jobs.excerpt: Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language.
jobs.description:
Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

  • T1 2027

  • Préavis de 3 mois accepté

🏡 Type de contrat

  • CDI - temps plein

  • Séniorité : Confirmé(e)

🌍 Localisation

  • 100% Remote (Europe) ou hybride à Lausanne

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld opère plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement, vendus dans le monde entier. Nous maîtrisons l'ensemble du parcours client : acquisition, conversion, paiement, utilisation et fidélisation.

Nous recherchons un(e) ProductData Scientist SaaS pour nous aider à prendre de meilleures décisions tout au long de ce parcours. Ta mission : transformer les données en analyses fiables, en recommandations concrètes et en expérimentations capables de mesurer ce qui crée réellement de la valeur.

Tu auras un rôle central dans l'évolution de notre pratique de l'A/B testing : challenger les méthodes existantes, renforcer le cadre d'expérimentation et accompagner les équipes dans la conception et l'interprétation de leurs tests. Tu pourras aussi analyser des sujets variés, de la valeur client par canal d'acquisition à la performance des paiements et à la rétention.

C'est un poste très orienté business et expérimentation. L'entraînement de modèles de machine learning n'est pas au cœur du rôle : ce qui compte, c'est ta capacité à mobiliser les bonnes méthodes pour éclairer une décision et en mesurer l'impact.

Tu interviens sur l'ensemble de nos produits SaaS.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu seras rattaché(e) à Youssef JANJAR, notre Chief Data Officer. Tu rejoins un département Data en plein essor, aux côtés d'un Data Engineer et d'un(e) Data Analyst.

Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe Data, le CEO, les Product Managers et les équipes Marketing, Paiement et développement. Tu aides les équipes à formuler leurs questions, à construire des tests pertinents et à transformer leurs résultats en décisions.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Expérimentation & A/B testing

  • Challenger notre processus actuel de conception et d'analyse des A/B tests, identifier ses limites et proposer des améliorations

  • Faire évoluer et mettre en place un cadre d'expérimentation robuste : formulation des hypothèses, choix des métriques, calcul de puissance, durée des tests et règles de décision

  • Concevoir et relire les plans de test avec les équipes avant lancement, puis challenger leur design et leur interprétation

  • Analyser les résultats à maturité, expliciter leurs limites et recommander les décisions à prendre

  • Faire évoluer les méthodes et les outils tout en les gardant suffisamment simples pour rendre les équipes autonomes

Analyse du parcours client & de la performance

  • Explorer les données d'acquisition, de conversion, d'usage, de paiement et de rétention pour comprendre les leviers de croissance et de revenu

  • Analyser les funnels et les cohortes, identifier les points de friction et proposer des hypothèses ou des tests à fort impact

  • Collaborer avec l'équipe Paiement sur les analyses et expérimentations liées à la performance des transactions et au risque

Valeur client & acquisition

  • Analyser la valeur des client(e)s par cohorte, canal d'acquisition, produit ou segment, en tenant compte de la maturité des données

  • Faire évoluer les analyses de LTV, de coût d'acquisition et de payback pour éclairer les décisions marketing et business

  • Avec le Data Engineer, explorer et améliorer l'utilisation des signaux de valeur dans les plateformes publicitaires, puis en mesurer l'impact

Collaboration & aide à la décision

  • Transformer les questions de la direction et des équipes en analyses et protocoles adaptés

  • Travailler avec le ou la Data Analyst et le Data Engineer pour fiabiliser les données et partager des définitions de métriques cohérentes

  • Communiquer clairement les résultats, les incertitudes et les recommandations à des interlocuteur(rice)s techniques et business

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en Data Science produit, growth ou dans un rôle analytique comparable

  • Expérience sur un produit à fort trafic ou avec des volumes de données importants, en SaaS, abonnement, e-commerce ou dans un contexte comparable

  • Expérience pratique de la conception et de l'analyse d'expérimentations, et de l'amélioration d'un produit ou d'une performance business grâce à la donnée

  • Une familiarité avec les données marketing, les interactions utilisateur(rice)s ou les paiements est appréciée ; tu n'as pas besoin d'être spécialiste de tous ces domaines

Compétences techniques

  • Solides bases en statistiques et en inférence, et capacité à choisir une méthode adaptée à la question posée

  • Design et analyse d'expériences : hypothèses, puissance statistique, tests multiples, métriques et maturité des cohortes

  • SQL avancé et Python pour l'analyse de données et les statistiques

  • Analyse de funnels et de cohortes, rétention et valeur client ; connaissance de la modélisation de LTV appréciée

  • Expérience avec un entrepôt de données et des outils d'analytics produit ; familiarité avec les données de PSP ou les plateformes publicitaires appréciée

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Sens business et intuition produit : tu relies tes analyses aux décisions et à leur impact

  • Esprit critique : tu sais challenger une hypothèse, un test ou une conclusion, arguments à l'appui

  • Pédagogie : tu sais expliquer clairement tes résultats, leurs limites et leurs implications

  • Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à prioriser dans un rôle transverse

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais niveau B2 minimum - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

✅ Les avantages du poste

  • Un impact direct et mesurable sur les décisions et le revenu

  • Premier(e) data scientist de l'entreprise : un rôle à construire et beaucoup d'ownership

  • Une vision complète du parcours client sur plusieurs produits SaaS

  • Une méthode d'A/B testing déjà structurée et un outillage existant à challenger et à faire évoluer

  • Des échanges directs avec l'équipe Data, les équipes métier et la direction

👣 Les défis du poste

  • Faire évoluer les pratiques d'expérimentation tout en accompagnant les tests en cours

  • Prioriser les sujets entre plusieurs produits et équipes

  • Allier rigueur statistique, compréhension business et recommandations actionnables

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Entretien technique avec notre Chief Data Officer, Youssef

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo

  • Prise de références

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche

Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante

Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence

Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ?

Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

☕ Budget coworking Si tu préfères bosser hors de chez toi, on prend en charge ton espace de coworking à hauteur de 200 euros par mois pour plus de confort et de focus.

🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🖥️ Budget équipement On te donne un budget pour t'équiper avec tout ce qu'il te faut : ordinateur portable, bureau, chaise, écran, casque… tout pour être au top !

🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.

🏢 Pour les profils basés à Lausanne Bureaux modernes, accès au sport, parking et participation aux frais de déplacement.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE"Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP"Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY"We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH"Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

jobs.description:
At VC3, we don’t just solve IT problems — we own them. We serve hundreds of municipalities and organizations across the United States and Canada, bringing IT to the people who need it most. We believe in earning trust, having a growth mindset, and delivering excellence every single time.

We're a team of doers, builders, and tech whisperers who live by 4 core values:
Go Beyond | Own It | Be Curious| Serve as One
We pride ourselves on making IT personal, making IT easy, and getting IT right. And it all starts with our talented team that is committed to raising the bar.
The Impact you will have:
In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support to VC3 clients, with a strong focus on resolving client requests to their satisfaction. You will also assist your Service Technician teammates with their incident ticket workload when needed.

What you will be doing:

  • Provide end user support to VC3 clients via inbound phone, email and webchat, following ITIL founded triage model to determine the appropriate course of action
  • Troubleshoot technical issues including hardware (monitors, keyboards, printers), applications, VPN/remote access, network drives, DNS, and workstation performance issues
  • Support user account management in Active Directory, Exchange, and O365, including account set ups/terminations, password resets, email updates and permission changes
  • Perform standard service tasks such as IMAC (installs, moves, adds and changes) requests, software installs, system updates
  • Manage mobile and telephone support, including email set up on mobile, adjust phone systems, call forwarding and updating extensions
  • Investigate spam/phishing emails, secure compromised email accounts, and complete malware scan and removal
  • Escalate out of scope issues to the appropriate elevated team
  • Ensure proper documentation by updating tickets, changing logs, internal guides, and knowledge base articles
  • Participate in the on-call rotation (1 week every 3-4 months)
  • Additional duties as required

The tools you bring:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support or customer service position OR recent technical education experience in a post-secondary environment
  • Demonstrable understanding of Windows OS (7–11), Office Suite/365, Windows Server (2016–2025), Active Directory, DHCP, DNS, and Terminal Services, MS Entra environment
  • Go Beyond– you take that extra step to create moments that are unexpected but appreciated.
  • Own It - You have the courage to do what's right, the resolve to take responsibility, and the grit to cross the finish line.
  • Be Curious - You challenge the status quo and aim for continuous improvement and constant learning.
  • Serve as One - You believe that together, we are greater than the sum of our individuals, and that teamwork is essential to success.

What’s in it for you:

  • Flexibility– We’re remote-first, but not remote-only. Some roles include an onsite component, depending on team needs. We aim to give you the flexibility to do your best work, plus company-paid time off to help you thrive in work and in life.
  • Well-being & Support - Caring for our team goes beyond the workday. We offer a range of benefits to support your overall well-being, from mental health and leave support through our Employee and Family Assistance Program, to financial wellness through company-matched 401(k)/RRSP plans. Whether it’s today’s needs or tomorrow’s goals, we’ve got you covered.
  • Grow with Us – Whether you’re just getting started or ready to take the next step, we are committed to investing in your growth. We offer structured development through our Leadership Academy, monthly learning sessions, mentorship programs, learning reimbursements, internal career fairs, job shadowing, and personalized career-pathing to support internal mobility.
  • People-First Culture – We live our values, support each other, and create a space where everyone belongs. We have a common goal of doing work that matters, with autonomy, recognition, and a mission to serve those who serve.
  • Transparent Leadership – From open communication to clear company goals, our leaders are involved, and our managers are here to support your growth every step of the way.

About Docketly

Docketly, a sister company to ABC Legal Services, is redefining legal support services. We make it easy, fast, and reliable for creditors'-rights attorneys to connect with court-hearing opportunities, pairing proprietary software with a nationwide attorney network. Based in Longmont, Colorado, we move fast and value people who do the same.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Full-Cycle Recruiter to own attorney recruiting from first contact to signed offer. This is not a coordinator role — you will build your own pipeline, source your own candidates, get on the phone, and close. You'll run a full desk: sourcing, screening, pitching, negotiating, and closing attorneys, with a monthly target of 15–20 hires. If you've run a recruiting desk before and know what it takes to hit a number every month, this role is built for you.

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting. Manage every stage of the hiring process for attorney roles — intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer negotiation, and close — with minimal handholding.
  • Source your own candidates. Build and work your own pipeline using LinkedIn Recruiter, bar association directories, referrals, and other channels. You are not waiting on inbound applicants.
  • Cold-call and pitch. Reach out directly to passive and active attorney candidates, pitch the opportunity, handle objections, and move qualified candidates through the process quickly.
  • Build your book of business. Develop and maintain a growing network of attorney relationships and referral sources you can call on for current and future openings.
  • Hit your number. Deliver 15–20 attorney hires per month against a clear quota, with visibility into your pipeline health and conversion at every stage.
  • Partner with hiring stakeholders. Work closely with practice leaders and operations to understand role requirements, market conditions, and shifting priorities.
  • Keep clean records. Log activity, candidate status, and outcomes accurately in the ATS/CRM so your pipeline and results are always current.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including sourcing your own candidates rather than relying on inbound flow.
  • Proven experience recruiting attorneys or other licensed/credentialed professionals.
  • Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling and cold outreach; not deterred by hearing “no.”
  • A track record of building and running your own candidate pipeline / book of business.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills — you can handle objections and get candidates to commit.
  • Demonstrated ability to consistently hit a monthly hiring quota (15–20+ hires/month or comparable volume).
  • Skilled with an ATS/CRM and sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, etc.).
  • Highly organized and self-directed; able to run a full desk without close supervision.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred (nice to have, not required)

  • Prior experience recruiting specifically for attorney or legal roles at scale.
  • Background in agency recruiting or RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing) where you owned a desk end-to-end.
  • Familiarity with legal industry credentialing, bar admission requirements, or practice-area nuances.
  • Experience recruiting in a high-volume, metrics-driven environment.

You'll Thrive Here If You've Worked In...

Agency recruiting, legal recruiting, executive search, high-volume corporate recruiting, or any desk-owning role where you sourced, pitched, negotiated, and closed candidates against a hard number.

  • Full-cycle recruiting
  • Candidate sourcing and cold outreach
  • Pipeline building and book-of-business development
  • Negotiation and objection handling
  • Closing and offer management
  • ATS/CRM and sourcing tools
  • High-volume phone and email communication
  • Quota management and self-direction

jobs.excerpt: About Hilo by AktiiaHigh blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year.
jobs.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.

Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.

Core responsibilities

Direction & Outcomes

  • Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.
  • Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

  • Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.
  • Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.
  • Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.
  • Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.
  • 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.
  • Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.
  • High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.
  • Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.
  • Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.
  • Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.
  • Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.
  • A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

  • Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.

How you work

  • AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.
  • Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.
  • Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.
  • Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.
  • Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.
  • Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

  • You need all requirements, research and data before you start.
  • You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.
  • You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

  1. Recruiter screen (30 min)
  2. Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency
  3. Product thinking and interaction design deep dive
  4. Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product
  5. Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

  • You take something off our plate and it gets done.
  • If it won't happen, you tell us first.
  • You bring the problem, the root cause and options.
  • You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.
  • The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:

Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.

Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.
