Mainland China & Spain Market Expertise | Remote Freelance Opportunity

Company: Volga Partners
Department: Legal
Domain Specialization: Legal & Regulatory
Engagement Type: Freelance | Project-Based
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
Experience: 3–5 Years
Compensation: Proposed $18–$45 USD/hour, based on location, qualifications, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Legal & Regulatory Services

Are you a legal or regulatory professional with experience interpreting laws, evaluating compliance requirements, or conducting legal research? Interested in applying your professional expertise to emerging Artificial Intelligence (AI) technology?

Volga Partners is seeking experienced Legal & Regulatory Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to support a specialized AI content evaluation pilot focused on the legal and regulatory environments of Mainland China and Spain.

We're looking for professionals who understand how legal frameworks operate, how regulations are interpreted and applied, and how complex legal information should be evaluated within the appropriate jurisdiction.

In this role, you'll leverage your expertise to review AI-generated legal and regulatory content, assess legal reasoning, verify information against authoritative sources, and identify inaccuracies or unsupported conclusions.

This is not a traditional legal advisory or legal representation position. Instead, you'll apply your professional knowledge and analytical judgment to help improve the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of AI-generated legal information.

No prior AI evaluation experience is required. Your legal knowledge, research abilities, and market-specific expertise are what matter most.

Areas of Legal & Regulatory Expertise We're Seeking

We welcome professionals with demonstrated experience in one or more of the following specializations:

  • Corporate & Commercial Law: Business regulations, commercial transactions, corporate governance, and contractual obligations.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Regulatory requirements, compliance frameworks, regulatory reporting, and compliance assessments.
  • Legal Research & Interpretation: Statutory interpretation, case law research, legal opinions, and regulatory guidance.
  • Financial & Business Regulations: Financial services regulations, business licensing, regulatory obligations, and institutional compliance.
  • Contract & Legal Documentation: Contract review, legal documentation, regulatory disclosures, and legal risk identification.
  • Administrative & Regulatory Law: Government regulations, administrative procedures, regulatory authorities, and enforcement requirements.
  • International & Cross-Border Regulations: International business requirements, cross-border legal considerations, and jurisdiction-specific regulatory frameworks.
  • Legal Risk & Compliance Analysis: Identification of legal inconsistencies, regulatory risks, and unsupported legal interpretations.

Candidates are not expected to specialize in every area listed. However, they should demonstrate meaningful professional knowledge within at least one relevant legal or regulatory specialization and the ability to evaluate technical legal information accurately.

Market-Specific Expertise

We are recruiting Legal & Regulatory SMEs with relevant professional experience or education involving one of the following markets.

1. Mainland China – Legal & Regulatory

Candidates should have relevant professional experience or education involving Mainland China's legal system, regulatory environment, or compliance requirements.

Relevant expertise may include:

  • Mainland Chinese laws, regulations, and administrative requirements.
  • Corporate and commercial law, business regulations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Interpretation of Chinese legislation, regulatory guidance, and official legal documentation.
  • Legal research, regulatory analysis, and compliance assessments involving Mainland China.
  • Identification of legal inconsistencies, unsupported interpretations, and regulatory concerns.
  • Review and validation of legal documentation and regulatory materials relevant to the Chinese market.

Location Requirement: Candidates must currently reside outside Mainland China, specifically in Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Malaysia, the United Kingdom, or the United States.

2. Spain – Legal & Regulatory

Candidates should have relevant professional experience involving Spain's legal system, regulatory environment, or compliance requirements.

Relevant expertise may include:

  • Spanish corporate law, commercial regulations, and business compliance requirements.
  • Spanish legislation and applicable European Union legal frameworks.
  • Interpretation of Spanish statutes, regulatory guidance, and legal documentation.
  • Legal research, regulatory analysis, and compliance assessments involving Spain.
  • Identification of legal inconsistencies, regulatory risks, and unsupported legal conclusions.
  • Review and validation of Spanish legal information and regulatory documentation.

Location Requirement: Candidates must currently reside in Europe or the United States.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Legal Expertise in a New Way

Use your experience in legal research, regulatory compliance, and legal analysis to contribute to emerging AI technology.

Help Improve Legal AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help improve the reliability, consistency, and accuracy of AI-generated legal and regulatory information.

Explore Emerging Legal Technology

Gain exposure to specialized AI evaluation projects while applying the professional expertise you've developed throughout your career.

Flexible Remote Opportunities

Participate in project-based assignments remotely, with scheduling based on project requirements and availability.

Earn Supplemental Income

Put your specialized legal knowledge to work through a freelance opportunity designed for experienced professionals.

Compensation & Project Structure

  • Engagement Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Project Type: Short-Term AI Evaluation Pilot
  • Estimated Workload: Approximately 36 total hours
  • Compensation: Proposed $18–$45 USD/hour, based on location and qualifications
  • Language: English
  • Schedule: Based on project requirements and candidate availability

Compensation ranges are preliminary and subject to final client approval.

Assignments will be offered according to project needs. Workloads may vary, and consistent hours, minimum assignments, or ongoing work are not guaranteed.

Specific project timelines, onboarding requirements, and additional details will be communicated as they are confirmed.

Bring Your Legal & Regulatory Expertise to the Future of AI

Your knowledge of legal systems, regulatory frameworks, compliance practices, and legal research can help improve how AI interprets and presents complex legal information.

If you have Legal & Regulatory expertise and relevant knowledge of Mainland China's or Spain's legal environments, we encourage you to apply.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the future of AI in Legal & Regulatory Services!

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

As a Legal & Regulatory SME – AI Evaluator, you'll apply your professional expertise to assess specialized legal information and help ensure AI-generated outputs are accurate, relevant, and legally sound.

Your responsibilities may include:

  • Evaluate Legal & Regulatory Content: Review AI-generated legal explanations, regulatory interpretations, compliance-related information, and legal documentation for factual accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Assess Legal Reasoning: Examine legal conclusions, regulatory interpretations, and analytical explanations for accuracy and alignment with applicable laws and established legal principles.
  • Verify Authoritative Sources: Research and validate legal information using legislation, official regulatory guidance, government resources, and credible legal references.
  • Identify Errors & Inconsistencies: Recognize inaccurate legal statements, unsupported interpretations, missing regulatory requirements, and potential compliance concerns.
  • Apply Jurisdiction-Specific Knowledge: Evaluate content against the legal systems, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements of Mainland China or Spain.
  • Review Output Quality: Assess completed work against project-specific instructions, evaluation criteria, and established quality standards.
  • Provide Structured Feedback: Clearly document findings, explain legal or regulatory inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by authoritative references.
  • Complete Independent Evaluations: Perform assigned reviews through designated online platforms while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and established deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • Approximately 3–5 years of relevant professional experience in legal services, regulatory compliance, legal research, corporate law, commercial law, or a closely related specialization.
  • Relevant academic qualifications in Law, Legal Studies, Business Law, Regulatory Affairs, Compliance, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated professional experience or relevant education involving Mainland China's legal or regulatory environment, or professional experience involving Spain's legal or regulatory environment.
  • Strong understanding of applicable laws, regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, or legal procedures within the relevant market.
  • Experience interpreting legal documentation, evaluating regulatory information, and identifying inaccuracies or unsupported conclusions.
  • Demonstrated ability to research and validate legal information using authoritative sources.
  • Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain legal findings and regulatory assessments. All project tasks will be conducted in English.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to evaluate complex legal information objectively.
  • Comfortable using digital documentation, legal research resources, and web-based platforms.
  • Ability to work independently, follow detailed evaluation guidelines, and consistently meet quality standards.
  • Must meet the geographic eligibility requirements for the applicable market.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in legal practice, corporate legal departments, regulatory compliance, legal consulting, or regulatory advisory services.
  • Experience reviewing legislation, legal opinions, contracts, compliance documentation, or regulatory guidance.
  • Familiarity with Mainland Chinese or Spanish regulatory authorities and legal requirements.
  • Professional experience involving international legal matters or cross-border regulatory activities.
  • Experience conducting legal research, document review, compliance assessments, or regulatory analysis.
  • Experience identifying legal inconsistencies, evaluating regulatory risks, or reviewing legal documentation for accuracy.
  • Previous exposure to AI-assisted legal research, legal technology, quality assurance, or AI content evaluation.

Retired legal and regulatory professionals with relevant experience are welcome to apply.

Prior AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

What Makes a Strong Candidate?

Ideal candidates combine legal or regulatory expertise with strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate complex information accurately.

Strong candidates typically have:

  • Independently reviewed legal documents, regulatory guidance, compliance materials, or legal research.
  • Applied legal reasoning to identify inaccuracies, unsupported interpretations, or missing regulatory considerations.
  • Conducted legal research using credible government, statutory, and regulatory sources.
  • Interpreted laws, regulations, or compliance requirements within their relevant jurisdiction.
  • Clearly communicated complex legal findings and supported conclusions with authoritative references.
  • Demonstrated sound professional judgment, attention to detail, and consistent quality standards.
  • Worked independently while maintaining confidentiality and meeting established deadlines.

jobs.excerpt: Protect Democracy seeks an experienced, passionate fundraising professional to join our organization as the Principal Giving Officer.
jobs.description:
Protect Democracy seeks an experienced, passionate fundraising professional to join our organization as the Principal Giving Officer. This role requires sharp, sophisticated fundraising, communication, and advocacy skills. Reporting to the Chief Partnerships Officer and working directly with the CPO & the Executive Director, this individual will be responsible for an existing, well-stewarded portfolio of ~60 individual and institutional donors with capacity to give at the mid-6 and 7 figure level, with specific identified prospects to cultivate as well.

The ideal candidate brings experience securing major gifts or capital investments of at least 7 figures per year and a deep understanding of the pro-democracy ecosystem. We are looking for an accomplished, passionate fundraiser with 10 or more years of direct fundraising experience including at least 3 years of experience in the pro-democracy nonprofit and advocacy space. The Principal Giving Officer is a remote position based in the United States.* The priority deadline to apply for this role is November 15, 2026.

Protect Democracy’s approach to fundraising involves building deep, long-term, trusting relationships with donors, who we see and engage as key partners in the broader democracy ecosystem. We are a highly collaborative team, building on one another’s successes and regularly sharing content and feedback with one another. Our agile, diverse fundraising team has been remarkably effective so far at raising unrestricted general operating funds and building a solid financial runway that allows us to hire exceptional talent and to launch effective interventions, from bringing 150+ legal actions to crafting and enacting critical federal and state legislation to innovating creative solutions like VoteShield, which monitors and protects 160 million public voter records across 24 states.

About our organization: Protect Democracy formed in late 2016, recognizing that the global wave of authoritarianism had begun to erode American shores. We have since assembled a team of120+ expertswho have served under Democrats and Republicans and in the senior ranks of other nonprofit, political, or media organizations. Our team includes lawyers, policy experts, legislative advocates, media strategists, writers, data analysts, and software developers. In 2023, our team received a Skoll Award for Social Innovation and a MacArthur Fellowship.

At Protect Democracy, we believe that diversity isn’t just a strength — it’s a necessity for tackling the complex challenges facing democracy. A broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthen our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. We strongly encourage candidates from diverse backgrounds and from across the political and ideological spectrum to apply. If you meet most but not all of the criteria listed below but believe nonetheless you’d be a stellar match for the role and could grow into it, we want to hear from you.

The Principal Gifts Officer will:

  • Manage a portfolio of 6- and 7-figure donors, in collaboration with our Chief Partnerships Officer and Executive Director, representing Protect Democracy in external presentations and one-on-one meetings;

  • Serve as an ecosystem ambassador, speaking confidently about Protect Democracy and also about the needs of the pro-democracy ecosystem at large;

  • Develop tailored strategies to engage new prospective high-capacity donors and upgrade existing key donors;

  • Cultivate, engage, and communicate with the Protect Democracy board, donors, and partner organizations;

  • Manage full cycle of existing donor engagement, including planning and conducting meetings with a portfolio of high-capacity donors and prospects capable of making major gifts of capital investment of $1M+ annually to Protect Democracy;

  • Be a team player, being on-call for emails, seeking opportunities to share resources and learning across the Partnerships team, and building subject matter expertise collaboratively;

  • Contribute to culture-building initiatives across the organization.

Required:

  • 10+ years of direct fundraising experience with progressive scope and scale, including some recent principal giving experience;

  • Experience in securing one-year major gifts or capital investments of at least $1 million;

  • At least three years of experience working in the pro-democracy sector either in fundraising or in another capacity.

Preferred, but not required:

  • Experience raising funds for a 501(c)(4).

The ideal candidate also brings:

  • A nuanced understanding of our country’s political landscape, the authoritarian threat, and the reality that our democracy has never fully represented communities of color;

  • Unfettered enthusiasm for Protect Democracy’s cross-ideological and nonpartisan approach to protecting our democracy;

  • Proven track record of having expanded and cultivated existing donor relationships over time;

  • Facility with CRM databases and donor data management;

  • Exceptional analytical, writing, presentation, and interpersonal skills and experiences cultivating both politically savvy and high level prospective audiences;

  • Growth mindset, collaborative orientation, and enthusiasm for giving and receiving feedback up, down and sideways.

Compensation:

The starting salary range for this role is $141,100-$166,000, commensurate with the candidate’s relevant experience, capabilities and skills and in alignment with internal equity.

About Protect Democracy:

  • *Flexible location. We are a remote-first organization based exclusively in the United States, meaning our staff work within the US and primarily virtually. We also offer shared workspaces for those who enjoy working in an office environment. We are established for remote work in many states across the country, and while candidates based anywhere in the United States are welcome to apply, we may not be able to offer employment in your current location. If you proceed in the hiring process, we will discuss where you currently live and what is possible in our initial interview. All staff are also required to travel at least two times per year to team retreats, and this role also requires periodic travel. (Accommodations to this requirement will be made only in exceptional circumstances.)

  • Commitment to an inclusive workplace. Protect Democracy is an equal opportunity employer. We believe that a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and lived experiences strengthens our ability to analyze problems, craft solutions, and drive meaningful change. Protect Democracy encourages applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

  • Phenomenal benefits. Our benefits package includes generous sick leave and a flexible vacation policy where we encourage team members to take 4-5 weeks every year, along with 12 paid holidays, 6 weeks of paid family medical leave, and 18 weeks of paid parental leave. We also offer a 401(k) plan with up to 6% employer match that vests immediately. Additionally, we cover employee medical premiums at 100% (with up to 95% coverage for dependents depending on plan selection), and employee and dependents dental/vision at 100%. All employees have access to long-term disability and life insurance, fertility benefits, a home office stipend, and bonuses at the discretion of the Executive Director.

  • Ample opportunities for personal & professional development. Candidates who do not meet all listed criteria should still apply, as our organizational structure focuses on providing mentorship and opportunities for professional growth.

To apply for this position:

Please complete the application linked below. As part of your application, you will be asked to upload PDFs of your resume and cover letter. (Applications missing any of the required materials will be considered incomplete and not reviewed.) The priority deadline to apply for this role is November 15, 2026; we will review applications received after that date on a rolling basis.

Important notes:

  • Contact if you require specific accommodations at any point in the hiring process.

  • Keep an eye on your promotions/spam folders to avoid missed communication.

  • A note on fair hiring and automated tech: To help our small team review applications efficiently and fairly, we use automated screening tools to assist with resume and response review. Every candidate flagged by our system is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team; we never rely on automated scoring alone to make hiring decisions. If you have questions about this process, or need an alternative application path as an accommodation, reach out to us at .

  • We are unable to provide status updates for each application we receive. If you reach out and do not hear back, please know it is not for lack of appreciation or interest, but simply for lack of staff capacity to respond to individual inquiries.

  • The application will include a voluntary EEO survey so that we can monitor the applicant pool as a whole for representation and equal employment opportunities, and to evaluate our progress as an organization toward a diverse and inclusive workforce, which we believe is a pillar of a thriving democracy. The categories used by the EEO survey are limited and may not reflect your lived experience; please feel free to opt out of any of the questions. Your responses to this survey are entirely separate from your application materials, are not accessible to those responsible for hiring decisions, and will not affect your candidacy in any way.

Highlights

Principal Giving Officer at Protect Democracy: build deep relationships with 6- and 7-figure donors and help fund the fight for American democracy. Remote in the US, $141K-$166K, excellent benefits.

Présentation de Soitec et contexte du poste

Soitec est une société cotée à l'indice SBF 120 de la Bourse de Paris qui intervient en amont de la chaîne de valeur de la microélectronique. Nos matériaux semi-conducteurs innovants sont indispensables au fonctionnement des smartphones et au déploiement de la 5G. Ils offrent également de nombreuses opportunités pour l’automobile connectée, les véhicules électriques et autonomes et l’intelligence embarquée dans les objets connectés.

Cette place nous confère une incroyable responsabilité, qui nous inspire au quotidien : rendre possible l’adoption massive d’innovations technologiques tout en limitant considérablement leur impact environnemental, dans une logique d’innovation responsable et de développement durable.

En quoi consiste le job?

En ce moment, nous définissons et déployons une culture de qualité unique, au travers notamment du Programme Zéro Défaut, dans tout ce que nous faisons, sans compromis, tout en développant notre agilité.

Suite à un mouvement, l'équipe Qualité Système de Thierry recherche un.e ingénieur.e du Système Qualité qui souhaite contribuer au déploiement d'un système de management de la qualité toujours plus ambitieux.

Vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la qualité de nos produits. Vous serez l'interface avec nos auditeurs et nos clients pour démontrer l'efficacité de notre QMS (Système de Management de la Qualité) et pour en améliorer continuellement la performance. Votre mission consistera principalement à guider nos équipes Opérations dans l'application des normes ISO9001 et/ou IATF 16949.

Dans le détail : - Évoluer et adapter notre QMS et ses outils pour accompagner la croissance de Soitec et de son organisation.- Piloter et développer le système pour les Analyses des Modes de Défaillance et de leurs Effets (AMDEC ou FMEA) pour évaluer les risques des produits et des processus.- Utiliser des méthodologies telles que le 8D, 5Pourquoi, Ishikawa, DMAIC pour résoudre les problèmes.- Piloter le plan d’audits internes annuel. Conduire ou participer à des audits internes pour identifier les écarts entre le système et la réalité opérationnelle. Accompagner les auditeurs internes. - Gérer les certificats de gestion des substances dangereuses.

Un défi majeur consistera à impliquer l'ensemble de nos filiales, en France ou à l'étranger, dans l'adoption de ces méthodologies de travail. Ces outils sont applicables à tous les sites de manufacturing de Soitec, nécessitant une collaboration étroite avec les collègues de différents sites. Pour accélérer cette implication, il est nécessaire de faire évoluer outils et systèmes de manière créative et participative.

Ce poste répondra à votre projet si vous êtes…

  • Diplôme d’ingénieur dans les domaines de l’électronique, de la chimie, des matériaux ou équivalent.- Capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer de manière pragmatique.- Créativité dans l'approche des problèmes et des solutions.- Excellentes compétences d'écoute et aptitude à intégrer les feedbacks du terrain.- Maîtrise de l'anglais nécessaire suffisante pour des interactions professionnelles.- Expérience préalable en création ou gestion d’AMDEC, plans de contrôle, 8D, audits internes ou externes.- Connaissance approfondie des normes ISO 9001 et IATF 16949 ainsi que du référentiel d’audit VDA 6.3.

Si vous êtes prêt(e) à relever le défi du travail en transverse, à influencer positivement et à enrichir vos compétences, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant. Nous mettons à disposition des formations pour vous accompagner dans l'apprentissage de ces sujets si nécessaire.

jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

About the Opportunity

The DRG QA/Training Manager leads the quality assurance and training team supporting Machinify’s DRG Clinical Validation function, including MS-DRG and APR-DRG validation. Reporting to the Sr. Director, DRG Operations, this role manages the DRG QA/Trainers, owns the audit program for new and existing DRG Reviewers, and directs onboarding and ongoing training so reviewers apply current clinical, coding, and organizational standards. The manager works with the DRG Clinical Educator, DRG Managers, and cross-functional partners to turn audit findings into training, process changes, and measurable quality improvement.

What you’ll do

Team Leadership:

  • Lead the DRG QA/Trainer team by setting goals, assigning and prioritizing audit and training work, and coordinating daily activities
  • Provide guidance, counsel, and development plans that support long-term retention and professional growth of QA/Trainer staff
  • Communicate priorities, updates, and expectations through regular one-on-one and team meetings
  • Monitor individual and team results to ensure audits and training are completed on time and in accordance with department standards

Quality Assurance:

  • Own the QA audit program for new and existing DRG Reviewers, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and alignment with established coding and clinical validation guidelines
  • Review QA/Trainer audit findings for consistency and calibrate the team on audit criteria and feedback
  • Ensure DRG Reviewers receive constructive, detailed feedback that highlights areas for improvement and recognizes high-performance results
  • Identify problems and trends in audit results, determine root causes, and implement corrective action plans
  • Collaborate with leadership to drive continuous improvement in audit accuracy, workflow efficiency, and reviewer performance

Training & Education:

  • Partner with the educator to plan and deliver new-hire training on DRG methodologies, clinical validation, and proprietary tools
  • Oversee ongoing training for existing staff, focusing on policy updates, skill development, and performance enhancement
  • Direct the development and maintenance of training materials and resources, using audit trends to target content where it is needed
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of training sessions and adjust content based on quality results

Policy, Documentation & Reporting:

  • Develop departmental QA policies, processes, and training standards
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of audit findings, feedback sessions, and training activities
  • Provide reports on key performance indicators, including quality scores, audit outcomes, and training effectiveness, on a predetermined schedule
  • Set timelines, communicate progress, track delivery, and escalate roadblocks or dependencies

Collaboration & Support:

  • Work closely with DRG Managers and the DRG Clinical Educator to ensure training and QA processes align with the company’s standards and objectives
  • Serve as an expert resource for DRG Reviewers, QA/Trainers, and other staff members, answering questions and offering guidance on complex cases or procedures
  • Provide internal and external partners with evidence and references supporting industry standards, auditing guidelines, and review stances
  • Collaborate with operations, product, data analytics, and technology teams to recommend process and solution improvements based on QA findings
  • Assist with research, special projects, and ad hoc claim reviews as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

What experience you bring (Role Requirements)

Education Requirements:

  • A bachelor’s degree in nursing (active/unrestricted license), health information management, or health administration is required
  • An active, unrestricted nursing license is preferred
  • Work experience may be considered in lieu of formal education at leadership discretion

Certification (at least one of the following is required)

  • RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator
  • RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician
  • CCDS - Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist
  • CDIP - Clinical Documentation Improvement Practitioner
  • CCS - Certified Coding Specialist
  • CIC - Certified Inpatient Coder

Qualifications:

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare billing and coding
  • 3+ years of inpatient claims auditing, quality assurance, or recovery auditing experience, and/or inpatient Clinical Documentation Integrity experience
  • Previous supervisory experience required
  • Experience in production and team management
  • Experience conducting training for clinical or coding staff
  • Experience with readmission reviews
  • Proven experience sharing DRG audit process knowledge with sales, marketing, and development teams

Skills

  • Expert in DRG methodologies and classification systems, including MS-DRG, APR-DRG, and AP-DRG
  • Expertise in ICD-10-CM/PCS coding, UHDDS definitions, Official Coding Guidelines, and AHA’s Coding Clinic Guidelines
  • Expertise in DRG validation, with in-depth knowledge of clinical criteria and documentation requirements to support code assignments
  • Deep understanding of Medicare and Commercial coding rules, regulations, and prospective payment systems
  • Familiarity with Milliman and InterQual guidelines
  • Proven ability to apply critical judgment in clinical and coding determinations
  • Deep curiosity and analytical skills to understand root causes of events and behaviors
  • Strong experience in data use and insights, including independently structuring and executing complex analyses
  • Ability to provide clear, actionable feedback and coach staff to improved performance
  • High standards of quality and attention to detail
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively in teams

Computer Equipment and Software:

  • Experience working with multiple monitors
  • Proven success in a remote working environment
  • Proficient in Windows office systems, including the full Microsoft Suite and Teams
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Experience with various software applications and collaboration with development teams

What We Offer:

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work
The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range.
Pay range: $130,000-$150,000 + Annual Bonus

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. jobs.excerpt: About Zinier80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless.
jobs.description:
About Zinier

80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?

Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.

We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Zinier is seeking a Software Development Engineer to join our global 24/7 Support Engineering team. As a front-line custodian of our customer experience, you will provide high-impact technical support across the entire Zinier platform.

To succeed in this role, you should bring strong hands-on expertise in JavaScript development, API integrations, and MySQL or any SQL based DBMS. Expertise in React would be an added bonus. This is an exciting opportunity for engineers who thrive on deep debugging, complex problem-solving, and direct customer engagement—with clear career progression pathways into senior technical or customer-centric roles, such as Senior Software Development Engineer, Solution Developer, Solution Architect and Delivery. For those who are interested in Customer Success, that could be a career path as well. Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries. Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself. This role will be mapped to customers’ locations across the world and hence would primarily be working in US and EMEA working hours which would be compensated accordingly. In future this role might be required to work over weekends as well.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor and respond to customer issues reported over the customer portal tickets or email or slack within defined SLAs.
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues, including workflow misconfigurations, API failures, code based issues and data discrepancies.
  • Investigate logs, trace workflow execution paths, and analyse JSON payloads to isolate breaking logic.
  • Resolve complex requests independently; escalate appropriately when required, with clear documentation of findings and own customer issues end-to-end.
  • File production deployment requests on behalf of customers, coordinating with internal teams.
  • If bandwidth allows, you will be working on Engineering and Implementation/Delivery Projects as well. People with Solution Architecture aspirations will work closely with the sales team(s) as well.
  • Identify gaps in knowledge-base articles and contribute new documentation to reduce repeat queries.
  • Ideate and implement AI solutions that would help customer experience or improve the product itself.
  • Maintain Zinier's high standards for customer communication and response-time adherence.
  • Engage actively in product and technical training to deepen platform knowledge.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and occasional weekend support as required by shift patterns.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field with 2+ years of experience in JavaScript development, Solutions development, Application Support, Customer Engineering or a related role.
  • Hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, JSON, HTML, and CSS for debugging and configuration analysis.
  • Familiarity with log analysis, REST APIs, and basic SQL queries.
  • Knowledge of operating systems, cloud services, and multi-tier web application architecture.
  • Experience with CRM and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Salesforce) and remote support tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage stakeholders at varying levels of technical expertise.
  • Strong analytical mindset and customer-first orientation.
  • Willingness to work shifts, weekends and 24/7 on-call rotations.

DESIRABLE SKILLS

  • Exposure to Grafana or similar monitoring/observability tools.
  • Experience with workflow-based or field-service management systems.
  • Knowledge of Java, Python, or JEE frameworks.
  • ITIL V3/V4 certification or equivalent foundation in service management.
  • User-level familiarity with Linux environments.

WHY JOIN US

  • Unique opportunity to form a front-facing layer that not only is the front-line to customer deployments, but also has the ability to work closely with Solution Architects and others to influence Product blueprints.
  • Work across the full tech stack — from debugging backend services(Java, spring boot) to exploring front-end interfaces built with React and extending into mobile UI development.
  • Build internal tools, fix production issues, and contribute to engineering stability, all while learning from experienced platform, product and solution engineers.
  • Be part of a high-impact team that bridges engineering and customer experience, where your work helps improve both product quality and customer trust.
  • Join a company that values learning, ownership, and long-term growth.
  • High performers progress to:
    • Senior Software Development Engineer, Support Engineering
    • Solution Developer, Solution Delivery

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role:

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing fintech company during a pivotal stage of growth. As the Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in strengthening and scaling our accounting operations, financial reporting, and internal controls.
Our Accounting & Finance team is fully remote and distributed. This role reports directly to the Assistant Controller and partners cross-functionally to support the company's continued growth and regulatory compliance.

What You'll Do:

  • Support the development and enhancement of internal financial reporting and reporting distribution processes.
  • Assist with the annual financial statement audit by preparing supporting documentation and responding to auditor requests.
  • Coordinate with the parent company on tax documentation and information requests.
  • Operate in a multi-entity environment, being a key resource to adjacent teams within the organization
  • Assist with weekly reserve computations and related reporting.
  • Develop, document, implement, and maintain accounting policies and procedures.
  • Perform ad hoc financial analysis, reporting, and special projects as needed.

Qualifications (required):

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • 5–7 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably within financial services.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy and organization.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment while working independently in a remote setting.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with a team-first mindset.
  • Demonstrated ownership, initiative, and a willingness to take on new challenges.

Qualifications (preferred):

  • CPA designation.
  • Experience working for a broker-dealer, clearing firm, or other regulated financial services organization.
  • Experience with Netsuite

How We Take Care of You:

jobs.description:
Coretek is seeking an Azure Data & AI Consultant to design, implement, and optimize modern data and AI solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. In this role, you will partner closely with clients to modernize data platforms, enable advanced analytics, and deliver AI-driven insights that support business transformation. You will be responsible for building scalable data pipelines, integrating AI services, and ensuring solutions align with industry best practices. This role requires strong technical expertise in Azure data services, experience with AI integration, and the ability to work effectively in a client-facing consulting environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Engagement: Act as a trusted advisor by conducting workshops, gathering requirements, and presenting solutions to both technical and business audiences.
  • Data Platform Development: Design and implement Azure-based data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Azure database systems (SQL, Cosmos DB, Postgres).
  • Data Engineering: Build robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate large volumes of structured and unstructured data from diverse sources.
  • AI Integration: Leverage Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, and Cognitive Services to deliver intelligent business solutions.
  • Solution Architecture Support: Collaborate with architects to design scalable, secure, and high-performance Azure Data & AI architectures.
  • DevOps & Automation: Implement version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automation using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code tools (Bicep, Terraform).
  • Data Governance & Security: Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security requirements including RBAC, encryption, and identity management.
  • Analytics & Visualization: Develop advanced reporting and interactive dashboards with Power BI to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.
  • Knowledge Sharing: Mentor junior team members, contribute to internal best practices, and stay current with Azure Data & AI innovations.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics, or AI, with hands-on expertise in Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python for data processing and AI tasks.
  • Hands-on experience with at least two Azure data services such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB.
  • Familiarity with AI services in Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, and Cognitive Services.
  • Experience developing Power BI solutions for advanced analytics and data storytelling.
  • Understanding of modern data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, and real-time streaming solutions.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and security best practices.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

Preferred:

  • Experience with event-driven architectures using Azure Event Hub, Service Bus, or Kafka.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing and performance optimization in Databricks/Spark environments.
  • Experience with consulting or client-facing project delivery.
  • Exposure to ML Ops practices and operationalizing machine learning models.
  • Azure certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102), Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305), or Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900).

Why Join Coretek?

  • Microsoft Azure Expert Partner: Contribute to cutting-edge Azure Data & AI projects with access to Microsoft's latest innovations and technical resources.
  • Career Growth: Advance your expertise through certifications, hands-on learning, and mentorship opportunities.
  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside top-tier architects and consultants in a supportive, client-first environment.
  • Professional Development: Access to training resources, Azure learning paths, and opportunities to work on diverse client engagements

jobs.description:
Job Title: Principal Cloud Solutions Architect – Azure Cloud

Location: US, Canada (Remote)

Employment Type: Full-time


About Altera


Altera, a member of the N. Harris Computer Corporation family, delivers health IT solutions that support caregivers around the world. These include the Sunrise™, Paragon Daneli, TouchWorks EHR, Altera Opal, Ventus, HealthQuest™ and dbMotion™ solutions. At the intersection of technology and the human experience, Altera Digital Health is driving a new era of healthcare, in which innovation and expertise can elevate care delivery and inspire healthier communities across the globe. A new age in healthcare technology has just begun.


Overview


We are seeking a seasoned Principal Cloud Solutions Architect to join our Cloud Solutions Architecture team and drive the design of comprehensive, enterprise-grade solutions in Microsoft Azure. This role is highly client-facing and requires a strategic thinker who can bridge business needs with technical execution while partnering closely with development teams.

The ideal candidate is an expert in Azure architecture with deep experience across data platforms (including Databricks), cloud networking, identity and access management, and operational excellence. They will play a critical role in shaping solution strategy, guiding implementation, and ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient cloud environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with business stakeholders, clients, and engineering teams to define and architect end-to-end cloud solutions aligned with strategic objectives
  • Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performing Azure architectures across multiple domains
  • Lead architecture for data and analytics platforms, including Azure Databricks and modern lakehouse patterns
  • Develop and enforce cloud networking strategies, including VNet design, hybrid connectivity, private endpoints, and secure access patterns
  • Define and implement Identity & Access Management (IAM) frameworks using Azure AD, RBAC, Conditional Access, and Zero Trust principles
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure architectural alignment, best practices, and successful solution delivery
  • Drive operational excellence, including monitoring, logging, observability, resiliency, and disaster recovery strategies
  • Establish and promote architecture standards, governance frameworks, and design patterns across the organization
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on technical decision-making and trade-offs
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value for clients and executive stakeholders

MHBG Coordinator

150 N. 18th Ave., Phoenix, Az 85007

Must Reside in Arizona.

Job Summary:
The Mental Health Block Grant (MHBG) Coordinator / Promoting the Integration of Primary and Behavioral Health Care (PIPBHC) Evaluator reports to the MHBG administrator and is responsible for coordinating (MHBG) program activities while leading evaluation, performance measurement, and outcomes monitoring activities for the (PIPBHC) grant. This position supports federal grant compliance, program implementation, strategic planning, performance reporting, and continuous quality improvement efforts to improve behavioral health outcomes and integrated care services throughout Arizona.
As the coordinator for MHBG-funded initiatives and the evaluator for the PIPBHC grant, you will work collaboratively with AHCCCS leadership, ACC-RBHAs, providers, MCOs, healthcare systems, community organizations, federal partners, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and achievement of grant objectives. This requires independent judgment, analytical expertise, and the ability to translate complex programmatic and performance data into actionable recommendations that support policy development.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Major duties and responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • PIPBC Grant Evaluation and Performance Measurement: Coordinate implementation of the PIPBHC evaluation plan and performance measurement activities by establishing baseline measures, tracking outcomes and objectives, and collecting, analyzing, and interpreting quantitative and qualitative data to assess program implementation and effectiveness.

PIPBC Grant Reporting and Monitoring: Prepare SAMHSA-required reports and data submissions while monitoring progress toward grant goals, identifying trends, performance gaps, and areas for program improvement.

PIPBC Grant Quality Improvement and Sustainability: Support continuous quality improvement, implementation monitoring, and sustainability planning activities to ensure program success and achievement of grant objectives.

Mental Health Block Grant (MHBG) Federal Grant Administration and Compliance: Support MHBG planning, implementation, monitoring, compliance, and reporting, prepare grant applications and SAMHSA-required submissions, while monitoring deliverables, work plans, budgets, and performance measures to ensure compliance with state and federal requirements.

Mental Health Block Grant (MHBG) System Improvement and Strategic Recommendations: Identify service gaps, emerging trends, and best practices and develop data-informed recommendations and strategies that improve service delivery, increase access to care, support sustainability, advance system transformation, and strengthen outcomes for MHBG priority populations. Support monitoring and evaluation of initiatives serving individuals with Serious Mental Illness (SMI), Serious Emotional Disturbance (SED), and First Episode Psychosis (FEP).

Location: USA, Remote (AMER remit, US working hours)

Reports To: AMER GTM Leadership team

Role Overview

Wunderkind is looking for a hands-on, high-energy Senior Manager (Team Lead), Pipeline Development to lead our AMER Business Development team. This is a role for a leader who wants to be close to the work every day: running stand-ups, joining call blocks, coaching the next conversation and celebrating every SQL and SAO that follows. You’ll lead a team of up to 10 Business Development professionals who open doors into Enterprise and Strategic brands, and you’ll own the performance that turns their effort into a pipeline our sellers can close.

Our GTM leadership owns the pipeline strategy, the playbook, territory design, headcount and compensation. That leaves you free to focus on what great team leads do best: bringing that playbook to life, running the US working day, holding the standard and making every BDA better than they were in the quarter before. If you’re a coach at heart who gets more energy from a rep’s breakthrough than from a strategy deck, and you’re looking for a role where you can build consistency, scale performance and watch a team grow under your leadership, we’d love to meet you.

Key Responsibilities

  • SQL and SAO Delivery: Own your team’s delivery of Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs) against target across our Enterprise and Strategic accounts in AMER, week in and week out.
  • Activity Metrics: Drive the daily and weekly activity standards that power pipeline, from calls and sequences to meetings booked, and keep the team’s effort focused on the accounts that matter most.
  • Run the AMER Day: Lead the rhythm of the US working day, running stand-ups, listening in on calls, coaching the next conversation, running pipeline reviews and managing weekly accountability. Under you, everyone knows where they stand and what comes next.
  • Coaching: Coach every BDA through call reviews, role plays and regular one-on-ones, building the skills and confidence that turn good reps into great ones.
  • Performance Management: Recognize great performance loudly and address underperformance early, fairly and with a clear plan, so the bar stays high and everyone knows how to reach it.
  • Lead by Example: Show the team what great Enterprise outreach looks and sounds like by by picking up the phone alongside your BDAs and living the standards you set
  • Process Improvement: Run our pipeline playbook with discipline, spot where processes can work better, and bring improvements to the playbook’s owner for approval before rolling them out with your team.
  • AE Partnership: Keep every BDA closely aligned with their paired Account Executive, so each SQL and SAO is handed over with the context needed to move it toward Closed-Won.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Enterprise SaaS Pipeline Experience: A minimum of 5 years in pipeline generation specifically within a SaaS environment, selling into Enterprise and Strategic accounts where product commitments are a minimum of 12 months.
  • Proven Team Leadership: At least 3 years leading and coaching a high-performing team, and the ability to articulate clearly how you have managed teams for success.
  • Hands-On by Design: Experience leading individual contributors directly, as this role is built for a front-line coach and isn’t suited to someone who manages through managers or team leads.
  • Marketing SaaS Background: A strong preference for experience in Marketing SaaS or adjacent spaces, such as martech, adtech or ecommerce technology.
  • Sustained Impact: A track record of building strong team performance and keeping it strong over time, through busy quarters, shifting priorities and the occasional curveball.
  • Pipeline Toolkit: Confident with Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and sales engagement platforms, and comfortable using AI tools to sharpen account research and personalization.

jobs.description:
Role: Actuarial Forecasting Lead

Duration: 12 months C2H

Location: Remote USA

Job Purpose

  • The Principal Actuary is the senior individual-contributor specialist responsible for developing an integrated quantitative risk framework linking insurance-driven mobile-device claims, rapidly depreciating inventory assets, and future physical supply and disposition commitments. The role converts uncertainty in demand, recoverable value, and market conditions into actionable risk management decisions.
  • This is a hands-on modeling position with no direct reports. The successful candidate must combine credentialed actuarial expertise in insurance claims and exposures with practical experience valuing physically delivered forwards, optional-volume agreements, or comparable structured physical supply arrangements. Physical settlement is the immediate focus; potential cash settlement is a longer-term capability.

Primary Job Accountabilities / Responsibilities

Insurance claims and exposure modeling | 25%

  • Build and validate probabilistic claims-frequency, cohort, and exposure models using insured-device populations, claims history, policy conditions, product mix, device age, churn, and external drivers.
  • Produce calibrated time-phased demand distributions by client, program, model family, and horizon; distinguish insured claims incidence from repair, replacement, substitution, and SKU-level fulfillment outcomes.
  • Backtest assumptions, explain forecast error, and partner with Data Science to translate predicted claims into decision-ready forecasts.

Inventory valuation and financial risk | 25%

  • Model depreciation, residual values, recoverability, liquidation discounts, price volatility, liquidity, obsolescence, and concentration across mobile-device inventory.
  • Assess the joint impact of claims, future supply, secondary-market prices, repair yields, and inventory holdings using stochastic scenarios, Monte Carlo simulation, expected loss, tail-risk metrics, and stress tests.
  • Provide forward-looking risk estimates and evidence for Finance-owned monthly inventory reserve assessments while distinguishing economic-risk outputs from accounting measurements.

Physical contract valuation and risk transfer | 20%

  • Price and assess physically settled forward purchases and sales, structured supply or offtake agreements, volume-flex commitments, and deliverable purchase/sale options.
  • Model strike or delivery prices, optional quantities, exercise timing, specifications, grading, counterparty performance, delivery terms, and embedded optionality; compare contract economics to spot transactions and inventory carry.
  • Partner with Procurement, Treasury, Legal, and Accounting on risk controls and commercial structures; support exploration of cash-settled products only after adequate benchmark and governance capabilities exist.

Inventory portfolio optimization | 15%

  • Integrate demand and market-value simulations to evaluate risk-adjusted buy, hold, repair, transfer, sell, and hedge decisions at model-family and portfolio levels.
  • Quantify working capital, stockout exposure, purchasing premiums, expected depreciation, and tail-risk tradeoffs to propose practical exposure limits and hedging thresholds.

Technical modeling and governance | 10%

  • Write reproducible Python and SQL models and document data lineage, parameters, validation, backtesting, assumption changes, and model limitations.
  • Coordinate with the Forecasting Lead on integrated work-product quality; retain ownership of actuarial methodology, assumptions, and specialist model judgments.

Cross-functional leadership and capability development | 5%

Establish common risk terminology, influence planning and procurement decisions without direct authority, and help develop the enterprise inventory-risk methodology.

Communicate complex probability and valuation findings to Supply Chain, Finance, Actuarial, Risk, and executive stakeholders.

Management Responsibility

  • Individual contributor; no direct or indirect people-management responsibility. Serves as the senior technical authority for actuarial and risk valuation methodology, mentors colleagues, and may coordinate cross-functional working groups.

Financial Responsibility

  • No independent purchase, trade, or reserve-approval authority. Develops quantitative recommendations influencing inventory working capital, economic risk limits, contract valuation, and reserve inputs; Procurement, Treasury, Legal, Risk, and Finance retain approval authorities.

Required Experience, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Hold an active professional actuarial credential (ACAS, FCAS, ASA, FSA, or recognized international actuarial equivalent). A CERA designation alone does not replace the base actuarial credential.
  • Demonstrated hands-on professional experience developing or materially validating insurance claims-frequency, exposure-based, or comparable insurance predictive-risk models.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience valuing or pricing physically delivered forward, offtake, volume-flex, commodity, or asset supply contracts with meaningful delivery obligations or embedded optionality; theoretical coursework alone is insufficient.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience spanning actuarial modeling, enterprise or asset risk, physical-market contract economics, and quantitative decision support.
  • Bachelor's degree in actuarial science, statistics, mathematics, quantitative finance, economics, engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • Advanced stochastic simulation, financial risk modeling, calibration, sensitivity analysis, tail-risk measurement, and evaluation of correlated exposure.
  • Strong hands-on Python and SQL proficiency; ability to design models, independently inspect model code, and explain methods and commercial implications.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with incomplete market data, communicate uncertainty, and navigate cross-functional decisions with strong ethical judgment.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge

  • CERA or advanced enterprise-risk/financial-risk credential in addition to a base actuarial credential.
  • Experience in mobile devices, electronics resale, inventory financing, physical commodities, or another market with steep depreciation and limited liquidity.
  • Experience with risk-adjusted optimization, supply chain planning, repair operations, or secondary-market pricing.
  • Familiarity with inventory valuation accounting and derivative accounting review processes, while recognizing Finance and Accounting as decision owners.
  • Experience implementing governed enterprise quantitative models and collaborating with commercial supply or procurement teams.

Measures of Success

  • Calibration and accuracy of claims distributions; quality and explainability of economic inventory-risk estimates; usefulness of physical-contract pricing decisions; repeatable model controls; measurable risk-adjusted inventory outcomes.

El/La , ESPECIALISTA EN HIDROLOGÍA proveerá apoyo técnico y científico a la unidad de conservación del Norte de los Andes y Sur de Centro América (NASCA) en el diseño e implementación de estrategias y herramientas de análisis y modelación matemática de servicios ecosistémicos relacionados con el agua, según las necesidades del grupo de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico, así como en el monitoreo y ajuste de las acciones de conservación que sean implementadas por los programas de conservación.

FUNCIONES ESENCIALES

El/La ESPECIALISTA EN HIDROLOGÍA desarrolla, gestiona datos, y aplica herramientas de análisis, evaluación y modelación matemática de servicios ecosistémicos relacionados con el agua, según las necesidades del grupo de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico. Trabaja en ocasiones en condiciones climáticas variables, en ubicaciones remotas, en terrenos peligrosos y bajo circunstancias físicamente exigentes.

RESPONSABILIDADES Y ALCANCE

Responsabilidades Técnicas:

  • Desarrollar y aplicar herramientas de análisis, evaluación y modelación de cuencas hidrográficas y sistemas fluviales, de sistemas de recursos hídricos, de infraestructura de sectores hidro-dependientes y servicios ecosistémicos según las necesidades del grupo de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico.
  • Diseñar y acompañar, desde el componente de hidrología, la implementación de programas de conservación y monitoreo de sistemas de agua dulce.
  • Desarrollar, administrar, actualizar, ejecutar y analizar resultados de los modelos espaciales, hidro-sedimentológicos, de calidad de agua y servicios ecosistémicos relacionados con el programa de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico.
  • Realizar análisis espaciales y administrar bases de datos requeridos para el programa de conservación de NASCA bajo el liderazgo del grupo de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico.
  • Asesorar y apoyar a los demás miembros del equipo de conservación de NASCA en temas especializados de análisis hidro-sedimentológicos y calidad del agua bajo la coordinación del líder del grupo de Gestión Integrada de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico.
  • Supervisar el trabajo de consultorías externas relacionadas con los proyectos en los que participa.
  • Brindar información técnica y realizar cálculo de métricas para la actualización del HUB de la Agenda Compartida de Conservación (SCA) de TNC.
  • Realizar actualizaciones en el HUB de la SCA de los proyectos en los que participa.
  • Responsabilidades asociadas a la sostenibilidad financiera: Proponer marcos técnicos innovadores que puedan incluirse en la presentación de propuestas técnicas de investigación, ciencia aplicada, consultoría y análisis de proyectos alineados con los objetivos del programa de Gestión Integral de Cuencas y Recurso Hídrico con enfoque en análisis de servicios ecosistémicos relacionados con el agua.Apoyar la elaboración de nuevas propuestas relevantes para las estrategias de NASCA.undefinedApoyar el liderazgo de los análisis técnicos especializados relacionados con definición y optimización de actividades de conservación (portafolios), modelación matemática hidro-sedimentológica, calidad de agua y servicios ecosistémicos que sean requeridos como parte del programa de conservación de NASCA.
  • Responsabilidades asociadas a Marketing y Comunicaciones:Apoyar la elaboración de material de divulgación de resultados y/o trasferencia de conocimiento, incluyendo reportes, publicaciones científicas, guías y manuales, ponencias y presentaciones, entre otros.Participar activamente en eventos técnicos para la comunicación y divulgación de resultados obtenidos en diferentes proyectos, investigaciones científicas consultorías y análisis.Brindar apoyo a los integrantes del Grupo de Gestión Integrada de cuencas y recurso hídrico para comunicaciones a nivel técnico de detalle.Acompañar al equipo directivo de NASCA o a otros equipos de trabajo en eventos o reuniones que requieran asesoramiento especializado en los temas de su trabajo.undefined

CUALIFICACIONES MÍNIMAS

  • Profesional en ingeniería o ciencias básicas con 2 años de experiencia en cargos similares o combinación entre experiencia y estudios.
  • Conocimiento y experiencia de trabajo en análisis y modelación de hidrología, sistemas de recursos hídricos, infraestructura de sectores hidro-dependientes, hidrometeorología y servicios ecosistémicos.
  • Conocimiento de uso de herramientas para la construcción y optimización de portafolios de actividades de conservación.
  • Conocimientos en el uso de herramientas de computación científica (como R, Python, MATLAB, entre otros).
  • Conocimiento en el uso de software especializado para modelación matemática (InVEST, RiOS, HEC-HMS, SWAT, WEAP, etc.)
  • Experiencia en el uso de sistemas de información geográfica para análisis y modelamiento espacial.
  • Experiencia preparando informes científicos y publicaciones basadas en resultados de campo.
  • Capacidad de trabajo autónomo y basado en objetivos, cumpliendo fechas y plazos.

CONOCIMIENTOS, HABILIDADES Y EXPERIENCIA DESEADAS

  • Especialización o maestría en hidrología hidráulica o afines con dos o más años de experiencia.
  • Conocimientos de análisis/modelación en calidad del agua (Qual2k, WASP, entre otros), morfología fluvial y/o cambio climático.
  • Experiencia en diseño y desarrollo de software.
  • Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de programas de monitoreo de sistemas de agua dulce.
  • Manejo y supervisión de contratos y proyectos
  • Capacidad para trabajar en campo durante periodos largos, viajar a diferentes lugares (dentro y fuera del país).

JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides senior level analyst support for reimbursement activities. Administers complex provider reimbursement methodologies timely and accurately. Responsibilities include implementation, maintenance and support of provider reimbursement for all provider types, including hospitals and facilities priced through prospective payment system (PPS) pricing. Maintains expertise in all forms of reimbursement methodologies including fee-for-service (FFS), value-based pricing (VBP), capitation and bundled payments.

Essential Job Duties

  • Researches, reviews, and deciphers state specific Medicaid, Medicare, and Marketplace reimbursement methodologies for providers, including hospitals and facilities.
    • Leverages expertise in complex groupers (APG, EAPG, APR-DRG, MS-DRG, etc.) utilized in reimbursement/priced prospective payment system (PPS) payment methodologies.
    • Supports implementation of new prices including: pricing software vendor specification review, identification of system changes needed to accommodate state-specific logic/needs, requirements development support, and creation and execution of comprehensive test plans.
    • Ensures ongoing price maintenance, quality assurance, and compliance with deployment activities.
    • Interprets release notes to accurately request and analyze impact reports of affected claims.
    • Analyzes, interprets, and maintains configurable tables and files that support claim adjudication rules, benefit plan support and provider reimbursement rules.
    • Assists in the development and execution of testing scenarios and conditions.
    • Performs unit and/or end-user testing for new configuration, programming enhancements, new benefit designs, new provider contracts and software changes.
    • Analyzes and reviews concerns and pricing variances to validate results, determine root-cause drivers, and develops solutions as necessary.
    • Collaborates closely with the information technology (IT) department and the pricing software vendor to resolve issues.
    • Identifies automation and improvement opportunities.
    • Researches and resolves reimbursement inquiries from internal teams and providers.
    • Collaborates with IT, operations, health plan representatives, the pricing software vendor, and other business teams involved in claim processing to resolve claims-related issues.
    • Provides complex provider reimbursement support for all health plan lines of business, and expansions into new states.
    • Serves as a departmental reimbursement-related subject matter expert.
    • Participates in various department-wide reimbursement projects.
    • Provides training and support to new and existing reimbursement team members.
    • Manages fluctuating volumes of work and prioritizes work to meet deadlines and needs of the reimbursement department and user community.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of experience in complex provider reimbursement, provider contracts, pricing configuration, claims adjudication, and/or relevant analyst experience within a health care operations setting in a managed care organization supporting Medicaid, Medicare, and/or Marketplace programs, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • Advanced experience using a claims processing system.
    • Advanced experience processing, reviewing, and researching facility claims/provider reimbursement inquiries.
    • Analytical and critical-thinking skills, and ability to manage complex reimbursement policies and trends.
    • Ability to collaborate with various stakeholders and explain complex reimbursement issues.
    • Flexibility to meet changing business requirements, and commitment to high-quality/on-time delivery

• High attention to detail.

  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
    • Microsoft Office suite proficiency, including Excel abilities (VLOOKUP/Pivot Tables, etc.), and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

AI Research Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: AI Research Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an AI Research Engineer to bridge cutting-edge applied research and production engineering, designing and shipping advanced machine learning systems that solve high-impact business problems. The role blends scientific rigor with practical software engineering, requiring deep understanding of modern ML and deep learning techniques alongside the ability to build robust, scalable, and well-instrumented production pipelines. The ideal candidate stays current with the rapidly evolving AI research landscape, can critically evaluate new techniques for real-world applicability, and is comfortable operating across the full lifecycle from problem framing and experimentation to deployment and continuous improvement.

  • Design, prototype, and evaluate applied AI solutions across natural language, vision, recommendation, and structured data domains.
  • Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML formulations with clear success metrics and evaluation strategies.
  • Stay current with the latest research in deep learning, large language models, and adjacent areas, and assess applicability to internal use cases.
  • Implement rigorous experimentation workflows including baselines, ablations, and statistically sound evaluation methodology.
  • Build production-quality training and inference pipelines using modern ML frameworks and orchestration tools.
  • Collaborate with ML platform engineers to ensure efficient use of compute, storage, and accelerator resources.
  • Optimize models for accuracy, latency, throughput, and cost based on production requirements.
  • Develop tooling for dataset construction, labeling, validation, and ongoing monitoring of data quality.
  • Partner with product, design, and domain experts to ensure model behavior aligns with user needs and policy requirements.
  • Implement safety, fairness, and reliability evaluations and incorporate findings into model selection decisions.
  • Document research findings, design decisions, and operational characteristics clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Mentor engineers on applied ML methodology, evaluation rigor, and responsible deployment.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, reading groups, and prototype-to-production playbooks.
  • Influence the broader AI roadmap based on research insight, capability gaps, and emerging opportunities.
Required Qualifications
  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a closely related field; or equivalent applied experience.
  • 12 or more years of combined research and applied ML engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.
  • Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating deep learning models at non-trivial scale.
  • Solid grounding in mathematics, statistics, and the theoretical foundations of modern ML.
  • Experience taking ML models from research prototype to production with appropriate observability and safeguards.
  • Familiarity with distributed training, mixed-precision training, and accelerator hardware.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including ability to explain complex methods clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to read, evaluate, and adapt techniques from current research literature.
  • Track record of shipping impactful applied AI projects.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Published research at top-tier AI/ML venues.
  • Experience with large language model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, or multimodal architectures.
  • Exposure to responsible AI, model evaluation, and alignment practices.
  • Experience contributing to open-source ML projects.

Job Title: Clinical Project Manager - cFSP
