Why Join Clinical Functional Service Partnerships (CFSP)?

At IQVIA, our Clinical Functional Service Partnership (CFSP) models offer the best of both worlds: the opportunity to work as an integrated member of a leading sponsor's team while benefiting from the global expertise, career development and support of IQVIA. CFSP roles provide the opportunity to develop specialist expertise on a dedicated program, with the flexibility to expand across sponsors and therapeutic areas as your career progresses.

Through our long-standing partnerships with top pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, you will contribute to the delivery of cutting-edge clinical research programs that bring innovative treatments to patients worldwide. Our professionals support studies across all phases of development and a broad range of therapeutic areas, gaining valuable experience in diverse and dynamic research environments.


Clinical Project Manager

At IQVIA, as a Clinical Project Manager you will lead the end-to-end delivery of clinical trials on behalf of one of our sponsors, managing timelines, budgets, risk and cross-functional teams to keep studies on track and compliant. Embedded within a sponsor’s team, you will gain deep therapeutic and operational expertise, supported by the strength and reach of IQVIA’s global infrastructure.

This is an exciting opportunity to lead regional and global clinical studies within a leading sponsor environment, while expanding your project management expertise within one of the world's leading clinical research organizations.


Key responsibilities

  • Participate in bid defense presentations in partnership with Business Development and may lead the presentation for smaller, less complex regional studies.
  • May be responsible for delivery and management of smaller, less complex, regional studies.
  • Develop integrated study management plans with the core project team.
  • Accountable for the execution of clinical studies, or assigned portion of clinical studies, per contract while optimizing speed, quality and cost of delivery and ensuring consistent use of study tools and training materials and compliance with standard processes, policies and procedures.
  • Set objectives of the core project team and/or sub-team(s) according to agreed upon contract, strategy and approach, effectively communicate and assess performance.
  • Collaborate with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.
  • Monitor progress against contract and prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Manage risk (positive and negative) and contingencies proactively and lead problem solving and resolution efforts.
  • Achieve project quality by identifying quality risks and issues, responding to issues raised by project team and/or sub-team members and planning/implementing appropriate corrective and preventative action plans.
  • May serve as primary or backup project contact with customer and would then own the relationship with the project’s key customer contacts, as well as communicate/collaborate with IQVIA business development representatives, as necessary.;
  • Build the cross-functional project team and lead their efforts; responsible for managing cross-collaboration of the core team and for overall project delivery to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.;
  • Ensure the financial success of the project.
  • Forecast and identify opportunities to accelerate activities to bring revenue forward.
  • Identify changes in scope and manage change control process as necessary.
  • Identify lessons learned and implement best practices.
  • May be assigned as the primary contact for vendors leading project vendor management and vendor management related activities as per project requirements.;
  • Adopt corporate initiatives and changes and serve as a change advocate when necessary.
  • Provide input to line managers of their project team members’ performance relative to project tasks.
  • Support staff development and mentor less experienced project team members on assigned projects to support their professional development.;

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor's Degree Life sciences or related field
  • 5 years of prior relevant experience including > 2 years of project management experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
  • Prior Regional or Global Clinical Project Management experience.
  • Leadership - Ability to work through others to deliver results to the appropriate quality and timeline metrics, monitoring/managing performance and providing feedback, experience productively partnering cross functionally and with customers to advance work effectively and efficiently.
  • Organisation - Planning, time management and prioritization skills. Ability to organize resources needed to accomplish tasks, set objectives and provide clear direction to others, experience planning activities in advance and taking account of possible changing circumstances.
  • Quality - Attention to detail and accuracy in work. Results-oriented approach to work towards delivery and output.
  • Collaboration - Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with coworkers, managers and clients. Strong customer service skills.
  • Finances - Good understanding of project financials including experience managing, contractual obligations and implications.
  • IQVIA Core Competencies - Ability to demonstrate all IQVIA competencies (Client Focus, Collaboration, Communication, innovation, Ownership).

Build Your Future with IQVIA

If you're looking for a role that combines clinical trial delivery, project leadership, sponsor partnership and career growth, we would love to hear from you. At IQVIA, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative studies, collaborate with industry-leading sponsors, leverage cutting-edge technology and develop your career within a global organization dedicated to transforming healthcare and improving patient outcomes worldwide.


IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain)

About the Role

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a senior VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit.

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability.

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Delivery

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability

Architecture

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role)
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards

Strategic Engineering Leadership

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices

Reporting Structure

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements.

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled.

Qualifications and Experience

Engineering Vision and Strategy

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them

Leadership at Scale

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change

Technical Depth

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function

Execution and Accountability

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns

Why This Role Matters

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape.

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists.

About Vonage and SA NwPS

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function.

jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Senior Security Engineer on Zoom's Enterprise Security team, you will own the AI Governance program end to end, defining the technical standards and risk posture that determine how Zoom adopts AI safely and at scale. On any given day, you will be assessing emerging AI use cases, building security frameworks for GenAI and agentic systems, and serving as the trusted technical voice on AI security for engineering and enterprise stakeholders across four critical domains. This is a hands-on, highly autonomous role that calls for real depth in both AI/ML systems and security engineering; candidates without working familiarity with how modern AI introduces security risk will not be set up for success here. You will work as part of a globally distributed, multi-domain security engineering team, collaborating closely with colleagues across time zones and contributing across adjacent security domains beyond AI.


About the Team

Zoom's Enterprise Security team is the engineering foundation behind how the company identifies, contains, and gets ahead of risk across its most critical systems. Working across AI, data, network, endpoint, and cloud security, the team builds the controls, standards, and architectures that let Zoom move quickly without creating unacceptable exposure. As Zoom deepens its investment in AI across Zoom Workplace and its broader platform, this team's work is increasingly central to how the company grows responsibly.


Responsibilities

  • Own the AI governance risk register and end-to-end assessment methodology across four domains (GenAI, Agentic AI, Shadow AI/Local AI, and AI Gateway/MCP); conduct and review risk evaluations using Likelihood x Impact scoring and drive remediation with owning engineering teams.
  • Identify and prioritize security gaps in GenAI deployments including prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and insecure output handling; define monitoring and guardrail requirements for agentic systems operating with significant autonomy and tool access.
  • Lead the Shadow AI governance strategy end to end, from quantifying risk exposure to recommending and operationalizing detection and enforcement controls across the enterprise.
  • Set the security bar for AI gateway and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations, including secure configuration, access control frameworks, and governance coverage.
  • Architect reference security patterns for AI adoption (AI gateways, MCP servers, agent frameworks, LLM integrations) and serve as design authority in AI-related architecture reviews; translate the AI Governance Risk Charter into a concrete roadmap of technical requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Drive evaluations of AI security tooling (AI gateways, CASB/SWG, agentic monitoring, MCP governance solutions), including POC design, cost-benefit analysis, and leadership recommendations; author and maintain security standards and policy for AI adoption.
  • Lead security architecture reviews and risk assessments across adjacent domains including Network, Endpoint, Cloud, and Data Security; contribute to incident response, detection engineering, and purple team exercises as shared team functions.
  • Serve as the primary technical partner to AI/ML, engineering, and enterprise teams; lead cross-functional working groups, mentor engineers on risk analysis and documentation quality, and deliver clear reporting on AI risk posture and forecasted challenges to leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of security engineering or cybersecurity experience, including end-to-end ownership of a security domain or program, with a track record of driving risk assessment, prioritization, and remediation across cross-functional teams.
  • Solid working knowledge of modern AI/ML systems and the security risks they introduce (LLMs, generative AI, agentic systems); direct experience securing GenAI or LLM-based applications in an enterprise environment is a strong differentiator.
  • Understanding of AI gateways, Model Context Protocol (MCP), CASB/SWG, or DLP tooling, and a working understanding of shadow AI detection and governance strategies.
  • Working knowledge across core security domains (network, endpoint, cloud, and data security) sufficient to independently lead architecture reviews and risk assessments outside of AI.
  • Experience designing security reference architectures or serving as a design authority in complex, cross-functional technical environments; threat modeling experience applied to AI or novel technology stacks is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, communicate risk clearly in writing and verbally, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and enterprise teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort operating in a globally distributed team with regular overlap with US Pacific hours; ability to work with high autonomy and produce clear, actionable risk documentation for leadership audiences.

Job Summary

Business Transitions is Mercer Advisors' dedicated practice serving business owners, founders, and executives navigating M&A transactions and major liquidity events. We pressure test valuation and deal process, model after tax proceeds in real time as terms shift and make sure the planning that protects the outcome happens before leverage disappears at LOI.

How This Role Fits

This role lives in the space between banking, law, and financial advice, and that is what makes it valuable. You work alongside the client's deal team, not in place of it.

  • Bankers negotiate terms and run the sale process. You help the owner understand what each term means for their after-tax outcome.
  • Attorneys draft agreements and provide legal counsel. You translate deal mechanics into planning decisions the owner can act on.
  • Your Mercer advisor colleague manages the ongoing relationship after close. You lead a structured handoff so the transition feels seamless.

Deal Execution

  • Represent the Business Transitions practice externally through industry events, speaking opportunities, and panel discussions as a credible voice on transaction dynamics and business owner financial planning.
  • Collaborate with Mercer's regional advisory teams to identify existing clients approaching a liquidity event and coordinate the internal resources needed to serve them.
  • Support business owner prospects referred through Mercer's existing growth channels, including custodial partners, digital advertising, and referral programs, as the deal-credible resource who advances and closes those relationships.

  • 8 to 15 years of experience working directly on M&A transactions. Relevant backgrounds include lower middle market investment banking, M&A advisory, corporate development at private equity backed or founder led companies, M&A and transaction law, M&A tax and deal accounting, wealth advisory with a demonstrated transactional background serving business owner clients, and RIA focused M&A and corporate development.

Job Description:

About the work

You'll work on the macOS sensor for CrowdStrike Falcon, an on-device security agent. It monitors file, process, network and identity activity, blocks malicious behavior, and streams telemetry to the cloud. The sensor runs entirely in user space as a System Extension. Much of the code is shared with Windows and Linux. The work requires high concurrency, high reliability, careful attention to memory & CPU usage and performance.

Required

  • Languages: modern C++ (C++17/20) and Swift 6 (async/await, actors, strict concurrency checking). Also Objective-C++ to bridge Swift, C++ and C APIs.
  • macOS systems programming: Foundation and CoreFoundation, GCD and pthreads, POSIX/BSD APIs, Mach IPC, launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPCConnection).

· Performance, debugging and test:

o Profiling CPU and memory with Instruments and os_signpost.

o Debugging with LLDB, crash logs and os_log.

o XCTest, sanitizers, fuzzing, and xcodebuild-based CI.

o Apple Silicon and Intel.

  • Experience with codebases shared across Mac, Windows and Linux.

Core skills (one or more of the areas listed below)

  • Process model and IPC: launchd daemons and agents, and XPC (C API and NSXPCConnection).
  • Endpoint Security and System Extensions: Endpoint Security clients handling both blocking (AUTH) events and notification events, user/MDM approval, upgrades.
  • Network Extension: content filters, both flow-level (NEFilterDataProvider) and packet-level (NEFilterPacketProvider), and Network.framework.
  • Security and crypto: Verifying code signatures (SecCode / SecStaticCode) and validating certificates (SecTrust), Keychain, Entitlements, hardened runtime, and macOS privacy permissions.

Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Specialty Account Executive Intelligence Center X

Industry aligned enterprise sales

Industry Energy, Life Sciences and CPG

Territory Industry focused – US based

Organization Siemens Digital Industries Software

Location Remote

Role type Individual contributor enterprise sales

Travel As needed, minimum expectation 25%

Help customers move from digital enterprise to agentic enterprise

The next era of enterprise AI will not be won by adding another disconnected model, dashboard or pilot. It will be won by connecting trusted enterprise context to intelligence and then turning that intelligence into governed action across the systems and workflows that run the business.

That is the opportunity behind Siemens Intelligence Center X, and it is the mission of this role.

About Siemens Intelligence Center X

Siemens Intelligence Center X, or ICX, is an enterprise platform for building and scaling industrial AI solutions. It brings together Graph Studio, AI Studio and Agent Builder, App Studio powered by Mendix, process orchestration and governance so customers can move from Context to Intelligence to Action in one governed environment.

ICX complements the systems customers already rely on, including PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and data platforms. It connects information across those systems, gives AI the context needed to reason, and enables people and agents to take measurable action through applications and orchestrated workflows.

The opportunity

We are looking for an accomplished enterprise seller to build and lead the ICX business across Electronics and Semiconductor. You will own a net-new ACV target and pursue consequential, multi-year platform opportunities that begin with a high-value business problem and expand across functions, use cases and geographies.

This is a role for a seller who creates demand, earns access to senior executives and leads from first insight through signature. You will combine the pace and ownership of a growth business with Siemens' industry credibility, customer relationships, technology portfolio and global reach.

Across Life Sciences, Energy and Utilities, and CPG organizations must improve speed, quality and resilience while managing complex operations, evolving demand and regulatory obligations. Their priorities span accelerating validated innovation, improving asset reliability and field productivity, and strengthening supply chain responsiveness and customer experience. ICX connects governed context across research, engineering, quality, manufacturing, assets, supply chains and commercial operations. This enables teams to apply AI, make informed decisions and coordinate action across the value chain while preserving the validation, traceability, safety and auditability their industries require.

What you will own

  • Create the market. Build a focused territory and account strategy, identify high-consequence business problems and generate qualified pipeline through insight-led prospecting, Siemens relationships, partners and executive networks.
  • Lead the value conversation. Engage CIOs, CDOs, COOs and line-of-business executives around measurable business outcomes, not features. Translate operational pain into an executive value case with clear metrics, urgency and sponsorship.
  • Run the full pursuit. Own the opportunity from qualification through discovery, tailored experience, commercial strategy, security and procurement, paper process and signature. Maintain momentum, create the next action and escalate blockers early.
  • Orchestrate the winning team. Lead a matrixed pursuit team that may include Siemens Account Orchestrators, Solution Architects, Value Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Expert Services, product leaders and industry specialists.
  • Make the customer experience count. Partner with the Solution Architect to convert discovery into a tailored ICX story and experience that proves how context, intelligence, action and governance come together against one consequential decision.
  • Build executive alignment. Multi-thread the account, develop a credible champion and secure access to the economic buyer. Create shared clarity on decision criteria, decision process, paper process and the cost of inaction.
  • Win with an ecosystem. Activate Siemens, hyperscaler and global systems integrator relationships where they create access, credibility, delivery confidence or scale.
  • Operate with discipline. Apply rigorous opportunity qualification, maintain an accurate forecast and create a healthy pipeline that supports sustained target attainment.

Industry priorities

  • Quality, safety and corrective action
  • Operational performance and asset reliability
  • Supply and network resilience
  • Engineering, change and capital project intelligence
  • Governed knowledge and workflow orchestration

What success looks like

  • A prioritized territory plan built around the accounts, executive relationships and use cases most likely to produce material ICX opportunities.
  • A qualified pipeline with measurable customer pain, executive sponsorship, a compelling event and a defined path to decision.
  • Strategic ICX lands with a credible roadmap to expand across additional use cases, business units and platform capabilities.
  • Customer-backed value cases that connect ICX investment to financial, operational or risk outcomes.
  • Reliable forecast performance and consistent progression across complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits.
  • Strong operating relationships across Siemens and the partner ecosystem, with clear ownership and accountability throughout the customer journey.

What you bring

Required experience and capabilities

  • A sustained record of meeting or exceeding enterprise software sales targets in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience creating and closing strategic platform opportunities, including multi-year agreements with executive visibility and seven-figure potential.
  • Executive presence and business acumen: you can earn credibility with C-suite and operating leaders, diagnose a business problem and build a financially grounded case for change.
  • Fluency in at least two of the following: enterprise AI and machine learning, knowledge graphs or data platforms, application development, process automation, cloud platforms or industrial software.
  • Command of a rigorous enterprise sales methodology and the judgment to qualify out, advance decisively and forecast accurately.
  • The ability to lead a diverse pursuit team without relying on formal authority, while maintaining pace and accountability across handoffs.
  • A willingness to learn the customer's industry, Siemens' portfolio and the evolving AI competitive landscape at depth.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred experience

  • Experience selling enterprise AI, data, automation, low-code or industry software platforms into Energy, Life Sciences and CPG.
  • Existing relationships with CIO and CTO; VP Manufacturing Operations, Research and Development and or Supply Chain, Safety Risk and Regulatory Affairs within the Energy, Life Sciences and or CPG Industries.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, agentic workflows, model governance, digital twins or cross-system orchestration.
  • Experience co-selling with global account teams, hyperscalers or systems integrators.
  • A track record competing against established platform providers and reframing customer decisions around differentiated business value.

Why join the ICX team

  • Build a category-defining business. Help shape how the world's most consequential enterprises operationalize AI with context, governance and action.
  • Sell where Siemens already matters. Enter strategic accounts with the credibility, relationships and industrial domain depth of one of the world's most trusted technology companies.
  • Own meaningful outcomes. Pursue enterprise platform opportunities tied to operational performance, resilience, quality, speed and growth.
  • Work with a serious technical bench. Partner with Solution Architects, AI and data specialists, value engineers, industry experts and services leaders who can turn a strong discovery into a differentiated customer experience.
  • Grow with the market. Develop at the intersection of industrial software, enterprise AI, agentic systems, applications and process orchestration.

How we work

We expect ownership, curiosity, direct communication and a bias for action. The strongest people on this team create the next step, challenge assumptions with evidence, escalate barriers early and stay accountable across every handoff. They are comfortable with the uncomfortable because consequential outcomes rarely come from passive selling.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager II to grow traffic across BOLD’s brands. You’ll work with Marketing, Paid Acquisition, SEO, and Engineering to build and scale how we acquire users across our sites.

You’ll lead growth projects across several teams, set up how we run experiments, and turn more high-intent visitors into active users. You’ll be the main product partner to marketing leadership, turning business goals into roadmaps and clear requirements.

About this team

You’ll partner closely with cross-functional growth and traffic leaders, software engineers, data scientists, and performance marketing teams to build scalable acquisition loops and drive user growth across BOLD’s multi-brand ecosystem.

What you'll do

  • Use traffic data and customer insight to make the case for where growth should come from, and get executives and marketing leaders aligned on it.
  • Run job distribution day to day: the real-time CPC bidding engine, API partner integrations and attribution, and click-quality controls like bot detection and fraud quarantine.
  • Own Joblist, our owned traffic-arbitrage channel, including Google bidding and ROAS targets, and run it as a traffic source for the marketplace rather than a stand-alone profit center.
  • Work with Engineering on the long-term growth tech roadmap. Spot where our acquisition platforms will hit their limits, and steer investment so they can scale.
  • Coach other PMs and partners on fixing growth and onboarding bottlenecks, working through ambiguity, and making sound product decisions.
  • Run experiments at scale across every customer-facing surface, and use research and data to decide what to test next.
  • Define and track the growth KPIs that matter to the business, such as traffic growth, conversion, CAC:LTV, and retention.

What you'll need

  • 8+ years in product management, with a track record of growing traffic, revenue, and user acquisition at a senior or principal level.
  • Experience working directly with marketing executives and sharing ownership of acquisition goals and budgets.
  • Deep knowledge of martech integrations, SEO, paid media attribution, programmatic landing pages, and personalized user journeys.
  • Strong skills in web analytics, user behavior modeling, and experiment design, and the judgment to use them when deciding where to invest.
  • Experience earning trust across teams, resolving conflicts between them, and coaching mid-level PMs.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, computer science, marketing, or a quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

What's good to have

  • Hands-on experience with custom media attribution, predictive LTV models, or programmatic SEO.
  • Experience owning growth across multiple brands or regions.

Benefits

Outstanding Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Bi-annual bonus
  • 401(k) plan with match
  • Equity in company
  • Flexible spending accounts (health, dependent care)
  • Internet and home office reimbursement

100% Full Health Benefits

  • Medical, dental, and vision (optional plans for your family)
  • Life & long-term disability insurance (optional)
  • Mental health support and resources
  • Wellness reimbursement (gym, health apps, etc.)
  • Pet Insurance (optional)

Flexible Time Away

  • Flexible PTO
  • Sick time policy
  • Observed holidays

Eligibility

Eligible Hiring Locations

This position is 100% remote, work from home.

BOLD can hire full-time residents of the following U.S. States & Territories: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia (Washington D.C) Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

California Residents: Please see our privacy notice for more info on how we handle your data.

Additional Pay Ranges
• All other locations: $150,000-$175,000
• SF/NY/Seattle : $165,000-$190,000
• Austin/Chicago: $155,000-$180,000

Individual pay is based on location, transferable skills, experience, and other relevant factors. This estimated range is based on the best available market data and factors, all of which are subject to change. This position may also be eligible for a bonus and medical, dental, vision, life, short and long-term disability insurance, 401(k), paid time off, sick leave, and paid holidays, all subject to applicable plan terms.

Starting pay range
$150,000—$190,000 USD

About Bold
We Transform Work Lives
As an established global organization, BOLD helps people find jobs. Our story is one of growth, success, and professional fulfillment. We create digital products that have empowered millions of people in 180 countries to build stronger resumes, cover letters, and CVs. The result of our work helps people interview confidently, finding the right job in less time. Our employees are experts, learners, contributors, and creatives.

We Celebrate And Promote Diversity And Inclusion
We value our position as an Equal Opportunity Employer. We hire based on qualifications, merit, and our business needs. We don't discriminate regarding race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, national origin or citizenship, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Federal Sales Account Executive (Marine Corps, Navy, Coast Guard)
jobs.excerpt: OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance.
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

Stephen Gorham is expanding the OPSWAT Federal team, and there has never been a better time to join. We’re in the middle of an exciting Federal expansion, fueled by incredible adoption of OPSWAT’s purpose-built solutions that help the DoD, Intelligence Community, and Federal Civilian Agencies meet their missions with greater security and confidence.

As part of this investment, we’ve opened our new state-of-the-art Critical Infrastructure Lab in Arlington, VA—a hub for innovation, collaboration, and hands-on demonstrations of our unique technologies. We’re continuing to make substantial investments in Federal because we see the difference OPSWAT makes for national security every day—and we want passionate people to join us in driving that mission forward.

About the Role

As a Federal Sales Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of OPSWAT’s federal growth. Your mission is to build, manage, and grow relationships across Federal agencies, while driving adoption of OPSWAT’s solutions for Zero Trust, critical infrastructure protection, and secure file and data transfer. You will work closely with capture managers, channel partners, and technical experts to develop strategies that deliver wins and expand OPSWAT’s presence in the Federal market.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own and drive a Federal sales territory focused on the Marine Corps, Navy and Coast Guard.
  • Meet or exceed annual sales quota by developing new business and expanding existing accounts.
  • Lead the complete sales cycle—from opportunity identification and qualification through negotiation and close.
  • Partner with Channel and Federal System Integrator partners to maximize contract vehicle access and joint wins.
  • Collaborate with capture managers and proposal teams to align sales strategy with capture efforts.
  • Leverage OPSWAT’s Critical Infrastructure Lab in Arlington, VA to host demonstrations, workshops, and executive briefings for customers and partners.
  • Provide accurate pipeline forecasts and contribute to Federal growth strategy.

What We Need From You

  • 10+ years of Federal technology sales experience, preferably in cybersecurity, networking, or critical infrastructure protection.
  • Deep understanding of Federal procurement processes, contract vehicles, and acquisition lifecycles.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas with Federal agencies.
  • Strong relationships within DoD, IC, and/or civilian agencies, and with Federal System Integrators.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Mission-driven mindset with a passion for protecting national security.

Why Join OPSWAT Federal?

  • Be part of a rapidly growing Federal team led by Stephen Gorham.
  • Help Federal agencies secure missions with purpose-built cybersecurity solutions.
  • Work in a culture of innovation and collaboration with substantial ongoing investment.
  • Access to a state-of-the-art Critical Infrastructure Lab in Arlington, VA.
  • Competitive compensation, uncapped career growth opportunities.

This is more than a sales role—it’s a chance to make an impact where it matters most. If you’re ready to help Federal agencies strengthen their security posture and drive OPSWAT’s Federal expansion, we’d love to hear from you.

OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.

To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.description:
At Flexspring, you will have the autonomy and flexibility to tackle your role in a way that is right for you. We foster a learning culture that will allow you to develop new skills and progress in your career.

Who We Are

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) company specializing in HR data integrations. We partner with HR teams and HR software companies to design and deliver custom integrations that connect HR, payroll, and business systems, reduce manual work, improve data accuracy, and help people's operations run more efficiently.

The Role

As an Account Manager at Flexspring, you will serve as a trusted partner to customers after implementation, ensuring they realize ongoing value from our integration solutions. You will own relationships across your book of business, balancing customer advocacy with commercial responsibility to drive renewals, expansion, and long-term partnerships.

This role sits at the intersection of customer success, business growth, and integration expertise. You will work closely with customers and internal teams to align business goals, promote adoption, and translate integration outcomes into measurable value.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end renewal process for your accounts, proactively managing risk and driving high retention
  • Identify and execute upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning customer needs with additional integrations and services
  • Build strategic account plans that connect customer objectives with Flexspring’s integration roadmap
  • Develop customer advocates and secure references through success stories, case studies, and participation in go-to-market initiatives
  • Serve as the primary post-sale point of contact, building long-term relationships with HR, IT, and Finance leaders
  • Measure, communicate, and demonstrate the business impact and ROI of Flexspring’s integrations
  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Delivery teams to share customer insights and influence product direction

What you’ll bring

Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, or a related role within SaaS, HR tech, or a technology-driven environment.
  • Proven track record of managing renewals and driving account expansion within an existing customer base.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining executive-level relationships.
  • Solid understanding of HR systems and the challenges associated with HR data integration.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce
  • Strong negotiation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to articulate business outcomes and return on investment.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, and collaborative, with a strong sense of ownership for customer outcomes

Nice to Have

  • Experience with HR and/or financial data integrations
  • Exposure to enterprise HR platforms such as Workday, SAP, Oracle, ADP, UKG, or Paylocity
  • Experience supporting customers across HR, IT, and Finance stakeholders
  • Additional language skills such as French, Spanish, Arabic, or other languages

What You Get

  • Work from home with flexible hours.
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Comprehensive health benefits package for you and your family.
  • Team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues.
  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
  • Competitive base salary.

For more information about Flexspring, visit:

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Flexspring is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. Flexspring is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Flexspring are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Flexspring does not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Flexspring encourages applicants of all ages.

**********************************************************************************************************************************************

Chez Flexspring, vous aurez l'autonomie et la flexibilité nécessaires pour aborder votre rôle d'une manière qui vous convient. Nous favorisons une culture d'apprentissage qui vous permettra de développer de nouvelles compétences et de progresser dans votre carrière.

Qui nous sommes

Flexspring est une entreprise iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) spécialisée dans les intégrations de données RH. Nous collaborons avec des équipes RH et des entreprises de logiciels RH pour concevoir et livrer des intégrations personnalisées qui relient les systèmes RH, de paie et d'affaires, réduisent le travail manuel, améliorent l'exactitude des données et aident les opérations liées au personnel à fonctionner plus efficacement.

Le rôle

À titre de gestionnaire de comptes chez Flexspring, vous agirez comme partenaire de confiance auprès des clients après la mise en œuvre, en veillant à ce qu'ils tirent une valeur continue de nos solutions d'intégration. Vous serez responsable des relations au sein de votre portefeuille de clients, en équilibrant la défense des intérêts des clients et la responsabilité commerciale afin de favoriser les renouvellements, l'expansion et les partenariats à long terme.

Ce rôle se situe à l'intersection du succès client, de la croissance des affaires et de l'expertise en intégration. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les équipes internes afin d'harmoniser les objectifs d'affaires, de favoriser l'adoption et de traduire les résultats d'intégration en valeur mesurable.

  • Agir comme principal point de contact après la vente, en établissant des relations à long terme avec les leaders des RH, des TI et des finances.
  • Mesurer, communiquer et démontrer l'incidence commerciale et le rendement du capital investi des intégrations de Flexspring.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes des produits, des ventes et de la livraison afin de partager les points de vue des clients et d'influencer l'orientation des produits.

Ce que vous apportez

Indispensable

  • 3 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de comptes, en succès client ou dans un rôle connexe au sein d'une entreprise SaaS, de technologie RH ou d'un environnement axé sur la technologie.
  • Antécédents éprouvés en gestion des renouvellements et en croissance des comptes au sein d'une clientèle existante.
  • Solide expérience dans l'établissement et le maintien de relations au niveau de la direction.
  • Bonne compréhension des systèmes RH et des défis associés à l'intégration des données RH.
  • Expérience de travail avec des plateformes de GRC telles que Salesforce.
  • Solides compétences en négociation, en présentation et en gestion des parties prenantes.
  • État d'esprit axé sur les données, avec la capacité d'exprimer clairement les résultats d'affaires et le rendement du capital investi.
  • Autonome, responsable et collaboratif, avec un fort sens des responsabilités à l'égard des résultats des clients.

Atout

  • Expérience avec les intégrations de données RH et/ou financières.
  • Exposition aux plateformes RH d'entreprise telles que Workday, SAP, Oracle, ADP, UKG ou Paylocity.
  • Expérience dans le soutien de clients auprès des parties prenantes des RH, des TI et des finances.
  • Compétences linguistiques additionnelles, comme le français, l'espagnol, l'arabe ou d'autres langues.

Ce que vous obtiendrez

  • Travail à domicile avec horaires flexibles.
  • 4 semaines de vacances payées par année.
  • Régime d'avantages sociaux complet pour vous et votre famille.
  • Événements d'équipe et occasions de rencontrer vos collègues.
  • Possibilité de travailler avec des technologies de pointe.
  • Salaire de base compétitif.

Pour plus d'informations sur Flexspring, visitez :

Déclaration d'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi

Flexspring est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et interdit toute forme de discrimination et de harcèlement. Flexspring s'engage envers le principe de l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi pour tous les employés et à offrir à ses employés un environnement de travail exempt de discrimination et de harcèlement. Toutes les décisions d'emploi chez Flexspring sont fondées sur les besoins de l'entreprise, les exigences du poste et les qualifications individuelles, sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion ou les croyances, l'origine nationale, sociale ou ethnique, le sexe (y compris la grossesse), l'âge, un handicap physique, mental ou sensoriel, le statut VIH, l'orientation sexuelle, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'état matrimonial, l'union civile ou le statut de partenariat domestique, le service militaire passé ou présent, les antécédents médicaux familiaux ou les renseignements génétiques, la situation familiale ou parentale, ou tout autre statut protégé par les lois ou règlements en vigueur dans les lieux où nous exerçons nos activités. Flexspring ne tolère aucune discrimination ou harcèlement fondé sur l'une de ces caractéristiques. Flexspring encourage les candidats de tous âges à postuler.

jobs.description:
Senior Executive Assistant

Circana is the leading advisor on the complexity of consumer behavior. Through unparalleled technology, advanced analytics, cross-industry data and deep expertise, we provide clarity that helps almost 7,000 of the world’s leading brands and retailers take action and unlock business growth. We understand more about the complete consumer, the complete store, and the complete wallet so our clients can go beyond the data to apply insights, ignite innovation, meet consumer demand, and outpace the competition.

For our colleagues, we focus on the moments that matter. From meaningful work and impact to continuous improvement, we challenge ourselves to grow both professionally and personally. You’ll feel a true sense of connection and purpose in your work and will craft the direction of your career in a highly personalized way. No matter the department you join, you’ll find yourself constantly growing and developing the skills of the future to deliver client growth. We believe in the undeniable strength that diverse people, culture, thought and skill bring to our business, our clients, our people and our communities. We are committed to nurturing a dynamic culture that embraces and celebrates openness, collaboration, creativity, equity, inclusivity and growth for all.

What will I be doing?

Deliver exceptional support to the President of Global Solutions on all administrative matters including scheduling meetings, handling calendars, submitting expenses, scheduling travel, team meeting content and coordination, plus any other miscellaneous requests or issues that arise.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a rapport with senior executives and stakeholders through strong lines of communication.
  • Demonstrate professionalism and strict confidentiality through all interactions, and with all materials, and exercise discretion at all times.
  • Assist with various tasks, including, but not limited to maintaining distribution lists and the Solutions Team calendar.
  • Cross functional training /meeting coordination.
  • Manage complex calendar and schedule management across global time zones for Division President.
  • Coordinate travel arrangements, including air, ground transportation, and accommodations.
  • Plan meetings (physical or virtual), taking and transcribing minutes, following up on action items/deliverables, planning events, arranging travel, and accommodation.
  • Maintain and refine processes that support the organization.
  • Prepare materials via PowerPoint for monthly Global Town Halls; Includes gathering potential topics and lining up speakers (in partnership with President and or /team leaders)

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive administrative experience, with at least 5+ years of experience providing C-Level administrative support.
  • Superb level of professionalism, business acumen, and maturity.
  • Exceptional organization skills, verbal and written communication skills, and meticulous attention to detail.
  • High proficiency in MS Office and auxiliary platforms, e.g., MS Teams.
  • Strong project and task management skills.
  • Ability to multitask and adjust in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in scheduling assistance and calendar management.
  • Ability to adjust working schedule as needed to support meetings before and after office hours.
  • Work with other EAs to align calendars for ELT and Board meetings
  • Experience with Concur a plus.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:This position can be located in the following area(s): Remote, US withtravel as needed (estimate 1x per quarter to Circana US Offices).

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee's position within the pay range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The compensation range for this role is $37.00 to $52.88 per hour.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Manager to join our Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) team. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing key client relationships, take an operational approach to account management, ensuring the delivery of high-quality pharmacy benefits, and driving client satisfaction. This role requires a deep understanding of PBM services, strong communication skills, and the ability to manage complex accounts.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own day-to-day operational management for an assigned book of PBM clients — including managing client touchbases, tracking inquiries, maintaining issue logs, resolving escalations, and ensuring overall client satisfaction against contractual commitments.
  • Serve as the primary operational point of contact for all client inquiries, both directly from clients and from internal team members acting on behalf of clients.
  • Co-lead and facilitate client meetings — including quarterly and annual business reviews — in close coordination with Account Leads.
  • Partner with the Implementation team during new client onboarding to ensure a seamless handoff from implementation to ongoing client management post-launch.
  • Gather and manage all client requirements for the annual open enrollment cycle, including benefit changes and customized plan configurations.
  • Facilitate client-facing webinars, benefit fairs, and employee education sessions on Rightway's PBM solution; travel to client sites may be required for open enrollment events.
  • Proactively identify operational trends and issues; work with internal operations teams and vendor partners to implement corrective and preventative measures.
  • Monitor and track all client deliverables against contractual obligations, surfacing risks and ensuring timely, accurate delivery across internal and vendor teams.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives focused on standardizing client operations and implementing process and production enhancements.
  • Support Rightway partners by interpreting plan design, researching and resolving written, phone, and electronic inquiries, and troubleshooting claims, benefit, and enrollment issues.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Education level: Bachelor’s Degree Required. Preferred: Master’s Degree
  • Work experience: 5-8 years in pharmacy operations
  • Important characteristics of ideal candidate: Detail-oriented, consultative and presentation skills, excellent communication & organization skills, ability to bring stakeholders together to identify solutions to challenges
  • Specific skills needed for the job: Solid client management skills, pharmacy benefit knowledge, effective & creative problem-solver, ability to prioritize and manage through change. Solid communication skills, ability to lead projects and influence others even without direct reporting line ownership. Basic knowledge of common spreadsheet tools (Excel, Google Sheets) and Presentation Tools (Power Point, Google Slides)

COMPENSATION: $92,000 - $130,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $300mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Francisco Partners, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

About the Job

Program Operations & SLA Governance:

  • Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.
  • Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.
  • Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.
  • Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

Proactive Service Recovery:

  • Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.
  • Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

Root-Cause & Program Delivery:

  • Identify and size the frequency and impact of patterns across escalations, and turn them into effective solutions that reduce repeat issues.
  • Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Engineering, Operations, and the rest of Customer Experience so every signal has a destination, every action has an owner, and every outcome is measured.

Data, Analytics & Reporting:

  • Write SQL queries to investigate spikes, isolate root causes, and answer ad-hoc questions from CX, Product, and Operations leaders.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tracking escalation volume, time to resolution, recurring themes, SLA adherence, and partner impact.
  • Prepare leaders for key partner meetings, business reviews, and incident readouts with clear, quantified impact.

Process & Playbook:

  • Define and improve escalation intake, severity criteria, SLAs, and communication standards.
  • Build repeatable processes that scale beyond the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • [5+] years of program or escalation management experience, preferably in customer experience, contact center, or partner operations.
  • Proven ability to run cross-functional programs with named owners, published service-level agreements, and measurable outcomes, without direct authority in fast-moving, high-pressure situations.
  • Hands-on analytical skills, including strong SQL and experience with visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Mode, Tableau, or similar) to find patterns and prioritize.
  • Understanding of contact center metrics (e.g., Consumer Sentiment, first contact resolution, average handle time, Internal Quality Score) and the operational levers that move them.
  • Ability to identify the root causes behind changes in key metrics and recommend a mitigation strategy.
  • Track record of building reporting that an executive audience actually uses to make decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to synthesize complex topics into a compelling narrative for executives and external partners.
  • Sound judgment on what to escalate, to whom, and when, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities, including direct conversations with upset customers, shoppers, and partners.
  • Strategic mindset: able to think ahead of where the program is today and help stand up a new operating model rather than maintain an established one.
  • High accountability and ownership, with a driven, self-starter approach.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing product feedback or change requests that Product teams accepted and shipped.
  • Experience building or scaling an escalation or incident-management process.
  • Experience with de-escalation strategies, including customer relationship management.
  • Experience with retail, grocery, e-commerce, or marketplace partners.
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, JIRA, Slack, etc.
  • Highly collaborative, with a track record of building trust across teams and a desire to help others learn.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). You should have experience managing and ideally growing a dispersed sales engineering team in a high-performance environment. Our Sales Engineering team is full of problem solvers and tinkerers who are not afraid to get their hands dirty (literally) and play a critical role in demonstrating and communicating the value of Samsara’s platform with our largest customers.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and inspired to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Manage individual and team performance ensuring our partnership with sales, product, support, and customer success teams are productive and efficient
  • Work with Account Executives and Regional Sales Directors on account planning, strategy, and sales call activity
  • Manage escalations (product issues, feature requests, etc.) in a pre-sales environment
  • Participate in customer/prospect calls as a trusted advisor
  • Partner with other Sales Engineering leaders to improve the overall Sales Engineering organization at Samsara

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • B.S. degree in Computer Science or similar
  • 5+ years of sales engineering management experience
  • Experience with Software Product sales: Infrastructure, SaaS
  • Knowledge in one or more of these areas of expertise: IoT, Networking / Security, SaaS, Cloud Technologies, or Physical Security
  • Strong technical and business acumen
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to partner with a broad coalition of stakeholders, ranging from sales, product, marketing, support, and customer success, and from individual contributors to executive team members across the organization
  • Demonstrated leadership, creativity, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent presentation and organizational skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced dynamic environment
  • Ability to travel as needed
  • Location: Remote, Germany or Remote, France
  • Language requirement: Fluent German or Fluent French

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

To support our accelerating market growth across the United Kingdom, we are seeking a highly motivated, results-driven Outbound Sales Agent to join our dynamic offshore team.
