jobs.description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the Role:

Syndi is Syndio's AI platform — one shared agent experience (in-product chat, Slack, Teams) serving our product lines, built on syndi-api: an agent runtime owning orchestration, tool calling, memory, RAG, evals, and observability, live in production today. The platform is young (v1 shipped this quarter), moving fast, and designed around a clear operating model: product teams contribute domain content through APIs, evals, and knowledge — the platform owns the experience.

We're hiring a staff-level engineer to take ownership of major runtime surfaces and grow into a technical owner of the platform. This is a high-autonomy role on a small team (3–4 engineers): you'll design, ship, and operate systems end-to-end, and you'll work directly with product-team owners through the platform's contribution seams.

What You'll Work On

  • Core runtime surfaces of syndi-api: the agent loop, tool execution and registry, memory, context management (Python, Postgres, Claude on Vertex, GCP).
  • The eval system — offline gates and online detector/judge evals written onto production traces — and its growth as product teams adopt it.
  • Production operation: observability (Datadog LLM Obs), incident response, the reliability of an agent surface real customers use.
  • The platform's contribution seams: reviewing product teams' tool wrappers and evals, evolving the GET /tools registry and drift-detection contract.
  • Clarifying, designing, and implementing compliance and legal requirements for Syndi.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years building production backend systems; deep comfort with Python, relational stores, and cloud infra (we're on GCP/Kubernetes).
  • You've built LLM-powered systems in production — an agent loop, tool-calling integration, RAG, or eval infrastructure — and have opinions from the scar tissue.
  • You design for operability: legal compliance, tracing, evals, and kill switches are part of the feature, not afterthoughts.
  • You can own a technical domain with light supervision: propose direction in writing with clear API specs, take review, ship, and carry the pager for what you shipped.
  • Strong written communication — our operating model runs on design docs and PR review across team boundaries.
  • Nice to have: experience being the platform side of a platform/product relationship; SSE/streaming systems; compliance-adjacent engineering (data minimization, auditability); prior Staff scope.

Why you'll love it here:

  • 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $205-225k USD or $180-200k CAD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise.
  • 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio’s success
  • 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to (up to 20 days PTO in Canada) plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.
  • 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.
  • 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.
  • 📍Remote-first in US + Alberta; in Calgary, non-mandatory office available

Role Progession

  • First 30 days: Focus on onboarding, mastering our core agent runtime surfaces, and shipping a small-scale contribution to understand the platform's contribution seams.
  • First 60 days: Independently manage core runtime surfaces, troubleshoot complex issues, and start co-owning a consumer team's integration from API design to eval sign-off.
  • First 90 days: Concretely ship a major runtime capability end-to-end (e.g., multimodal input or a new channel surface), take on-call for the platform, and co-own a consumer team's integration from API design to eval sign-off.

The interview overview

Below you'll find an outline of the interview plan for our Staff Software Engineer (AI Platform) position. Please note that this is what we expect the process to look like; we may ask you for supplemental information or require an additional step before making a final decision.

  1. Recruiter Screen (25 min)

  3. Technical Discussion - LLMs (60 min)
  4. Take-Home Assignment

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Join Samsara's In-Vehicle Experience team as a Senior Software Engineer. You'll be the technical leader of the team, setting the direction for what we build and how. We are building AI voice experiences that speak to, coach, and assist drivers as they work, spanning proactive assistance, on-demand interaction, and the range of situations in between. We are looking for the product-minded full-stack engineer who will figure out what those experiences should be, ship them, and build the systems that let them evolve into one coherent product rather than a set of disconnected tools.

You'll design what agents say and how they behave, build the services that support them, and iterate on both based on what drivers actually experience. These systems sit at the intersection of software, AI, and the physical world. Because drivers interact with our products while operating a vehicle, decisions about what reaches them, and when, carry real weight. The systems underneath are where the hard-to-reverse decisions live. How agents share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, and how the system's decisions can be explained after the fact. You'll decide what's worth building, and own the systems that make it possible.

You'll ship against clear priorities from day one. We are looking for someone whose instinct is to shape the direction of the team's work, not just execute against it. Putting forward a point of view, making the case for it, and getting the team moving in a new direction is core to how this person operates. Engineers who habitually notice what should improve and then make it happen, rather than waiting to be told, will find this kind of role familiar.

AI-assisted engineering is central to this role. You will be expected to use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor proficiently throughout the software development lifecycle, not only for code generation but also for investigation, design, testing, review, and operational work.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada.

In this role, you will:

  • Define what to build and how to build it, shaping product direction from the engineering side.
  • Build and ship voice agent experiences from zero to one in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Iterate quickly based on real interactions.
  • Own the technical direction for how these experiences coordinate: how they share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, how the system holds up as more experiences are added, and how its real-time decisions can be investigated by the teams that need to.
  • Make and document architectural tradeoffs where requirements are still evolving, favoring foundations that generalize as new use cases emerge over one-off solutions that don't.
  • Serve as the team's technical anchor: review designs, unblock decisions, and mentor engineers as they expand into unfamiliar technical domains.
  • Introduce new patterns for full-stack and AI-assisted engineering, and get the team using them.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of products from concept through production.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Recent, primary experience shipping LLM/agent based products end-to-end, including evaluation of AI behavior in production.
  • Experience with memory, context, or retrieval systems for AI applications (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, long-lived session context).
  • Strong programming and design fundamentals (Go, TypeScript, Python).
  • Experience designing APIs and service boundaries that other systems rely on.
  • Experience setting technical direction on a team and mentoring other engineers.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
  • Located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada (this is a fully remote role).

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building zero-to-one products in fast-moving, high-autonomy environments.
  • Experience building persistent memory or personalization systems where agents learn about users over time.
  • Experience with multi-agent orchestration: coordinating multiple agents, avoiding conflicts, and maintaining consistency.
  • Experience building scheduling or arbitration systems.
  • Experience designing systems that combine structured and open-ended signal collection to inform product decisions.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$142,800—$184,800 CAD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. jobs.description:
Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. What we need now is the person who brings it to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the architecture review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you.

This is a teaching and review role. You'll be the senior technical presence the cohort learns from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real architectural feedback on student deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs.

Your audience: experienced engineers leveling up to system architecture roles. Many already write production code daily. They will spot shallow feedback instantly, so the bar here is real seniority, not familiarity.

Format: Async-first with scheduled live sessions. Live sessions and office hours are timed around a US-based cohort. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Areas of expertise

We will bring on three Experts, each focused on one of the following areas.

Expert A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)
  • Module 2 — API & Service Architecture (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, service boundaries, DDD)
  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

Expert B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

Expert C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)

Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, Q&A sessions, and group events, helping them clarify concepts and navigate assignments.
  • Host webinars and workshops on program topics, industry insights, and extracurricular skills.
  • Review and assess student projects, providing clear, constructive feedback aligned with program standards.
  • Engage with students on the Hub through written guidance, ongoing communication, and curated learning resources.
  • Share professional expertise to equip students with practical skills and career strategies.
  • Foster a collaborative learning environment that builds confidence, encourages interaction, and supports student growth.
  • Conduct Mock Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.
  • Record instructional videos for the curriculum, clearly explaining key concepts, methodologies, and course topics to support student learning.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a senior software/systems architect, platform engineer, or senior backend/infrastructure engineer
  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company, not just coursework or side projects
  • Depth across the architectural spine: system design, API and service architecture, cloud and infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD), and distributed systems
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's architecture live
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work

What we can offer you

  • Milestone-based payments tied to deliverables
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours
  • A digital office — we use modern tools (Notion, Miro, Slack, Figma) to keep collaboration smooth
  • Professional trust and autonomy — no micromanaging
  • The chance to see real impact: our metric is graduates landing jobs in tech
  • Join a diverse, international, and close-knit team excited to work with you

Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're launching a program for experienced engineers transitioning into system architecture roles. The curriculum is being built by a team of senior authors. What we need now is the person who brings it to life for students: hosts the live sessions, reviews the work, runs the architecture review boards, and sets the technical bar for the people supporting alongside you.

This is a teaching and review role. You'll be the senior technical presence the cohort learns from week to week. You'll run live sessions and office hours, give real architectural feedback on student deliverables, and act as the escalation point for a team of supporting instructors who handle first-line questions. The best person for this is someone who has actually designed and shipped systems at scale, has opinions about what good architecture looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their design is wrong, not just whether it runs.

Your audience: experienced engineers leveling up to system architecture roles. Many already write production code daily. They will spot shallow feedback instantly, so the bar here is real seniority, not familiarity.

Format: Async-first with scheduled live sessions. Live sessions and office hours are timed around a US-based cohort. Estimated 15 to 25 hrs/week.

Areas of expertise

We will bring on three Experts, each focused on one of the following areas.

Expert A — System Foundations, API & Data

  • Module 1 — Foundations of System Engineering (Architecture principles, OpenTelemetry, distributed systems)
  • Module 2 — API & Service Architecture (REST, GraphQL, gRPC, service boundaries, DDD)
  • Module 3 — Data Architecture & Storage Patterns (SQL/NoSQL, sharding, replication, Redis caching)

Expert B — Cloud, Distributed Systems

  • Module 4 — Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Engineering (Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, FinOps)
  • Module 5 — Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture (CAP theorem, event-driven, Kafka, alert routing)

Expert C — Security, AI Systems & Architecture Leadership

  • Module 6 — Security & Compliance Architecture (Zero-trust, threat modeling, compliance, secure CI/CD)
  • Module 7 — AI Systems Design & Integration (LLM integration, RAG, ML reliability, AI governance)
  • Module 8 — Architecture Documentation & Leadership (ADRs, C4 diagrams, technical communication)

Please indicate in your application which area fits you best. If you have overlapping skills, don’t hesitate to apply and indicate it in your application. Submit all resumes or CV's in English.

What you will do

  • Mentor students through 1:1 video calls, Q&A sessions, and group events, helping them clarify concepts and navigate assignments.
  • Host webinars and workshops on program topics, industry insights, and extracurricular skills.
  • Review and assess student projects, providing clear, constructive feedback aligned with program standards.

  • Share professional expertise to equip students with practical skills and career strategies.
  • Foster a collaborative learning environment that builds confidence, encourages interaction, and supports student growth.
  • Conduct Mock Interviews providing constructive feedback on both their technical responses and interview skills.
  • Record instructional videos for the curriculum, clearly explaining key concepts, methodologies, and course topics to support student learning.

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a senior software/systems architect, platform engineer, or senior backend/infrastructure engineer
  • Has designed and shipped systems at scale in a real company, not just coursework or side projects
  • Depth across the architectural spine: system design, API and service architecture, cloud and infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD), and distributed systems
  • Can explain why a decision was made, not just how it was implemented, and can diagnose and critique someone else's architecture live
  • Strong technical communication: comfortable leading a live session and writing clear, specific review feedback
  • Strong English C1+ — instruction and review are in English for a US-based audience
  • Comfortable using AI tools in day-to-day technical work

What we can offer you

jobs.excerpt: Rob Levine Law is looking for a Director of Client Experience to help us create a remarkable, consistent client experience for 1,200+ new clients per month.
jobs.description:
Rob Levine Law is looking for a Director of Client Experience to help us create a remarkable, consistent client experience for 1,200+ new clients per month. The experience will be delivered across our 4 areas of practice, Personal Injury, Social Security Disability, Veterans Disability and Workers Compensation. We represent clients throughout all 50 states.

This person will be responsible for all interactions and touchpoints across the client journey and will own the entire client experience from end-to-end. From initial prospecting/intake calls through to case resolution, this person will make sure that the firm’s 400 team members deliver exceptional experiences across a host of primary touchpoints including phone calls, text messages, emails, printed documents, video interactions (recorded and live), and in-person meetings.

The Director of Client Experience will serve as the clients’ biggest champion — constantly looking at our law firm and its offerings through their eyes and asking: What’s working? What’s not working? What’s frustrating? What could be better? How can we be even more remarkable?
This is a highly collaborative role, reporting directly to the CEO but working cross-functionally across marketing, sales, client services, accounting/finance, technology, and operations to eliminate friction and design experiences that drive loyalty. The goal will be to turn client insights and needs into clearly defined action steps that make delivering great experiences easier for our teams. You will need to be systems and process minded, while also serving as a creative generator and implementor.

Responsibilities
  • Own the Client Experience. Help define what we want clients to experience and feel at every stage of their relationship with us, across all touchpoints (human, digital, and self-service).
  • Drive Relationship Depth and Retention. Bring a strong relationship-building lens to the client experience, identifying opportunities to deepen connections, increase responsiveness and engagement, and give clients more reasons to stay committed to the representation through claim resolution.
  • Listen to Clients. Make sure we have simple, effective ways to understand what clients love, what frustrates them, and why they stay or leave. Build and maintain a voice-of-client (VoC) program: designing surveys, analyzing feedback data, and synthesizing insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Turn Feedback into Action. Connect the dots between what clients are telling us and what we can change/improve, at individual office locations and across the organization. Present client trends and behavior drivers to the firm’s executive leadership team.
  • Find the Friction. Look across the client journey for unnecessary hassles, inconsistencies, points of confusion, or moments that aren’t living up to the experience we want to deliver.
  • Spot and Scale What’s Working. With 19 locations and 1,200+ new clients per month, chances are someone, somewhere has already solved a problem or created a fantastic client experience. Help us find those wins, share them, and scale the best ideas.
  • Help 400+ Team Members Deliver a Remarkable Experience. Partner with operations and training to make sure our teams have the tools, clarity, and support they need to take great care of clients. Partner with marketing to build a consistent CX/EX communications channel so everyone understands and embraces a commitment to remarkable experiences. Build a robust CX culture through education, training programs, and internal communications that embed client-centric thinking across all departments and locations.
  • Connect Experience to the Business. Help us understand how client experience impacts retention, referrals, loyalty, and growth — and where improving the experience can have the greatest impact. Represent client perspective in leadership discussions, advocating for investment in client-facing improvements as needed. Establish and govern CX standards across the firm, conducting audits of touchpoints and service delivery against established benchmarks.

Qualifications
We’re looking for someone who is part strategist, part problem-solver, and part doer. You should bring:
  • Significant experience (8-12 years) leading customer/client experience or another client-focused function in a multi-unit organization
  • Strong experience with experience marketing, including understanding what drives engagement and long-term client relationships
  • Experience owning and interpreting VoC/NPS programs at program-design level, not just reporting level
  • Demonstrated success improving client experience and retention
  • The ability to use data and client feedback to identify opportunities and turn insights into action
  • Experience working across departments and locations and influencing teams you may not directly manage
  • A genuine interest in the law and the role diligent representation can play in the life of someone that needs legal assistance
You’re curious. You’re diligent. You notice things. You ask great questions. You know how to get people excited about improving client experience.
Most importantly, you believe that client experience is everyone’s job — but someone has to wake up every day thinking about how to make it better and rally the team to keep it top of mind in every case/claim, across all locations, every day.

What Success Looks Like
Success means we understand our clients better, act on their feedback faster, and create more consistency across our locations without losing the personal and emotional connection that makes great experiences memorable. It means getting more clients to choose us, stay with us, tell their friends, and feel like their lawyers are representing them to the fullest every day.

jobs.title: Chemical Safety Expert for AI Model Safety Audit
jobs.excerpt: Type: contract Location: remote Interview: Required Interview language: English About this role Description We are hiring chemists and chemical safety professionals to audit how AI models respond to sensitive questions in the field.
jobs.description:
Type: contract

Location: remote

Interview: Required

Interview language: English

About this role

Description

We are hiring chemists and chemical safety professionals to audit how AI models respond to sensitive questions in the field. Each task gives you a user request and the answers three different models gave to it. You classify the request (benign, dual-use or adversarial), mark each answer as safe or unsafe and say why, rank the three against each other, and write the answer the model should have given. For dual-use requests you also note what makes it sensitive, what legitimate purpose it serves, and who should be able to get an answer.

The requests are realistic: what synthetic and analytical chemists, toxicologists, industrial hygienists, process safety engineers, regulators and occasionally bad actors actually ask. Some are ordinary professional questions that models wrongly refuse, and catching those matters as much as catching the dangerous ones.

Who we're looking for

Synthetic and analytical chemists; toxicologists and pharmacologists; industrial hygienists and chemical safety/process safety professionals; CWC or chemical-security specialists; hazmat, poison-control or chemical incident responders; and chemical regulators (EPA, OSHA, HSE, OPCW-adjacent, or equivalent). Usually a relevant degree plus five or more years of professional experience. Experience with safety data sheets, exposure assessment, incident reports or regulatory review is a strong plus.

Before you apply

Open only to citizens or permanent residents of the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand and the European Union.

Your profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Toxicology, Environmental Health & Safety, Industrial Hygiene, Hazardous Materials Management, or a closely related field; advanced degree or professional safety certification is a strong plus.

  • 3+ years of professional experience in chemical safety, laboratory safety, hazardous materials handling, EHS, toxicology, industrial hygiene, chemical risk assessment, regulatory compliance, or related technical safety work.

  • Strong understanding of chemical hazards, including toxicity, corrosivity, flammability, reactivity, incompatibilities, exposure routes, storage risks, spill response principles, PPE, ventilation, and safe handling practices.

jobs.description:
About Ratehub & the Role

WHO IS RATEHUB?

We’re a company on a mission. We are a unique Canadian Fintech that is the one-stop shop for all financial needs of the consumer: Save, Spend, Borrow, Invest, and Protect. Every single team member — from Product & Engineering to Sales & Marketing, Finance, Operations, and everything in between — is obsessed with one thing: helping Canadians make better financial choices. And we’re pretty great at it, too. Via our digital application technology and our award-winning in-house brokerages, we help over 2M Canadians per month make a positive impact on their finances. We have many unique businesses: a mortgage brokerage, a life insurance brokerage, a home and auto insurance brokerage, a mortgage originations and servicing business, a Financial Services Marketplace, and a content business across Ratehub and MoneySense. 365 days a year, we deliver our users the best online mortgage experience, personalized credit card and loan options, and cheaper auto and home insurance policies than they typically get from their existing financial adviser.

Changing how people make financial choices isn’t easy, though. We know that achieving our mission is full of challenges — challenges that can be complex and often unexpected but that are always interesting, rewarding, and fun to solve as a team. This is where you come in. We are on the hunt for the right candidate to join us and help lead us forward to continued growth.

About the role

We’re looking for a Content Strategist to help grow Ratehub’s organic presence and reach more Canadians through high-quality, data-driven content.

This is a mid-level individual contributor role reporting to the Senior Organic Growth Manager. You’ll work closely with the Sr. Mortgage Editor, VP of Mortgages, Content Team, PR Team, Email, Partnerships Team, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The role sits at the intersection of content strategy, SEO, GEO, analytics, content creation, and distribution. You’ll use performance data, search trends, audience insights, and emerging AI search data to identify opportunities, make recommendations, and execute content initiatives that drive organic growth.

As the Content Strategist dedicated to our Mortgage business unit, you’ll work closely with the Sr. Mortgage Editor who will provide the majority of the mortgage insights, analysis, and subject-matter expertise. You don’t need to be a mortgage expert when you join, but you’ll be expected to develop a strong working knowledge of the Canadian mortgage market over time, so you can confidently translate expert insights into effective content and ensure what we produce is accurate, relevant, and useful to consumers.

Your goal is simple: use content, search, data, and distribution to bring more qualified traffic to Ratehub.ca. You’ll work across blogs, landing pages, newsletters, eblasts, social content, short-form video, forums, and emerging search channels, with a focus on measurable organic growth.

What you’ll do

Develop a data-driven content and SEO/GEO strategy

  • Develop a strong understanding of SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and use SEO and AI Search Analytics platforms to monitor how Ratehub's content is appearing in traditional rankings and AI-generated answers.
  • Use analytics, search data, audience insights, and content performance across both traditional and AI-powered search to identify opportunities and recommend what content to create, update, optimize, or retire.
  • Analyze organic traffic, rankings, on-page engagement, conversions, and AI-search visibility (mentions and citations across LLMs and generative search platforms) to understand what's working and where there are opportunities to improve.
  • Identify content gaps, high-value topics, and emerging search trends, including which topics, sources, and formats are being surfaced by AI search engines
  • Recommend the right format and channel for each opportunity (blog post, landing page, newsletter, eblast, Reel, social post, forum contribution) and changes to improve content's ability to be discovered, referenced, and cited by search engines and generative AI platforms.
  • Work with the Senior Organic Growth Manager and other stakeholders to turn analysis and recommendations into actionable content initiatives and help inform the broader SEO and GEO strategy.
  • Stay up to date on changes in search, AI discovery, GEO best practices, and emerging search behaviours.

Create and optimize content

  • Develop and maintain a mortgage content calendar and prioritized content backlog, balancing evergreen content with timely opportunities.
  • Write and produce unique, useful, and engaging content across multiple formats, including blog posts, landing pages, mortgage rate pages, social content, forum posts, and short-form video scripts.
  • Use content analysis, search data, and performance insights to create copy that addresses what consumers are actually searching for and helps them make informed financial decisions.
  • Develop an understanding of the factors affecting Canadian borrowers, including Bank of Canada rate announcements, Government of Canada bond yields, CPI releases, CREA housing data, lender activity, and broader economic trends, and work with the Sr. Mortgage Editor to validate that content accurately reflects the latest market developments.
  • Translate mortgage insights, market analysis, and expert commentary into clear, accessible, consumer-friendly content, using expert input as the foundation while bringing your own perspective on structure, messaging, search intent, format, and audience engagement.
  • Learn to recognize the questions, concerns, and search behaviours of Canadian mortgage consumers, and stay curious about the industry, proactively building your knowledge over time.
  • Refresh and rewrite existing landing pages and high-value content — including French-language landing pages, in collaboration with our translators — to keep them accurate, relevant, competitive, and aligned with SEO and GEO best practices, using performance data to guide improvements.
  • Use AI tools to assist with research, ideation, analysis, and content generation, and test and implement emerging AI content practices, while maintaining strong editorial standards, originality, accuracy, and Ratehub's brand voice.

Manage content distribution and email

  • Own the building and management of Ratehub's weekly newsletters, including coordinating with the Partnerships Team on the Credit Card newsletter and determining the topics and articles featured in the Mortgage newsletter.
  • Own the building and management of Mortgage weekly eblasts and promotional emails, working with the Sr. Mortgage Editor and other stakeholders to incorporate their content and insights.
  • Use performance data and audience insights to determine which topics and content should be featured and how they should be positioned, and identify the right channel and format for each piece of content rather than relying solely on traditional search.
  • Support organic growth across Google Search, AI search, Reddit and other forums, social media, email, and short-form video, and develop recommendations for how content can be distributed to bring more qualified traffic to Ratehub.ca.
  • Create and support timely social content across platforms, including Meta, TikTok, and LinkedIn, and participate in community engagement where appropriate, to support organic content, paid marketing, and PR initiatives.

Publish and manage website content

  • Edit, format, and publish content using WordPress, ensuring pages are accurate, optimized, and ready for publication.
  • Work closely with the Editorial Team to ensure content meets Ratehub’s editorial and brand standards.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders on the prioritization and implementation of relevant CMS components, website functionality, and content updates.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the content experience, and ensure users can easily find and engage with the information they need.

What we’re looking for

  • 4–6 years of experience in content strategy, content marketing, SEO, digital publishing, or a related field.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to create content that is original, engaging, informative, and genuinely useful to consumers.
  • Strong understanding of SEO, GEO and AI-powered search, with an interest in how LLMs are changing content discovery.
  • Experience using analytics and SEO tools to analyze content and channel performance, and turn insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEO platforms, and/or AI Search Analytics platforms.
  • A strong understanding of how content, SEO, GEO, email, and distribution work together to drive measurable business results.
  • A curious, analytical, and test-and-learn mindset, with a willingness to experiment with new content formats, AI tools, and emerging discovery channels.
  • Strong research skills, and the ability to quickly develop expertise in a complex subject area.
  • A demonstrated ability to take complex information from subject matter experts and turn it into clear, compelling, consumer-friendly content.
  • A strong interest in the Canadian mortgage and broader personal finance space, with the curiosity and drive to develop deep mortgage expertise over time.
  • Previous experience with WordPress or another CMS.
  • Experience building and managing email newsletters or eblasts, including content selection, production, and publishing.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Fluency in French is an asset

CULTURE FIT:

Members first - we prioritise the interests and needs of our members above all else.We solve member pain points and focus on member satisfaction. We start with members, and end with the P&L.

Growth mindset - we set ambitious goals and challenge the status quo. We take responsible risks and are accountable for our actions.

Better together - we are One team with One common goal. We make our footprint bigger than our foot, leave our egos at the door, support each other to achieve great results as One company.

Run after problems - we tackle problems head on and focus on finding solutions. Obstacles are seen as opportunities for growth and innovation. We have the hard conversations and choose the harder right over the easier wrong. And we do it with a smile.

Measure Learn Iterate Innovate - we focus on getting things done. We measure what matters, iterate, learn, iterate many times in a data-driven way, which is how we will innovate.

JOB PERKS:

Competitive Compensation: A salary that reflects your experience and the Canadian market.

Remote-First Environment: The flexibility to work from anywhere in Canada, with occasional in-person team gatherings for collaboration.

Flexible Hours: Autonomy to manage your schedule to support work-life balance.

Professional Development: An individual training allowance to help you grow your skills and career.

Team Socials: Regular events, both remote and in-person, to build connections across the organization.

The estimated salary range for this position is $75,000 - $100,000.

jobs.excerpt: Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions.
jobs.description:
Proof is the world's first identity-assured transaction management platform and we are on a mission to digitize trust for all of life’s most critical transactions. Developed by the same market leaders and experts who brought notarization online with Notarize℠, Proof offers trust in a digital world by verifying identities and securing transactions to protect businesses and their customers. Since 2015, we’ve completed many of the world’s first digital commerce transactions, including the first online real estate closing, online mortgage closing, online auto sale, and online will and we're still just getting started!
Proof's brand has to signal two things at once: the rigor of a WebTrust-audited certificate authority that banks can rely on, and the simplicity of an identity people can verify once and reuse anywhere. As Proof expands from the online notarization category we created into portable digital identity and agentic authorization, our brand needs to grow with us.

As Director of Brand and Creative, you'll own Proof's brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, and creative output across every touchpoint, including proof.com, campaigns, events, sales materials, and executive presence. Day to day, you'll set creative direction, lead design production, and build a brand that earns trust from regulated institutions and stands out in identity and fintech.

What you’ll do as the Director of Brand and Creative at Proof:

  • Brand strategy and architecture: Define and steward Proof's brand platform (purpose, personality, voice, and the promise of trust in high-consequence transactions), and develop brand architecture for the platform, VDC, notarization, and agentic authorization with the Director of Product Marketing. Lead brand evolution or refresh work as needed.
  • Visual and verbal identity: Own the brand system and guidelines, including logo, color, typography, iconography, illustration, photography, motion, and data visualization. Partner with the Head of Demand Content and Director of Communications on tone-of-voice guidelines.
  • Brand hub and templates: Build a self-serve brand hub and template library so Sales,
    Marketing, and the wider company stay on brand.
  • Campaign and launch creative: Lead creative concepting and execution for
    campaigns, product launches, and brand moments with Revenue Marketing and Product Marketing.
  • Design across touchpoints: Oversee design for proof.com, digital advertising, sales collateral, presentations, video, social, and event environments, including booth and experiential design with the Event Marketing Manager.
  • Creative operations: Run intake, prioritization, and review and approval workflows, and manage creative budgets, agencies, and freelancers.
  • Brand health and governance: Establish brand health metrics and research
    (awareness, consideration, perception among target buyers), govern consistency across marketing, sales, partners, and co-marketing, and work with Product Design so the product and marketing brand feel like one company.

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years in brand and creative, including 4+ years leading brand or creative teams at a B2B technology, fintech, or security company, or senior agency experience on comparable brands.
  • A portfolio showing brand systems and campaigns that made complex or trust-centric products clear and distinctive.
  • Experience leading a brand refresh or new brand architecture during a company's category expansion.
  • Strong creative direction across design, copy, video, and motion, and the ability to get hands-on when needed.
  • Ability to align executives on creative decisions and explain the business rationale behind brand choices.

You'll really stand out if you have:

  • Experience building brands for financial services, payments, or identity companies.
  • Experience with AI-assisted creative workflows and modern tooling (Figma, Adobe CC, Webflow).
  • Experience spanning both B2B enterprise and consumer-facing touchpoints.

Position Logistics:

    Travel: This role will include occasional travel for Proof Summit, team onsites, industry events, and customer or partner meetings. Your manager will share more about expected travel during the interview process.

Our Proof Pillars:

  • Pave the Way: When obstacles arise, we break through barriers with passion and perseverance. We lead with creativity and forward-thinking. We aim to set new standards and shape the future in a repeatable, scalable way so the path to success is easier for our team to follow.
  • Own It: We embrace the responsibility that comes with supporting life's most important transactions. When a problem arises we relentlessly pursue the solution with a 'Yes before no' attitude. Because every problem and every transaction is treated like it's our own.
  • Act with Integrity: We are in the business of building trust and it is at the core of everything we do. We are honest and transparent with our customers, each other and ourselves. If we make a mistake, we own up to it right away and do what it takes to make it right. Our dedication to security and compliance is key to earning trust, fighting fraud and ultimately, our success.
  • Play to Win: We believe excellence is about always striving to be better so when we get it wrong, we iterate, we learn and we grow. We know we can only go so far alone, we're better together and collectively, we win!

Here are some of our great benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Life insurance, long and short-term disability coverage
  • 401k Plan with a 4% match, beginning on your hire date
  • Unlimited Sick and Vacation time
  • 14 paid company holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 4 week sabbatical after 5 years of continuous full time employment
  • Health Reimbursement Arrangements for fertility and gender affirmation
  • Lunch on Proof through Grubhub credit
  • Monthly work from home stipend
  • Professional development credit
  • Monthly reimbursement for Wellness
  • And more!

This position will be posted and accepting applications through October 23, 2026.

Proof uses Identify & Defend, our fraud prevention and identity verification tools, to confirm that individuals engaging with Proof at any stage correspond to a real identity. It’s a quick security step that helps keep the process safe for everyone. Defend & Identify are used solely for identity verification and fraud prevention and are not used to assess employment eligibility or qualifications.

Proof is committed to building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and everyone is encouraged to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.excerpt: The Specialized Talent Sourcer identifies and attracts top candidates with specific skill sets or expertise to fill niche positions.
jobs.description:
The Specialized Talent Sourcer identifies and attracts top candidates with specific skill sets or expertise to fill niche positions. They have a deep understanding of the industry and job requirements they recruit for, and utilize specialized sourcing techniques to effectively match qualified candidates to the defined unique needs of client organizations.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collaborating closely with recruiters and hiring managers to understand the unique job requirements and effectively align sourcing efforts with the organization’s goals.
  • Reviewing and posting attractive job adverts on specialized job boards to boost the interest from target candidates. Reviewing and processing applications on all platforms in a timely manner.
  • Utilizing various sourcing methods such as online platforms, social media, and networking to identify and connect with potential candidates who possess the specific skills and qualifications required for niche positions.
  • Implementing traditional, creative, and targeted candidate attraction strategies, such as mobile and email campaigns, cold calling, utilization of recruitment marketing, etc. to cultivate and grow talent communities​ for current and future hiring needs, ensuring a steady and engaged pipeline of specialized talent is always available.
  • Engaging with potential candidates through personalized outreach, networking events, and communication channels to establish rapport and interest in job opportunities.
  • Conducting and presenting thorough and regular market research to understand industry trends, salary benchmarks, and talent availability, which helps in planning effective sourcing and hiring strategies.
  • Pre-screening candidates to assess their qualifications, experience, and cultural fit before presenting them to the hiring team.
  • Sharing market and candidate insights to business hiring groups, while consulting them on sourcing and hiring strategies.
  • Actively promoting the employer brand to potential candidates, highlighting the company’s strengths in the specific industry, and opportunities for career growth.
  • Ensuring accurate and up-to-date records of candidate interactions and sourcing activities, using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other available tools.
  • Staying updated with industry best practices, sourcing tools and techniques to continually improve the effectiveness of talent sourcing strategies.
  • Fostering diversity and inclusion by sourcing candidates from diverse backgrounds and underrepresented groups, contributing to a more inclusive workforce.
  • Identifying areas for process improvement within the talent sourcing function and suggesting innovative ways to enhance recruitment efficiency.

Position Requirements:

Education:

  • High School diploma required, bachelor’s degree in human resources or any related field is preferred.
  • Successful completion of the Sourcing Foundation training
  • Cielo TalentCloud ACE certification required.

Experience:

  • 3 years’ experience in sourcing or recruiting is required.
  • Deep understanding of, and solid sourcing experience in a certain industry (or industries, markets) is required.

Exposure:

  • Proficiency in using specialized sourcing techniques, such as X-Ray, Advanced Boolean, data mining, extensions, and aggregators etc.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage both with candidates and hiring teams.
  • Strong research and market analysis skills
  • Ability to handle candidate data with accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with data protection regulations.
  • Capability to manage multiple sourcing tasks and priorities efficiently, meeting deadlines and handling niche recruitment requirements.
  • Aptitude to address sourcing challenges creatively, finding innovative solutions to attract specialized talent.
  • Continuous learning about industry trends, sourcing best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong focus on achieving sourcing targets

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Cielo is a brand that reflects our big idea – that talent is rising – and with it our opportunity to rise above. We create careers for ambitious people by moving beyond traditional assumptions of what it means to work in talent acquisition.

Cielo is the world's leading Talent Acquisition Partner. We deliver a better talent experience for everyone through Talent Acquisition, Search, Consulting, and Digital Accelerators™. With our fresh approach – we design and build comprehensive, proven solutions inspired by technology to find and keep the unique talent that elevates our clients above the competition.

Wonderschool is harnessing the power of technology to provide comprehensive support to child care providers operating out of their homes as well as in the government and non-profit sectors. Our products enable child care providers to create high-quality environments and meet the demands of their business, while also helping parents in need of childcare solutions through the creation of an accessible marketplace.

Wonderschool already has active partnerships across 15 states and a very rich pipeline. This is not a build-from-scratch role - you’re coming in to scale what’s already working.

This is not a 9-to-5 job. It requires a significant amount of travel - you will attend events throughout the country, work alongside marketing to generate leads and attract the full funnel, and personally carry a bag while building and leading a sales team.

Compensation

$450,000 OTE + equity

What You’ll Do

  • Take ownership of a well-defined, proven sales playbook and scale it across states, cities, and counties
  • Run meetings, develop pipeline, and own go-to-market strategy for government sales
  • Sell - this is a player-coach role; a significant portion of your time will be in front of customers closing deals
  • Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing sales team
  • Partner with marketing to drive event presence, lead generation, and top-of-funnel pipeline

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara’s solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
  • Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process
  • Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training
  • Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
  • Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred
  • Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies
  • 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products
  • Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills
  • Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations
  • Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time
  • Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software
  • Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Fluency in French is desirable but not essential
  • Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
  • Change management delivery experience
  • Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Role Overview

The DevOps Engineer is responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and continuously improving the infrastructure, deployment pipelines, operational tooling, and delivery practices that support the iiPay application platform, associated services, and the broader product development ecosystem.

The DevOps Engineer will work closely with Product Development, Quality Assurance, Product Management, Support, and Infrastructure teams across Vistra to ensure the iiPay platform can be delivered, operated, and scaled effectively. The role focuses on improving delivery automation, platform reliability, monitoring, operational readiness, and deployment safety while supporting the company's product and business objectives.

The successful candidate will understand not only how solutions are implemented, but why they are being delivered, ensuring DevOps initiatives support broader goals such as scalability, stability, efficiency, client satisfaction, and commercial growth.

The DevOps Engineer will play a key role in delivering our vision: To deliver an innovative, state-of-the-art workflow-driven global payroll solution that ensures accurate and timely payroll for clients and employees while remaining intuitive, easy to implement, and easy to operate.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Reliability and Operations

  • Design, implement, and maintain highly available, secure, and scalable infrastructure.
  • Ensure environments and applications meet reliability, performance, and availability objectives.
  • Proactively identify and address infrastructure, deployment, and operational risks.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability solutions that support rapid issue detection and resolution.
  • Participate in release activities, operational support, and incident response processes.

CI/CD and Delivery Enablement

  • Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines across products and services.
  • Establish and promote consistent pipeline standards and best practices.
  • Reduce deployment risk through automation, validation, testing, rollback mechanisms, and deployment controls.
  • Investigate and resolve build and deployment issues, addressing root causes to prevent recurrence.
  • Work closely with development teams to streamline software delivery workflows.

Automation and Infrastructure as Code

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual operational effort through automation.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code solutions and configuration management processes.
  • Automate environment provisioning, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operational activities where appropriate.
  • Ensure automation solutions are reliable, maintainable, and support long-term scalability.

Required Skills and Experience

The successful candidate requires experience, skills, and a proven track record in the following areas:

  • Extensive DevOps Experience
    • Proven track record in designing, implementing, and managing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and deployment processes.
  • Security Expertise
    • Strong understanding of security best practices including vulnerability management, secure coding principles, access controls, and compliance standards.
  • Platform Scalability & Performance
    • Ability to design and maintain scalable infrastructure that supports high availability and optimal performance under varying loads.
  • Cross-Technology Integration
    • Experience working with complex web-based SaaS platforms composed of multiple interrelated components developed in Java and C#.
  • Key Technical Skills
    • Proficient in PowerShell scripting for automation tasks.
    • Hands-on experience with TeamCity, Octopus Deploy and Azure DevOps for continuous integration.
    • Nginx and general web server configuration skills
  • System Reliability & Monitoring
    • Implement robust monitoring, alerting systems, and incident response strategies to ensure platform stability.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
    • Proficiency with tools such as Terraform for automated provisioning and configuration management.
  • Cloud Platform Knowledge
    • Hands-on experience with cloud providers like AWS or Azure for deploying and managing services.
  • Collaboration Skills
    • Work closely with development teams to streamline workflows between software engineering and operations ensuring smooth integration of new features.
  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting
    • Strong analytical skills to diagnose issues across distributed systems involving Java/C# components efficiently.

Qualifications

  • Proven industry experience in a DevOps Engineer or similar role.
  • Experience supporting SaaS applications and cloud-based platforms.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.

jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain or the UK.
  • Contract:
    • Spain: Full-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
    • UK: Full-time, permanent
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link -
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

Curious what it's actually like to work at Airalo? We've put together a guide for each of the hubs we hire from most, covering our benefits, remote culture, employment setup, and what our team values most:

  • Life at Airalo · España:
  • Life at Airalo · United Kingdom:
As a Senior Product Designer in Airalo’s User Experience division, you will shape consumer product experiences across native mobile and web for millions of people around the world. This is a senior individual contributor role focused on leading design from problem framing through delivery, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and contributing to the Airalo Product Design Guild - our community for craft, critique, design systems, research-led decision-making, accessibility, experimentation, AI, and continuous learning.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead end-to-end product design for Airalo’s consumer mobile and web experiences, from discovery through delivery.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, Data, Growth, and other designers to translate customer needs, insights, and strategy into high-quality product improvements.
  • Create user journeys, flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, UX copy, and production-ready specifications.
  • Facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and stakeholder conversations that create alignment and momentum.
  • Contribute to Airalo’s Design System, improving consistency, accessibility, quality, and efficiency across products.
  • Mentor other designers through feedback, pairing, critique, and shared practice.
  • Help strengthen the Product Design Guild by raising the bar for craft, collaboration, research-led decision-making, and thoughtful use of AI.

Must-haves:

  • 6+ years or similar of dedicated experience in product design at a tech startup, scale-up, product-led company, or product-focused agency.
  • A strong portfolio showing high-quality UI, thoughtful interaction design, strong product thinking, and measurable impact.
  • Extensive experience designing, testing, and shipping native mobile and web applications for B2C products.
  • Ability to lead ambiguous design problems from discovery through delivery, balancing user needs, business goals, technical constraints, and product strategy.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to explain design rationale clearly to cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Figma and FigJam skills, with experience creating flows, prototypes, product specifications, and production-ready design assets.
  • Advanced experience working with design systems, native mobile guidelines, responsive design, accessibility, and product quality across mobile and web.
  • Advanced experience with motion, prototyping, or interaction details that bring product experiences to life.
  • Experience working in Lean and/or Agile product development environments, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Content, Data, and Growth.
  • Able to facilitate workshops, critiques, ideation sessions, and alignment conversations.
  • Experience using AI and emerging tools to improve the design workflow beyond simple prototyping.

Good to have:

  • Experience in telecommunications, travel, marketplaces, subscriptions, or global consumer products.
  • Knowledge of eSIMs, GSMA-related technologies, or mobile connectivity services.
  • Experience partnering deeply with Research, Data, Growth, or Content Design teams.

You should apply if…

  • You lead through craft, clarity, and systems thinking. You can turn complex problems into simple, well-crafted experiences while considering journeys, patterns, accessibility, content, edge cases, and scale.
  • You can own ambiguous problems. You do not need every answer before you start. You ask good questions, define the path forward, make smart trade-offs, and keep momentum without waiting to be told what to do.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You use research, data, customer feedback, and product strategy to make decisions that improve the user experience and support business goals.
  • You communicate with confidence and humility. You can explain design decisions clearly to designers, engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders without becoming defensive.
  • You raise the bar for the design community. You give thoughtful feedback, invite critique early, mentor others, and contribute to a Product Design Guild where designers learn and improve together.
  • You are curious about AI and new ways of working. You actively explore how AI and emerging tools can improve design workflows, speed up learning, and help teams make better decisions.

This isn't for you if…

  • You only want to design screens. This role requires shaping problems, influencing direction, collaborating across disciplines, and staying involved from discovery through delivery.
  • You need certainty or close direction to make progress. Senior designers at Airalo are expected to move through ambiguity, create momentum, and make thoughtful decisions independently.
  • You avoid feedback or critique. Our design culture depends on sharing unfinished work, challenging ideas respectfully, and changing direction when the evidence points elsewhere.
  • You optimize for perfection over impact. We care deeply about quality, but we also need to make pragmatic decisions, learn quickly, and ship improvements.
  • You are not interested in customers or the community. Speaking to customers, learning from them, and contributing to the Product Design Guild are central to how we build better products.

Why People Join Us

🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.

For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.

🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK

We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.

Our team spans 60+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.

Before You Hit Apply

By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here:
