What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We're looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial enterprise sales professional to lead YipitData's expansion into the world's largest banking institutions.

While we've established early traction within the banking and advisory ecosystem, significant opportunity remains to expand our presence within Tier 1 global banks, including institutions such as JPMorgan Chase, Morgan Stanley, and Bank of America.

In this senior individual contributor role, you'll own our most strategic banking accounts, with a primary focus on opening new relationships, acquiring flagship customers, and establishing YipitData as a trusted provider of proprietary data, research, and insights.

We're looking for someone who brings deep familiarity with the banking industry, understands how major financial institutions evaluate and use data and insights, and has established relationships that can accelerate our understanding of the market and create new commercial opportunities.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role. While YipitData has extensive experience delivering insights to sophisticated customers, our go-to-market approach within large banking institutions is still evolving. You'll have significant ownership in shaping our banking go-to-market strategy, from identifying priority buyers and high-value use cases to refining our market positioning and developing a repeatable approach to winning within the world's largest financial institutions.

The ideal candidate combines a proven track record of complex enterprise sales with deep banking industry knowledge, strong relationships, and a passion for building new business.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. We expect east coast / central time work hours. Depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Senior Sales Executive, Strategic Banking, You Will:

  • Own our Tier 1 banking commercial strategy: Lead commercial development across a portfolio of the world's largest banking institutions, with responsibility for building relationships, generating opportunities, and winning new business.
  • Open doors into strategic accounts: Leverage your banking industry knowledge, professional network, and proactive business development skills to identify and engage key stakeholders within complex financial institutions.
  • Identify high-value use cases and buyers: Develop a deep understanding of how different banking teams leverage external data, research, and insights, identifying the functions, decision-makers, and business challenges where YipitData can deliver differentiated value.
  • Drive new customer acquisition: Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from initial prospecting and discovery through solution development, executive engagement, procurement, negotiation, and closing.
  • Build executive-level relationships: Establish credibility with senior banking professionals and develop relationships across multiple buying centers to support initial customer acquisition and long-term account penetration.
  • Sell differentiated data and insights solutions: Work closely with our Solutions and Research teams to connect YipitData's proprietary capabilities to the specific needs and strategic priorities of banking customers.
  • Establish flagship customer partnerships: Prioritize winning meaningful relationships with major banking institutions that create a foundation for broader adoption and expansion.
  • Develop a repeatable sales playbook: Translate early wins, customer feedback, and market learnings into actionable strategies that improve our ability to win across the banking vertical.
  • Own pipeline development and forecasting: Build and manage a strategic pipeline of enterprise opportunities, maintaining strong deal discipline and accurate revenue forecasts.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have extensive experience selling complex enterprise solutions into major banking institutions, ideally with direct exposure to Corporate / Commercial and Investment Banking teams, and a strong understanding of their organizational structures, buying processes, and commercial priorities.
  • You understand the banking data and insights landscape. You have firsthand experience with how banking professionals use external data, research, analytics, or intelligence to inform business decisions and can identify compelling use cases for differentiated insights solutions.
  • You bring an established professional network within the banking industry, with relationships and market knowledge that can accelerate customer discovery, stakeholder access, and new business development.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of landing new business within large, complex financial institutions, including creating opportunities from scratch and navigating sophisticated, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • You're a proactive, strategic hunter who is energized by breaking into difficult-to-access accounts and building new commercial relationships.
  • You have experience operating in emerging markets, developing new customer segments, or introducing new solutions, and you're comfortable building a go-to-market approach without a fully established playbook.
  • You have strong executive presence and commercial judgment, with the ability to build credibility with senior banking stakeholders and translate complex solutions into clear business value.
  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You can identify market opportunities and develop account strategies while personally driving the prospecting and sales activity required to win.
  • You are highly collaborative and intellectually curious, with the ability to translate customer conversations into valuable market insights and actionable recommendations for internal teams.
  • You thrive in entrepreneurial environments, take ownership of outcomes, and are motivated by the opportunity to build a strategically important business.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $130,000 - $160,000. This role is eligible for a generous variable compensation, as well as equity.Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Primary responsibilities are assigned according to departmental needs, with cross-training and backup support across accounting functions.

Accounts Payable & Vendor Administration

    • Process vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, and other payable transactions accurately and on time.

    • Review invoices and purchase orders for accuracy, proper coding, and required approvals.

This single role owns two connected accountabilities: the performance of Landline's MSP, and the design, operation, and evidencing of the company's control program against the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.

Landline operates in a regulated transportation environment and contracts with airline partners and airports that impose their own security and data-handling requirements. The control program must satisfy those obligations as well as the company's internal risk requirements.

Compensation

120,000 – 175,000

What You Will Do

  • Administer the Vanta GRC platform, including integrations, control monitoring, evidence collection, automated test configuration, and remediation tracking
  • Perform periodic control testing and design effectiveness reviews, document results, and drive remediation to closure with named owners and due dates
  • Own the policy lifecycle: drafting, annual review, approval routing, publication, and attestation tracking
  • Maintain the enterprise risk register, including risk scoring methodology, treatment decisions, and executive reporting

  • Administer the security awareness training program, including phishing simulation and completion tracking

  • Own the MSP contract lifecycle, including scope changes, renewals, pricing negotiation, and the exit and transition plan
  • Verify that MSP-operated controls function as contracted, requiring evidence rather than assertion
  • Govern access administration performed by the MSP, including joiner/mover/leaver execution, privileged access review, and periodic user access certification
  • Maintain the responsibility assignment matrix (RACI) that defines which controls the MSP operates, which Landline operates, and which are shared
  • Operate the vendor intake and security review process for new technology purchases
  • Maintain the vendor inventory with data classification, criticality tiering, and review cadence
  • Collect and review third-party assurance artifacts (SOC 2 Type II reports, ISO 27001 certificates, penetration test summaries), including analysis of complementary user entity controls and any qualified opinions
  • Track vendor contract security terms, breach notification obligations, and data processing agreements
  • Maintain the incident response plan and coordinate the annual tabletop exercise
  • Serve as compliance lead during security incidents, covering evidence preservation, regulatory notification analysis, and post-incident reporting
  • Maintain business continuity and disaster recovery documentation, and coordinate annual restoration testing with the MSP
  • Deliver a recurring compliance and vendor performance report to executive leadership
  • Provide security and compliance input to procurement, legal, and operations
  • Track and report program metrics

What We're Looking For

  • Five or more years in IT compliance, information security, IT audit, or IT governance, including at least two years with direct responsibility for a control program or audit function

  • Clear written communication, as this role produces documentation that external parties read and rely on
  • Professional certification such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, or CISSP is a plus
  • Direct NIST CSF 2.0 implementation experience, particularly the Govern function and cybersecurity supply chain risk management (GV.SC), is a strong plus
  • Experience in transportation, aviation, logistics, or another operationally regulated industry is a plus
  • Familiarity with PCI DSS, CCPA/CPRA, or state breach notification requirements is welcome
  • Prior experience building a compliance program from an early or undefined baseline is valued
  • ITIL foundation or an equivalent service management background is a plus
  • Contract negotiation experience with technology vendors or service providers is a plus

Location

jobs.title: Product Designer - Mid level (Remote, Europe)
jobs.excerpt: Why this roleLearnWorlds helps creators, educators and organizations build and grow learning businesses.
jobs.description:
Why this role

LearnWorlds helps creators, educators and organizations build and grow learning businesses. We're a profitable, product-led SaaS company with customers in more than 150 countries. Our product serves two audiences at once: the people who build and run online schools, and the learners who use them. Designing well for both is what makes the work interesting.

AI is changing how products get made, and design along with it. A product direction might now begin as a PM prototype, an engineering experiment, customer feedback, AI output, or a designer's own idea. The designer's job is to judge what is worth pursuing and make it better, with the whole product in mind.

With time to market shrinking, we're looking for a Product Designer who notices what could be better and acts on it. Someone who gets hands-on and uses AI to expand what they can take on, without lowering the bar on quality or product thinking.

How you'll work here

You work across the whole platform

You're not tied to one product area. You design for both admin and learner experiences, moving between focused UI and interaction improvements, complex workflow-heavy flows, AI-enabled experiences, and our shared patterns and design system.

You create momentum

You don't wait for every problem to become a ticket. You notice gaps and opportunities, then decide what is worth fixing and move it forward. Context will often be incomplete. Creating clarity is part of the job.

You know when to push

Good judgment matters as much as craft. You know when to challenge a direction, simplify it, keep going, or stop. You care about quality without treating every detail as equally important. Bring an opinion and explain it. Be ready to change it when someone has a better one.

You multiply your impact with AI

AI should increase the amount and range of work you can meaningfully take on. Use it throughout the work: explore and prototype, get up to speed on unfamiliar areas, test and critique ideas, and automate low-value tasks. You use AI to take on more without giving up the judgment that makes the work good, and you can explain what it contributed, what you rejected, and how you made the final call.

You make the work better with others

Reporting directly to the Head of Product Design, you work closely with Product Managers, engineers, instructional designers and fellow Product Designers, and you stay involved until the thing works. You can challenge an idea without making it personal, and you can be challenged without getting defensive. Strong opinions, lightly held. No ego, no politics.

You bring something distinctive

There should be something you're unusually good at. We don't need to define it for you, but we should feel the difference in the work and in the team. Meeting the brief is expected. Bringing useful ideas beyond it is what will make you stand out.

You have the fundamentals

You have strong product and UI craft and can take work from problem to delivery. Ideally, you have professional experience designing SaaS, B2B or other complex digital products. You're comfortable with changing priorities. You communicate clearly, work autonomously, and can drive initiatives forward when needed. You know when to use existing patterns and when they need to change.

Requirements

  • This is a mid-level role. We expect roughly 3 or more years of professional product design experience, but we care more about evidence than exact years.
  • A portfolio is required. Show strong work and be clear about what you owned, why you made the decisions you did, and what changed because of them. Where AI was part of your process, tell us what it contributed and where your own judgment took over.
  • Strong English is required. It's our daily working language.
  • We're a fully remote European team with offices in Athens, Crete and Limassol.
  • We don't offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already have the legal right to work remotely from their country of residence, subject to LearnWorlds' hiring eligibility requirements.
  • Practical exercises are part of the hiring process (see below).

Recruitment process

We want each step to tell us something different about how you work. The process is designed to stay focused while giving both sides enough evidence to make a good decision.

  1. Application and practical assessment. Alongside your CV and portfolio, you'll answer a small set of role-specific questions and complete a short 10 min observation exercise.
  2. Talent acquisition conversation. A conversation about your motivation, expectations, availability and practical fit for the role.
  3. Design task and cognitive assessment. You'll have a week to work on a focused product design task and complete a short cognitive assessment. AI is welcome as part of your process.
  4. Live design review and conversation with the Head of Product Design. We'll review your work together, challenge decisions, discuss trade-offs, and talk about how you work, collaborate and make decisions.
  5. Final conversation with the CPO. A final discussion about product judgment, ambition, and alignment with where LearnWorlds is heading.

Benefits

    • Private life and health insurance plan
    • Fully remote work if you prefer to work from home, apart from when we have team meetings a few times per year
    • Your personal annual training budget
    • An annual home office allowance to set up your personal space
    • Company laptop & monitor
    • 23 days of paid time off
    • 3 early summer Fridays in July and August
    • Access to AI tools at work
    • A free LearnWorlds School to build and sell your own courses
    • Company retreats & other onsite team activities (see the video of our latest retreat).

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. It’s a short, self-recorded video, completed once on your own time, and it’s the final step that completes your application.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Security Architect responsible for designing, developing, and governing enterprise security architectures that protect information systems, applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and sensitive data. This role establishes security architecture principles, reference designs, technical standards, and implementation patterns aligned with organizational risk tolerance, mission objectives, and applicable federal security requirements.

Work Location: This is a remote position, but candidate must be willing to work during the hours of 8am - 5pm EST

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and maintain enterprise security architecture principles, reference architectures, technical standards, and security design patterns.
  • Translate business, mission, and regulatory requirements into secure architectural solutions across applications, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, and cloud environments.
  • Conduct security architecture reviews and threat modeling to identify design weaknesses, architectural risks, and opportunities to strengthen security controls.
  • Define security requirements for new systems, technology integrations, modernization initiatives, and enterprise platforms.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and provide architecture recommendations that balance security, scalability, performance, cost, and operational requirements.
  • Establish architecture governance processes and ensure security considerations are incorporated throughout the system development lifecycle.
  • Provide technical architecture guidance to security engineering, DevSecOps, cloud platform, infrastructure, and application teams.
  • Define security architecture requirements for secure software development, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and automated policy enforcement.
  • Establish secure integration patterns for security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and threat detection capabilities.
  • Review technical designs, solution proposals, and implementation plans to validate alignment with security architecture standards.
  • Support the selection and integration of security technologies based on technical requirements, threat models, and organizational needs.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust level clearance
  • Bachelors Degree and 12 years of experience, a Masters Degree and 10 years of experience, an Associates Degree and 14 years, or a High School Diploma or equivalent and 16 years of experience
  • One or more of the following relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CASP, CCISO, Security+, or CAP
  • Demonstrated experience designing and reviewing security architectures for complex enterprise, cloud, hybrid, or federal information systems.
  • Strong understanding of security architecture principles, threat modeling, defense-in-depth, least privilege, identity security, encryption, and network security.
  • Experience applying security frameworks and controls, including NIST SP 800-53 and other applicable federal or industry standards.
  • Proven experience translating security requirements into technical architecture designs, implementation standards, and security control specifications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

jobs.title: Chief Estimator
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are Rising Edge Group is an electrical contracting company founded in 2002, specialization in high-voltage electrical solutions that power critical infrastructure across North America.
jobs.description:
Who We Are 

Rising Edge Group is an electrical contracting company founded in 2002, specialization in high-voltage electrical solutions that power critical infrastructure across North America. With operations in both Canada and the United States, we partner with clients across the electrical utilities, renewable energy, and industrial sectors to design, build, and maintain the critical infrastructure systems communities and industries rely on.  

Driven by a clear vision to strengthen the stability, reliability, and advancement of energy infrastructure, we take pride in delivering work that matters. Guided by our STRIDE values - Safety, Teamwork, Responsibility, Integrity, Deliver, and Excellence - we foster a people focused culture of growth, mentorship and collaboration where safety always come first.

What You'll Do

Reporting to the Director of Pre-Construction, the Chief Estimator provides strategic and technical leadership while actively preparing and reviewing estimates for complex electrical infrastructure projects, including substations, transmission, distribution, and BESS.

Working closely with regional leadership, project management, engineering, the pre-construction team, this role ensures estimates are accurate, competitive, and aligned with project execution strategies while supporting team development and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities include, but may not be limited to:

  • Lead and support estimating activities across the US, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and quality in all estimates and proposals.
  • Manage and assist in preparing, review, and validate detailed cost estimates for complex, high-value, and high-risk electrical infrastructure projects, including labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, and indirect costs.
  • Train and develop a team of Estimators
  • Improve and manage estimating processes and templates.
  • Establish and maintain estimating standards, procedures, cost methodologies, and review processes to support accurate and consistent estimating practices.
  • Lead the development and review of proposal deliverables, including project schedules, cash flow analyses, construction methodologies, execution plans, and supporting documentation.
  • Assess project risks, commercial exposures, and constructability constraints while identifying value engineering and cost-saving opportunities.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Pre-Construction, Estimating Manager, regional leadership, and business development teams to support bid/no-bid decisions, pursuit strategies, client presentations, commercial negotiations, and contract awards.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Lead Estimators, Project Estimators, and other pre-construction personnel, supporting their development and promoting knowledge sharing.
  • Analyze historical project costs, benchmarking data, productivity assumptions, labor and material pricing, and market trends to improve estimating accuracy and competitiveness.
  • Partner with project management, engineering, procurement, and construction teams to ensure estimates align with project execution requirements and current market conditions.
  • Evaluate estimating software, tools, and workflows while implementing continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, standardization, and reporting.

Additional Information

As a condition of employment, candidates will be required to complete pre-employment screening including professional reference checks and a criminal record check.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field considered an asset.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in electrical estimating, pre-construction, or electrical infrastructure project delivery, preferably within the high-voltage, utility, or renewable energy sectors.
  • Experience in InEight (Hard Dollar) estimating software is a plus.
  • Extensive experience developing, reviewing, and validating estimates for complex electrical infrastructure projects, including substations and/or battery energy storage systems (BESS).
  • Strong understanding of high-voltage electrical construction methods, labor productivity, material and equipment costs, subcontractor pricing, and project execution requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical bid reviews, establish estimating standards, assess project risks and commercial exposures, and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Experience mentoring estimating professionals and collaborating with senior leadership, project management, and engineering teams across multiple regions.
  • Strong understanding of protection and control systems, electrical drawings, specifications, and project execution plans.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing construction schedules using Microsoft Project and/or Primavera P6.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and relevant estimating software.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites or regional offices as required.

Benefits

Why Rising Edge Group?

Safety & Excellence: Safety is at the heart of everything we do. Every project is approached with diligence, strategic planning, and reliable execution practices to protect our teams and the clients we serve while delivering world-class high-voltage solutions. Our unwavering commitment to safety and quality drives excellence on every project, every day.  

People-First Culture: You’re more than a job title. Every person contributes to powering essential energy infrastructure across North America. Our teams are built on collaboration, respect, and accountability. We support our employees through meaningful engagement initiatives, team events, and a culture that prioritizes wellbeing, inclusion, and genuine lasting connections.

Career Growth & Impact: Your role is a path to a long-term career. We empower our employees with hands-on experience, exposure to diverse projects, and opportunities to advance across disciplines, locations, and career paths. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development, you’ll build lasting expertise while making a tangible impact in an environment where teamwork and integrity guide our work.

Reward & Recognition: We believe skill, dedication, and excellence deserves recognition. Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a strong culture of appreciation ensure your achievements are celebrated, your growth is supported, and your work truly makes a difference.  

At Rising Edge Group, you’re not just building projects, you’re building a meaningful career where your work helps power the future, one project at a time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Junior Quality Specialist supports the quality assurance process to ensure websites are accurate, functional, visually consistent, and aligned with Luxury Presence standards. You review websites using established QA guidelines and checklists, identifying and documenting issues before they reach the client.

This is an entry-level role focused on developing strong attention to detail, design judgment, and technical QA skills while learning from experienced team members.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Quality Assurance

  • Website QA: Review websites for content accuracy, functionality, design consistency, responsiveness, and completeness using established QA checklists.

  • Quality Standards: Follow QA processes to identify, document, and report issues clearly for efficient resolution.

  • Issue Identification: Flag missing content, formatting inconsistencies, broken links, visual issues, and potential compliance concerns, escalating complex findings when needed.

Client Vision & Brand Representation

  • Brand Alignment: Verify that websites follow the client's provided branding, design framework, and requirements.

  • Visual Consistency: Identify inconsistencies in imagery, spacing, typography, colors, and overall website presentation.

Team Collaboration & Feedback

  • Quality Feedback: Provide clear, specific, and actionable feedback to Website Builders and Data Specialists.

  • Collaboration: Work with senior Quality Specialists and production teams to clarify issues and support timely corrections.

Product & Process Improvement

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring issues and share observations that could help improve quality and workflows.

  • Problem Solving: Research basic QA and design issues using available resources, SOPs, and internal tools, escalating complex challenges when appropriate.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Experience

  • 0–1 years of experience in website QA, quality control, web design, or a related field.

  • Basic understanding of website functionality, responsive design, and UX/UI principles is a plus.

  • Familiarity with website editors, QA tools, or design platforms is a plus, but not required.

  • Willingness to learn Luxury Presence quality standards, design best practices, and compliance guidelines.

Skills & Mindset

  • Attention to Detail: Strong ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.

  • Visual Awareness: Good eye for design with an interest in developing stronger judgment around layout, spacing, typography, imagery, and overall website quality.

  • Clear Communication: Ability to provide organized, respectful, and actionable written feedback.

  • Critical Thinking: Willingness to investigate issues, ask questions, and understand the reasoning behind quality standards.

  • Adaptability – Be open to feedback, new tools, and evolving processes.

  • Integrity – Do the right thing, even when no one is watching.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary... jobs.description:
Position Summary...

As a Distinguished AI/ML Engineer within Walmart Global Tech's Site Reliability Engineering organization, you will lead the technical development of next-generation agentic AI systems and intelligent automation solutions that ensure mission-critical reliability, scalability, and operational excellence across Walmart's entire technology ecosystem. You will architect and implement cutting-edge machine learning platforms and autonomous agents that revolutionize how we monitor, predict, and automatically resolve issues across all of Walmart's systems, supporting millions of Associates and customers globally.

Walmart Global Tech's Site Reliability Engineering organization is built with hybrid systems and software engineers who take technical ownership for reliability, scalability, automation, and mission-critical issues related to uptime, availability and fast rate of improvement of Walmart's e-commerce, stores, and omni-channel platform. As a technical expert in this domain, you'll drive the transformation of traditional SRE practices into AI-powered, self-healing, and autonomous systems built on modern tech stacks with intelligent capacity management and predictive performance optimization.

You'll be responsible for designing and building Tier 0 high-availability, resilient agentic platforms that serve as the backbone for reliability engineering across all of Walmart's systems, stores and facilities across US and international markets while defining and implementing unified, intelligent, operationally robust technical solutions and tools for all Walmart Technology organizations across all channels and geographies.

About Team:

The Site Reliability Engineering organization at Walmart Global Tech is responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of all systems that power the world's largest retailer. As a Fortune #1 company, our work impacts hundreds of millions of customers and associates globally through every transaction, every search, and every interaction across Walmart's digital and physical ecosystem.

We are the guardians of system reliability for Walmart's e-commerce platform, supply chain systems, in-store technology, financial services, and all critical business operations. Our SRE organization is at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI/ML technologies to traditional reliability engineering challenges, building autonomous systems that can predict, prevent, and resolve issues before they impact customers or business operations.

The SRE team is one of the core engineering organizations within Walmart Global Tech, working closely with all product and engineering teams across the enterprise to ensure that every system meets the highest standards of reliability, scalability, and performance. We're invested in building a robust, intelligent, and highly automated infrastructure that supports Walmart's mission to help people live better through technology innovation and operational excellence.

What you'll do...

AI/ML & Agentic Systems Technical Leadership:

  • Architect and develop advanced agentic AI systems that can autonomously handle complex reliability engineering workflows, predictive failure analysis, and self-optimization across all Walmart technology systems.
  • Design and implement multi-agent orchestration platforms that coordinate between different AI agents for automated incident response, capacity planning, and performance optimization across e-commerce, supply chain, and in-store systems.
  • Build intelligent observability and monitoring systems using ML-driven anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and autonomous incident resolution capabilities that span all of Walmart's technology ecosystem.
  • Develop self-healing infrastructure platforms that leverage AI to predict, prevent, and automatically resolve system issues before they impact customers, associates, or business operations across any Walmart system.

Site Reliability Engineering Technical Excellence:

  • Design, write and build advanced tools to improve reliability, latency, availability, and scalability of all Walmart Tech systems including: 1) Engineer reliability and availability starting with metrics and measurements across all domains, 2) Enable scaling by providing technical solutions, developing automation and/or optimizing processes for all engineering teams, 3) Build tools/automate to prevent re-occurrence of problems across all mission critical Walmart services, 4) Augment existing instrumentation to build a cohesive picture of system characteristics across the entire Walmart technology landscape with special attention to points of failure.
  • Architect and implement fault-tolerant systems and services across Walmart's hybrid cloud infrastructure with focus on autonomous recovery and intelligent failure prediction for e-commerce, supply chain, financial services, and in-store technology.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams and leadership across all Walmart technology organizations to establish technical strategies and solutions to improve mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to restore (MTTR) through intelligent automation and predictive capabilities.
  • Work with service owners across all domains (e-commerce, supply chain, stores, fintech, etc.) to define SLOs and build SLIs to ensure all critical systems are meeting SLAs while maintaining optimal performance and user experience.
  • Perform complex troubleshooting and analysis of large-scale distributed systems across Walmart's entire technology stack, using expertise in coding, algorithms, and distributed system design.

Strategic Technical Innovation:

  • Partner closely with all engineering organizations including E-commerce, Supply Chain, Store Technology, Fintech, and Data Platform teams to deliver autonomous reliability solutions through advanced machine learning, natural language processing, and computer vision technologies.
  • Drive the development of MLOps and AIOps platforms that enable continuous learning, model deployment, monitoring, and autonomous optimization of reliability engineering systems across all Walmart domains.
  • Innovate in agentic AI technologies for SRE including large language models (LLMs) for automated incident response, reinforcement learning agents for capacity optimization, multi-modal AI for infrastructure monitoring, and federated learning for cross-domain reliability insights.
  • Implement advanced CI/CD pipelines for reliability systems including automated deployment, validation, and rollback mechanisms for SRE tools and monitoring systems with built-in observability and performance monitoring.
  • Establish platform engineering excellence by building reusable SRE infrastructure, intelligent monitoring platforms, and developer productivity tools that serve all Walmart engineering teams.
  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to engineering teams across all Walmart organizations on advanced SRE concepts, AI/ML for reliability, platform engineering best practices, and autonomous system design through code reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What you'll bring:

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with 12+ years of hands-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering, AI/ML Engineering, or Platform Engineering.
  • Proven track record as a senior individual contributor in SRE, AI/ML, or Platform Engineering with experience influencing technical decisions and driving technical excellence across teams.
  • Deep experience working with mission-critical systems with KPI expertise in MTTD, MTTR, availability, model performance, and autonomous system reliability.

Must-Have Technical Experience:

  • Expert-level AI/ML engineering experience with deep expertise in machine learning algorithms, deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and production ML system deployment at scale.
  • Advanced experience with agentic AI systems including multi-agent frameworks, autonomous decision-making systems, LLM-based agents, and agent orchestration platforms.
  • Comprehensive Site Reliability Engineering expertise including hands-on experience with Service Management (Incident, Problem & Change Management), Performance and Capacity Engineering for AI/ML systems.
  • Expert-level cloud engineering experience (Azure, GCP, AWS) with deep knowledge of cloud-native AI/ML services, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and serverless architectures.
  • Deep observability and monitoring expertise with hands-on experience in:
    • Distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin, OpenTelemetry) for AI/ML pipelines
    • Metrics collection and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog) with ML-specific dashboards
    • Log aggregation and analysis (ELK stack, Splunk, Fluentd) for model and system monitoring
    • APM tools and performance monitoring for AI/ML workloads
    • AI-driven anomaly detection and predictive monitoring systems
Platform Engineering experience including:
  • Building developer platforms and internal tooling for AI/ML teams
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Service mesh architectures (Istio, Linkerd) for AI/ML services
  • API gateway and microservices platform development
  • Self-service ML deployment platforms and developer productivity tools

Industry & Domain Experience:

  • Experience in large-scale retail, e-commerce, or high-traffic consumer-facing systems with strict availability and performance requirements (strongly preferred).
  • Experience with mission-critical distributed systems serving millions of concurrent users across multiple domains (e-commerce, payments, inventory, supply chain, etc.).
  • Experience with enterprise-scale SRE implementations supporting diverse technology stacks and business-critical applications across multiple organizational domains.
  • Experience with complex multi-cloud and hybrid cloud environments supporting diverse workloads with varying reliability and performance requirements.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration Skills:

  • Technical thought leadership and influence in AI/ML architecture decisions, SRE methodologies, and platform engineering strategies across all Walmart technology domains.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration experience working with diverse engineering teams across E-commerce, Supply Chain, Store Technology, Fintech, Security, and Platform Engineering to deliver enterprise-wide reliability solutions.
  • Excellent technical communication skills with ability to articulate complex SRE and AI/ML concepts to diverse engineering audiences and influence technical decisions across multiple organizations.
  • Mentorship and knowledge sharing experience, providing technical guidance on SRE best practices, AI/ML for reliability, and platform engineering through code reviews, technical discussions, and documentation.
  • High degree of technical ownership and accountability for complex, mission-critical reliability systems with ability to work independently on high-impact projects that span multiple engineering domains.

Preferred Technical Experience:

  • MLOps and model lifecycle management experience with tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Seldon, or similar platforms for enterprise-scale reliability and monitoring deployments.
  • Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision expertise for building intelligent log analysis, automated incident response, visual infrastructure monitoring, and conversational AI for SRE operations.
  • Edge computing and distributed systems experience for deploying monitoring and reliability solutions across retail stores, distribution centers, and edge infrastructure.
  • Real-time streaming and event-driven architectures using Kafka, Pulsar, or similar technologies for processing high-volume operational data streams across all Walmart systems.
  • Advanced security practices for reliability systems including secure monitoring, data privacy in observability, and secure multi-tenant SRE platforms.
  • Chaos Engineering and fault injection experience across diverse system types including e-commerce, supply chain, financial services, and in-store technology.
  • Performance optimization for large-scale distributed systems including database optimization, network performance tuning, and infrastructure cost optimization.
  • Open source contribution experience in SRE, observability, and infrastructure automation tools and familiarity with industry best practices and emerging technologies.

jobs.description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $60/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

  • Design the system architecture for web, mobile and AI products. Services, data model, hosting and how the pieces talk to each other
  • Write the technical parts of proposals and scopes of work. Modules, user flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and estimates the team can stand behind
  • Design integrations with third-party APIs and vendors. Plan for retries, queues, webhooks and monitoring, and keep a clean way to swap a provider later
  • Plan multi-tenant and white-label setups with proper data isolation and access control
  • Build security and privacy in from day one. Encryption, audit logs, consent, data residency and the evidence clients need for an outside audit
  • Design AI and LLM features for client products, including model choice, retrieval (RAG), guardrails and the evaluations that prove quality in production
  • Plan in phases. Ship a lean MVP first and keep the design ready for the full build without a rewrite
  • Work with sales and project managers on scope, timelines and risk. Push back early when something will not fit
  • Review the dev team's code, pull requests and technical approach. Catch drift from the design early and explain what to change
  • Guide and unblock engineers, set technical standards, and own technical quality through delivery and handover
  • Keep the architecture docs current so anyone on the team can pick up the context

Requirements

  • Strong backend and data fundamentals. You've designed APIs and relational data models (Postgres or similar) and you know where they break
  • Cloud architecture experience on AWS, Azure or GCP, including containers, deploys and monitoring
  • Real integration design experience. Third-party APIs, webhooks, SSO and OAuth, background queues and failure handling
  • Hands-on AI architecture. You've designed LLM or RAG features with evaluation for production client products, and you know what they change about cost, latency and testing

  • AI-augmented workflow. You use AI tools every day in your own design, review and writing work
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Clients read your documents and hear your voice directly

Nice to have

US Treasury Operations Manager

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

Role Overview

The Treasury team is part of Circana’s global Finance and Strategy organization and manages a broad range of operational and strategic activities, including cash management, banking, liquidity planning, capital structure, and financial risk management. The team supports approximately 25 countries and partners closely with Controllership, Tax, Legal, and Financial Planning & Analysis.

As the US Treasury Operations Manager, you will lead daily US cash management and liquidity activities, including cash positioning, forecasting, banking administration, intercompany funding, and operational controls. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring reliable daily execution while strengthening processes, controls, visibility, and scalability.

In partnership with the Assistant Treasurer and OUS Treasury Operations Manager, you will support coordinated global liquidity management, recommend operational improvements, and help advance Circana’s broader Treasury capabilities.

This role reports to the Assistant Treasurer and manages one Treasury Analyst.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own daily US cash positioning and liquidity management, ensuring adequate funding for payroll, payments, and other business obligations.
  • Coordinate with the OUS Treasury Operations Manager to support global cash visibility, coverage, and funding needs.
  • Lead daily, weekly, and monthly cash forecasting, improving accuracy and decision-making through clear assumptions and variance analysis.
  • Manage cash deployment and short-term investment activity to optimize the use of available cash.
  • Oversee Treasury payment execution and partner with Controllership to resolve bank reconciliation items, ensuring accurate cash visibility and a strong control environment.
  • Manage US bank account structures, including account openings and closures, authorized signers, user access, entitlements, and security controls.
  • Support intercompany funding, loan administration, and cash repatriation activities in partnership with Tax, Legal, and Controllership.
  • Maintain accurate tracking of intercompany loans, interest calculations, and supporting documentation in accordance with internal policies.
  • Deliver clear reporting and actionable insights on liquidity, cash trends, forecast variances, and potential risks.
  • Evaluate Treasury-related risks and recommend practical mitigation strategies to Treasury leadership.
  • Lead process, control, and system improvements that strengthen automation, visibility, efficiency, and scalability.
  • Maintain Treasury procedures and operational control frameworks.
  • Lead and develop the Treasury Analyst by setting priorities, overseeing execution, and supporting professional growth.
  • Partner across Treasury, Controllership, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and other Finance teams to resolve issues and advance cross-functional initiatives.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on Treasury Operations experience, including cash positioning, liquidity management, cash forecasting, and banking administration.
  • Strong understanding of corporate cash management, banking structures, cash deployment, intercompany funding, and Treasury controls.
  • Experience managing bank accounts, authorized signers, user access, entitlements, and online banking security.
  • Experience with treasury management systems and ERP platforms. Kyriba and NetSuite experience are preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to strengthen processes and controls while improving efficiency, visibility, and scalability.
  • Experience analyzing cash forecasts, variances, liquidity trends, and financial risks.
  • Strong judgment and ability to distinguish routine operational activity from issues requiring escalation.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Controllership, Tax, Legal, FP&A, and global Finance teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop others through direct management, mentoring, or significant team leadership.
  • Experience leading cross-functional projects, Treasury improvements, or systems initiatives.
  • Multinational Treasury or global operations exposure is preferred.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location:This is a Remote US position. Candidates must be available to support Treasury activities during US banking hours. Eastern or Central time zones are preferred

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this role is $100,000 - $125,000 USD. This job is also eligible for bonus pay.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

SNP Transformations, Inc. stands as a global leader in delivering innovative software solutions for digital transformation and automated data migrations. Expected Outcomes:

SNP Transformations, Inc. is seeking a Technical SAP Consultant to support the design, development, testing, and delivery of technical solutions for SAP transformation projects. The successful candidate will work with functional consultants, technical teams, and client stakeholders on mergers, acquisitions, carve-outs, divestitures, and SAP S/4HANA migrations, with a focus on ABAP development, integrations, and data transformation. This role will translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and support successful deployment and knowledge transfer.

The Technical SAP Consultant will be a key contributor to our team with the following responsibilities:

Project Implementation:

Project Coordination:

· Provide task estimates, maintain delivery documentation, and contribute to technical reviews to support quality, timely execution, and client satisfaction.

Qualifications & Requirements:

· Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.

· At least 5 years of experience in Information Technology, including hands-on SAP technical development and delivery experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • · Hands-on SAP technical consulting experience across SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • · Ability to independently deliver assigned technical work, collaborate across workstreams, and meet agreed project milestones.
  • · Strong knowledge of ABAP and object-oriented ABAP, including modular development, exception handling, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • · Understanding of SAP application architecture, relational data models, SAP Data Dictionary objects, and business process dependencies.
  • · Experience developing reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows, including user exits, enhancement points, and BAdIs.
  • · Experience with SAP HANA-oriented development, including CDS views, optimized Open SQL, and familiarity with AMDP.
  • · Experience building and troubleshooting integrations using IDocs, RFCs, BAPIs, APIs, and OData services.
  • · Familiarity with SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, and SAP Gateway services to support application development and troubleshooting.
  • · Familiarity with SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite for extensions and integration with SAP and non-SAP systems.
  • · Experience with data extraction, mapping, transformation, loading, validation, and reconciliation in SAP migration projects.
  • · Working knowledge of SNP CrystalBridge transformation tools, SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server (SLT), or comparable migration tools is a plus.
  • · Experience delivering technical solutions across SAP implementation or transformation projects, including SAP S/4HANA migrations, system consolidations, or carve-outs.
  • · Strong client-facing skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts, clarify requirements, and present solution options to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • · Understanding of cross-module integration and the technical impact of changes across SAP business processes.
  • · Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA custom code adaptation, code quality checks, and clean-core principles.
  • · Ability to produce clear technical specifications, development documentation, test evidence, and knowledge-transfer materials.
  • · Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments, including iterative development, technical reviews, and defect management.
  • · Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to resolving technical issues.
  • · Strong planning and coordination skills, including estimating technical tasks, managing dependencies, and escalating delivery risks.
  • · Full project lifecycle experience spanning requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
  • · Knowledge of SAP transport management, background processing, authorization considerations, and collaboration with SAP Basis teams.
  • · Relevant SAP certifications in ABAP development, SAP HANA development, or SAP BTP are preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant – Solution Advisory & Presales
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAIM is seeking a commercially minded Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant who can connect business needs with technology, lead compelling customer conversations, and turn opportunities into clearly defined projects.
jobs.description:
About the Role

AIM is seeking a commercially minded Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant who can connect business needs with technology, lead compelling customer conversations, and turn opportunities into clearly defined projects.

This role combines business discovery, functional solution design, project scoping, presales, demonstrations, and marketing support. You will work closely with our sales, delivery, and marketing teams to help customers understand the value of Dynamics 365 and establish a practical path to implementation.

The ideal candidate brings experience across ERP and CRM, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core Dynamics 365 area and the ability to shape solutions across interconnected business processes.

Exceptional presentation and communication skills are a critical success factor. You must be able to engage executives, facilitate productive workshops, explain complex concepts clearly, and deliver persuasive demonstrations grounded in customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

Business Discovery and Solution Design

  • Lead discovery workshops with executives, business leaders, and operational teams.
  • Understand customer objectives, business processes, pain points, existing systems, and reporting requirements.
  • Translate requirements into future-state processes and recommended Dynamics 365 capabilities.
  • Conduct fit-gap assessments, prioritizing standard functionality and identifying justified extensions or integrations.
  • Define phased implementation roadmaps with clear outcomes, priorities, and dependencies.
  • Collaborate with specialists and technical architects to validate cross-application, integration, security, and data migration requirements.

Project Scoping and Estimation

  • Develop statements of work covering deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, customer responsibilities, and acceptance criteria.
  • Break projects into workstreams and estimate functional effort, collaborating with technical and delivery leads to validate the overall plan.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and factors that could affect cost or timelines.
  • Recommend implementation phases that balance business value, budget, and delivery capacity.
  • Ensure a complete handover from sales to delivery, maintaining alignment between customer expectations and project commitments.

Presales, Presentations, and Demonstrations

  • Partner with sales to qualify opportunities and assess customer needs and solution fit.
  • Lead executive presentations that connect Dynamics 365 capabilities to business priorities.
  • Build and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting the customer’s industry, processes, and challenges.
  • Use clear storytelling to explain how a solution improves day-to-day work and business performance.
  • Respond confidently to questions, manage objections, and communicate tradeoffs honestly.
  • Clearly distinguish standard functionality from configurations, integrations, and custom development.
  • Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, executive presentations, and customer workshops.
  • Maintain reusable demonstration environments, scripts, and business scenarios.
  • Support licensing discussions alongside licensing specialists.

Marketing and Practice Development

  • Collaborate with marketing to create solution one-pagers, presentations, webinars, demo videos, and campaign content.
  • Translate technical capabilities into compelling business use cases and customer outcomes.
  • Present at customer events, partner sessions, and webinars.
  • Help develop repeatable assessments, implementation packages, and industry-specific offerings.
  • Bring customer insights and recurring requirements into AIM’s service development process.

Delivery Collaboration

  • Support functional design, configuration, testing, training, and adoption where required.
  • Maintain continuity between the proposed solution and implementation.
  • Help resolve functional questions and assess change requests during delivery.
  • Mentor junior consultants and improve discovery, documentation, and demonstration standards.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Typically 5+ years of Dynamics 365 functional consulting experience, including multiple completed implementations.
  • Ideally, experience across both ERP and CRM, with deep hands-on expertise in at least one core area:
    • ERP: Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management.
    • CRM and service applications: Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, or Project Operations.
  • Ability to lead discovery across interconnected business processes, scope cross-application solutions, and engage specialists where deeper expertise is required.
  • Demonstrated experience leading discovery workshops, fit-gap assessments, tailored demonstrations, and project scoping.
  • Strong understanding of business processes within the candidate’s primary area of expertise.
  • Experience producing clear requirements, process maps, functional designs, proposals, and statements of work.
  • Familiarity with Power Platform and the role of automation, analytics, and integrations within Dynamics 365 solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with sales, technical, delivery, and marketing teams.

Critical Success Factor: Presentation and Communication

The successful candidate must demonstrate:

  • Executive presence: Confidence and credibility when engaging senior decision-makers.
  • Clear communication: Ability to explain complex business and technology concepts in accessible language.
  • Compelling demonstrations: Ability to tell a coherent story through customer-specific workflows and outcomes.
  • Strong facilitation: Ability to ask thoughtful questions, listen actively, manage discussions, and build alignment.
  • Persuasive business writing: Ability to produce clear proposals, scopes of work, presentations, and marketing content.
  • Audience awareness: Ability to adapt the level of detail and message for executives, business users, and technical teams.
  • Commercial judgment: Ability to communicate value, address objections, and set realistic expectations.

Candidates should be prepared to deliver a short solution presentation or demonstration and discuss how they would scope a customer opportunity as part of the interview process.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within a Microsoft partner or consulting organization.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications.
  • Experience with legacy ERP or CRM migrations.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, and agent-based business scenarios.
  • Experience developing packaged services, industry solutions, or marketing content.
  • Background in finance, accounting, supply chain, professional services, or customer operations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers understand the proposed solution, its business value, and the implementation approach.
  • Presentations and demonstrations build confidence and advance qualified opportunities.
  • Scopes of work contain realistic estimates, clear assumptions, and achievable commitments.
  • Delivery teams receive complete, actionable handovers.
  • Sales and marketing gain reusable assets that strengthen customer engagement.
  • AIM develops a more repeatable and scalable Dynamics 365 practice.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You combine functional expertise, commercial judgment, and outstanding communication. You can move confidently from an executive conversation to a detailed process workshop, then translate what you have learned into a compelling demonstration and a well-defined project scope. You take ownership and understand the delivery implications of the commitments you make.

jobs.description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.

Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.

For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.

The role

You will be the face of My Money Matters’ education for our members, helping them make the most of their salary. You’ll cover topics from budgeting to retirement planning both online (1:1s, webinars, short form) and offline (wellness days, workshops).

You will be a valuable and vocal contributor to the shape of our guidance. Working alongside the content team, you’ll take part in regular brainstorms, giving your input as the subject matter expert.

We are pioneering a modern approach to content and engagement. No reams of generic advice about every topic under the sun. Instead, we make actionable, contextual guidance delivered only when it’s needed - supported by Max, our AI coach. You’ll be a key part of driving forward a coaching function that contributes to improving the financial outcomes of our members.

In a typical week you might cover:

  • A handful of online 1:1 meetings - covering topics like debt or pensions
  • An on-site pension workshop - a two-hour session prepping employees for retirement
  • Brainstorming session - coming up with the next big content idea with the whole team
  • Presenting on camera - working with our content team to script and film short-form

On sites are key to our education, you can expect travel to be part of the role, expenses covered.

The right person

If this sounds like you, we’d love to chat:

  • A great presenter - bright, positive, knowledgeable and engaging across a range of topics
  • Qualified or experienced - you hold, or are working towards, a financial qualification, or have relevant workplace experience
  • Customer-oriented - you get satisfaction from helping people achieve financial goals
  • Enthused by new ideas - you’re excited to build a modern approach to financial guidance
  • Resilient - as upbeat and engaging in the tenth session of the day as the first
  • Tech-savvy - interested in AI to help build Max, our friendly AI coach and colleague

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) and shared-cost AVCs

This is a remote-first role with some expectation for travel to London
