jobs.description:
VIRTUAL NONPROFIT EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week

This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.

VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.

We are looking for a skilled Executive Assistant with direct nonprofit experience who can own the client relationship and provide back-office support to nonprofit leaders. You will work with executive directors, founders, and boards, keeping donor records current and board meetings on schedule so leadership can focus on the mission. Self-motivation and professional discipline are essential, because clients will rely on you as part of their organization.

Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another's success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.

Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.

EXPECTATIONS

Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive & Professional Manner

  • Demonstrate a strong work ethic and positive attitude with clients, board members, donors, volunteers, and partners.
  • Ensure all communication reflects VaVa's standards of professionalism and care.
  • Contribute to a thriving contractor culture by embracing VaVa's values.

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

  • Manage day-to-day account activities reliably, and learn the mission and funding realities behind each client's priorities.
  • Anticipate client needs and communicate progress consistently so clients always know where things stand.
  • Handle challenges independently without letting quality or client confidence slip.
  • Track engagement hours and flag early when adjustments are needed to sustain service.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage the client's inbox, calendar, and travel across time zones, including drafting responses, scheduling meetings, resolving conflicts, and handling itineraries and last-minute changes.
  • Coordinate board and committee meetings, including scheduling, agendas, board packets, RSVPs, votes, and action item tracking.
  • Support geographically dispersed boards with scheduling polls, rotating meeting times across time zones, automated reminders, and travel coordination for retreats and annual meetings.
  • Attend virtual board and committee meetings to take and circulate minutes, and maintain governance records such as bylaws, conflict of interest disclosures, officer and term tracking, and the annual board calendar.
  • Maintain donor and constituent records in the client's CRM, including data entry, deduplication, cleanup, and import and export mapping.
  • Process gifts by issuing acknowledgments and tax receipts, sending thank-you outreach, following up with lapsed donors, monitoring recurring gifts, and matching online donations to CRM records.
  • Set up online giving pages and donation forms under client direction, and prepare donor lists and segments for appeals.
  • Support grant applications by tracking the funder calendar and requirements, researching funding opportunities, drafting and editing narratives under client direction, and compiling and submitting materials through funder portals.
  • Track initiatives and deadlines in the client's project management tools, and pull program and outcomes data for grant reports, board updates, and donor communications.
  • Plan and coordinate fundraising events, programs, and webinars, virtual or in person, including vendor contracts, ticketing and registration, volunteer assignments, run-of-show documents, and follow-up.
  • Manage volunteer recruitment, scheduling, onboarding paperwork, hour logging, and recognition, and serve as the point of contact for volunteers, vendors, board members, and the client's team.
  • Draft and edit donor, partner, and board correspondence, email newsletters, presentations, board decks, and executive briefings that need little revision.
  • Build and maintain spreadsheets for donor, grant, and event tracking, including basic analysis for leadership reports.
  • Use AI notetakers such as Otter, Fireflies, or Granola, and other AI tools, to summarize meetings, draft first-pass thank-you letters and newsletter copy, and organize research; automate recurring reminders and follow-ups where appropriate.
  • Handle donor data, personnel matters, financials, and strategic plans with discretion, and never enter client data into unapproved AI tools.
  • Collaborate with fellow VaVa contractors when projects benefit from shared or specialized support.
  • Handle additional administrative requests as they arise, with flexibility.

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.
  • At least 3 years of demonstrated experience in an executive or administrative support role, including direct support to at least one executive.
  • At least 1 year of experience supporting a nonprofit leader, board, or organization.
  • At least 1 year of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity.
  • Available at least 20 hours per week to support high-touch (daily), deliverable-focused clients.

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including polished documents and presentations and spreadsheets with formulas, imports, exports, and basic analysis.
  • Daily use of Slack and Zoom, including meeting setup, basic troubleshooting, and facilitation support.
  • Experience with at least one CRM or donor management system, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, DonorPerfect, Bloomerang, or Blackbaud, including data entry, gift acknowledgments, and tax receipts.
  • Experience with at least one project management platform such as Trello, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, or Monday.com.
  • Experience with scheduling tools such as Calendly or Acuity, and polling tools for meeting times across time zones.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage high-volume inboxes, complex calendars, and travel remotely across time zones.
  • Experience supporting remote board operations, including agendas, packets, minutes, governance records, and follow-up.
  • Experience coordinating events with vendors and volunteers, including registration and ticketing platforms such as Eventbrite or Cvent, and day-of logistics.
  • General AI literacy and comfort using AI tools to draft content and streamline routine tasks, with an understanding of what donor and organizational data should never be entered into AI systems.

Preferred

  • Experience researching, drafting, or submitting grant applications, including funder portals and research tools such as Candid or Instrumentl.
  • Experience building and sending email newsletters in platforms such as Mailchimp, Constant Contact, or Flodesk.
  • Experience with online fundraising platforms such as Givebutter, Classy, Zeffy, or Mightycause.
  • Experience with board portals such as BoardEffect, Diligent, or OnBoard.
  • Experience with volunteer management tools such as VolunteerHub, SignUpGenius, or Bloomerang Volunteer.
  • Experience with workflow automation tools such as Zapier, even at a basic level.
  • Experience facilitating virtual webinars, including breakout rooms and participant troubleshooting.

EDUCATION

A degree is not required. Demonstrated competency and consistent professional growth carry more weight than a credential alone. Candidates without a degree should hold at least one relevant certification, such as an administrative professional certification, Google Workspace certification, Nonprofit Leadership Alliance certification, nonprofit management certificate, CRM platform certification, or equivalent. A commitment to continued learning is an expectation of this role.

This role ensures alignment with enterprise IT/OT cybersecurity, architecture, and infrastructure standards, while assessing current state capabilities, identifying gaps, and delivering a clear, actionable roadmap to a best in class future state supported by data driven business cases.   • Assess and document the current state OT/DCS technologies, control strategies, data flows, and system architectures in collaboration with site personnel.

  • Build and manage strategic partnerships with OT vendors, defining technology roadmaps that ensure reliable, scalable, and future ready OT infrastructure.

  • Promote knowledge sharing across plants and teams, fostering cross functional collaboration and consistent OT practices enterprise wide.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or a related technical field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Operational Technology roles within manufacturing or chemical process industries.
  • Deep understanding of Distributed Control Systems (DCS), PLCs, SCADA, HMI, and related industrial automation technologies.
  • Proven experience in developing OT strategies, technology roadmaps, and supporting plant modernization projects.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering, IT, cybersecurity, and operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply data-driven decision-making to identify opportunities for efficiency and improvement.

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Strategic Impact: A well-articulated and actionable OT roadmap is in place, endorsed by key stakeholders, and aligned with both business goals and security requirements.

  • Integrity: Truth over comfort. Trust over revenue.

  • Accountability: Own the contract, the commitment and the consequences; every win and failure is yours.

Diversified Botanics does not engage external recruiting agencies. All candidates must apply directly.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on, cross-functional operations role for a resourceful problem solver. You’ll work across compliance, procurement, fulfillment, and production, handling whatever the business needs on a given day. One hour you might be completing a state sales tax exemption certificate for a raw material purchase or a vendor credit application. The next you might be moving pallets between facilities. Much of the work can be taught. What can’t be taught is the drive to figure things out. This is an on-site position at our [city], Utah facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Support procurement of raw materials, including vendor paperwork such as sales tax exemption (resale) certificates and credit applications

  • Bring options and potential solutions when something goes wrong, not just the problem

  • Learn quickly and are comfortable figuring out unfamiliar tasks on your own

  • Enjoy variety and are equally comfortable with paperwork and physical work

  • Take ownership of tasks from start to finish

You May Struggle Here If You

  • Stop when you hit a roadblock and wait for someone else to solve it

  • Prefer a narrowly defined role with the same tasks every day

  • View hands-on or physical work as outside your job

What You Bring

  • Experience or working knowledge in at least two of the following: compliance, procurement, fulfillment, or production oversight

  • Strong problem-solving skills and resourcefulness

  • Ability to perform physical tasks such as moving pallets

This role is for someone who gets things done across the operation. If you can figure out a state tax form in the morning and move inventory in the afternoon, and you bring solutions instead of stopping at problems, we want to talk to you.

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Neobank.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Indonesia. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Indonesia.

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

jobs.description:
Overview / Responsibilities

Wood is looking for a Senior Human Environment Consultant to join our growing team in Eastern Canada.

Please note this role may have the option to work from any Wood location in Eastern Canada or even remotely.

About the Human Environment Team

Wood’s Human Environment team is a diverse group of social researchers that work collaboratively across Canada. Working together in an interdisciplinary environment, we study the interactions between human populations and the natural and physical environments in project-specific contexts. This includes a wide range of industrial, government and Indigenous clients. Our services include social and economic baseline research, socio-economic impact assessments (including GBA+ analysis, land and resource use, visual aesthetics and impacts on Indigenous Rights), socio-economic effects monitoring and management, communication and engagement with public stakeholders, government agencies and Indigenous Nations and Peoples as well as Indigenous Knowledge studies. Working with Wood’s Canadian Director of Social Inclusion and across geographies and disciplines, our Human Environment team leads the advancement of social inclusion internally and with our clients to strengthen the social aspect of ESG throughout our projects.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting to the Discipline Lead, Human Environment, you will:

  • Provide technical leadership through senior review of project deliverables and mentoring colleagues.
  • Advise on a wide variety of social and economic research activities in support of baseline studies, impact assessments, and effects management and monitoring plans for a wide range of projects, including municipal, resource development, remediation and environmental assessment projects
  • Provide expertise in meeting regulatory requirements for environmental and impact assessments including the various provincial process as well as those of the Impact Assessment Agency Canada regarding gender-based analysis plus and impacts on Indigenous rights
  • Support the planning and implementation of Indigenous and public engagement programs for a wide range of projects, including municipal, resource development, remediation and environmental / impact assessment projects
  • Promote excellence in social and economic impact assessment, incorporating best international industry practices, contributing to the growth of our Human Environment services through high quality and consistent service to internal and external clients
  • Elevate the knowledge and success of our technical professionals through participation in Wood’s Global Technical Expert Network
  • Promote and support weaving together Indigenous Knowledge and Western Science to support holistic project understanding and solutions
  • Prepare and contribute to technical proposals, presentations and reports
  • Contribute to and participate in business development initiatives with internal and external clients
  • Mentor and work with teams to empower and promote development and advancement
  • Liaise and work effectively with team members, other Wood technical specialists, clients, government agencies, Indigenous communities and stakeholders
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills / Qualifications

  • University degree (graduate level preferred) in Social Sciences, Economics, Indigenous studies or related field preferred
  • At least 10 years relevant experience in conducting and providing senior guidance on social and/or economic research and analysis and in environmental assessments (municipal, provincial, federal)
  • Knowledge of and experience meeting Canadian impact / environmental assessment requirements (federal, provincial, territorial)
  • Experience working with Indigenous Nations and Peoples in data gathering and reflecting their perspectives regarding Indigenous rights and knowledge in impact assessments
  • Strong relationship building and culturally informed conflict resolutions approaches, including ability to facilitate challenging conversations to resolve complex issues
  • Experience working on resource development, infrastructure and linear projects (transportation, transmission lines, pipelines)
  • Excellent written, oral and interpersonal communication skills (English; French and Indigenous language is an asset)
  • Strong budgetary, statistical and report presentation skills
  • Desire to provide excellent client service and commitment to continuous technical improvement
  • Ability to work independently and while encouraging collaboration in a strong entrepreneurial environment
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage and prioritize several assignments at one time and deliver on time and within budget
  • Fluency with the use of Microsoft 365 for Business products including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, OneDrive
  • Valid driver’s license

Company Overview

Wood is a global leader in engineering and consultancy across energy and the built environment, helping to unlock solutions to some of the world’s most critical challenges. We provide consulting, projects and operations solutions in more than 60 countries, employing around 40,000 people. www.woodplc.com

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is hiring experienced software engineers with kubernetes experience to help scale up its AI Infrastructure. We expect you to have significant software engineering experience with kubernetes including cluster operations, operator development, node health monitoring and working with GPU resource scheduling. We welcome out-of-the-box thinkers who can provide new ideas with strong execution bias. Expect to be constantly challenged, improving, and evolving for the better. You will help advance NVIDIA's capacity to build and deploy leading infrastructure solutions for a broad range of AI-based applications. If you're creative, passionate about kubernetes and GPUs, and love having fun, please apply today!

For two decades, we have pioneered visual computing, the art and science of computer graphics. With the invention of the GPU - the engine of modern visual computing - the field has expanded to encompass video games, movie production, product design, medical diagnosis and scientific research. Today, we stand at the beginning of the next era, the AI computing era, ignited by a new computing model, GPU deep learning.


What you will be doing:

  • You will be part of an DGX Cloud team responsible for production systems that enable large scalable GPU clusters to be used for a variety of AI workloads. This includes working on custom software related to scheduling GPU resources on kubernetes.
  • Implementing monitoring and health management capabilities that enable industry leading reliability, availability, and scalability of GPU assets. You will be harnessing multiple data streams, ranging from GPU hardware diagnostics to cluster and network telemetry.
  • Working with teams across NVIDIA to ensure production AI clusters run reliability and consistently with maximum performance. Evaluating system failures and improving services based on a well-defined incident management process.

What we need to see:

  • Direct experience in a software engineering role within a highly technical organization with demonstrable impact from your work. Software development experience with kubernetes APIs and frameworks not just operating a cluster.
  • Highly motivated with strong communication skills, you can work successfully with multi-functional teams, principles, and architects and coordinate effectively across organizational boundaries and geographies.
  • 8+ years in similar role and experience on large-scale production systems. Experience with common software engineering principles, tools and techniques.
  • You possess a BS in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or a comparable Degree or equivalent experience.

Penguin Ai: We're Not Just Building AI, We're Revolutionizing Healthcare! Want to Be Our Technical Program Management Maestro?

Who We Are: The Penguin Ai Rebellion!

We’re not your average AI company - and we don’t want average teammates. Penguin Ai was founded by healthcare veterans who knew the system needed more than hype and half-baked algorithms. We built an AI platform that actually works in healthcare - across Prior Auth, HCC Coding, and all those soul-crushing workflows no one brags about. Our platform is fast to implement (think: 60 days), reduces administrative costs up to 40%, and makes payers look like heroes without writing a line of code.

This is AI for the real world of healthcare. And just to put a fine point on it: powerhouses like Snowflake and AWS don't just partner with anyone. Their trust in our platform speaks volumes about our robust, scalable, and secure technology.

Our audacious vision was first ignited by ourCEO Fawad Butt, whose leadership asChief Data Officerat bothOptumandKaiser Permanentegave him oversight of healthcare data representing nearly75% of American lives. So, he didn't justseethe problem; helivedit. Fawad understood that healthcare AI couldn't be a bandage - it had to be apurpose-built, battle-ready solution, meticulously crafted for the intricate, human-first world of medicine, not some hastily retrofitted industry software.

  • So with Fawad, who else is steering this iceberg? A dream team boastingover 150 years of combined, hard-won healthcare experience!We're talking bout heavy hitters likeKishore, Niki, Nate and Dan… who all bring different successes & expertise from AI & healthcare.These aren't just impressive resumes; they're the architects and masterminds behind a platform that doesn't just process data – it genuinelyunderstands healthcare's pulse.

We're growing faster than a penguin on a waterslide and we’re always on the hunt for customer-obsessed problem-solvers to help our clients unlock the full potential of their AI investments.

This isn’t some futuristic sci-fi movie set, this is AI for the real, gritty, essential world of healthcare where speed & data matter.

Your Epic Quest as Our Senior Technical Program Manager!

The Senior Technical Program Manager owns delivery. You are the person standing between a signed contract and a live, value-producing deployment at a health system or payer, and you are accountable for getting from one to the other on time, with the customer still smiling. You’ll run our most complex implementations end to end, drive the engineering work behind them, and be the single voice the customer trusts on status, risk, and what happens next. This role exists because 60-day implementations don’t happen by accident; they happen because someone with real technical depth and real operating rigor makes them happen.

Your Day-to-Day Superpowers: What You’ll Actually Do:

Delivery – owning the program end to end

  • Own the full delivery lifecycle for enterprise customer implementations, from kickoff through go-live and hypercare, against a committed timeline and scope
  • Build and run the integrated program plan across Product, Engineering, Data, Clinical, and the customer’s own IT and operations teams; you own the critical path and everyone knows it
  • Run the operating cadence – weekly working sessions, executive steering, internal delivery reviews – and keep every one of them decision-oriented, not status theater.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and blockers relentlessly, and escalate early with a proposed answer rather than a problem statement
  • Own the go-live readiness process: cutover plans, rollback criteria, support handoffs, and the go/no-go call
  • Write the doc. Delivery plans, weekly status narratives, risk memos, retrospectives, and correction-of-error reviews that hold up in front of a CEO or a health system CIO

Technical – being the technical conscience of the program

  • Go deep on the integration architecture for every implementation: EHR connectivity, payer and clearinghouse feeds, API integrations, and the data pipelines underneath them
  • Lead technical design discussions with customer IT teams and our engineers; translate requirements into scoped, sequenced engineering work and push back when the ask doesn’t match the architecture
  • Own environment readiness across the customer’s stack and ours: data access, security reviews, VPN/SFTP/API connectivity, test data, and UAT
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to get through customer security questionnaires, HIPAA and SOC 2 reviews, and BAAs without slowing the program down
  • Surface where implementations keep hitting the same friction and turn it into product and platform requirements, so the next customer goes faster than the last one

Customer – being the face of Penguin from kickoff to go-live

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer program leadership through the implementation; you set expectations, hold them, and reset them honestly when the facts change
  • Present to customer executives, from VP Revenue Cycle to CIO and CMO, with the credibility to explain technical decisions and the judgment to know when not to
  • Manage change on the customer’s side: workflow redesign, end-user readiness, and adoption, because a technically perfect deployment nobody uses is a failure
  • Own the handoff to Customer Success and Support with a clean, documented picture of what was built, what was decided, and what’s still open

Scaling delivery – building the machine, not just running it

  • Build the reusable implementation playbook: templates, checklists, timelines, and gating criteria that turn our 60-day implementation into a repeatable system rather than a heroic one
  • Define delivery metrics (time-to-value, milestone adherence, defect escape rate, customer health) and instrument them so leadership sees delivery health without asking
  • Mentor and set the bar for the delivery function as it grows

What We're Looking For: Your TPM Arsenal!

  • 7+ years as a Technical Program Manager or equivalent at a top-tier technology company – Amazon/AWS, Google, Microsoft, Meta, or peers – where you owned large, cross-functional, customer-committed programs
  • Real technical depth: you’ve been a software engineer, solutions architect, or equivalent, or you’ve earned the standing to run design reviews with senior engineers. You read architecture diagrams, API specs, and data models fluently and can spot the gap
  • A track record of delivering enterprise customer implementations or launches with hard external commitments, ideally with health systems, payers, or other large regulated institutions
  • Genuine customer presence: you’ve been the primary technical contact for demanding enterprise customers and have run executive steering meetings that ended in decisions
  • Exceptional written communication. You can compress a messy program into a onepage narrative that a CEO can act on, and you write status that people actually read
  • Bias for action and ownership in the Amazon sense: you run toward the fire, you don’t wait for permission, and you finish what you start
  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace: you’ve operated where the plan changed weekly and still shipped

Bonus Points: Your Secret Weapons!

  • You’ve worked in revenue cycle, utilization management, or prior authorization and have seen what “denied” costs a provider
  • You’ve delivered AI or ML products into production for enterprise customers and understand what changes when the output isn’t deterministic
  • You’ve built a delivery function from scratch, not just operated inside one
  • You hold PMP, SAFe, or similar credentials, and you’d cheerfully trade all of them for one more on-time go-live
  • You’ve written a correction-of-error document that changed how a team works

The Culture Fit: Join Our Colony!

You'll waddle with us if:

  • You like your coffee with a side of delightful chaos
  • You're fuelled by complexity and obsessed with delivering amazing results
  • You want to deliver something that fundamentally matters, transforms healthcare and ultimately saves lives

Education & Qualifications: Brainiac Basics

  • A Bachelor's degree in a related field

Comp & Perks: Because Even Superheroes Need Support!

  • Competitive salary: We reward greatness!
  • Medical, vision, and dental coverage: Keep you healthy and smiling!
  • Generous vacation policy and company holidays: Recharge and conquer!
  • A front-row seat in one of healthcare's most exciting AI companies – witness history in the making!

The Senior Manager will lead a combined Security Engineering and Operations function for North America, overseeing vulnerability management, incident response, threat hunting, and hands-on security engineering. You will establish the managed vulnerability service engagement, define SLAs and remediation processes, and scale the team from unsustainable crisis-mode incident response to proactive threat management and strategic engineering. This role requires both operational discipline and technical credibility.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead and develop the Security Operations Engineer, Senior Security Engineer, and Security Engineers; build high-performing teams and coaching culture

  • CISSP, CISM, or CEH certification

Compensation and Benefits

The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

jobs.title: Pharma Contracting Lead
jobs.excerpt: Evio OverviewEvio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.
jobs.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation.  

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy– The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity – We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights – one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure – We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless – Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency – Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence – We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

Pharma Contracting Lead

About the role

Evio and the six health plans we represent are uniquely positioned in the market and have demonstrated success in creating innovative partnerships with pharmaceutical manufacturers. As the regulatory environment for health plans, PBMs/GPOs, and manufacturers rapidly evolves over the next several years, Evio is expanding our direct manufacturer contracting capabilities and growing the team supporting this work.

The Pharma Contracting Lead will contribute to the team by developing manufacturer relationships, negotiating innovative medication agreements, and driving deal flow and revenue in this growing business segment.

Evio focuses on entering into innovative agreements with pharmaceutical manufacturers that reduce medication costs for Evio's investor/customer health plans and their members.

The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of the pharmaceutical supply chain, payer-pharma contracting strategies, and a proven track record of developing, negotiating, and closing pharma-payer agreements. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strategic thinking, industry credibility, and a willingness to roll up their sleeves.

What you'll do

In this role, you will partner with senior Evio leaders and teammates to:

  • Establish and grow relationships with assigned pharmaceutical manufacturers across medical and pharmacy benefits.
  • Design creative deal structures for targeted medications, emphasizing innovative, non-rebate arrangements that improve access and affordability for Evio's health plan customers.
  • Negotiate and secure medical benefit access contracts with assigned pharmaceutical manufacturers that meet Evio's strategic and financial goals.
  • Manage the full deal cycle from origination through contract execution, coordinating with legal, operations, and other cross-functional teammates to resolve issues and maintain momentum.
  • Secure market-leading pricing, terms, and safeguards by leveraging the volume of Evio investor/customer health plans across high-spend specialty and provider-administered medications.
  • Represent Evio at industry meetings, conferences, and in discussions with pharmaceutical manufacturers and payer customers, including occasional live and virtual Evio board interactions.
  • Independently identify and advance new contracting opportunities, solve complex challenges, and drive deals forward in an evolving business.
  • Be willing to travel based on meeting requirements and business needs; however, a significant amount of deal creation and negotiation can be done virtually.

Your skills and experience

  • Industry experience: 10+ years of experience, with extensive experience either with a pharmaceutical manufacturer or in a pharma-facing role at a health plan or PBM.
  • Pharmaceutical supply chain expertise: Industry expertise in the full medication supply chain, spanning and medical benefits, specialty pharmacy, and distributor dynamics.
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Health plan pharmacy decision-making, including benefit design considerations, PBM dynamics, and provider-payer relationships.
    • Pharmacy and medical benefit claims data.
    • Pharmaceutical manufacturers' commercial strategies, including market access, patient services, distribution, HEOR, and sales and marketing.
  • Clinical and therapeutic considerations: Ability to incorporate clinical and therapeutic considerations into the design of pharma-payer deals, including product positioning within formularies and medical policies.
  • Financial modeling: Experience with financial structure modeling for payer-pharma deals.
  • Contracting expertise: Proven experience structuring and closing innovative pharma-payer contracts, with deep understanding of rebates, pricing and regulatory implications, formulary access, trade relations, and supply chain dynamics.
  • Commercial problem-solving: Strong strategic and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify opportunities, develop new solutions, and drive commercial results.
  • Executive communication and relationship building: Strong communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to build credibility and negotiate effectively with pharmaceutical executives and payer leadership.
  • Hands-on execution: Comfortable working hands-on, building new approaches, and driving execution without the large teams or established processes of a traditional pharmaceutical company or PBM.
  • Collaboration and adaptability: Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and navigate changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Salary considerations

Anticipated annual base pay range: $200,000 - $225,000 plus additional variable compensation.

At Evio, we’re committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract and retain top talent that is aligned with our culture, mission and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunities depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire. Evio also offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidate experience, and market and business considerations.

How we take care of you:

  • Great Health Insurance: The company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match: Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off: We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave: Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

We’ve recently learned of fraudulent job postings and individuals falsely claiming to represent Evio. Protecting our candidates is incredibly important to us, and we want to share a few reminders:
  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.
If you believe you’ve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance — we’re grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy notice Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

jobs.description:
About Cinnamon

Cinnamon is the most ambitious independent Roblox studio in the world.

Our games have generated billions of visits. LifeTogether (4+ billion). BlockSpin (1.3+ billion). BayView (600+ million). Built from scratch, owned outright and funded by their own success. No investors. Just great games.

We’re expanding our development teams and looking for an exceptional Lead Roblox Developer who combines hands-on technical ability with strong game design judgement.

Someone who can take responsibility for a game, build an enjoyable experience and lead a small team towards making it successful.

The Role

You’ll combine hands-on development, technical game design and team leadership to build Roblox games experienced by players worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who can decide what to build as well as how to build it. You should be comfortable taking an idea from an early prototype through development, release and ongoing improvement.

Depending on your experience, your responsibilities may include leading a development pod, taking ownership of a product or contributing across multiple projects. We’ll discuss the appropriate scope during recruitment.

On a small team, your work directly influences the finished game.

The mechanics you design, the systems you build and the standards you set will shape what players experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the development of Roblox games from initial concepts through release and ongoing updates

  • Design and build gameplay systems, mechanics and features using Roblox Studio and Luau

  • Create satisfying core loops, progression systems, economies and monetisation

  • Prototype quickly and iterate based on playtesting, player feedback and performance data

  • Set development priorities and coordinate the work of a small team

  • Collaborate closely with programmers, artists and other specialists

  • Take responsibility for the quality of gameplay, UI, audio and the overall presentation

  • Build readable, maintainable systems that other developers can understand and extend

  • Optimise performance across client and server

  • Debug and improve existing systems

  • Use AI tools to accelerate development while checking and improving their output

  • Contribute ideas that improve retention, engagement and the overall player experience

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong hands-on game development experience with clear examples of work you personally delivered

  • Strong technical game design skills and the ability to implement your own ideas

  • Proven experience shipping games or major gameplay systems

  • Experience taking meaningful responsibility for a game’s development and quality

  • Deep understanding of gameplay feel, player retention, progression systems and monetisation

  • Strong technical judgement and the ability to make architecture and gameplay decisions independently

  • Ability to rapidly prototype, iterate and polish gameplay based on testing and feedback

  • Experience leading developers or coordinating the work of a small development team

  • High standards for the complete player experience, including presentation and usability

  • Comfortable taking ownership of complex problems with minimal direction

  • Experience using AI tools in development and the ability to understand, assess and improve their output

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills within a small team

Experience with UI, audio, VFX, optimisation, tooling, LiveOps or large-scale Roblox experiences is highly valued.

Roblox Experience Matters

Strong Roblox Studio and Luau experience is highly valued.

We’re also open to exceptional developers from other game development backgrounds who combine technical ability with strong game design judgement.

You may be an experienced Roblox developer, an independent game creator, a technical designer or a hands-on development lead.

If you’re coming from another engine, show us your ability to design and build enjoyable games. You should have a clear interest in Roblox, an understanding of its audience and a willingness to work directly in Roblox Studio.

Roblox has its own technical constraints, player expectations and production culture. Successful games require more than technically correct code. Features need to feel immediate, understandable and satisfying while operating reliably at scale.

We want to understand your individual contribution to previous projects.

Tell us what you designed, what you built, which decisions you owned and how your work influenced the finished game.

Strong Developers Take Ownership

Writing code is only part of the job.

We’re looking for someone who can be given a problem rather than a detailed specification.

You should be comfortable deciding how a game or system should work, identifying problems before they become blockers and pushing back when you believe there’s a better solution.

You should also be able to give clear feedback, support other developers and recognise when something technically works but still isn’t enjoyable.

AI is central to how we work. We expect you to use it to accelerate development while understanding the code and systems it produces. You remain responsible for reviewing the output, fixing problems and maintaining quality across a shared codebase.

That means taking responsibility for what you build from the first prototype through release and beyond.

What matters is whether the game gets better.

Location and Working Arrangement

This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity.

We are open to:

  • Permanent employees who are already based in the UK and have the right to work here

  • Remote contractors based anywhere in the world

Working arrangements and time zone requirements will depend on the team and the scope of the role.

We do not provide visa sponsorship.

Please state your salary expectations or contractor rate, location, time zone and availability in your application.

Why Join Cinnamon?

At Cinnamon, you’ll have the opportunity to shape games from the beginning, take substantial creative and technical responsibility and see your decisions reach players.

We move significantly faster than traditional AAA development while maintaining high expectations for quality. We believe Roblox deserves the same ambition, creativity and craftsmanship as any major gaming platform.

We’ve never relied on investors to build Cinnamon. The studio is funded by the success of the games we’ve created, allowing us to grow through our own products.

You’ll work with a team that has experience building and operating successful Roblox games, alongside specialists who can support the development of your projects.

Our goal is simple: build some of the best games on Roblox.

We’re highly selective about who we work with because every individual directly influences the quality of what we create.

If you’re excited by combining hands-on development, game design and team leadership, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Get

  • Base salary or contractor compensation appropriate to your experience and responsibilities

  • Additional performance incentives, with the structure and terms discussed during recruitment

  • Remote working

  • Company pension for eligible UK permanent employees

  • Significant responsibility and autonomy

  • Direct influence on game design, development priorities and product quality

  • Opportunity to lead a small development team

  • Support from an established studio and its specialists

  • Opportunity to help create the next Roblox hit

Recruitment Process

1️⃣ Application review

We’ll review your experience, portfolio and individual contribution to previous projects. Please include examples of games you’ve worked on and explain what you personally designed, built or led.

2️⃣ Asynchronous introduction

If shortlisted, you’ll receive a video introducing Cinnamon, the role and how we work. We’ll ask you to submit a short video answering questions about your experience and approach.

3️⃣ Practical Roblox development task

Selected candidates will complete a focused development task. We’ll provide the brief, assessment criteria, submission requirements and timeframe before you begin.

We’ll assess game design, technical implementation and the overall player experience. AI tools are welcome. You should be able to explain your decisions and the work you submit.

4️⃣ Final discussion

If your assessment meets our standard, you’ll discuss the role’s scope, team setup, compensation and next steps with our Operations Manager and relevant team members.

🎉 If there’s a strong fit on both sides, we’ll move to a formal offer or contractor agreement.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Reporting

PRODUCT AND INDUSTRY FIT

  • Knowledge of utility-specific billing complexity, including smart meter programs, interval data processing, time-of-use pricing, settlements, regulatory requirements and customer affordability programs.
  • Knowledge of other event-based billing complexity, including convergent billing, subscription monetization, usage charging, roaming, partner settlements and digital service bundling.
  • Experience leading complex software sales pursuits, including qualification, opportunity shaping, executive workshops, solution demonstrations, commercial negotiations and contract closure.
  • Understanding of modern payment ecosystems, including direct debit, card processing, payment orchestration, digital wallets, open banking and customer payment experience optimization.
  • Ability to identify and qualify opportunities for AI-enabled billing transformation, including intelligent exception management, automated dispute resolution, payment recovery optimization and agent-driven customer engagement.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based software commercial models, including SaaS, subscription licensing, consumption-based pricing, implementation services and managed services offerings.
  • Ability to collaborate across product, engineering, implementation and partner teams to create winning pursuit strategies and deliver compelling client outcomes.

Travel may be required for role. 0-100% depending on client and business need.

Here's What You Need:


  • Minimum 8+ years of experience in enterprise software sales or a closely related commercial role.
  • Minimum 8+ years experience selling software solutions to large enterprises; familiarity with SaaS, license and managed service commercial models.

Professional Skills:

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Accounting Manager (AI-Native) to own the full accounting function for a fast-scaling premium food brand sold through major retail, the natural channel, and direct to consumer.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Accounting Manager (AI-Native) to own the full accounting function for a fast-scaling premium food brand sold through major retail, the natural channel, and direct to consumer. You will bring day-to-day accounting in house from an outside firm, run the monthly close end to end, own the general ledger and financial statements, and lead the company's deduction and chargeback recovery. This is a build-and-own role, not a maintenance seat.

This is also a genuinely technology-forward role. You will run the company's cloud finance stack, build dashboards and automated workflows, and use Claude every day to work faster and think more clearly. If you bring strong full-cycle depth, US GAAP experience, a CPG or food and beverage background, and real enthusiasm for using AI and automation to do finance better, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Own the entire accounting function of a fast-growing premium food brand with major retail and DTC distribution
  • Real room to grow as the company scales, up to running the whole system independently

What You'll Work On

Full-Cycle Accounting and Monthly Close

  • Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close on a proactive, tight calendar with no chasing and no surprises
  • Own AP, AR, bank and credit card reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, and intercompany entries
  • Keep an accurate, reconciled balance sheet and a clear, timely income statement with variance commentary management can act on
  • Work with the outside firm to internalize their work and steadily take full ownership

Inventory and Cost Accounting

  • Own inventory accounting for a physical-product food business: reconcile the ledger to what is actually in stock, and investigate and explain variances
  • Keep cost of goods clean and accurate, owning inventory valuation, costing, and adjustments for shrink, spoilage, damage, and timing differences
  • Partner with operations and the warehouse or 3PL on counts, cut-off, and the data behind inventory and margin
  • Build a repeatable, documented inventory reconciliation process the business can rely on every month

Revenue Recognition and Financial Statements

  • Apply US GAAP revenue recognition for CPG and FMCG including gross-to-net, trade spend, slotting, promotions, and returns so the top line is clean and defensible
  • Keep the books audit-ready and lender-ready at all times, backed by a clean audit trail that stands up to bank and lender scrutiny
  • Own audit prep and support external auditors and tax preparers

Deductions and Chargebacks

  • Own retail and distributor deductions and chargebacks end to end including shortages, MCBs, spoilage, and freight
  • Identify, document, validate, and dispute deductions, file at scale, track recovery, and lead the workflow that wins back cash that would otherwise be lost
  • Reach out to customers and distributors on AR, collections, and disputed deductions to resolve issues early and keep cash coming in

Cost Analysis and Savings

  • Analyze margin, COGS, vendor spend, and freight to find cost leaks and bring management specific, actionable ways to save without being asked
  • Manage cash reporting, AR aging, vendor terms, and inputs to forecasting and the line of credit

Compliance

  • Own sales tax, 1099s, and internal controls and keep the company diligence-ready as it raises capital

Cloud-Native and AI-First Ways of Working

  • Own and run the cloud finance stack including Xero and Airtable with disciplined, well-documented books
  • Build and maintain live dashboards and trackers for close status, AR aging, deductions and recovery, cash, inventory, and margin so the team sees the numbers without asking
  • Connect and automate across the ledger, banks, Airtable, deduction management, OCR, and settlement tools so data flows without manual re-keying
  • Use Claude daily to reconcile, categorize, draft dispute packages, and speed up analysis, and build repeatable documented processes around it, always checking the AI's work before it reaches the books

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 6 years of full-cycle accounting, including running a monthly close end to end and preparing financial statements you owned
  • Working command of US GAAP with experience supporting US-based companies
  • Hands-on inventory and cost accounting in a physical-product business, reconciling the ledger to stock and keeping cost of goods clean (CPG, food and beverage, or consumer goods preferred; retail, wholesale, or hospitality inventory also relevant)
  • Real, current fluency with AI in your accounting work. You should already use a tool like Claude day to day, or be able to clearly show you can get there fast and sanity-check everything it produces before it reaches the books
  • Able to build dashboards and automated workflows yourself, not just read reports someone else built
  • Strong with spreadsheets and cloud accounting, and comfortable owning and running a stack like Xero and Airtable, not just working inside it
  • Exposure to trade spend, deductions, and distributor or retailer chargeback disputes, or the ability to learn this quickly and run it across a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English with proactive communication across time zones
  • Flags issues early and closes loops without being asked

Nice to Have

  • CPA or local equivalent
  • Hands-on experience building automated accounting workflows with AI tools including Claude
  • Background supporting a high-growth or venture-backed consumer brand
  • Experience with natural channel distributors such as UNFI or KeHE
  • Prior experience bringing accounting in house from an outside firm

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your full-cycle accounting experience, and walking through a deduction or chargeback dispute process you owned or a close process you improved — including the tools, dashboards, or AI workflows you used

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a sharp, full-cycle accountant who can own the books end to end, recover cash through deduction management, and use AI and automation to run a finance function that punches above its weight, this role gives you the ownership and the room to grow to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or a related field
  • At least 5 years of full-cycle accounting including running a monthly close and preparing financial statements
  • Working command of US GAAP with experience supporting US-based companies
  • CPG, FMCG, food and beverage, or consumer goods experience
  • Strong with spreadsheets and cloud accounting and comfortable owning and running a stack like Xero and Airtable, not just working inside it
  • Comfortable using AI in your work or genuinely excited to get up to speed fast — you should be ready to use Claude every day and to sanity-check what it produces
  • Exposure to trade spend, deductions, and distributor or retailer chargeback disputes, or the ability to learn this quickly and run it across a distributed team
  • Excellent written and spoken English with proactive communication across time zones
  • Flags issues early and closes loops without being asked

jobs.title: Network Test Automation
jobs.excerpt: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a newly formed team working for a globally recognized networking leader on their flagship router product. The team’s mission is to build and enhance robust test automation and CI/CD pipelines, keeping the routing area healthy through continuous pre-commit testing: every pull request automatically triggers automated test suites on a large-scale CI/CD test orchestration platform, catching bugs before they reach the codebase.

Your work will focus heavily on designing, developing, and optimizing CI/CD test automation frameworks and test suites. You will automate provisioning, traffic generation, diagnostics, and regression testing using Python, pytest, PTF, sonic-mgmt, and Ansible. Additionally, you will own weekly regression runs and triage failures - from reading device and test logs, through distinguishing genuine product bugs from pipeline or environment issues, to raising well-documented defects.

The scale is significant: the platform executes hundreds of test suites and roughly a thousand test runs a day across pre-commit, nightly, and weekly pipelines. To keep triage fast at this scale, the workflow is supported by modern AI tooling - an AI-powered root cause analysis agent that turns hours of log digging into minutes, and collaboration bots that automatically pull the right people into dedicated spaces when a suite fails.

What else you should know:

  • The team is being formed right now - you will help shape how it works from day one

  • Support is also available from the DevOps and the Network team, as CodiLime engineers are responsible for developing and maintaining the CI/CD test orchestration platform

  • You will cooperate directly with the development and test engineers in a distributed, international environment (Europe, India, US)

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the team, will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining robust CI/CD test automation pipelines and test suites in Python for pre-commit PR testing and weekly regression runs

  • Automating environment provisioning, traffic generation, network diagnostics, and continuous regression testing across virtual and physical testbeds

  • Debugging failed runs - analyzing device, system, and test logs, distinguishing product bugs from test-suite or environment issues, and raising well-documented defects

  • Collaborating closely with development teams to understand the features they deliver and designing test coverage for those use cases

  • Extending test automation as new features are delivered in the Routing area

  • Leveraging AI tools (AI-assisted RCA, LLM coding assistants) to speed up scripting, log analysis, and root cause identification

  • Coordinating issue resolution with suite owners and dev/test engineers through dedicated collaboration channels

  • Managing physical and virtual testbed environments and provisioning resources for test execution

  • Identifying, analyzing, and resolving flaky tests to maintain high pipeline reliability

Do we have a match?

For success in this role, strong hands-on expertise in Python test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and network test tools is essential:

  • Strong Python programming skills and deep hands-on experience with pytest, PTF (Packet Test Framework), sonic-mgmt, and Ansible

  • Solid background in CI/CD engineering and automated test orchestration, focused on automating provisioning, traffic generation, diagnostics, and regression testing

  • Solid networking knowledge with a focus on routing (BGP, OSPF, routing tables, VRFs, Layer 3 concepts) and working with SONiC routers

  • Understanding of router concepts - overlay architecture, policies, IPsec tunnels (hands-on router experience is strongly preferred)

  • Proven debugging and troubleshooting skills: reading logs, CLI-level investigation, isolating root causes across product, test, and environment layers

  • Experience working closely with software development teams and translating delivered features into test scenarios

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in everyday engineering work

  • Experience with Docker

  • Good Linux command-line skills (shell scripting, command-line tools)

  • Good knowledge of English (B2+ level)

  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD platforms

jobs.description:
Über Stoïk

Stoïk schützt kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen in Europa vor Cyberrisiken. Der 2021 gegründete Cyberversicherer verbindet Cyberversicherung mit eigenen Sicherheitstools, Managed Services und einem internen Incident-Response-Team (CERT). So begleiten wir Unternehmen vor, während und nach einem Angriff. Unser CERT sieht täglich, welche Angriffe Unternehmen Geld kosten, und genau das prägt die Prävention, die wir entwickeln.

Unser Ziel: der CISO Europas zu werden.

  • 15.000+ geschützte Unternehmen in 7 europäischen Märkten

  • 2.000+ Maklerpartner

  • 300+ Sicherheitsvorfälle pro Monat, bearbeitet von unserem CERT

  • 200+ Mitarbeitende, unterstützt durch über 70 Mio. € von a16z, Alven und Munich Re

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust unseren neuen Vertriebskanal über MSPs (Managed Service Provider) und IT-Dienstleister in Deutschland aktiv mit auf

  • Du identifizierst, gewinnst und entwickelst strategische Partnerschaften mit MSPs als Multiplikatoren für unsere Cybersicherheitslösungen

  • Du positionierst Stoïk als bevorzugten Partner für IT-Dienstleister, die ihren Kunden ganzheitliche Cyber-Lösungen anbieten möchten

  • Du baust proaktiv langfristige Partnerschaften auf und beherrschst gleichzeitig unsere Partnerprozesse – strukturiert, verlässlich und mit Blick fürs Detail

  • Du begleitest MSP-Partner operativ im Tagesgeschäft, unterstützt bei Bedarf in Kundengesprächen und trägst zu einer hohen Abschlussquote bei

  • Du trackst Performance, Pipeline und KPIs strukturiert in unserem CRM (HubSpot) und leitest datengetriebene Optimierungen ab

  • Du bringst Marktfeedback aus dem MSP-Umfeld zurück ins Unternehmen und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Lösungen bei

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, Channel Sales oder Partnermanagement – idealerweise im Umfeld von IT-Dienstleistern, Cybersecurity oder Versicherungen

  • Verständnis für die Arbeitsweise und Geschäftsmodelle von MSPs / IT-Service-Providern

  • Freude daran, einen neuen Kanal von Grund auf mitzugestalten und strategisch aufzubauen

  • Unternehmerisches Mindset und die Fähigkeit, eigenständig Strukturen zu entwickeln

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene Arbeitsweise und Routine im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot)

  • Bereitschaft, dich fachlich tief in das Thema Cybersicherheit einzuarbeiten

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir dir

  • Die Chance, einen neuen strategischen Vertriebskanal maßgeblich mit aufzubauen

  • Remote-first-Arbeiten mit moderner Tool-Landschaft

  • Regelmäßige Teamtreffen, Offsites und internationales Umfeld

  • Kompetitives Gehalt mit attraktivem, performance-orientiertem Bonusmodell

  • Eine Kultur, die Geschwindigkeit, Ownership und unternehmerisches Denken fördert

Job Summary: Citizens Inc. is looking for someone who can review proofs of loss quickly, ensure claims are administered in accordance with policy provisions and the company’s practices and philosophy, and work well with others. This requires a detail-oriented mind set, critical thinker who is willing to take initiative and work consultatively with others. This person will work effectively and efficiently to meet expected turnaround times. We look for our claim analysts to be analytical and provide prompt, fair payment of all legitimate claims.

WHAT YOU WILL GET TO DO

Customer Service and Communication:

  • Answer and respond to inbound telephone inquiries from policy beneficiaries or their representatives and provide excellent service during their claims inquiries.
  • Correspond with agents, policyholders, hospitals, doctors, attorneys, beneficiaries, and claimants for information regarding the claim.
  • Correspond with customers for resolutions of concerns through outgoing calls or written communications.
  • Maintain communication with management regarding developments within areas of assigned responsibilities and perform special projects as required or requested.
  • Ability to develop and maintain positive working relationships with internal/external stakeholder.

Analytical and Decision-Making:

  • Review policy contracts and determine if coverage is applicable.
  • Review and prepare claims for processing, update claims information in the claims application.
  • Determine base payment by referring to policy coverage and limits, deciding on the course of action (payment, further investigation, or denial).
  • Assess, research, and correct claims discrepancies, collaborating with other team members as needed.

Administrative and Process Management:

  • Maintain claims information in the claims application.
  • Maintain the assigned follow-ups and pending inventory.
  • Process verifications and manage the verification inventory.
  • Maintain complete confidentiality of company business.
  • Participate in educational seminars, webinars, and local claims meetings.

Cross-Training and Skill Development:

  • Cross-train on various product processing within the claims department.
  • Approval limit will vary with experience level, including release authority up to a certain amount.
  1. Based on experience could be approved to release up to $1000 without secondary review
  2. Have release authority no more than $10,000

Performance Standards:

  • Ability to establish rapport and build relationships in a professional manner.
  • Ability to address issues/concerns in a professional manner.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment shaped by constant change and innovation.
  • Ability to balance prompt claim settlement against the need to be accurate in determining liability for each claim.
  • Comply with HIPAA and other privacy regulations.
  • Meet the minimum qualitative standards for a Domestic Claims Analyst I
    1. Financial accuracy: 99.5%
    2. Payment accuracy: 98%
    3. Procedural accuracy: 95%

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred. However, insurance related work experience and strong computer skills acceptable.
  • Courses in business, finance, economics and mathematics are particularly helpful.
  • Complete LOMA 1 & 2 (280 & 290) courses, Associate, Customer Service (ACS) designation and working toward the Associate, Life & Health Claims designation (ALHC).
  • Associate, Life & Health Claims (ALHC) and Associate, Life Management Institute (ALMI) certifications are necessary for advancement to a claims manager position.
  • Skill in Microsoft Office products
  • Excellent analytical, organizational and interpersonal skills
  • Well-developed written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong math and/or financial skills

Acuity Inc. is seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer to join our Engineering Team, helping drive the design and delivery of AWS cloud-scale data platforms for federal clients. Join Acuity, Inc., a technology consulting firm that supports federal agencies.
