  • Build and maintain scalable PySpark-based data pipelines in Databricks notebooks to support ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of structured and semi-structured data.

  • Design and implement Delta Lake tables optimized for ACID compliance, partition pruning, schema enforcement, and query performance across large datasets.

  • Develop ETL and ELT workflows that integrate multiple source systems into a centralized, query-optimized data warehouse architecture.

  • Leverage Spark SQL and DataFrame APIs to implement business rules, dimensional joins, and aggregation logic aligned to warehouse modeling best practices.

  • Collaborate with data architects and engineers to implement cloud-native data solutions on AWS using S3, Glue, RDS, and IAM for secure, scalable storage and access control.

  • Conduct technical discovery and mapping of legacy source systems, identifying required transformations and designing end-to-end data flows.

  • Implement governance practices including metadata tagging, data quality validation, audit logging, and lineage tracking using platform-native features and custom logic.

  • Support ad hoc data access requests, develop reusable data assets, and maintain shared notebooks that meet operational reporting and analytics needs across teams.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering and Agile analytics
  • 2+ years of experience creating software for retrieving, parsing and processing structured and unstructured data
  • 1 to 2 years of experience building scalable ETL and ELT workflows for reporting and analytics

  • BA or BS degree

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);

Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.

In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks.

Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.

Some examples of the projects you could work on:

  • Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
  • Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab
  • Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)
  • Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants
  • Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale
  • Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response
  • Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
  • Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
  • Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
  • Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
  • Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
  • Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
  • Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.

Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.

Required Skills/Abilities

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or evidence of further education strongly preferred.
  • 1–3 years' experience of relevant project management experience.
  • Experience working in an international or multicultural context is desirable.

Physical Requirements

  • Able to work remotely with minimal supervision.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Why this role matters

Engine is the travel and spend management platform transforming how businesses move. We're cash flow positive, scaling rapidly, and backed by Telescope Partners, Blackstone, and Permira — and our 2027 growth targets are the most ambitious we've ever set. The success of our two newest products, Omni & OBT, will make or break that plan.

Omni is Engine's lodging infrastructure: an API and supply platform that partner platforms embed to offer Engine's inventory to their own customers. OBT is Engine's infrastructure for travel management companies (TMCs): an online booking tool that TMCs run their business on. Together, they are how Engine scales, by distributing through other platforms.

That’s where you come in. These are new products sold into complex buying committees at large enterprises that are notoriously hard to reach. As our ABM lead, you’ll build the account-based strategy that gets Omni and OBT in front of the people who can say yes.

What you'll own

  • End-to-end ABM campaign execution: Full ownership of ABM programs for Engine's Omni & OBT products, spanning 1:1 and 1:few plays for our biggest and most complex deals, including targeting, personalization strategy, asset creation, channel orchestration, and pipeline reporting.
  • Creative asset production: Custom one pagers, landing pages, infographics, and account-specific content, built by you from concept to finished deliverable. Work with partner acquisition and growth leadership to align every asset to the accounts and deals that matter.
  • Paid ABM campaigns: Partner with performance marketing counterparts to build and optimize paid programs that surround entire buying committees, warming, converting, and nurturing target accounts. Own audience strategy, messaging, and the feedback loop between paid performance and account engagement.
  • Gifting and direct mail: Build and run a repeatable, predictable gifting and direct mail engine (Sendoso sends, dimensional mail, campaign-triggered gifting) with clear playbooks for when to deploy, who qualifies, and what it returns.
  • Account research: Develop org charts, buying committee maps, and research briefs that partner acquisition reps actually use in live deals. Turn intent signals, tech stack data, and public information into a sharp point of view on every priority account.
  • Pipeline accountability: Net-new pipeline influence and opportunity acceleration on Engine's highest-value deals, sourced or influenced by your programs. Deliver clean reporting to sales, growth, and executive leadership on what's working and what isn't.
  • Partner acquisition partnership: Tight alignment with partner acquisition and leadership on account targeting, campaign timing, and follow-up motion. At this deal size, every play is coordinated, not sprayed.

This team operates at the intersection of speed and rigor. You'll be expected to ship fast, learn faster, and help your team build the playbooks that turn one-off wins into repeatable programs. Some of the challenges you'll inherit:

  • The personalization tradeoff: True 1:1 personalization doesn't scale, and scaled campaigns feel generic. You'll build the systems, templates, and AI-assisted workflows that let Engine deliver deal-specific relevance across our most valuable accounts without weeks of turnaround per account.
  • The buying committee problem: Strategic deals are won across many stakeholders, not one champion. You'll make sure that by the time an AE reaches out, the whole committee has already seen Engine in their feed, their inbox, and their mailbox.
  • The asset bottleneck: AEs working seven-figure deals need custom one pagers, landing pages, and account research faster than any centralized creative process can deliver. You'll close that gap by producing high-quality assets and building repeatable systems.
  • The gifting machine: Direct mail and gifting work, but today they're ad hoc and unpredictable. You'll turn them into a programmatic engine with clear triggers, playbooks, and ROI math, so we know exactly when a gift moves a deal and when it doesn't.
  • Sales adoption: The best account research and campaign plays are worthless if AEs don't use them. You'll build enablement and feedback loops tight enough that partner acquisition reps pull ABM into their deals instead of marketing pushing it on them.

What you’ll bring

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Manager
jobs.excerpt: Crystalia Glass LLC is a U. S. -based manufacturer and provider of premium glass solutions, specializing in custom glass partitions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects.
jobs.description:
Crystalia Glass LLC is a U.S.-based manufacturer and provider of premium glass solutions, specializing in custom glass partitions for residential, commercial, and institutional projects. We operate a full-cycle model — from design and manufacturing to sales, delivery, and installation — with production facilities in the United States and Europe.

The U.S. market is our core focus. Crystalia Glass is a stable, scaling business, serving B2C, B2B, and B2G clients across multiple states. We combine strong product quality, competitive pricing, high service standards, and operational efficiency to set a benchmark within our industry.

We are strengthening our commercial function and are looking for a Sales Enablement Manager to own the quality of sales execution across the full funnel, from first contact and needs discovery to closing and order handover.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Sales Enablement Manager will diagnose why deals are lost, coach sales teams, build and adapt sales standards and CRM stage logic, and embed AI into everyday sales work. Success depends on driving adoption across sales teams and measuring real change in sales representatives’ behavior and conversion.

Employment Type:

- Full-time 8.30 am - 5 pm, NY (EST zone).

- Remote work.

- B2B contract (sole proprietorship status or corporate entity).


Key responsibilities:

Analyze performance

  • Review won, lost and stalled deals across funnel stages, matching calls and messages against CRM history and using AI to flag missed questions, weak arguments, unhandled objections and missing next steps.
  • Assess each sales stage (discovery, qualification, value presentation, objection handling, negotiation, closing and follow-up), including how scripts are adapted to the client and whether call goals are achieved.
  • Identify root causes of performance gaps (skills, knowledge, process or tools) and recommend targeted fixes.

Develop the team

  • Run one-to-one and team call and deal reviews, role-plays (including AI-simulated buyers and objections), live call observation and product knowledge checks.
  • Build individual development plans and coach sales representatives on specific sales behaviors.
  • Coach team leads to apply shared quality criteria in daily work with their teams.

Track results

  • Track whether new behaviors and AI workflows are applied in real deals and how they affect conversion, deal outcomes and time spent.

Standards and CRM

  • Audit existing sales standards for gaps, contradictions and requirements that don’t help the sale.
  • Write and update sales standards: scripts, objection guides, follow-up rules, contact quality criteria and product instructions, as well as CRM stage rules — the goal, entry and exit criteria, required data, sales representative actions and next steps for each stage, ownership at handover, and SLAs agreed with the process owner (response time, working hours, exceptions and escalation).
  • Pilot and roll out new standards: incorporate feedback from sales representatives and team leads, agree commercial rules with sales leadership, write requirements for CRM fields, prompts, notifications, reports and automation, take part in acceptance testing, and train sales representatives after changes.
  • Monitor adherence to standards in the CRM: overdue tasks, missing next steps, unconfirmed stage moves, missing loss reasons and handover quality.

AI in sales work

  • Build reusable AI workflows for sales representatives and team leads (call and meeting preparation, meeting summaries, follow-up messages, discovery question planning and checking proposals against client and product data), train sales teams to use them, observe real usage and fix errors.
  • Work with AI agents and bots; maintain instructions, templates and knowledge-base materials.
  • Use AI to help sales representatives plan next steps in the CRM, making sure they review every AI-drafted message or data update before it goes to a client or changes key deal information.

Build enablement assets

  • Build and maintain the team skills map, call and deal scorecard, prioritized list of loss reasons and a library of examples and exercises.

Requirements

  • Experience in sales enablement, sales coaching or sales development in a comparable market, with personal responsibility for identifying gaps in sales representatives’ performance.
  • Experience with a complex physical product with a long sales cycle, ideally in architectural glass, interior systems or a related field.
  • Deep understanding of the full B2B/B2C sales cycle, including negotiation, closing and repeat sales.
  • Strong understanding of both phone sales and in-person sales in a showroom.
  • Strong call and deal review skills: specific feedback, structured practice and verification that skills transfer to real work; experience coaching team leads to apply shared quality criteria.
  • Experience writing sales standards and driving their adoption through team leads and sales representatives, without direct authority over the sales team; clear and concise writing; strong team player.
  • Confident CRM use at the level of funnel, stages, tasks, ownership, SLAs and data quality; ability to write change requirements.
  • Proven, hands-on use of AI in sales work, with at least one implemented workflow showing a clear task, data, personal contribution, users and result. Fluent with AI tools, structured instructions, files and knowledge bases, and able to train others to use them; experience with any specific AI product is not required.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to measure the impact of new tools and processes with before/after comparison, compare conversion rates on a like-for-like basis (same funnel stage, period and lead sources), recognize when there is too little data for a reliable conclusion, and be clear about what the numbers do and do not prove.
  • Fluent English (C1/C2).

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based bonuses.
  • Full ownership of the sales enablement function in a fast-growing U.S. company, with the freedom to build it the right way.
  • Direct influence on how the sales team sells, with results visible in conversion and deal outcomes.
  • Hands-on work with AI in real sales processes, not pilots that stay on paper.
  • Joining a highly professional and dynamic team.
  • Exciting experience working with prestigious clients in the US market.

NVIDIA's invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Our products are used to build and parallelize the most meaningful scientific applications in the world for weather modeling, climatology, fluid dynamics and defense. We support real science and scientists throughout the world.

We are now looking for a Compiler Engineering Manager! NVIDIA’s HPC Compiler team is looking to hire a Compiler Engineering Manager to join the team building one of the world's most important optimizing compiler products. Your work will support development of compilers for high-performance computing and drive the underlying technology that powers GPU code generation for Python, C++, Fortran, OpenACC and OpenMP. Do you love the inherent challenges of complex software projects and driving systemic improvements in compiler performance and development methodologies? Are you self-motivated and a comfortable in a fast-paced team? Being a compiler engineering manager requires both traditional software management skills and a dedication to the success of our end users. We are looking for a manager to lead teams working on compiling Python, C++, and Fortran HPC applications, measuring performance, and charting the journey to speed-of-light execution. If you want to drive innovative compiler development in high-performance computing, then we want you!

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing a team of experienced compiler and performance engineers

  • Establish team objectives to meet schedules and goals.

  • Act as a mentor and advisor to grow our next generation of leaders.

  • Establish and evolve policies and procedures that affect the immediate organization.

  • Communicate with senior management for team vision and development.

What we need to see:

  • Degree in Computer Science, ECE or equivalent experience; (Ph.D. or Masters preferred)

  • A software engineer with 10+ overall years of experience with at least 4+ years of hands-on management

  • Strong software design fundamentals and a deep understanding of compilers and programming languages

  • Knowledge of software engineering principles

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Contributing to LLVM or other open source projects

  • Familiarity with GPU code generation, OpenMP, and OpenACC standards

  • Knowledge of compiler internals from front end to run-time environment

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Job Description

Research Associate II, Patient Centered Research - Evidera


Research Associate II, Patient Centered Research, PCR Academy


At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Location/Division Specific Information

Evidera’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group combines a unique portfolio of scientific fields, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, and other. Our work has helped identify and clarify unmet clinical needs, assess burden of illness and evaluate patient outcomes, preference and/or adherence, while supporting promotional and labeling claims on a global scale.

Discover Impactful Work:

The Research Associate II independently completes basic project management tasks (financial management, timelines, client correspondence); requires senior supervision for more advanced and complex tasks (protocol and report development, statistical analysis). Assists with authorship of client deliverables.

A day in the Life:

Science

  • Independently prepares proposal drafts, protocol drafts, and reports/summaries. Can summarize quantitative and qualitative analysis results for projects.
  • Conducts literature reviews and tables data from articles.
  • Responsible for data collection, especially qualitative data including conducting cognitive interviews and co-moderating or moderating focus groups.
  • Understands the basic elements of psychometric analysis.
  • Performs data management, including data entry and review.
  • Conducts data analysis, including preparing qualitative code book, performing coding, and reviewing quantitative data tables.
  • Maintains familiarity with current scientific literature. May co-author presentations for scientific conferences and manuscripts for scientific journals.

Project Management

  • Oversees and conducts site recruitment, site management, site training, and data management.
  • Efficiently delegates and communicates within/outside of project team, and communicates regularly with senior members (i.e. principal investigator) about project tasks. Responsible for overseeing the project budget, routinely checking PDR and achievement reports, approving and tracking subcontractor and possibly client invoices, and maintaining the project checkbook.
  • Able to track timelines and keep project team informed in order to complete work within the expected timeframe.
  • Communicates regularly with senior project team members (i.e. principal investigator) about project budget and timelines
  • Oversees and manage IRB submission procedures, electronic and paper filing, SOP requirements, business office practices, etc.
  • Travel 10-30 % of the time.

Financial & Business Development

  • Able to communicate effectively with clients.
  • No specific proposal writing goal for this level, though individuals may choose to work on selected proposals if interested

PCR Operations Support

  • Manage and present internal scientific trainings, and attends trainings led by colleagues
  • May attend scientific conferences for professional development/training
  • Conforms to SOPs and other Evidera trainings

Keys to Success:

Education and Experience

  • MA/MS/ with More than two years of experience or BA/BS/ with More than three years of experience (or equivalent thereof in outcomes research/ clinical trial execution/human subject’s research).
  • MS Word, PPT, Excel; Endnote, Pubmed/Embase, ATLAS.ti, ability to use Access with interface provided.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Knowledge of fundamentals of health outcomes/human subjects research principles and good clinical practices.
  • Practical knowledge of research project implementation.
  • Demonstrates: good communication skills, strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work well within a team environment.
  • Knowledge of practical research implementation (IRB process, data collection and management, familiar with qualitative and quantitative analysis)
  • Demonstrates ability to work well within diverse project teams
  • Well-developed communication skills and scientific writing skills, as demonstrated by peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, or other scholarly work
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Collaborative team member, capable of efficient multi-tasking

Physical Requirements / Work Environment

  • Normal and routine office duties.
  • May require domestic and international travel.

Benefits

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

*only shortlisted candidates will be contacted


#Evidera


Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today!

Bugcrowd helps security teams move faster by identifying the exposures that matter most so they can act first and stay ahead of attackers. By combining the power of humans and AI, teams can preempt attack paths and prevent breaches. Based in San Francisco and New Hampshire, Bugcrowd is supported by General Catalyst, Rally Ventures, Costanoa Ventures, and others. Visit .

Job Summary

The Manager, Security Operations is responsible for leading a team of Security Consultants while ensuring the timely and accurate triage, validation, and resolution of security submissions. This role requires a strong technical foundation in application security, incident response, and vulnerability assessment, combined with proven people leadership skills. The ideal candidate is an experienced security professional who excels at developing team members, driving operational excellence, improving processes through data and automation, and partnering cross-functionally to deliver exceptional outcomes for customers.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Security Consultants through regular feedback, career development, and performance management.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one security specialty (web, network, cloud, or mobile) and provide technical guidance to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrate expertise across all vulnerability submission types and support complex escalations and appeals, partnering with other business units as needed.
  • Drive operational excellence by measuring team performance, identifying opportunities for automation, and implementing process improvements.
  • Plan, prioritize, and manage team workloads while adapting to changing business needs and customer priorities.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to the growth of the broader security organization through knowledge sharing and technical leadership.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships to improve workflows and deliver high-quality customer outcomes.
  • Lead effective meetings, clearly communicate priorities, and ensure timely execution of action items.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to leadership and customers by providing sound technical judgment and operational insight.
  • Stay current on security industry standards, emerging threats, and best practices to continuously improve team capabilities.

Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Operations, Application Security, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, or a related field.
  • Previous experience leading, supervising, or mentoring technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of common vulnerability classes, including the OWASP Top 10.
  • Experience with incident response, vulnerability triage, and validation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • OSCP or a comparable security certification, or equivalent hands-on offensive security or vulnerability research experience.
  • Experience using Python to automate workflows or process operational data.
  • Experience using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools to create dashboards and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Demonstrated success implementing operational improvements through metrics, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

Language

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Most entry-level roles fill your time and allow you to earn a minimum amount. This one builds something more!

If you enjoy connecting with people, understanding what matters to them, and improving with every conversation, this is your entry point into sales. You’ll gain confidence on the phone, learn how to guide meaningful conversations, and see your effort translate directly into results.

No door knocking. No cold calling. Just thoughtful conversations with people who have already taken the first step! You'll have flexibility to work the way you work best - either fully remote or with hybrid connection and training in our local Orem office. As one of our customer-facing voices, your work is instrumental to our continued growth.

What You’ll Do (and Why You’ll Love Doing It)

As an Appointment Setting Specialist with Precoa (Remote or Hybrid), you will follow up with warm leads who have already expressed interest in preplanning. You’ll set client appointments to meet with a local professional to craft an intentional plan and gain peace of mind. And, you’ll also grow your ability to communicate, influence, and create momentum in a conversation!

In this role you can:

  • Launch an impactful career: You’ll develop your sales skills and level up through ongoing training and professional development so you can benefit now and in the future.
  • Enjoy a full-time rhythm with room to breathe: A consistent schedule (remote or hybrid) so you can build a career and still balance life outside of work.
  • Champion needed solutions: You’ll be provided warm leads who are interested in the recession-resistant product that you are selling.
  • Enjoy a stable base + unlimited bonuses: You control what you make with the security of base pay and the excitement of bonuses based on your efforts!

Are you ready to start building experience that pays off?

Requirements

If you have these skills, we want to talk with you!

  • Interest in sales
  • Demonstrated common sense, compassion, and empathy, on the phone and with colleagues
  • Ability to work a hybrid schedule - preference for those who can periodically work in office in our Orem, Utah location.
  • Comfortability with PC operations, software and video conferencing
  • Ability to type notes effectively
  • Experience with CRM systems a bonus!

Benefits

What we offer you as part of #PrecoaLife

  • Full-time schedule (40/hr/week) with consistency to balance work and life
  • Competitive hourly salary with unlimited monthly bonuses
  • Fully remote or hybrid option
  • A dynamic, fun and engaging in-office culture including phenomenal training, ping pong, snacks and genuinely kind and caring co-workers
  • Pathways to advance within the team as you grow your skills

About Precoa

At Precoa, our people are the heart of our success. Core Employees strive to live our values of kindness, progression, and craftsmanship every day — bringing emotional intelligence, common sense, positivity, and authentic connection to everything they do.

If you love solving challenges, building real relationships, and driving meaningful results, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re a national leader in the preneed industry. Our passion is helping people plan today so their families can focus on connection when they need it most. Recognized as a Top Workplace for 15 consecutive years, we’re committed to creating a place where you can live a fulfilling life, do meaningful work, grow your potential, and enjoy the journey along the way.

Headquartered in Portland, OR, with a satellite office in Utah, we’re a team driven to make a difference — every day, through every connection.

jobs.title: Assistant Controller
jobs.excerpt: Privia Health is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Assistant Controller to join our accounting team.
jobs.description:
Privia Health is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented Assistant Controller to join our accounting team. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, this key leadership role will be instrumental in scaling our financial operations, strengthening internal controls (SOX), driving key accounting workflows, and leading finance system transformations. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of public accounting and public company experience, with expertise in U.S. GAAP, audit readiness, and leading remote teams.

Primary Job Duties:

Financial Operations & Close Management

  • Direct month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close routines to ensure accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements and reconciliations.
  • Oversee the review of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and supporting schedules across business units.
  • Partner with FP&A on budget-to-actual variance analyses and operational reporting to deliver actionable insights.
  • Lead financial integration activities for mergers and acquisitions (M&A) to ensure seamless onboarding and accounting alignment.
  • Direct or assist with specialized initiatives and projects as needed, demonstrating strong project management capabilities and a focus on enhancing operational processes.

•Technical Accounting, SEC Reporting & Governance

  • Provide technical accounting guidance on complex transactions, including purchase accounting (ASC 805), revenue recognition (ASC 606), leases (ASC 842), and new accounting standards.
  • Oversee the preparation of supporting accounting data, reconciliations, schedules, and technical input for SEC filings (Forms 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K) prepared by the Financial Reporting team.
  • Maintain and monitor the company’s internal controls framework to ensure full SOX 404 compliance.
  • Serve as a key liaison for external auditors, managing audit schedules, requests, and issue resolution.

•Systems, Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Serve as the functional finance lead for the upcoming ERP transition, assisting with chart of accounts design, data migration, user acceptance testing (UAT), and workflow design.
  • Identify and execute automation opportunities across existing financial software to streamline close cycles and operational routines.

•Treasury Operations

  • Support operational treasury functions, including banking relationships, electronic fund transfers (ACH/wires), account structure administration, and positive pay management.

•Team Leadership & Development

  • Manage, mentor, and foster accountability across a fully remote accounting team.
  • Establish clear performance goals to foster continuous development and cross-functional alignment.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
• Certification: Certified Public Accountant (CPA) preferred
• Experience: 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, combining public accounting (Big 4 or large regional preferred) and public company environment experience.
• Background in healthcare, physician practice management, or health-tech environments preferred.
• Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of U.S. GAAP, SOX 404 compliance, internal controls design, and the management of internal and external audit engagements.
• Leadership: Proven track record of hiring, managing, and developing remote accounting professionals.
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively across executive leadership, IT, HR, and external auditors.
• Systems: Experience with Workday Financials and/or Microsoft Dynamics highly preferred.
• Specialized Skills: Direct experience with enterprise ERP implementations, income tax provision oversight, or corporate treasury operations highly preferred.

The salary range for this role is $150,000.00-$175,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs). This role is also eligible for an annual bonus targeted at 15%. The base pay offered will be determined based on relevant factors such as experience, education, and geographic location.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

﻿Technical Requirements (for remote workers only, not applicable for onsite/in office work):

In order to successfully work remotely, supporting our patients and providers, we require a minimum of 5 MBPS for Download Speed and 3 MBPS for the Upload Speed. This should be acquired prior to the start of your employment. The best measure of your internet speed is to use online speed tests like . This gives you an update as to how fast data transfer is with your internet connection and if it meets the minimum speed requirements. Work with your internet provider if you have questions about your connection. Employees who regularly work from home offices are eligible for expense reimbursement to offset this cost.

Privia Health is committed to creating and fostering a work environment that allows and encourages you to bring your whole self to work. We understand that healthcare is local and we are better when our people are a reflection of the communities that we serve. Our goal is to encourage people to pursue all opportunities regardless of their age, color, national origin, physical or mental (dis)ability, race, religion, gender, sex, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law.

Privia Health™ is a technology-driven, national physician enablement company that collaborates with medical groups, health plans, and health systems to optimize physician practices, improve patient experiences, and reward doctors for delivering high-value care in both in-person and virtual settings. The Privia Platform is led by top industry talent and exceptional physician leadership, and consists of scalable operations and end-to-end, cloud-based technology that reduces unnecessary healthcare costs, achieves better outcomes, and improves the health of patients and the well-being of providers.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Spain. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Spain.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the technical workflows behind vehicle crash simulations. Analyzing crash data and debugging simulation models are critical steps in automotive safety engineering. We want to understand how current automated result analysis methodologies are performing in the field.

How It Works

You will participate in a remote interview to discuss your day-to-day simulation workflows. We will ask you to walk us through a recent time you debugged a complex vehicle crash simulation. You will also review a few concepts for automated result analysis and share your professional feedback. The session requires a stable internet connection and a quiet environment for the video call.

Who This Is For

We are looking for automotive engineers who specialize in crash simulation and structural analysis. We welcome CAE engineers, crash simulation analysts, automotive safety engineers, and structural analysts. Candidates should have hands-on experience with simulation debugging and result analysis methodologies.

What You'll Do

  • Walk us through your typical vehicle crash simulation workflow.

  • Describe a recent time you debugged a complex simulation model.

  • Evaluate concepts for automated result analysis methodologies.

  • Share feedback on the tools you use for structural analysis.

Who Should Apply

  • Professional experience in automotive engineering or vehicle safety.

  • Hands-on expertise with crash simulation workflows.

  • Familiarity with simulation debugging and result analysis.

  • Comfortable discussing technical methodologies over a video call.

$126 per hour

jobs.excerpt: Remote, international · Independent contractor · Paid in USD · For experienced sales professionals and anyone ready to start in tech sales Represent well-known brands and fast-growing startups to sharpen the phone skills AI can't replace, and earn uncapped commission in USD on your own schedule.
jobs.description:
Remote, international · Independent contractor · Paid in USD · For experienced sales professionals and anyone ready to start in tech sales

Represent well-known brands and fast-growing startups to sharpen the phone skills AI can't replace, and earn uncapped commission in USD on your own schedule.

At Sellfire, our mission is to help sales professionals build great careers in a world of AI. Whether you're an experienced rep or just getting started, this role is built to help you earn more and grow faster.

What you'll do

  • Make live outbound calls for fast-growing B2B tech companies, reaching gatekeepers and decision-makers

  • Use Sellfire's AI-enabled platform. It handles lead lists, call prep, dialing and coaching insights, so your time goes into real conversations

  • Book qualified meetings for our customers' sales teams

  • Get call-by-call feedback and coaching from Logic-Based Selling, our proven calling methodology

Why reps choose Sellfire

  • Earn real money. You're paid in USD for results: commission for every qualified meeting you set that the prospect attends. The better you get, the more you make.

  • Control your hours. Work any hours you choose between 8 AM and 9 PM US Eastern Time, Monday to Friday. Work around other commitments. You decide how much you work. No shifts and no minimum schedule.

  • Choose your accounts. Pick which customer programs you call for.

  • Work with brands that are going places. You'll call on behalf of well-known brands and fast-growing startups. That's real experience with venture-backed startups and brands hiring managers recognize.

  • Build a track record US companies recognize. Experience selling into the US market for venture-backed tech companies stands out. You'll build real numbers like dials, connects and meetings booked.

  • Train like a pro before you dial. Learn through short video lessons, test what you know with quizzes, and practice live calls with AI prospects that act like real gatekeepers and decision-makers.

Grow your sales career

In tech, the SDR (sales development rep) role is the foundation of a sales career. Many of today's top account executives, sales leaders and founders started there. A typical path looks like this:

  • SDR / BDR. Open conversations, qualify prospects and book meetings. This is the work you'll do here.

  • Account Executive. Run demos, manage deals and close revenue, often after a year or two as an SDR.

  • Senior AE, Sales Manager or Sales Leader. Bigger deals, a team of your own, or a seat in leadership.

Whether you're new to sales or already have experience, this role gives you hands-on US B2B experience, daily coaching, and results you can point to.

Why build a career in sales

  • High earning potential. Sales pay is tied directly to results, so strong performers can out-earn their peers early in their careers.

  • Fast, merit-based growth. Your numbers speak for themselves, so promotions come from performance, not tenure.

  • Skills that transfer anywhere. Persuasion, listening, resilience and handling objections help in any job, or in starting your own company.

  • Demand in every industry. Every company needs revenue, so good salespeople are needed everywhere.

  • A path to leadership and entrepreneurship. Many founders and executives got their start in sales.

  • Skills AI can't easily replace. As AI takes over routine work, the ability to build trust in a live conversation becomes more valuable.

Who we're looking for

  • Based outside the United States

  • Strong spoken English. You'll be calling business owners and decision-makers in the US

  • Students, recent grads, and anyone with extra time ready to start a sales career

  • Experienced sales professionals (SDR, BDR, inside sales, call center or telesales) who want to earn uncapped commission selling into the US

  • Experience calling US customers is a plus

Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Backend Software Engineer in our CARE - AI Engine team in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

We build AI-powered backend services that put LLMs in front of real users. We need a senior engineer who can ship them and keep them reliable, observable, and fast in production.

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Backend Software Engineer on the AI Engine team, you will:

  • Design and ship AI-powered features end to end. You own quality, latency, and cost.
  • Build backend services and APIs that hold up under real load.
  • Instrument what you ship, watch the numbers, fix what's wrong.
  • Review code and designs critically. Push back when something doesn't add up.
  • Help taking prompt, retrieval, and agent changes from experiment to production.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Strong communicator, written and verbal, with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Critical thinker. You question assumptions instead of nodding along.
  • No ego. Comfortable saying "I don't know" and going to find out.
  • Proactive. You notice things that should be better and fix them without being asked.
  • Collaborative across product, design, data science, and engineering.

WHAT YOU NEED

  • Strong Python and a track record of shipping and operating production backends.
  • Solid AWS, including serverless (Lambda).
  • SQL and NoSQL (DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Postgres). you understand access patterns and where things fall over.
  • APIs you've actually designed, integrated, and monitored in production.
  • Event-driven systems (Kafka, SQS).
  • Production observability: metrics, logs, traces, alerts (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Comfort with distributed systems and loosely-scoped problems.

BONUS POINTS

  • Strong SQL and some data pipeline experience (e.g., Airflow).
  • Experience with LLM-based systems in production. Evaluation, prompts, retrieval, agentic workflows.
  • AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).
  • Kotlin, Go, or Java for cross-team work.

We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that experience working with Kotlin, Golang, or Java, microservices, and distributed systems are mandatory requirements.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhuband LinkedIn!

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

Tech Stack

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.excerpt: We’re hiring someone to lead our sales team.  Not a fundraiser, and not someone who manages a book of LPs: a sales leader who builds a team that wins sophisticated buyers and keeps winning them.
jobs.description:
We’re hiring someone to lead our sales team. Not a fundraiser, and not someone who manages a book of LPs: a sales leader who builds a team that wins sophisticated buyers and keeps winning them.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

What your team sells
Your team matches our clients’ raises with the investors who fit them. Each associate holds a book of investor members and client companies. They learn what every investor is looking for, pitch the right company at the right moment, and turn that interest into founder meetings. It’s relationship-led, long-cycle business development with some of the most demanding buyers there are. Done well, it compounds. Send one deal that doesn’t fit, and an investor stops reading.

The role
This is a sales leadership role first. You’ll run six associates and report directly to both founders.
Most of running a sales team is unglamorous, and that’s the part that matters. When conversion dipped on one of our teams, more leads didn’t fix it. Daily standups, weekly reviews of real call recordings and coaching time spent on the people who needed it did. We want someone who already works that way.

What you’ll own

  • The rhythm: a Monday kickoff on priorities and targets, weekly 1:1s with every associate, live call coaching, and a Friday review of every win and loss.

  • The numbers: discovery calls, new investors onboarded, pitches, founder meetings and referrals, reported weekly to both founders.

  • Conversion: turning investor interest into founder meetings, and finding out why when it doesn’t happen.

  • Your team: hiring, onboarding and growing every associate.

  • The standard: every introduction your team sends is one you’d put your own name on.

  • Senior calls: when a call needs someone senior in the room, that’s you. You’ll also work closely with client success, so every client’s raise keeps moving.

Who we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in sales or business development, including leading a team, ideally of five or more people. You can tell us what they achieved and who you grew.

  • You’ve hired people, coached them and, when it came to it, let them go.

  • You’ve sold to sophisticated buyers: institutions, investors, or wealth and financial services clients.

  • You’ve worked with family offices or VCs, whether selling to them, working alongside them or raising from them yourself. You know how they decide.

  • You run a team on numbers, and you know the difference between activity and progress.

  • AI tooling and a clean CRM handle your admin, so your hours go to people.

What you get
A heavily performance-weighted package: a base salary plus a direct share of your team’s commissions, with no cap on the upside. On-target earnings of US$200K to US$300K when the team performs well. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A team that is already working, a direct line to both founders, and a seat where the companies defining the future meet the capital that backs them.

How to apply
Hit apply. The form is short and we read every application. Please don’t name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.

Compensation: $200K – $300K OTE, uncapped

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical auditing, regulatory compliance, quality systems, and inspection readiness could help artificial intelligence better understand compliance risks, regulatory expectations, and audit best practices?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced Regulatory Compliance Auditors who can apply their auditing expertise, compliance knowledge, and industry experience to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional auditing position. You won't be conducting supplier audits, preparing organizations for regulatory inspections, or managing compliance programs. Instead, you'll evaluate complex compliance and audit-related content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Regulatory Compliance Auditor Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze auditing, quality, manufacturing, compliance, supplier oversight, and inspection-readiness scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in regulatory requirements, audit principles, and pharmaceutical industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely

jobs.excerpt: Maximus is looking for a Lead Growth Product Manager.
jobs.description:
Maximus is looking for a Lead Growth Product Manager.

Company: Maximus | Location: Remote (US) | Reports to: Head of Product | Type: Full-time

About Maximus

Maximus () is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability and 8-figure ARR with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

About the Role

This is a growth role with real surface area and real resources behind it.

You get a dedicated engineering pod, an embedded designer, a marketing team spending a meaningful budget you'll partner with daily, and direct access to leadership. You will own the conversion product — the get-started flow, eligibility and questionnaire experience, plan selection, payment methods, and checkout — across Testosterone, Weight Loss, and every protocol we launch. You'll play a critical role in executing strategies around organic growth, referral programs, abandonment reclamation, and average order value.

This role spans several growth domains at once, with the autonomy to sequence them yourself, budget for the AI and experimentation tooling you need, and a real voice in how we build it. We expect this role to operate AI-first — using it to compress the cycle from idea to live test and to ship more experiments than a team our size otherwise could.

We're looking for someone who has run this before at a DTC subscription business at a meaningful scale. Someone with a powerful voice and a game plan that is centered around data and buyer psychology. You'll set the testing agenda, uphold the fundamentals across every flow we own, and iterate well past market par.

You will report to the Head of Product and lead a dedicated engineering pod aligned to our Acquisition task force. This is a senior IC role with full ownership of the conversion and organic growth roadmap.

What You'll Do

The conversion product

  • The get-started flow, eligibility and questionnaire experience, plan selection, payment methods, and checkout across every protocol

  • The acquisition product roadmap — the sequenced bets that ladder up to our growth objectives — built in close partnership with Marketing

  • Distinct strategies by service line. What wins in Testosterone is not what wins in GLP-1: different personas, different objections, different economics

  • Pricing strategy executed downstream in the funnel, with latitude to propose and run your own promotions

AOV and the economics behind it

  • Average order value through the mechanics at the point of purchase: plan mix and ordering, longer-duration adoption, add-on attach, bundle presentation

  • The commercial case for your work — you should be able to bring Finance a test proposal, a budget ask, and clear success criteria, and defend all three

Experimentation and the platform

  • The testing roadmap and cadence, brief through readout, held to a real evidence standard

  • The case for the funnel, experimentation and analytics stack we invest in. This role shapes the platform, it doesn't inherit it

Organic growth and reclamation

  • Organic net-new customer growth, the referral program, and cart and flow abandonment reclamation — as products, not campaigns

  • Continuity with Marketing so the journey holds together end to end: the claim in the ad matches the landing page, which matches what a prospect sees in the flow, carrying their context forward rather than starting from scratch


What You'll Bring

The things that will separate a strong candidate here:

  • You've moved AOV or plan mix, not just conversion rate. Plenty of growth PMs optimize CVR. Far fewer have changed what a customer commits to at the moment of purchase

  • You've scaled paid spend and watched blended conversion dilute as traffic got colder — and you know how to read cohort-level signal instead of chasing a blended number down

  • You've made an offer or pricing recommendation that leadership adopted, and you can walk through the economics you used to make the case

  • You build your own measurement. You write your own queries, you're fluent in Amplitude, and you've stood up instrumentation rather than inherited a dashboard

  • You're subscription-aware. You know a cheap customer who churns in month two isn't a win, and you've designed acquisition with retention in view

  • You've killed an idea you believed in because the data didn't support it, and you can tell that story without flinching

Plus the baseline:

  • 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 owning a consumer conversion funnel with direct revenue accountability at meaningful paid spend

  • Fluency with modern funnel and AI tooling, and a real opinion on how to compress the cycle from idea to live test

  • Excellent written communication; our culture runs on clear documents and explicit tradeoffs

  • Nice to have: telehealth, regulated consumer, or another high-consideration category where eligibility or compliance shapes the funnel

Who You Are

You have strong opinions about funnels and you hold them loosely when the data disagrees. You're comfortable owning a number leadership watches weekly. You'd rather run six well-designed tests this quarter than one perfect one. You know the difference between a growth hack and a growth system, and you're building the second.

Relentlessly resourceful. Highly proactive, doesn't quit, finds solutions with little guidance. Strong bias for action and comfort in ambiguity with a high degree of autonomy.

Passion for men's health and development. Genuine interest in helping men develop a healthy masculinity, and personal investment in health optimization — diet, exercise, sleep, focus, relationships.

World-Class Benefits

  • Full Suite: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Liquidity of options whenever available

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Compensation Range: $150K - $225K
