Location: Primarily remote, anywhere in the US. Regular travel to client communities and team gatherings.
Comp: 160-190K Base + Participation in our warrant program


About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. Our platform delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering healthcare providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

In senior living, Teton helps care teams spot fall risk before it becomes a fall, and alerts staff immediately when a fall does occur.

The Role

As Teton's Director of Customer Success, US, you'll make sure every senior living community we serve gets real results from Teton: fewer falls, faster response, care levels and care revenue that match residents' needs, and care teams that trust and use Teton every day. Our customers don't buy features; they buy outcomes. You'll lead the team that takes ownership of making them happen.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership leadership role. You'll be in the work with your team and our customers, while helping set the strategy for how US Customer Success delivers outcomes at scale as we grow. You'll lead and grow our team of US Customer Success Managers, partner closely with Account Management, Clinical, Deployment and Product, and be a peer to our UK & EU Customer Success Director.

The role reports to the VP of Customer Experience.

What You'll Own

Customer outcomes across the US portfolio

  • Make outcomes the measure of success at every community: fewer falls, faster response, timely care assessments, and care revenue that reflects the care delivered.

  • Make sure every operator can see the value of Teton in their own data.

  • Step in personally where communities aren't getting results.

A high-performing CSM team

  • Hire, develop and retain CSMs who know the product deeply, lead with insight, and own their communities' results.

  • Set a clear, high standard for how we engage customers, and hold the team to it.

  • Scale the team as we grow, with small, customer-aligned pods led by player-coaches who still carry customers.

  • Roll out and evolve CS career paths, so every CSM knows how to grow.

Customer health and retention

  • Own customer health across the US portfolio: catch risk early and act on it.

  • Partner with Account Management, who own renewals and expansion, so every renewal is backed by proven outcomes.

Change management with care teams

  • Help operators build Teton into how their teams work, from daily routines to care planning, so adoption lasts.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with the Clinical Solutions Lead on clinical credibility with nursing leaders and clinical playbooks.

  • Partner with Deployment on clean handoffs from go-live to steady state.

  • Bring a clear, consolidated voice of the customer to Product.

How Success Is Measured

Targets are set with your manager and reviewed quarterly.

  • Customer outcomes: measurable results at every community.

  • Customer health: a healthy, engaged portfolio.

  • Retention: strong customer retention, in partnership with Account Management.

  • Customer experience: customers who find Teton easy to work with, trust us as a partner, and see us as essential to how they deliver care.

  • Team: a high-performing, engaged team.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Proven Customer Success leadership, including building and leading CSM teams.

  • Experience leading Customer Success for complex, multi-site customers in a high-growth B2B company.

  • A track record of measurable customer outcomes and retention, not just activity.

  • Strong data fluency: you use health, usage and outcome data to run the business and coach your team.

  • Executive presence with operator leadership, and the credibility to lead hard conversations.

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up: you've built and led through ambiguity, changing priorities and rapid growth, and you thrive in it.

Preferred

  • Healthcare technology experience, ideally in senior living, post-acute or long-term care.

  • Experience leading clinical or operational change in care settings.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, and modern collaboration tools.

Mindset

  • Outcome-driven: you measure success by what changes for residents, staff and operators, not by what the team produced.

  • Radical ownership: when an outcome doesn't happen, your first question is what we could have done differently.

  • Hands-on and strategic: you set direction and roll up your sleeves.

  • Builder's mindset: you create structure where there isn't any, move fast, and adjust as you learn, without waiting for a perfect playbook.

  • Sharp, professional and results-driven.

  • Curious about AI, computer vision, and how new technology lands on the floor.

Location

Primarly remote, anywhere in the US. Regular travel to client communities and team gatherings.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • 401(k) plan, paid time off, and health insurance.

We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged, it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer, AI Email App
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Technical Lead, Applications, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing
jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The LICDC is responsible for conducting Biopsychosocial assessments and evaluations for individuals experiencing substance use disorders. This role involves utilizing clinical expertise to identify client needs, develop individualized treatment plans, and provide recommendations for appropriate care. The LICDC Assessor collaborates with a multidisciplinary team to ensure holistic, client-centered treatment approaches.

  • Clinical Assessment:
    Conduct in-depth clinical assessments to evaluate the nature and severity of substance use and co-occurring disorders. Utilize structured interviews, evidence-based tools, and collateral information to inform diagnosis and care planning.

Identify and document readiness for discharge, anticipated supports, and continued care needs to ensure a smooth transition from services.

Report any necessary compliance concerns for all service lines to the Navita Quality department.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-functional Safety Management Team (SMT) meetings and provide safety guidance and input to key documents, including Investigator Brochures (IBs), informed consent forms (ICFs), protocols, study reports, regulatory reports, and regulatory responses.
  • Contribute to signal detection, monitoring, evaluation, interpretation, escalation, and communication of safety information through established safety governance processes.
  • Maintain ongoing monitoring and assessment of safety profiles for assigned investigational and marketed products, supporting continuous benefit-risk evaluation.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Development, Regulatory Affairs, Biostatistics, Data Management, and other functions. Represent PVRM on cross-functional teams and at partner safety meetings, including Joint Safety Forums (JSFs) and Pharmacovigilance Committee (PVC) meetings, as applicable.
  • Review adverse event reports, including serious cases, to support appropriate interpretation, consistency, and quality across individual case and aggregate safety assessments; support Analysis of Similar Events as needed.
  • Review relevant clinical coding, including reactions, suspect/concomitant products, indications, laboratory data, and medical history, and support preparation and review of Investigator Brochures, protocols, informed consent documents, clinical study reports, and other safety-related documents.
  • Facilitate early identification and escalation of safety issues through established safety governance processes. Serve as SMT Chair or Quorum member as assigned.
  • Serve as a PVRM subject matter expert in the review of study protocols, interim clinical trial reports, clinical study reports, safety summary documents, and responses to regulatory requests.
  • Support preparation and presentation of individual case safety issues; conduct aggregate safety data analyses and interpretation; contribute to submission documents, including ISS and SCS, and support development of risk-mitigation strategies.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of safety and risk-management documents, including Risk Management Plans (RMPs), Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategies (REMS), and expectedness guides, as applicable.
  • Work collaboratively with PVRM and cross-functional team members to manage the benefit-risk profile of assigned products and support patient safety.
  • Review literature search strategies and literature monitoring activities, with vendor support, and ensure relevant information is incorporated into signal detection and evaluation activities.
  • Participate in and lead assigned aggregate safety report activities, including data compilation, analysis, interpretation, and preparation or review of assigned sections, with vendor support as applicable.
  • Coordinate responses to ad hoc safety issues and requests from regulatory authorities, study sites, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders in collaboration with appropriate medical and cross-functional colleagues.
  • Serve as a PVRM subject matter expert for assigned programs and contribute expertise across R&D and Commercial functions.
  • Develop or contribute to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions, and other controlled PVRM documents, as assigned.
  • Contribute to departmental and cross-functional inspection readiness, quality, compliance, and operational improvement initiatives.
  • Support PVRM and cross-functional projects requiring safety input, promote compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal procedures, and foster a Patient First culture consistent with SMPA values.

Key Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of pharmacovigilance, drug safety, benefit-risk assessment, and global safety requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience with signal detection, evaluation, and safety data analysis.
  • Experience preparing and/or contributing to aggregate safety reports, regulatory submissions, and responses to regulatory authorities, including FDA and EMA and/or other global health authorities.
  • Ability to interpret clinical and safety data and communicate safety findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional and matrixed environment.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across organizational and geographic boundaries.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high-quality work with minimal supervision.
  • Demonstrated leadership and project-management capabilities.

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a healthcare, life science, or related scientific field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant pharmacovigilance, drug safety, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry experience.
  • Relevant experience in clinical development safety, signal management, aggregate reporting, and/or benefit-risk assessment preferred.
  • Prior experience leading cross-functional activities, programs, or projects strongly preferred.
  • Prior experience in oncology and/or neurology preferred.
  • Comprehensive understanding of applicable FDA and EU pharmacovigilance requirements and GCP/GVP/ICH safety guidelines for investigational and marketed products.

Travel Requirements:

Primarily remote role with periodic on-site meetings in office. Must be able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.



Mental/Physical Requirements:

Fast-paced environment handling multiple demands is involved. Must be able to exercise appropriate judgment as necessary. Requires a high level of initiative and independence. Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Requires ability to use a personal computer for extended periods of time.

Base salary is part of our total rewards package which also includes the opportunity for merit-based salary increases, short incentive plan participation, eligibility for our 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances and leaves provided in line with your work state. jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Datavail is hiring a Senior Data Architect to lead the design and delivery of modern data platforms for our clients
  • You will own the architecture of client engagements from discovery through production, with a primary focus on Microsoft Fabric and the Azure data ecosystem
  • You will define target-state architectures, build the data models that underpin them, and establish the SDLC and DevOps practices that let client teams operate and extend what we deliver
  • This is a client-facing role
  • You will work directly with business stakeholders, client IT and security teams, and Datavail delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers, often across several engagements at once

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture and solution design
  • Lead discovery and current-state assessments of client data estates, including sources, integrations, platforms, data quality, security posture and operating model
  • Define target-state and transition architectures for analytics, data warehousing, Lakehouse, real-time and operational data workloads
  • Produce architecture deliverables: solution architecture documents, logical and physical architecture diagrams, architecture decision records (ADRs), non-functional requirements and capacity plans
  • Evaluate platform and build-versus-buy trade-offs across Fabric, Databricks, Azure Synapse Analytics and Azure SQL, and present recommendations with cost, risk and effort clearly stated
  • Apply the Azure Well-Architected Framework (reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency) and the Cloud Adoption Framework's cloud-scale analytics guidance to every design
  • Design for scale and multi-domain ownership, including data mesh and hub-and-spoke patterns where they fit the client's organization
  • Plan and lead migrations from on-premises SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS and legacy data warehouses, and from Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools, to Fabric and Azure
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, maintain reference architectures and standards, manage exceptions, and track technical debt
    Microsoft Fabric and Azure platform
  • Architect end-to-end Fabric solutions across OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Spark notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence (Eventstream, Eventhouse, KQL) and Power BI
  • Design OneLake strategy: workspace and domain structure, shortcuts to ADLS Gen2 and external storage, database mirroring, and medallion (bronze/silver/gold) layering on Delta Lake
  • Size and govern Fabric capacities (F SKUs), including workload isolation, capacity monitoring, throttling behavior and cost management
  • Forecast consumption, set budgets and tagging/showback standards, monitor unit economics, and optimize cloud/Fabric spend
  • Design Power BI semantic models for performance and scale, including Direct Lake, Import and DirectQuery storage modes, composite models, incremental refresh, and row-level and object-level security
  • Integrate Fabric with the wider Azure estate: ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory, Databricks and Unity Catalog, Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Azure Functions and Azure Machine Learning
  • Design network and identity controls: Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities and service principals, Azure Key Vault, private endpoints and Private Link, managed virtual networks and workspace-level access
  • Data modeling
  • Own conceptual, logical and physical data models for client solutions, from business glossary through to deployed schemas
  • Apply the right modeling approach for each layer: Kimball dimensional modeling (star schemas, conformed dimensions, bus matrix, slowly changing dimensions Types 1, 2 and 6), Data Vault 2.0 (hubs, links, satellites) for integration layers, and normalized 3NF models for operational and master data
  • Design canonical and enterprise data models, master and reference data structures, and entity resolution approaches
  • Define naming standards, data type conventions, key strategies (surrogate, natural, hash), and partitioning and file layout for Delta tables
  • Maintain models in a modeling tool (erwin Data Modeler, ER/Studio, SqlDBM or equivalent) and keep them in version control alongside code
  • SDLC and DevOps
  • Establish the delivery lifecycle for data workloads: environment strategy (dev, test, prod), branching and pull request standards, code review, release management and rollback
  • Implement Fabric Git integration with Azure DevOps or GitHub, Fabric deployment pipelines, and automated deployment using the Fabric REST APIs and the fabric-cicd library
  • Build CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Pipelines and GitHub Actions for Fabric items, Azure Data Factory, Databricks (Asset Bundles), SQL database projects (DACPAC/sqlpackage) and Power BI (PBIP/TMDL)
  • Define infrastructure as code with Bicep and Terraform for Azure resources, identities and networking
  • Embed automated testing: unit tests for transformations, data quality and contract tests, schema-drift detection, and regression testing of semantic models
  • Define DataOps practices for observability, alerting, lineage, pipeline SLAs and incident response, and hand them over with runbooks
  • Define support models, SLAs/SLOs, escalation paths, training, documentation, and handoff criteria
  • Work within Agile delivery (Scrum or Kanban) using Azure Boards or Jira, including backlog refinement, estimation and sprint planning
  • Set standards for AI-assisted development with GitHub Copilot and AI coding agents across design, code, testing and documentation, including review and quality guardrails
  • Data governance and security
  • Design governance frameworks aligned to DAMA-DMBOK, covering data ownership and stewardship, metadata, data quality, lifecycle and retention
  • Implement Microsoft Purview for data catalog, lineage, classification and sensitivity labels across Fabric and Azure sources
  • Design least-privilege security models using Fabric workspace roles, item permissions, OneLake security, and row-, column- and object-level security
  • Ensure solutions meet client regulatory obligations such as HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, GDPR and CCPA, working with client compliance and security teams
  • Establish responsible AI and AI governance aligned to the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the EU AI Act and Microsoft's Responsible AI Standard, including approved model use, data access policies for AI, and human oversight
  • Design security controls for AI workloads, covering prompt injection, data exfiltration through agents, content filtering with Azure AI Content Safety, and Microsoft Purview data security for AI
  • AI and machine learning enablement
  • Design data foundations that support AI and machine learning: curated feature data, data quality controls and governed access for model training and inference
  • Architect solutions that use Azure Machine Learning, Fabric Data Science and Azure OpenAI, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over enterprise data with Azure AI Search
  • Prepare client data estates and semantic models for Copilot in Fabric and Power BI
  • Design Fabric IQ solutions, including ontologies that define business entities, relationships, rules and data bindings to lakehouses, eventhouses and Power BI semantic models, and Fabric data agents for conversational Q&A over ontology-grounded data
    Model knowledge graphs for multi-hop reasoning over connected enterprise data, using Graph in Fabric and other graph technologies where appropriate
  • Architect agentic solutions with Microsoft Foundry and Foundry IQ, using knowledge sources and knowledge bases that ground agents in both unstructured content and structured Fabric data
  • Define where AI agents and models sit in the overall platform, including when to use Fabric, Foundry or Databricks, and how agents access governed data through APIs, tools and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
  • Design GenAIOps practices: evaluation of response quality and groundedness, tracing and observability, prompt and model versioning, and monitoring of token usage and cost
  • Plan AI cost and capacity, including model selection, provisioned versus pay-as-you-go deployments, and the impact of AI workloads on Fabric and Databricks compute
  • Consulting, pre-sales and delivery
  • Support pre-sales: lead technical discovery calls, shape solution approaches, build effort estimates and contribute to proposals and statements of work (SOWs), including scope, assumptions, deliverables and acceptance criteria
  • Fulfill the technical lead role on client engagements: own the technical approach and architecture standards, keep delivery aligned to scope and budget, serve as the primary technical contact for client teams, and raise risks and change requests early
  • Review implementation against approved designs, conduct readiness reviews, and provide production sign-off
  • Present architecture and recommendations to audiences from engineers to C-level executives, in writing and in person
  • Identify follow-on opportunities and contribute to account growth based on client needs
  • Develop solution accelerators and Datavail intellectual property (IP), such as reference architectures, reusable frameworks, deployment templates and packaged offerings, that speed up delivery and differentiate the practice
  • Stay ahead of innovation across Microsoft Fabric, Azure and the wider data and AI market: evaluate preview and newly released capabilities, build proofs of concept, and turn what works into practice guidance and client recommendations
  • Convert recurring patterns, decisions, and lessons learned into reusable Datavail intellectual property—including architecture blueprints, decision frameworks, assessment tools, checklists, templates, and accelerators—while protecting client confidentiality
  • Leadership and mentoring
  • Lead technical delivery teams of data engineers, analytics engineers and BI developers on client engagements
  • Mentor team members through design reviews, code reviews, pairing and certification guidance
    Contribute to hiring, interviewing and onboarding for the Data & Analytics practice

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing or analytics, including 5+ years in a data or solution architect role
  • 3+ years designing and delivering data solutions on Azure, and hands-on delivery experience with Microsoft Fabric in production
  • End-to-end architecture ownership of at least two enterprise-scale data platform implementations
  • Expert-level dimensional modeling skills and working knowledge of Data Vault 2.0 and normalized modeling
  • Advanced SQL (T-SQL and Spark SQL) and working proficiency in Python/PySpark. Working knowledge of DAX and KQL
  • Practical experience implementing CI/CD, Git-based workflows and infrastructure as code for data platforms
  • Experience in a professional services, consulting or client-facing delivery environment, including pre-sales and estimation

  • Ability to travel up to 25% to client sites

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

About Nerdio

At Nerdio, our mission is to simplify the lives of IT professionals and maximize their Microsoft cloud and end user computing investments.

We support organizations of all sizes looking to deploy, manage, and cost-optimize native Microsoft technologies. We partner with Enterprises and Managed Service Providers all over the world to add value on top of their existing native Microsoft investments like Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365, and Microsoft Intune.

Created in 2016, Nerdio has always taken a market-leading and collaborative approach to cloud deployment and management. In fact, our product roadmap is greatly influenced by the regular feedback we receive from having seen companies deploy AVD into production environments several thousand times using Nerdio technology.

Today, Nerdio is used in over 50 countries by more than 15,000 organizations of every size and vertical. We’re committed to delivering exceptional service and support, which starts with identifying and supporting the best staff possible.

We are a fast-moving, nimble company looking for individuals who are collaborative, empathetic, driven and who love to move at the speed of light. If you want to be part of the AVD transformation that Microsoft and Nerdio are leading, then we want to speak with you.

About the role

Nerdio is hiring a Digital Program Manager to orchestrate the scaled customer experience across Customer Success. You will own the automated journeys end to end, and act as an internal consultant to the rest of the CS organization: finding friction in the customer journey and removing it with automation and agentic AI.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Digital Customer Success and work alongside the Pooled CS team, but your reach is wider: the plays you build are designed for reuse across Customer Success, so customers get one seamless experience no matter who owns the moment. This is a builder role with no named book of business. You bring the ownership and customer-first urgency of a CAM or TAM to cross-functional programs, and you are comfortable bringing structure to ambiguity.

What you'll do

Orchestrate the scaled customer experience

  • Own the digital journey from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion readiness. Build, launch, monitor, and iterate the plays and automations at each stage.
  • Build the triggers and handoffs that bring in a CAM or TAM at the right moment (health thresholds, renewal risk, expansion signals, escalations, champion changes, customer requests), following the coverage model set by the strategy lead.
  • Deliver against the current and future-state journey maps owned by the strategy lead. Surface the friction points you find in the data and in the field, and close them so the experience feels the same regardless of who owns the moment.

Act as an internal consultant to Customer Success

  • Lead discovery with CS teams: ticket analysis, stakeholder interviews, and data review to find where manual, repetitive, or inconsistent work hurts customers or burns CAM/TAM capacity.
  • Recommend and build the fix: automation, signal-based triggers, and agentic AI. Give teams plays they can turn on today.

Lead agentic AI and automation

  • Move the program from static plays to adaptive, agentic journeys for higher-complexity moments, such as personalized onboarding and automated EBR/TVR one-pagers.
  • Equip CAMs and TAMs with agentic insights that make their jobs easier and return capacity to them.
  • Evaluate tools, run pilots, and set guardrails so AI-driven touches are accurate, on-brand, and hand off to a human when one is needed.

Run the program and the partnerships

  • Own program and project management from discovery to launch to iteration: scope, plan, sequence, and keep a current view of the roadmap, status, and dependencies.
  • Partner with Marketing on every lifecycle communication, RevOps on segmentation and metrics, Product on telemetry and in-app messaging, Support on ticket signals, and Sales on expansion.
  • Prove impact. Tie each play to NRR, adoption, and risk reduction, run test-and-learn cycles, and share results broadly.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital customer success, lifecycle or adoption marketing, CS operations, or program management for a scaled customer segment.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional programs from idea to launch and influencing partners without direct authority.
  • A consultative approach: you can run discovery, facilitate working sessions, and turn what you hear into a prioritized plan.
  • Hands-on experience with CS, marketing automation, or CRM platforms, and the ability to build or configure automated journeys.
  • Practical experience with, or strong curiosity about, AI agents and LLM-based workflows, and sound judgment on where AI should and should not act.
  • Data fluency: you use product telemetry, health scores, and attribution to choose what to build and show what worked.
  • Strong prioritization, risk management, and written and verbal communication for audiences from CAMs to executives.
  • A builder mentality and comfort with ambiguity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cloud, or the Microsoft and MSP ecosystem.
  • Experience with Partner Success or Support operations.
  • Hands-on use of no-code or low-code agent builders and prompt design.

  • Competitive Base and Incentive Plan
  • Stock Options
  • Health and Welfare Plans*
  • Life and Disability Plans*
  • Retirement Plan*
  • Unlimited Flexible Paid Time Off, including your birthday off!

jobs.excerpt: We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.
jobs.description:
We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.

For over 50 years, we've been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life-cycle - offshore and on land.

We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions.

Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves - all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency.

With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.

The Role & Responsibilities

The role will be responsible for taking technical ownership of key workstreams on EnerMech's Azure Databricks data platform, operating across the full platform stack: data modelling and pipeline development in Databricks, the underlying Azure infrastructure, and the CI/CD, DevOps and DataOps practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and scalable.

The role holder operates with a high degree of autonomy, makes and documents architectural decisions, resolves complex platform issues, and is a technical point of contact for the global EBS Team, and business stakeholders.

This is a fully remote role in the UK,supporting our Enterprise Business Systems (EBS) function in the Mumbai Shared Service Centre.

Key reponsibilities will include:

    • Design, build, quality and reliable operation of assigned workstreams on the Azure Databricks data platform, from scoping through to production deployment.
    • Integrity of the medallion data model (bronze/silver/gold) for assigned data domains, ensuring data is modelled, validated, documented and certified for downstream reporting and analytics.
    • Build and optimise Delta tables and materialized views, with attention to performance at scale.
    • Design and implement data quality frameworks (preferably DQX or equivalent), including quarantine/error handling and validation against data contracts.
    • Define job-specific compute configurations appropriate to each workload, balancing performance and cost.
    • Contribute to and troubleshoot Terraform-managed infrastructure (networking, storage, Key Vaults, Managed DevOps Pools, Dev Centers).
    • Own and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines, variable groups/libraries, and repository security, permissions and branch policies.
    • Support environment-level Azure configuration, including subscription-level access, RBAC for user and pipeline (service principal) identities, and Terraform state backend management across multiple storage accounts and environments.
    • Operate autonomously across a workstream, from scoping through to production deployment.
    • Use AI-assisted tooling to support day-to-day development, validating outputs against authoritative sources (architecture decisions, technical leads, documentation) before acting on them.
    • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including across time zones with colleagues in the UK, Americas, Middle East and Asia Pacific.

The Requirements

Essential

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 6+ years in data engineering, including 3+ years hands-on with Azure Databricks in production.
  • Demonstrated ownership of medallion architecture design and data modelling.
  • Implemented data quality frameworks and data contracts in production.
  • Implemented PII protection (masking, tokenisation or access tiering) across environments.
  • Platform engineering experience: diagnosing infrastructure issues, not just consuming platform services.
  • Track record of autonomous delivery, including direct stakeholder engagement.
  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate (minimum).

Desirable

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
  • Microsoft AZ-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions.
  • Multi-environment Azure networking (VNet peering, DNS zone design, NAT Gateway).
  • Migrating or standing up CI/CD pipelines, incl. introducing pipeline templates/standards.
  • Governance and identity patterns (e.g. Entra ID, RBAC scoping).
  • Applying regulatory frameworks (e.g. GDPR) to data platform design.
  • Shared service centre or global delivery model experience, ideally in energy or industrial services.

jobs.description:
About the role

Pave Bank is a digital bank built for businesses that operate globally, with a client base concentrated in digital asset trading venues, payment providers, stablecoin issuers and fintechs. Our Commercial team owns the client relationship from first conversation through to ongoing revenue growth.

We are looking for a Data Analyst who will sit inside the Commercial team and turn client, transaction and pipeline data into decisions. This is not a reporting role where you wait for requests and return a spreadsheet. You will build the dashboards, the models and the internal tools that the Commercial team uses every day, and you will ship them yourself.

We expect you to work with AI as a default part of how you build. If you currently do everything by hand and see AI tooling as optional, this role will not suit you.

What you will do

Commercial analytics

  • Analyse client revenue, transaction volumes, payment corridors and product usage to show where growth is actually coming from

  • Build and maintain client profitability and unit economics models, including fee income, correspondent costs and FX spreads

  • Track pipeline health, conversion rates, time to onboard and time to first transaction, and explain the movements behind the numbers

  • Identify at risk clients through changes in activity patterns, and identify cross sell and upsell opportunities across the book

  • Support pricing decisions with evidence, including scenario modelling for fee changes and volume tiers

  • Prepare data for board, investor and management reporting, and be able to defend every number in it

Dashboards and reporting

  • Design and own the the Commercial team's dashboard layer, covering revenue, pipeline, client activity and product adoption

  • Move the team away from manual spreadsheets towards live, self serve reporting that people actually open

  • Define metrics clearly and consistently, and document them so the definitions do not drift between teams

  • Work with Operations, Finance, Compliance and Product to make sure the underlying data is trustworthy

Tooling and automation

  • Build internal tools that solve real Commercial problems, for example client scoring, pricing calculators, lead enrichment, reporting automation and data quality checks

  • Deploy and host those tools on Google Cloud, and keep them running

  • Automate recurring manual work in the Commercial workflow instead of absorbing it

  • Write clean, documented, maintainable code that someone else on the team can pick up

AI adoption

  • Use Claude Code and similar agentic tools as your primary build environment for analysis, tooling and automation

  • Build AI assisted workflows into Commercial processes, for example summarising client interactions, drafting first pass commercial documents and structuring unstructured data

  • Set the standard for AI usage inside the Commercial team, share what works, and help colleagues adopt it

  • Apply good judgement on where AI output needs human verification, particularly for anything client facing or regulatory

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Minimum 3 years in an analytical role, ideally in fintech, payments, banking or a data heavy commercial environment

  • Strong SQL, comfortable writing complex queries against large transaction datasets without hand holding

  • Python for analysis and for building small applications and services

  • Hands on experience with Google Cloud, including deploying and hosting an application, for example Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, App Engine, BigQuery, Cloud Scheduler

  • Demonstrated experience building dashboards in a modern BI tool, for example Looker Studio, Metabase, Tableau or Power BI

  • Practical, daily use of AI coding tools. You should be able to walk us through something you built with Claude Code or an equivalent agent, and explain what you delegated and what you reviewed yourself

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills, including modelling and Google Sheets automation

  • Strong commercial instinct. You care about why the number moved, not only what it is

  • Fluent professional English, written and spoken, is mandatory. Our working language is English and you will present analysis directly to senior stakeholders and clients. Georgian is an advantage but not a substitute

Nice to have

  • Understanding of payments mechanics, including SWIFT, SEPA, correspondent banking, card scheme settlement or stablecoin flows

  • Experience with dbt, Airflow or similar transformation and orchestration tooling

  • Familiarity with CRM data models and pipeline analytics

  • Front end skills sufficient to build a usable interface, for example React or Streamlit

  • Exposure to digital assets or a regulated banking environment

How we work

  • Small team, wide scope. You will own your work end to end rather than hand specifications to someone else

  • AI first by default. We expect meaningful output volume from a small headcount, and AI tooling is how we get there

  • Direct access to decision makers. Good analysis changes what we do, quickly

  • Bias to shipping. A working tool used by the team beats a perfect design nobody uses

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings.Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.

About the Role

As a Senior or Staff Full Stack Software Engineer at Trase, you will build and support software for Red Cell Federal (RCF), Red Cell Partners (RCP), and RCP incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, delivering user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt Trase OS and build secure AI applications for their missions.

This is a hands-on role with ownership from requirements through production support. You will work directly with partner engineers, Product, the dedicated TPM and DevOps/SRE engineers, Trase Platform Engineering, and GRC to deliver working solutions across the frontend, backend, and integration layers.

The level will reflect your experience and demonstrated scope. Senior engineers will independently own complex features and partner integrations end to end. Staff engineers will also lead architecture across engagements, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor engineers.

Why this Role is Needed

RCF and RCP companies need software that works within their applications, security controls, and deployment environments. Success requires intuitive user experiences, reliable APIs and agent workflows, clear audit trails, and dependable integrations.

You will close partner-specific functionality gaps, diagnose issues across application and platform boundaries, and deliver small, validated increments. You will also turn recurring partner needs into reusable improvements with Trase's platform team.

What You'll Do

  • Build full-stack features for RCF/RCP partners, from responsive UI interfaces and administrative tools to backend services, data models, and production integrations.
  • Work directly with partner engineers and Product to clarify use cases, reproduce issues, define acceptance criteria, and deliver small increments. Surface scope, dependencies, and risks with the TPM before committing dates.
  • Integrate partner applications and agents with Trase OS APIs and SDKs, external APIs, MCP tools, and model-provider endpoints. Provide working examples and clear integration documentation.
  • Build reliable agent and workflow integrations, including asynchronous execution, event streaming, state handling, retries, timeouts, and error recovery. Preserve correctness and data integrity across failures.
  • Create usable interfaces for configuring agents, managing connections and policies, reviewing runs, and inspecting logs, traces, costs, and audit history. Make failures and recovery actions understandable to users.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access, secrets integration, and audit events across frontend and backend services. Partner with Governance, Risk and Compliance on application security findings and engineering evidence for applicable federal requirements.
  • Adapt application configuration and dependencies for customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Work with DevOps/SRE on packaging, deployment prerequisites, and end-to-end validation.
  • Own quality through code reviews, unit and integration tests, end-to-end tests, representative workflow evaluations, and regression coverage. Verify application behavior in the target environment before partner handoff.
  • Diagnose and resolve partner-reported defects across the UI, APIs, SDK, data stores, and runtime services. Add useful telemetry, support incident investigation, and validate fixes with partners.
  • Support releases, upgrades, and ongoing application maintenance, including federal deployments such as Second Front where applicable. Review and integrate partner contributions, maintain API/SDK compatibility, and coordinate security fixes with platform and DevOps/SRE owners.
  • Document architecture, setup, known limitations, and troubleshooting steps; provide partner walkthroughs and knowledge transfer. Share reusable solutions with the platform team and mentor other engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production applications; scope and technical leadership appropriate to Senior or Staff level.
  • 5+ years of hands-on full-stack development spanning modern web frontends, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Strong frontend skills with TypeScript/JavaScript and React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, including state management, API integration, and clear, accessible user experiences.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java, or a similar language, including API design, service integration, validation, and error handling.
  • Experience designing data models and working with relational databases, migrations, caching, and asynchronous or event-driven processing.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secure API access, secrets handling, and audit logging in production applications.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, code review, Git, containers, CI/CD, and deploying or troubleshooting applications in cloud or Kubernetes environments.
  • Ability to debug across browser, service, API, and data layers using logs, metrics, and traces, and to own issues through validated resolution.
  • Strong technical judgment, clear written and verbal communication, and experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into maintainable solutions and useful documentation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve implementation, testing, troubleshooting, or code review, with careful validation of the resulting changes.

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior full-stack software engineering experience supporting national security, defense, federal agencies, or other government programs.
  • An active U.S. government security clearance.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Foundation Model Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $200,000–$230,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for an Foundation Model Engineer to design, execute, and operationalize fine-tuning workflows for large language models across supervised, preference-based, and reinforcement learning approaches. The role requires deep practical experience with modern training stacks, careful dataset construction, rigorous evaluation methodology, and the engineering discipline to operate complex training pipelines reliably. The ideal candidate combines strong ML intuition with production-grade engineering practices, and is comfortable navigating the trade-offs between data quality, compute budget, evaluation rigor, and shipping velocity. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • 10 or more years of combined ML research and engineering experience, with significant LLM exposure.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks, especially PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience fine-tuning transformer-based language models at non-trivial scale.
  • Familiarity with distributed training strategies including FSDP, ZeRO, and pipeline parallelism.
  • Experience with RLHF, DPO, or other preference optimization techniques.
  • Strong understanding of evaluation methodology, benchmarks, and human evaluation design.
  • Experience operating training jobs on GPU clusters and recovering from failures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Track record of shipping or publishing impactful LLM work.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Publications at top-tier ML venues.
  • Experience with multimodal model fine-tuning.
  • Familiarity with synthetic data generation and dataset distillation.
  • Open-source contributions to LLM training libraries.
  • Exposure to responsible AI evaluation and red-teaming practices.

How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908)676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

jobs.excerpt: DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems.
jobs.description:
DLB Associates is a premier engineering and consulting firm specializing in innovative, mission-critical solutions across hyperscale data centers, advanced infrastructure, and high-performance building systems. With over four decades of expertise, we partner with some of the world’s most influential companies to design and optimize environments that demand precision, scalability, and resilience.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Co-Simulation Engineer III

Position Location: Remote - workvirtually frommost locations in the United States

Job Summary

The Co-Simulation Engineer III will have the opportunity to work with and collaborate with senior design staff to develop multi-domain co-simulation and digital twin capabilities for data center design and construction.The role also includes computational fluid dynamics (CFD) modelingof the data center and its associated internal and external environments. This person will work as part of the Engineering Team and interact closely with the Project Management Team to producehydraulic network models,CFD models,digital twinapplications,and QC design specifications through engineering modeling.

The Co-Simulation Engineer III will receive limiteddirectionon day-to-day work and general instruction on new projects or assignments. Will execute andassistproject leadership on projects of complex scope. Will work independently or under limited supervision.

The Co-Simulation Engineer III will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

Essential Functions

Co-Simulation Planning and Requirements Definition (10%)

  • Coordinate closely with design teams to define co-simulationobjectives, key performance metrics, and acceptance criteria, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of project requirements.
  • Participate in discussions to define modeling prerequisites, collect necessary design and operational data, andestablishappropriate assumptionsand initial conditions for simulations.
  • Identifycoupling strategies and model boundaries (1D network, 3D CFD, controls),anticipatechallenges, and recommend modifications to design parameters or modeling approach to improve efficiency and fidelity.

Develop and Integrate Multi-Domain Co-Simulation Models (60%)

  • Independently develop thermo-hydraulic (flow-network) models for chilled water and liquid cooling systems (pumps, valves, heat exchangers, CDUs, manifolds, cold plates).
  • Build andmaintainsystem-level models for steady-state and transient response, including redundancy/failure-mode scenarios and control logic impacts.
  • Develop co-simulation interfaces between 1D networks and 3D CFD/thermal models and manage data exchange, time steps, and convergence.
  • Perform pressure drop, flow balancing, and heat rejection analyses tovalidatedesign intent and support equipment selection and sizing.
  • Utilize hydraulic modeling tools such asFlownex(highly desired),SiemensFlomaster,AspenHYSYSor equivalent, andmaintainworking knowledge of CFD tools(at least one)such as Cadence Reality DC Design, ANSYS Fluentand STAR-CCM+.
  • Create and curate simulation-ready system schematics,componentlibraries, and metadata to support reusable model assets and digital twin workflows.
  • Develop and/or review model setup including boundary conditions, solver settings, co-simulation time steps, and quality checksappropriate forthe intended use case.
  • Review and/or prepare detailed co-simulationreportsdocumenting assumptions,methodology, results, and actionable design recommendations.
  • Assistin developing proposals including modeling scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Conduct technical discussions with clients and internal stakeholders, presenting modeling findings, interpreting results, and providing engineering recommendations.
  • Timely and effective management of modeling tasks, including resource forecasting, coordination, and version control of model assets and scripts.
  • Perform QAQC peer reviews for co-simulation models where he or she is not the lead analyst.

Guide and Direct Validation, Calibration, and Commissioning Support (20%)

  • Conduct rigorous validation and calibration of system/co-simulation results using analytical techniques and real-world data to ensure models areaccurateand fit for purpose.
  • Collaborate with design, commissioning, and operations teams to collect and reconcile site data (BMS/SCADA, flow/temperature/pressure measurements) for model calibration.
  • Prepare validation and calibration reports comparing model predictions with measured data, documenting uncertainty, limitations, and performance envelopes.
  • Work with the CFD team and interact closely with the project management team to ensure alignment between system models, CFD models, and design intent.
  • Review and respond to technical queries related to modeling assumptions, co-simulation results, and design implications.
  • Review and complete validation checklists and documentation; contribute to modeling standards and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Review and approve model updates based onvalidationfindings and project changes.

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports, issue logs, and model status updates for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Update andmaintainmodel libraries, coupling scripts, and project documentation (assumptionslog, revision history,RFIresponses as applicable).
  • Manage personal hours using company tools.

TECHNOLOGY, DIGITAL TOOLS & AI-ENABLED EFFICIENCY

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identifyopportunities to improve processes anddemonstratea continuous learning mindset, seeking outnew technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt toemergingtechnologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

Position Requirements (Intermediate level for all the following)

  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and hydraulics (pump/valve/pipe networks and control impacts).
  • Strong knowledge of chilled water systems, including flow control, balancing, and operating envelopes.
  • Experience with hydraulic / flow-network tools (Flownex,SiemensFlomaster, AspenHYSYS, or equivalent).
  • Working knowledge of CFD tools for data center and equipment analysis (Cadence Reality DC Design, ANSYS Fluent,Siemens STAR-CCM+or equivalent).
  • Ability to interpretP&IDsand MEP design documents; familiarity with AutoCAD/Revit is a plus.
  • Familiarity with hyperscale data centers and liquid-cooled applications is a plus.
  • Programming skills (Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar) for automation and data analysis are a plus.
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management.
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness, and resourcefulness in a distraction-free workspace.
  • Ability to interpret results and communicate well in writing and verbally to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements.
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports, and correspondence.
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve asprimarypoint of client contact.
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision.
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously across concurrent modeling efforts.

Physical Demands

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonableaccommodationsmay be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving throughoffice,facilityand other environments
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 25 pounds

Travel / Relocation Requirements

  • Approximately 10%,this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetingsfor business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

Education / Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering(or similar relevant engineering field) and five (5) years ofexperiencein a consultancy setting.

OR

  • Master's or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering (or similar relevant engineering field) and two (2)years of experiencein a consultancy setting.

Benefits

DLB Associates offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

DLB Associates is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce.

Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award-winning team!​

​NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

DLB does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to DLB in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where DLB has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of DLB and DLB will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

Role Summary
The Senior WebLogic Middleware Administrator is responsible for the administration, configuration, maintenance, security remediation, compliance management, automation, troubleshooting, and operational support of enterprise Oracle WebLogic platforms and supporting infrastructure. The role focuses on maintaining highly available, secure, and compliant environments while using automation to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and ensure consistency across middleware services.


Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and support Oracle WebLogic Server environments, including domain, Admin Server, Managed Server, cluster, and Node Manager configuration.
  • Support Oracle HTTP Server and Apache, plus Tomcat and IIS as needed.
  • Perform security remediation, vulnerability management, Oracle Critical Patch Update (CPU) patching, upgrades, and compliance validation.
  • Manage SSL/TLS certificates, keystores, truststores, LDAP, Kerberos, Active Directory integration, SSO, and WebLogic security realms and authentication providers.
  • Administer Linux, Solaris, and Windows servers supporting middleware environments.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation for WebLogic administration, patching, compliance validation, and operational support using Shell, Python, and WLST (Jython) scripting.
  • Automate deployments, domain and configuration updates, certificate management, reporting, and system health checks.
  • Support CI/CD deployment processes and enterprise automation tools where applicable.
  • Perform performance monitoring, JVM tuning, data source and connection pool tuning, thread and heap dump analysis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
  • Execute change management, incident management, and service restoration activities.
  • Maintain documentation, procedures, audit evidence, and compliance records.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree and 6-8 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 6+ years of middleware administration experience, with a primary focus on enterprise WebLogic environments.
  • Experience in security remediation, vulnerability management, and audit compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience developing automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • US Citizenship required and ability to obtain a government security clearance.

Required Technical Skills

  • Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle HTTP Server, Apache, Tomcat, IIS
  • WLST (Jython), Shell, Python, XML, HTML, Awk, Sed, Curl
  • Linux (RHEL, SUSE), Solaris, AIX, and Windows Server administration
  • SSL/TLS, LDAP, Active Directory, Kerberos, SSO, security hardening
  • REST API integration (including WebLogic REST management), task scheduling, and operational scripting
  • Oracle database (JDBC, data sources, GridLink/multi data source configuration)
  • JVM tuning, monitoring, and performance analysis

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Fusion Middleware, Coherence, or SOA Suite exposure
  • Kafka, Zookeeper, Artifactory, WordPress, ServiceNow, or Remedy administration
  • Ansible, Jenkins, Git, GitLab CI/CD, or similar tools
  • Experience supporting security audits and compliance frameworks
  • Working exposure to IBM WebSphere (a plus, not required)
